title: CandleX Private Elixir - Atelier Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Initio Parfums Side Effect

Private Elixir is the boldest candle in the line. An airy, jasmine-like opening gives way to cinnamon, saffron and creamy sandalwood, then aged rum and tobacco.

It is warm, boozy and addictive, and one candle is enough for a large room.

Part of the Atelier line, poured in the Grasse region of France in natural wax with a single lead-free cotton wick. Solid black or white jar, 8 oz (227 g), up to 50 hours of burn time.

title: CandleX Midnight Suit - Atelier Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum

Midnight Suit is clean tailoring in scent form. Green cardamom leads, lavender and powdery iris follow, and warm vanilla, woods and amber finish it.

It is smooth and aromatic with a soft sweetness, easy to live with from the first drink of the evening to the last.

Part of the Atelier line, poured in the Grasse region of France in natural wax with a single lead-free cotton wick. Solid black or white jar, 8 oz (227 g), up to 50 hours of burn time.

title: CandleX La Madame - Atelier Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Frederic Malle Portrait of a Lady

La Madame is a dark rose with a spine. Rose, raspberry and blackcurrant open with a pinch of clove, then incense, patchouli and sandalwood take over, and amber, benzoin and musk carry it for hours.

It is elegant and a little dramatic, at home in an entryway, a dressing room or beside a bath.

Part of the Atelier line, poured in the Grasse region of France in natural wax with a single lead-free cotton wick. Solid black or white jar, 8 oz (227 g), up to 50 hours of burn time.

title: CandleX Ember Lounge - Atelier Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille

Ember Lounge smells like a private club after hours. Cinnamon, clove, ginger and a trace of anise come first, followed by pipe tobacco, cocoa and coriander, with vanilla, tonka bean and benzoin underneath.

It is spiced, sweet and a little smoky, made for cold nights, a good chair and a long conversation.

Part of the Atelier line, poured in the Grasse region of France in natural wax with a single lead-free cotton wick. Solid black or white jar, 8 oz (227 g), up to 50 hours of burn time.

title: CandleX Amber Absolute - Atelier Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely

Amber Absolute is the warm end of the evening. It opens on rum and bergamot with a resinous touch of elemi, softens into lavender and davana, and settles into vanilla, roasted hazelnut and dark chocolate over cedarwood and patchouli.

It is a rich, sweet, woody scent that fills a living room without turning heavy. Light it when the house is quiet and let the first burn run until the wax pool reaches the edge of the jar.

Part of the Atelier line, poured in the Grasse region of France in natural wax with a single lead-free cotton wick. Solid black or white jar, 8 oz (227 g), up to 50 hours of burn time.

title: Decantx DIY Box Kit - 3pcs Premium Decant Atomizer Kit
description_html:
The DIY Box Kit-

Do Your Decant with the Decantx DIY Box Kit!

Make your own decant sample fragrances with our DIY kit. We have compiled all the necessary components and options for the various decanting methods together in one easy to use, efficient and cost-effective kit for you to maximize your spray.

Decantx has created the perfect “do it yourself” box with all the tools and supplies needed to create your own sample sized formats wherever you are. Whether you need to travel with your favorite fragrances or want to share your perfumes with friends and family, we got you covered.

This kit includes:

  • Atomizers – 5ml or 10ml Colored Atomizers. (3 Piece)
  • Spray Nozzle – Spray Method. Best for sealed perfume bottles. Remove current spray top from perfume bottle and replace with our Spray Nozzle. Position Spray Nozzle into open Atomizer and spray to fill. (3 Piece)
  • Funnel – Pour Method. Best for opened perfume bottles or other samples. Place Funnel into place on the Atomizer and carefully pour contents into Atomizer. (3 Piece)
  • Pipette Pump – Dispensing Method. Best for dispense transferring from open perfume bottles or to adjust amount of fragrance. Place bottom of Pipette Pump into open bottle and pump until desired fill. Transfer fragrance into Atomizer by pumping. (3 Piece)
  • Velour Travel Case – Travel case for one atomizer. (1 Piece)

description_html:
Jusbox Feel 'N' Chill is a fresh, juicy blend of watermelon, fig leaf and coconut.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2017. Cardamom, watermelon and bergamot open bright, pine needles, fig leaf and coconut nectar form a green, sweet heart, and musk, amber and vetiver give it a soft finish.

Relaxed and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Bvlgari Pour Homme Eau De Parfum for Men
description_html:
Bvlgari pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a refined blend of tea, ginger and musk.

Jacques Cavallier Belletrud created it in 2024. Darjeeling tea and ginger open fresh, black tea and guaiac wood form the heart, and white musk and ambrette give it a clean finish.

A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Glitter Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Glitter is a sweet blend of pear, coffee and marshmallow.

Launched in 2024, it opens with green mandarin, pear and lemon. Orange blossom forms a bright floral heart, and vanilla absolute, coffee, marshmallow, musk and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Playful and seductive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Mizensir Golden Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mizensir Golden Oud is a smooth, ambery blend of incense, rose and oud.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2020. Olibanum and Bulgarian rose open resinous, papyrus and oud form a woody heart, and Cetalox and amyris give it a soft, musky finish.

Refined and warm, it is a great evening scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Muse Inspiring Ink Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Muse Inspiring Ink is an aromatic blend of lavender, incense and orris.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2025. Lavender, incense and clary sage open aromatic, orris, Bourbon vanilla and ambrette form a soft heart, and an ink accord and amberwood give it a woody finish.

Modern and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Yellow Dream Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Valentino Born in Roma Yellow Dream is a light blend of lemon, rose and white musk.

Launched in 2021, it opens with bright lemon. Rose forms a soft floral heart, and white musk gives it a clean, powdery finish.

Fresh and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Absolu Parfum Intense For Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Absolu is a warm, woody blend of black pepper, amber and frankincense.

Anne Flipo and Caroline Dumur created it in 2025. Black pepper opens spicy, amber, ambergris and woods form a warm heart, and sandalwood, frankincense and patchouli give it a smooth, powdery finish.

Powerful and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Montale Arabians Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Arabians Musk is a sweet blend of honey, dates and vanilla.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Honey and bergamot open golden, dates and orange blossom form a sweet heart, and musk, tonka bean, vanilla and sugar give it a soft finish.

Cozy and inviting, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Le Labo Fleur d'Oranger 27 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Fleur d'Oranger 27 is a bright blend of orange blossom, lemon and petitgrain.

Françoise Caron created it in 2006. Lemon, orange blossom, petitgrain and bergamot come together in a fresh, aromatic and luminous white floral scent.

Light and uplifting, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hermes Hermessence Rose Ikebana Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Rose Ikebana is a fresh, fruity rose with tea and rhubarb.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2004. Cassia, tea, fruity notes, rhubarb, rose, lemon, orange, musk and spices come together in a light, crisp and airy floral scent.

Delicate and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hermes Hermessence Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Oud Alezan is a soft, rosy oud with rose water.

Christine Nagel created it in 2024. Rose, rose water and oud come together in a smooth, floral and quietly woody scent.

Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Hermes Myrrhe Eglantine Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Myrrhe Églantine is a soft, balsamic blend of wild rose and myrrh.

Christine Nagel created it in 2018. Wild rose and myrrh come together in a warm, gently spicy and ambery floral scent.

Delicate and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Givenchy L’Interdit Le Parfum for Women
description_html:
Givenchy L'Interdit Le Parfum is a fruity, resinous blend of pear, tuberose and myrrh.

Launched in 2025, it opens with pear, bitter almond and apple. Tuberose, jasmine and mimosa form a floral heart, and benzoin, myrrh, patchouli, opoponax and vetiver give it a warm finish.

Elegant and rich, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Dior Lucky Esprit De Parfum Unisex
description_html: Lucky Esprit De Parfum by Dior is a captivating Floral Green scent designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2024, this fragrance is a fresh addition to the Dior lineup. Renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian crafted this elegant aroma, featuring a top note of Lily of the Valley, a heart of Leather, and rich Woody Notes as its base.

title: Tom Ford Amber Intrigue Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Amber Intrigue is a warm blend of dates, cinnamon and amber.

Julien Rasquinet and Pascal Gaurin created it in 2024. Dates, cinnamon and olibanum open sweet and spicy, sandalwood and vetiver form a woody heart, and amber and labdanum give it a rich finish.

Cozy and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Maison Crivelli Iris Malikhân Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Crivelli Iris Malikhân is a leathery iris with black currant and vanilla.

Marc Zini created it in 2020. Leather, black currant syrup, vanilla, pink pepper, cinnamon, galbanum, mastic, mimosa, coriander, amber, orris and cypress come together in a soft, woody and powdery leather scent.

Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Desert Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Velvet Desert Oud by Dolce&Gabbana is an amber scent suitable for both women and men. This fragrance was introduced in 2013.

title: Roja Elysium Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja Elysium Noir is a fresh, woody blend of citrus, blackberry and frankincense.

Antoine Cotton created it in 2025. Lemon, bergamot, lavender, orange, mandarin and geranium open bright, blackberry and rose form a fruity heart, and juniper, ambroxan, frankincense, patchouli, leather, cypress and sandalwood give it a smoky finish.

Versatile and refined, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Penhaligon's The Cut Eau de Parfun for Men
description_html:
Penhaligon's The Cut is a fresh, green blend of cypress, lavender and mint.

Launched in 2025, it blends cypress, clary sage, lavender, cedarwood, basil, mint and fir into a crisp, aromatic and woody scent.

A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

title: Bond No 9 Oud Supreme Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Oud Supreme by Bond No 9 is a unisex fragrance, suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2025, this scent was created by perfumer Miroslav Petkov. The composition opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Cassis, and Lemon. At its heart, it reveals a beautiful blend of Turkish Rose, Geranium, and Carrot, leading to a deep, rich base of Oud, Patchouli, Benzoin, and Resin.

title: Bond No 9 Good Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Good Oud by Bond No 9 is an Oriental Woody fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2025, this scent features the creative vision of perfumer Miroslav Petkov. The fragrance opens with top notes of Magnolia, Osmanthus, Cinnamon, Sumac, Bark, and Cumin. Its heart reveals a blend of Pomegranate, Peru Balsam, Myrrh, Resin, and Clary Sage, while the base unfolds with Wild Berries, Labdanum, Vanilla Bean, Resin, Oud, and Patchouli.

title: BDK Parfums Rouge Smoking Extrait de Perfum Unisex
description_html:
BDK Rouge Smoking Extrait is a richer, boozier version of Rouge Smoking.

Amélie Bourgeois and Margaux Le Paih Guérin created it in 2024. Cherry, almond, pink pepper, red mandarin and bergamot open sweet, Peru balsam, milk, tonka bean and labdanum form the heart, and oud, rum, vanilla and amber give it depth.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Amouage Overture Women Eau de Parfum
description_html: Overture Women by Amouage is an Amber Woody perfume designed for women, launched in 2020. Created by perfumer Annick Menardo, this contemporary fragrance features an intriguing blend of notes. The top notes include Brandy, Apple, Saffron, and Bergamot, while the heart reveals May Rose, Benzoin, Myrrh, Cinnamon, and Geranium. The scent is anchored with base notes of Leather, Olibanum, and Labdanum.

title: Huda Kayali Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Kayali Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 is a sweet, candy-like blend of vanilla, marshmallow and caramel.

Gabriela Chelariu and Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2024. Vanilla, pear, marshmallow, rum and ylang-ylang open sweet, bubble gum, jellybean, caramel and jasmine form a playful heart, and sugar, patchouli, tonka, cashmere wood and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Fun and indulgent, it works year-round, day or night.

title: DS&Durga Brown Flowers Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Brown Flowers by DS&Durga is a unisex floral fragrance that debuted in 2025. Created by perfumer David Seth Moltz, this fresh scent features top notes of wild carrot and citron, complemented by middle notes of jasmine sambac, coffee blossom, and orchid. Its rich base combines roots, coffee, and musk for a distinctive experience.

title: Hugo Boss The Scent Le Parfum for Women
description_html:
Boss The Scent Le Parfum for Her is a warm, sweet blend of orange blossom and pink pepper.

Launched in 2022, it opens with orange blossom and pink pepper. Vetiver forms a smooth heart, and Akigalawood and patchouli give it a warm, woody finish.

Sensual and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Vanille Couture  Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Vanille Couture is a rich, boozy take on Libre with vanilla.

Launched in 2025, it blends Bourbon vanilla, orange blossom, lavender, vanilla caviar and rum into a warm, sweet and smooth scent.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Prada Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence is a warm, green blend of pistachio, neroli and sandalwood.

Launched in 2025, it blends pistachio, neroli and sandalwood into a creamy, powdery and gently spicy scent.

Smooth and modern, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Mancera Xplicit Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Xplicit Vanilla is a rich blend of Mexican vanilla, dark chocolate and oud.

Pierre Montale created it in 2025. Mexican vanilla and dark chocolate open sweet, Cambodian oud, brown sugar, Australian sandalwood and cedarwood form a warm heart, and tonka bean, amber and benzoin give it a cozy finish.

Indulgent and smooth, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Byredo Rouge Chaotique 2025 Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Rouge Chaotique 2025 by Byredo is an Oriental Woody scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance, which debuted in 2025, features a top note of Cassis, a middle note of Oak, and base notes of Papyrus, Oud, and Patchouli.

title: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Absolu Parfum for Men
description_html:
Armani Code Absolu Parfum is a smooth, sweet and woody take on the classic Code.

Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2019. Green mandarin and apple open bright, nutmeg, orange blossom and carrot seed form a warm heart, and tonka bean, suede, vanilla and woods give it a soft, rich finish.

Made for fall and winter, it works for date nights, evenings out and everyday wear.

title: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Intuition by Aramis is an aromatic fougère scent designed for men. Released in 2025, this fragrance is a fresh addition to their collection.

title: Mes Bisous Passion Island Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mes Bisous Passion Island is a juicy, tropical blend of passionfruit, mango and pineapple.

Launched in 2024, it opens with ginger, lime, pink pepper, lemon and bergamot. Passionfruit, mango, pineapple, nectarine and black currant form a fruity heart, and patchouli, musk, sandalwood, amber and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Fun and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Carolina Herrera La Bomba Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: La Bomba by Carolina Herrera is an Oriental Floral scent designed for women. This fragrance is part of a new collection and was introduced in 2025. Crafted by perfumers Christophe Raynaud, Quentin Bisch, and Louise Turner, La Bomba opens with a top note of Pitahaya, followed by heart notes of Red Peony and Frangipani. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of Vanilla and Patchouli.

title: Frederic Malle Superstitious Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Frédéric Malle Superstitious is a radiant, aldehydic floral with peach, jasmine and rose.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2016. Aldehydes, peach, jasmine and rose meet vetiver, incense, amber and patchouli for a bright yet earthy floral with a warm, woody depth.

Elegant and striking, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Parfums de Marly Valero Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Valero is a fresh, aromatic blend of citron, juniper and lavender.

Launched in 2025, it opens with citron, bergamot and juniper. Lavender, geranium, nutmeg and cypress form an aromatic heart, and ambrox, patchouli and sandalwood give it a clean, woody finish.

Crisp and polished, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Parfums de Marly Eragon Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Eragon is a warm, sweet blend of cardamom, cinnamon and leather.

Launched in 2025, it opens with cardamom, mandarin and bergamot. Cinnamon, cypriol and davana form a spicy heart, and leather, tonka bean, vanilla bean and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Bold and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Parfums de Marly Carios Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Carios is a spicy, woody blend of saffron, black pepper and ambroxan.

Launched in 2025, it opens with saffron, mandarin, pink pepper and bergamot. Black pepper, geranium and red thyme form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, tonka bean, cedarwood and vetiver give it a smooth finish.

Confident and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Byredo Casablanca Lily 2025  Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Byredo introduces Casablanca Lily 2025, a floral fragrance suitable for both women and men. Launched in 2025, this new fragrance features a captivating blend of notes. The top notes include Gardenia and Plum, while the heart of the fragrance reveals Indian Tuberose and Carnation. Finally, it is anchored by base notes of Palisander Rosewood and Honey.

title: Frederic Malle The Moon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Frédéric Malle The Moon is a fruity, leathery blend of raspberry, rose and oud.

Julien Rasquinet created it in 2019. Raspberry, litchi and saffron open juicy, violet, Turkish rose, olibanum and red berries form a rich heart, and oud, sandalwood, leather, patchouli and amber give it a deep finish.

Opulent and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Byredo Vanille Antique 2025 Unisex
description_html:
Byredo Vanille Antique is a deep, resinous vanilla with oud and tuberose.

Launched in 2025, it opens with freesia and plum. Amber, oud, cashmere wood and tuberose form a rich heart, and Madagascar vanilla and labdanum give it a warm, lasting finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Byredo Mister Marvelous Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html: Mister Marvelous Eau de Cologne by Byredo is a captivating Woody Aromatic fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2014. The scent opens with refreshing top notes of Petitgrain and Neroli, complemented by a heart of Bamboo and Lavender. The fragrance concludes with warm base notes of Cedar and Amber, creating a harmonious and charismatic olfactory experience.

title: Afnan 9PM Elixir Parfum Intense Unisex
description_html: 9PM Elixir by Afnan is a captivating Oriental Spicy fragrance designed for both women and men. This fresh addition to the fragrance world was introduced in 2025, crafted by the talented nose of Imran Fazlani. The scent opens with enticing top notes of Cardamom, Nutmeg, and Elemi, leading into a heart that features Pimento, Leather, and Lavender. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of Vanilla, Patchouli, Labdanum, and Rock Rose.

title: Mancera Intense Instant Crush Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Intense Instant Crush is a rich blend of leather, saffron and salted caramel.

Pierre Montale created it in 2025. Black leather, saffron, Sicilian mandarin and bergamot open bold, salted caramel, amberwood, Moroccan rose and patchouli form a sweet heart, and Mysore sandalwood, vanilla, white musk and oakmoss give it a creamy finish.

Seductive and smooth, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: By Kilian Angels' Share On The Rocks Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
By Kilian Angels' Share On the Rocks is a cooler, brighter twist on the famous cognac scent.

Launched in 2025, it blends cognac and tonka bean with fresh grapefruit, bergamot and sparkling aldehydes, grounded by a touch of myrrh. It keeps the warm, boozy soul of Angels' Share but feels lighter and more refreshing.

Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

title: Initio Parfums Can't Get Enough Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Initio Can't Get Enough is a bright, boozy blend of citrus, cognac and cinnamon.

Launched in 2025, it opens with aldehydes, bitter orange, grapefruit, bergamot and lemon. An icy accord and cognac form the heart, and cinnamon, tonka bean, oak and amber give it a warm finish.

Fresh and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Byredo Bois Obscur Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Introducing Bois Obscur by Byredo, a captivating Oriental Woody fragrance designed for both women and men. Launched in 2025, this innovative scent features top notes of Eucalyptus, Saffron, and Papyrus. Its heart reveals a rich blend of Oud, Tuberose, and Jasmine, while the base is anchored by warm notes of Patchouli, Labdanum, Amber, and Sandalwood.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Babycat Raw Bourbon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Babycat Raw Bourbon is a warm, peppery vanilla with suede and resins.

Launched in 2025, it opens with black and pink pepper. Saffron, resins and olibanum form a warm heart, and vanilla, suede and cedarwood give it a smooth, sensual finish.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Penhaligon's The Dandy Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Penhaligon's The Dandy is a boozy, woody blend of raspberry, whiskey and oak.

Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2024. Raspberry, citron and bergamot open juicy, oak, whiskey and cedarwood form a rich heart, and patchouli and Clearwood give it an earthy finish.

Charming and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Mancera Fig Me Up Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Fig Me Up is a fruity blend of rhubarb, fig and toffee.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Rhubarb, fig leaf and French violet open green, fig nectar, plum, oud, geranium and Australian sandalwood form a juicy heart, and tobacco, white musk, toffee and tonka bean give it a sweet finish.

Fresh and playful, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Mancera Cinque Terre Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Cinque Terre is a fresh, Mediterranean blend of lemon, sea salt and fig leaf.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Lemon, cardamom and rosemary open bright, sea salt, fig leaf, cedar, pine and amber form a breezy heart, and oakmoss, sandalwood, tonka bean and labdanum give it a warm finish.

Fresh and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Mancera Cherry Cherry Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Cherry Cherry is a juicy blend of black cherry, heliotrope and vanilla.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Black cherry, bergamot and lemon open bright, patchouli, heliotrope, orris root and jasmine form a powdery heart, and white musk and vanilla pod give it a soft finish.

Playful and warm, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Jo Malone London Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Red Hibiscus is a warm floral with ginger, hibiscus and vanilla.

Launched in 2024, it opens with mandarin, ginger and black cardamom. Hibiscus, black orchid, jasmine, ylang-ylang and water lily form a lush heart, and vanilla, amber and incense give it a warm finish.

Exotic and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Dior Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum Unisex
description_html: Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum by Dior is a captivating Floral Fruity scent designed for both women and men. Released in 2024, this innovative fragrance is crafted by the renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with fresh notes of Cherry and Pink Pepper, leading into a heart of luxurious Bulgarian and Turkish Rose, and is anchored by a base of enticing Red Fruits.

title: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Versace Man Eau Fraîche Extrême is a fresh, aromatic blend of lemon, lavender and cedar.

Olivier Cresp created it in 2025. Orange blossom, lemon and pink pepper open bright, clary sage, lavender and geranium form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, musk and Virginia cedar give it a clean finish.

Crisp and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Dior Rose Star Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Rose Star by Dior is an Oriental Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2025, this new scent was created by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Sichuan Pepper, Pear, and Lemon, followed by a heart of enchanting Rose. It concludes with a warm base of Honey and Musk.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Noir Eau de Parfum Intense For Women
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Noir Intense for Women is a fruity blend of strawberry, orchid and vanilla.

Strawberry, mandarin and lime open juicy, pink orchid, patchouli, sweet pea and jasmine form a floral heart, and vanilla, vetiver, amber and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Sweet and seductive, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club New York Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club New York is a polished blend of citrus, lavender and vanilla.

Launched in 2025, it opens with Italian mandarin, black currant and bergamot. Lavender, geranium and sandalwood form an aromatic heart, and Bourbon vanilla, fir and oakmoss give it a warm finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

title: Prada Amber Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Prada Amber is a warm, classic blend of honey, rose and amber.

Carlos Benaim, Clément Gavarry and Max Gavarry created it in 2004. Fruity notes, green notes, tarragon and bergamot open fresh, ylang-ylang, rose, honey, carnation and jasmine form a rich heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, benzoin, patchouli and amber give it a warm finish.

Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Sugar Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Sugar is a sweet blend of wild berries, orange flower and almond.

Wild berries and sugar open juicy, orange flower and passion flower form a floral heart, and almond and vanilla give it a creamy, sweet finish.

Playful and cozy, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Pour Homme is a warm blend of basil, melon and vanilla.

Launched in 1997, it opens with basil, bergamot, petitgrain, melon and clementine. Gardenia, sage and lavender form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean, patchouli and musk give it a smooth finish.

Smooth and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Paris Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Paris is a fruity blend of clementine, champagne and passion flower.

Launched in 2015, it opens with clementine, galbanum, black currant and champagne. Passion flower, patchouli and jasmine form a floral heart, and amber, sandalwood and vetiver give it a warm finish.

Bright and fun, it works day or night in spring and summer.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Paris Tendre Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Paris Tendre is a fresh, fruity floral with champagne, violet and rose.

Launched in 2016, it opens with mandarin, champagne, ginger and red currant. Violet, French rose, freesia and orris root form a soft heart, and musk, amber and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Light and pretty, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Paris Pour Homme Eau de Toilette
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Paris Pour Homme is a spicy, woody blend of cardamom, star anise and fir.

Launched in 2015, it opens with cardamom, star anise and grapefruit. Mandarin, sage and champagne form a bright heart, and cedar, patchouli and fir resin give it a warm finish.

Smooth and confident, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Noir Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Noir for Men is a sweet, aromatic blend of cardamom, honey and tobacco.

Launched in 2012, it opens with cardamom, bergamot and grapefruit. Lavender, honey, musk, coriander and orange blossom form a warm heart, and tonka bean, tobacco and moss give it a smooth finish.

Seductive and cozy, it is made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Bvlgari Pour Femme Eau de Toilette
description_html: Bvlgari Pour Femme is a classic feminine Floral fragrance created in 1994 by renowned perfumer Sophia Grojsman for the Jewelry and Fragrance house of Bvlgari. It has an aorma profile that is powdery, violet, floral, iris, woody, white floral, rose, vanilla, amber, and fruity. It has been discontinued and is now listed as a vaulted fragrance by Bvlgari.

title: Michel Germain Sexual Femme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Michel Germain Sexual Femme is a sweet blend of chocolate, rose and raspberry.

Mexican chocolate, rose, red berries, raspberry, patchouli and tonka bean come together in a fruity, warm and gently woody gourmand scent.

Playful and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Givenchy Dahlia Noir L’Eau for Eau de Toilette Women
description_html:
Givenchy Dahlia Noir L'Eau is a fresh, airy blend of neroli, peony and musk.

François Demachy created it in 2013. Neroli, green notes, lemon and grapefruit open bright, peony and rose form a soft floral heart, and cedar, amberwood, musk and patchouli give it a clean finish.

Light and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum for Men
description_html: Bvlgari Man In Black Parfum, introduced by Bvlgari in 2024, is a captivating Amber Woody fragrance designed for men. Created by the renowned perfumer Alberto Morillas, this scent features an intriguing blend of top notes that include spices and elemi.
