title: Tom Ford Vert Boheme Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Vert Bohème is a green, fruity floral with honeysuckle, magnolia and galbanum.

Olivier Gillotin created it in 2016. Honeysuckle, woods, magnolia, galbanum, violet leaf and Sicilian mandarin come together in a fresh, juicy and green scent.

Light and natural, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: BDK Parfums Impadia Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BDK Impadia is a fruity, rosy blend of pear and vanilla.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2025. Pear, mandarin and bergamot open bright, Bulgarian and Turkish rose and African orange flower form the heart, and akigalawood, vanilla absolute and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

title: Le Labo Poivre 23 London Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Poivre 23 is a warm, spicy blend of pepper, incense and guaiac wood.

Nathalie Lorson created it in 2008. Guaiac wood, sandalwood, vanilla, labdanum, pepper, incense, patchouli and styrax come together in a smooth, resinous and spicy woody scent.

Refined and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Toilette is a lighter, darkly floral take on Black Orchid.

Launched in 2015, it opens with black currant, truffle, ylang-ylang and bergamot. Tuberose, black orchid and fruity notes form a rich heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, vetiver, patchouli and incense give it an earthy finish.

Seductive and moody, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Laudano Nero Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Laudano Nero is a dark, smoky blend of cognac, tobacco and incense.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2014. Rosemary, myrtle, cognac, tobacco, amber and wormwood open rich, iris, sandalwood, honey, cedar and red rose form the heart, and labdanum, vanilla, oud, vetiver, oak and incense give it a deep finish.

Moody and intense, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Kirke Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Kirke is a juicy, fruity blend of peach, berries and passionfruit.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Peach, pear, cassis, raspberry, passionfruit and a sandy accord open bright and sweet, lily-of-the-valley adds a fresh floral touch, and vanilla, sandalwood, heliotrope, patchouli and musk give it a soft finish.

Cheerful and long-lasting, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Sisley Eau du Soir Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Sisley Eau du Soir is a deep, mossy chypre with florals, spice and woods.

Hubert and Isabelle d'Ornano and Jeannine Mongin created it in 1990. Mandarin and grapefruit open bright, ylang-ylang, patchouli, rose, iris, pepper, labdanum, carnation, jasmine, oakmoss and syringa form a rich heart, and musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Elegant and sophisticated, it is perfect for fall and winter date nights.

title: Rasasi Hawas Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Hawas for Him is a fresh, fruity aquatic with cinnamon and apple.

Launched in 2015, it opens with cinnamon, lemon, bergamot and apple. Orange blossom, cardamom, plum and watery notes form the heart, and ambergris, musk, driftwood and patchouli give it a clean finish.

A popular choice for spring and summer, day or night.

title: Prada L’Homme Water Splash Eau de Toilette
description_html:
Prada L'Homme Water Splash is a fresh, powdery blend of neroli, ginger and iris.

Daniela Andrier created it in 2019. Neroli, cardamom and mandarin leaf open bright, ginger and iris form a soft heart, and cedar, amber and sandalwood give it a clean, woody finish.

Light and refined, it is great for outings and the gym in spring and summer.

title: Prada L'Homme Intense Eau de Parfum
description_html:
Prada L'Homme Intense is a deeper, warmer take on Prada's iris signature.

Daniela Andrier created it in 2017. Iris opens soft and powdery, amber and patchouli warm the heart, and tonka bean, sandalwood and leather give it a smooth, sensual base.

Refined and easy to wear for the office, everyday and evenings, from spring through winter.

title: Prada Les Infusions d'Iris Cedre Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Prada Infusion d'Iris Cèdre is a powdery, woody blend of iris, incense and cedar.

Daniela Andrier created it in 2015. Neroli, iris, incense, benzoin and cedar come together in a soft, ambery and refined woody scent.

Elegant and calm, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Penhaligon's Endymion Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html:
Penhaligon's Endymion is an aromatic blend of lavender, coffee and incense.

Launched in 2003, it opens with mandarin, sage, bergamot and lavender. Coffee and geranium form a warm heart, and olibanum, nutmeg, cardamom, sandalwood, vetiver, myrrh, leather, black pepper and incense give it a spicy finish.

Polished and versatile, it works for the office, date nights and casual days in spring, fall and winter.

title: Amouage Decision Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Decision is a bright, resinous scent of incense, juniper and vanilla.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2025. Bergamot, cardamom and pink pepper open fresh and spicy, frankincense, juniper and myrrh form a cool, resinous heart, and vanilla, cedarwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Modern and versatile, it works in every season, day or night.

title: Amouage Existence Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Existence is a bright, airy blend of lily of the valley, aldehydes and incense.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2025. Lily of the valley, aldehydes and rose open fresh, frankincense, Mystikal and labdanum form a resinous heart, and white musk, benzoin and ambergris give it a clean finish.

A luminous daytime scent for spring and summer.

title: Penhaligon's Castile Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Penhaligon's Castile is a fresh, clean blend of orange blossom, petitgrain and rose.

Launched in 1998, it opens with orange blossom and petitgrain. Bergamot, orange blossom and rose form a soft heart, and musk and woods give it a clean finish.

Light and elegant, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring and summer.

title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Legend Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Legend is a salty, marine take on Invictus with a warm amber base.

Domitille Michalon Bertier and Nicolas Beaulieu created it in 2019. Sea notes, sea salt and grapefruit open fresh, spices, geranium and bay leaf form an aromatic heart, and red amber and guaiac wood give it a warm finish.

Versatile and easy, it is great for everyday wear from spring through fall.

title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Aqua (2018) Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Aqua is a fresh, marine blend of grapefruit, sea notes and ambergris.

Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Nicolas Beaulieu created it in 2018. Grapefruit and violet leaf open crisp, sea notes, rosewood and violet form a cool heart, and amberwood and ambergris give it a warm finish.

Breezy and sporty, it is great for date nights and outings in spring and summer.

title: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Lucky Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Lucky is a sweet, nutty blend of hazelnut, honey and plum.

Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2018. Plum, grapefruit and bergamot open bright, hazelnut, honey, cedar and orange blossom form a sweet heart, and amberwood, patchouli, oakmoss and vetiver give it depth.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, from the office to date night.

title: Narciso Rodriguez for Him Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Narciso Rodriguez for Him Eau de Toilette is a musky blend of patchouli, violet leaf and amber.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2007. Patchouli, violet leaf, amber and musk come together in an airy, powdery and slightly earthy scent.

Clean and refined, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in spring, fall and winter.

title: Thierry Mugler A*Men Pure Malt Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Mugler A*Men Pure Malt is a warm, boozy blend of whiskey, malt and coffee.

Jacques Huclier created it in 2009. Fruity notes, orange and bergamot open bright, patchouli, coffee, whiskey, cedar and malt form a rich heart, and musk, amber, vanilla and peat give it a smoky finish.

Seductive and warm, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in fall and winter.

title: Thierry Mugler Angel Men A*Men Pure Havane Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Mugler A*Men Pure Havane is a warm, sweet blend of tobacco, honey and cacao.

Jacques Huclier created it in 2011. Tobacco and white honey open rich, vanilla, cacao and patchouli form a gourmand heart, and amber, labdanum and styrax give it a warm, resinous finish.

Cozy and seductive, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in fall and winter.

title: Thierry Mugler A*Men Pure Coffee Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Mugler A*Men Pure Coffee is a rich, earthy blend of coffee, patchouli and vetiver.

Jacques Huclier created it in 2008. Vetiver, musk, patchouli, coffee and cedar come together in a dark, roasted and woody scent.

Bold and cozy, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

title: Thierry Mugler A*Men Kryptomint Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Mugler A*Men Kryptomint is a cool, gourmand blend of mint, coffee and chocolate.

Jacques Huclier created it in 2017. Mint and sage open fresh, geranium forms an aromatic heart, and vanilla, chocolate, tonka bean, coffee and patchouli give it a sweet, warm finish.

Fresh and fun, it works for the office, the gym, date nights and casual days from spring through fall.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Colonia Il Profumo by Acqua di Parma is an Aromatic Fruity fragrance designed for both women and men. This fresh scent was introduced in 2025. The top notes feature vibrant Orange, Bergamot, Lemon, Petitgrain, and Pineapple, while the heart of the fragrance blooms with Verbena, Neroli, Lavender, Ylang-Ylang, and Rose. The base notes create a rich foundation with Moss, Vetiver, Cedar, Patchouli, Leather, and Sandalwood.

title: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Acqua di Parma Buongiorno is a fresh, herbal scent made for bright mornings.

Launched in 2025, it opens with basil, spearmint, petitgrain, lemon and rosemary. Mandarin leaf and wild lavender form the heart, and cedarwood, white musk and amber give it a clean finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Valentino Uomo Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Valentino Uomo Eau de Toilette is a smooth, refined blend of iris, vetiver and spice.

Olivier Polge created it in 2021. Lemon and bergamot open bright, iris and vetiver form an elegant heart, and cardamom and black pepper give it a warm, spicy finish.

Sophisticated and smooth, it is perfect for fall and winter date nights.

title: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Armani Code Eau de Toilette is a smooth blend of green mandarin, lavender and tonka bean.

Antoine Lie created this 2023 version. Green mandarin opens fresh, lavender forms an aromatic heart, and cedar and tonka bean give it a warm finish.

Polished and versatile, it suits date nights and everyday wear in fall and winter.

title: Parfums de Marly Percival Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Percival is a bright, clean citrus-aromatic that works almost anywhere.

Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2018. Mandarin, bergamot, lavender and geranium open fresh, violet, jasmine, coriander, cinnamon and hedione add a soft, airy heart, and ambroxan, amberwood, balsam fir and musk leave a clean, modern trail.

Percival is clean, fresh and easy to like, which makes it one of the most versatile scents in the Parfums de Marly line. Wear it from spring through fall, from the office to the gym to date night.

title: Parfums de Marly Pegasus Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Pegasus is a creamy blend of almond, heliotrope and vanilla.

Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2011. Heliotrope, cumin and bergamot open soft, lavender, bitter almond and jasmine form the heart, and amber, vanilla and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

title: Parfums de Marly Kuhuyan Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Kuhuyan is a leathery blend of violet leaf, heliotrope and oud.

Alexandra Kosinski created it in 2013. Violet leaf and jasmine open fresh, heliotrope and leather form a soft heart, and tonka bean, oud and ambergris give it an animalic, sweet finish.

Bold and sensual, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

title: Parfums de Marly Godolphin Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Godolphin is a smooth, leathery blend of saffron, iris and woods.

Michele Saramito created it in 2010. Saffron, fruity notes, maté, thyme, green notes and cypress open aromatic, orris, rose and jasmine form an elegant heart, and vetiver, leather, musk, amber, Virginia cedar and vanilla give it a rich finish.

Refined and versatile, it suits date nights, everyday wear and evenings out in spring, fall and winter.

title: Parfums de Marly Galloway Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Galloway is a fresh, clean blend of citrus, orange blossom and iris.

Launched in 2014, it opens with pepper and citrus. Orange blossom and iris form a soft heart, and musk and amber give it a clean finish.

Easy to wear for spring and summer days, from everyday to date nights.

title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boisé is a fruity, woody fragrance with a fresh citrus burst.

Pierre Montale created it in 2011. Spicy notes, black currant, bergamot and Sicilian lemon open bright, jasmine, patchouli and fruity notes form the heart, and white musk, vanilla, sandalwood, leather, cedar and moss give it a smooth finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, at the office, the gym or on a date.

title: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Lancôme La Vie Est Belle is a sweet, joyful blend of iris, praline and vanilla.

Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Olivier Polge created it in 2012. Pear and black currant open bright, orange blossom, iris and jasmine form the heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, praline and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Versatile in fall and winter, from the office to date night.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Kokorico Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Kokorico is a smooth blend of fig leaf, cacao and cedar.

Olivier Cresp and Annick Menardo created it in 2011. Fig leaf opens green, cacao and patchouli form a dark, sweet heart, and Virginia cedar and vetiver give it a dry, woody finish.

Seductive and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Jo Malone London Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Lime Basil & Mandarin is the house's signature fresh, peppery citrus.

Launched in 1999, it opens with mandarin, lime and bergamot. Thyme, basil, lilac and iris form an aromatic heart, and vetiver and patchouli give it a dry, woody finish.

Crisp and uplifting, it is a great everyday and office scent for spring and summer.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Eau de Toilette
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male is a sweet, intense blend of pear, lavender and vanilla.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2015. Pear, bergamot, mint, lemon and lavender open fresh and fruity, caraway, clary sage and cinnamon form the heart, and cedar, amber, black vanilla and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male In The Navy Eau de Toilette
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male in the Navy is a cool, aquatic blend of mint, sea notes and vanilla.

Nathalie Gracia-Cetto and Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Mint and watery notes open fresh, sea notes form a breezy heart, and vanilla and ambergris give it a soft, salty-sweet finish.

Easygoing and fresh, it is great for casual days and date nights in spring and summer.

title: Thierry Mugler Alien Extraintense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Mugler Alien Extraintense is a rich white floral with jasmine, tuberose and vanilla.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2025. Petitgrain opens green, jasmine and tuberose form a lush heart, and cashmeran, vanilla and amberwood give it a warm, woody finish.

Sensual and bold, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Essence de Parfum Eau de Parfum
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Essence de Parfum is a warm, spicy blend of cardamom, leather and vanilla.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2016. Artemisia, cardamom, pepper and bergamot open bright, leather, sage, lavender and cinnamon form an aromatic heart, and costus, vanilla, amberwood, musk and coumarin give it a rich finish.

Seductive and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum is a sweet, tropical blend of pineapple, coconut and woods.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2022. Pineapple, ginger, iris and cypress open bright, coconut and woods form a creamy heart, and amber, tonka bean, sandalwood and ambergris leave a warm finish.

Fun and inviting, it works in every season, day or night.

title: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau Tres Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Terre d'Hermès Eau Très Fraîche is a lighter, citrusy take on Terre d'Hermès.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2014. Water notes, orange and citrus open bright, geranium forms a fresh heart, and cedar, woods and patchouli give it a clean, earthy finish.

Crisp and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Mon Guerlain is a soft, elegant blend of lavender, jasmine and vanilla.

Delphine Jelk and Thierry Wasser created it in 2017. Bergamot and lavender open fresh, jasmine sambac, iris and rose form the heart, and Australian sandalwood, Tahitian vanilla, benzoin and coumarin give it a warm finish.

Versatile from spring through winter, for the office and everyday wear.

title: Guerlain L’Homme Ideal Sport Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Sport is a fresh, aquatic take on L'Homme Idéal with almond and neroli.

Delphine Jelk and Thierry Wasser created it in 2017. Spices, almond and watery notes open fresh, neroli forms a bright heart, and patchouli, vetiver and coumarin give it a woody finish.

Clean and sporty, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Guerlain L’Homme Ideal Cool Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Cool is a fresh, green take on L'Homme Idéal with mint and almond.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Mint, anise, orange and bergamot open cool, neroli, water notes and almond form a fresh heart, and ambroxan, vetiver and patchouli give it a clean finish.

Light and crisp, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Flora Rosa Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Flora Rosa is a soft, fruity rose with red berries and iris.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2013. Red berries open juicy, iris and rose form a powdery floral heart, and musk gives it a clean finish.

Light and romantic, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Gucci Pour Homme II Gucci for Men
description_html:
Gucci Pour Homme II is a warm, spicy blend of violet leaf, black tea and cinnamon.

Karine Dubreuil created it in 2007. Bergamot and violet leaf open green, pimento, black tea and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and musk, myrrh, olive tree and tobacco leaf give it a smooth finish.

Refined and versatile, it is great for date nights and outings year-round.

title: Gucci Guilty Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Oud is a fruity, dark blend of blackberry, rose and oud.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2018. Blackberry, Bulgarian rose and pink pepper open juicy, cypriol and patchouli form an earthy heart, and amber, oud and leather give it a rich finish.

Bold and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Gucci Guilty Intense Pour Homme Eau de Toilette
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Intense Pour Homme is an aromatic blend of lavender, orange flower and cedar.

Jacques Huclier created it in 2011. Lavender, coriander and Amalfi lemon open fresh, orange flower and neroli form a floral heart, and amber, Virginia cedar and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Smooth and confident, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

title: Gucci Guilty Black Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Black is a green, aromatic lavender with coriander and orange blossom.

Launched in 2013, it opens with green coriander and lavender. Green notes, orange blossom and neroli form a fresh heart, and cedar and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Easy and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Limited Edition 2020 for Women
description_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia 2020 is a sweet, fruity floral with pear, gardenia and brown sugar.

Launched in 2020, it opens with pear and red berries. Gardenia and frangipani form a sunny white floral heart, and brown sugar and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Joyful and pretty, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Tom Ford Jonquille de Nuit Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Jonquille de Nuit is a green, powdery floral with mimosa, narcissus and orris.

Launched in 2012, it opens with mimosa, angelica, violet leaf, cyclamen and bitter orange blossom. Narcissus forms a green floral heart, and orris and amber give it a powdery finish.

Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

title: Goutal Petite Cherie Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Goutal Petite Chérie is a soft, fresh blend of pear, peach and rose.

Annick Goutal created it in 1998. Pear, peach and freshly cut grass open bright, hedione, lilac and rose form a delicate heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a gentle, sweet finish.

Light and tender, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Givenchy Play Intense Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Givenchy Play Intense is a warm, smooth blend of coffee, pink pepper and woods.

Emilie Coppermann and Lucas Sieuzac created it in 2008. Mandarin and bergamot open bright, amyris, coffee and pink pepper form a rich heart, and labdanum, tonka bean, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Smooth and sensual, it is great for date nights and evenings in fall and winter.

title: Givenchy Pi Neo Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Givenchy Pi Neo is a light, fresh citrus with cedar, myrtle and patchouli.

Françoise Donche created it in 2008. Mandarin and bergamot open bright, cedar and myrtle form a clean, aromatic heart, and patchouli gives it a gentle, earthy finish.

Fresh and dependable, it is great for the office, the gym and everyday wear in spring and summer.

title: Givenchy Pi Air Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Givenchy Pi Air is a light, fresh take on Pi with neroli, ginger and lavender.

Launched in 2017, it opens with neroli and ginger. Florals, lavender and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and cedar, musk and benzoin give it a soft, warm finish.

Easy and fresh, it is great for the office, the gym and everyday wear from spring through fall.

title: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Intense Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Givenchy Gentlemen Only Intense is a smoky, leathery blend of pepper, patchouli and incense.

Jean Jacques created it in 2014. Green mandarin, pink pepper, mint, lemon, birch leaf and black pepper open bright, patchouli, leather, violet leaf, coriander and cedar form a dark heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean, amber and incense give it a warm finish.

Bold and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Givenchy Gentleman Cologne for Men
description_html:
Givenchy Gentleman Cologne is a crisp citrus with a soft, powdery iris heart.

Nathalie Lorson and Olivier Cresp created it in 2019. Petitgrain, lemon and bergamot open fresh, iris, vetiver and rosemary form a refined heart, and musk and ambroxan give it a clean finish.

Light and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum 2025 for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum 2025 is a fresh, resinous take on Y.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2025. Ginger and bergamot open bright, pine needles and balsam fir form a resinous heart, and amber and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Versatile in every season, day or night.

title: Paco Rabanne Million Gold Elixir Parfum Intense for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Million Gold Elixir is a sweet blend of yellow mandarin, sandalwood and vanilla.

Launched in 2025, it opens with yellow mandarin. Sandalwood forms a creamy heart, and vanilla gives it a warm, sweet finish.

Smooth and confident, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Huda Kayali Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 31 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Huda Kayali Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 31 is a sweet, fruity rose with peach and praline.

Launched in 2025, it opens with pear, peach, mandarin and orange. Peony, rose, violet and magnolia form a pretty floral heart, and vanilla, praline, musk, ambrox and vetiver give it a creamy finish.

Romantic and bright, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Etat Libre d'Orange Divin'Enfant Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Etat Libre d'Orange Divin'Enfant is a sweet, powdery blend of marshmallow, orange flower and tobacco.

Antoine Lie created it in 2006. Leather, marshmallow, orange flower, tobacco, rose, amber, musk, coffee and tonka bean come together in a soft, sweet and slightly animalic scent.

Cozy and playful, it is a great daytime scent in fall and winter.

title: Escentric Molecules Molecule 04 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Molecule 04 is a soft, creamy sandalwood skin scent.

Geza Schoen created it in 2017. Built around sandalwood, it is smooth, powdery and warm, sitting close to the skin with a quiet glow.

Calm and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym from spring through fall.

title: Escentric Molecules Molecule 02 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Molecule 02 is a minimalist scent built on ambroxan.

Geza Schoen created it in 2008. Ambroxan alone gives it a warm, clean, ambery and slightly salty glow that sits close to the skin.

Subtle and easy to wear every day, at the office or the gym.

title: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 is a minimalist scent built on a single molecule, Iso E Super.

Geza Schoen created it in 2006. The result is a soft, woody, velvety aura that blends with your skin and smells slightly different on everyone.

Subtle and easy to wear every day, in any season, from the office to the gym.

title: Escentric Molecules Escentric 02 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 02 is a soft, ambery skin scent with ambroxan and iris.

Geza Schoen created it in 2008. Iso E Super and ambroxan blend with iris and jasmine for a clean, warm and powdery scent that sits close to the skin.

Easy and versatile, it suits the office, the gym and everyday wear in spring and summer.

title: Dolce&Gabbana The One Royal Night Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: The One Royal Night by Dolce&Gabbana is a captivating Amber Woody fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2015. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of Cardamom and Basil, followed by a rich heart of Nutmeg and Pear Wood. The fragrance culminates in a warm base of Amber, Sandalwood, Cedar, and Labdanum.

title: Dolce&Gabbana The One Mysterious Night Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: The One Mysterious Night, crafted by Dolce&Gabbana, is an Amber Spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2018, this scent features top notes of Saffron and Grapefruit, followed by a heart of Rose, Agarwood (Oud), and Clary Sage. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of Amber, Precious Woods, Labdanum, and Tonka Bean.

title: Dolce&Gabbana The One Gentleman Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: The One Gentleman by Dolce & Gabbana is an amber fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2010. It features a top note of Pepper, complemented by middle notes of Lavender, Cardamom, and Watercress. The base is anchored by warm notes of Vanilla and Patchouli.

title: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Italian Zest Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Light Blue Italian Zest Pour Homme, crafted by Dolce & Gabbana, is a refreshing Citrus Aromatic fragrance designed for men. Launched in 2018, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Grapefruit, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, and Lemon. The heart reveals a spicy blend of Sichuan Pepper, Rosemary, Hedione, Palisander Rosewood, and Freesia, while the base features a warm and earthy combination of Musk, Oakmoss, Incense, and Amberwood.

title: Dolce&Gabbana The One Luminous Night Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: The One Luminous Night by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating Amber Woody fragrance designed for men. This enticing scent made its debut in 2021 and was created by perfumer Jean-Christophe Herault. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Black Pepper, Basil, and Bergamot. Its heart reveals a rich blend of Dates, Sage, and Geranium, while the base features warm notes of Amber, Incense, and Sandalwood.

title: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Swimming in Lipari Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Light Blue Swimming in Lipari by Dolce & Gabbana is an aromatic aquatic fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2015. This scent features refreshing top notes of sea salt and grapefruit, complemented by middle notes of mandarin orange and rosemary. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of ambergris, woody notes, and musk.

title: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Italian Love Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Light Blue pour Homme Italian Love by Dolce & Gabbana is an aromatic green fragrance designed for men. This new scent was introduced in 2022, crafted by perfumer Shyamala Maisondieu. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of grapefruit and Sicilian bergamot, transitioning into a heart of ozonic notes, violet leaf, green notes, and cashmeran. The base features rich notes of vetiver, musk, patchouli, and guaiac wood.

title: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Forever Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Light Blue Forever pour Homme, crafted by Dolce & Gabbana, is a refreshing Woody Aquatic scent designed for men. Introduced in 2021, this fragrance was masterfully created by perfumer Shyamala Maisondieu. The composition opens with vibrant top notes of Grapefruit and Bergamot, leading into a heart of Ozonic notes and Violet Leaf. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of Java vetiver oil, White Musk, and Patchouli.

title: Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Toilette is the original fresh, green fig.

Olivia Giacobetti created it in 1996. Fig, fig leaf and fig tree wood blend into a green, milky and gently woody scent.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Diptyque Oyedo Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Oyedo Eau de Toilette by Diptyque is a captivating Citrus Aromatic fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2000, this scent was crafted by perfumer Akiko Kamei. The fragrance opens with invigorating top notes of Mandarin Orange, Yuzu, Lemon, and Lime, followed by a heart of Thyme. The experience is rounded out with a warm base of woodsy notes.

title: Diptyque Eau des Sens Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Eau des Sens is a bright, bittersweet orange blossom.

Olivier Pescheux created it in 2016. Orange blossom and bitter orange open bright, juniper berries add an aromatic heart, and angelica and patchouli give it a soft, woody finish.

A sunny daytime scent for spring and summer.

title: Dior Pure Poison Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Pure Poison by Dior is a captivating floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2004. This enchanting scent was crafted by the talented noses of Carlos Benaim, Dominique Ropion, and Olivier Polge. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Jasmine, Orange, Bergamot, and Sicilian Mandarin, leading into a heart of Gardenia and Orange Blossom. The composition is anchored by base notes of Sandalwood, White Amber, Cedar, and White Musk, creating a sophisticated and alluring aroma.

title: Dior Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming is a captivating Floral Fruity scent for women, introduced by Dior in 2016. The fragrance was crafted by renowned perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with vibrant top notes of Raspberry, Black Currant, Pomegranate, and Pink Pepper, leading to a heart of elegant May Rose and Peony. The composition is grounded by a base note of soft White Musk.

title: Dior Joy Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Joy by Dior is a captivating Floral Woody Musk fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2018. Created by perfumer Francois Demachy, this scent features bright top notes of Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. The heart unveils a delightful blend of Jasmine, Grasse Rose, Peach, and Cassis, while the base is composed of rich notes of White Musk, Sandalwood, Cedar, Patchouli, and Benzoin.

title: Dior J'adore 2011 Eau de Toilette  for Women
description_html: J'adore Eau de Toilette 2011 by Dior is a captivating floral fragrance designed for women. Launched in 2011, this scent features a refreshing blend of top notes that include citruses, mandarin orange, and neroli. The heart reveals a bouquet of jasmine, African orange blossom, ylang-ylang, tuberose, and rose, followed by a warm and inviting base of woody notes and vanilla.

title: Dior J'adore Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Dior J'adore is a luminous, iconic floral bouquet.

Calice Becker created it in 1999. Peach, magnolia, mandarin, pear, bergamot and melon open bright, rose, violet, freesia, plum, jasmine, orchid and tuberose form a lush heart, and cedar, blackberry, musk and vanilla give it a soft finish.

Elegant for spring and fall, day or night, from the office to everyday wear.

title: Dior Homme Intense 2011 Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Dior Homme Intense is a velvety iris and lavender fragrance with timeless elegance.

François Demachy created it in 2011. Lavender opens soft and aromatic, iris, pear and ambrette form a powdery, almost lipstick-like heart, and Virginia cedar and vetiver give it a refined woody base.

Sophisticated and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

title: Dior Homme Eau Eau de Toilette
description_html: Dior Homme Eau for Men is a Woody Aromatic scent designed for men, introduced by Dior in 2014. The fragrance was crafted by the renowned perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with refreshing top notes of Coriander, Grapefruit, and Calabrian Bergamot, transitions into a refined heart of Tuscan Iris, and concludes with a rich base of Virginian Cedar and Amber.

title: Dior Fahrenheit Cologne for Men
description_html: Dior's Fahrenheit Cologne is a captivating Woody Spicy fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2015. Created by renowned perfumer Francois Demachy, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian mandarin, and lemon. The heart reveals an elegant blend of French violet and patchouli, while the foundation consists of rich base notes including Haitian vetiver, nutmeg, Virginian cedar, and caraway.

title: Dior Aqua Fahrenheit Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Aqua Fahrenheit by Dior is a captivating Woody Floral Musk scent designed for men, introduced in 2011. The fragrance was crafted by renowned perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with invigorating top notes of Grapefruit and Mandarin Orange, transitioning into a heart of Violet, Mint, and Basil, before settling into a rich base of Leather and Vetiver.

title: Dior Eau Sauvage Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Dior Eau Sauvage is an elegant citrus-aromatic classic that still feels modern.

Edmond Roudnitska created it in 1966. Rosemary, basil, bergamot, lemon and caraway open crisp and bright, patchouli, rose, coriander, jasmine and orris form a refined heart, and musk, amber, vetiver and oakmoss give it a timeless finish.

A daytime classic for spring and summer.

title: Dior Dune Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dune by Dior is an enchanting Amber Woody scent designed for women. Introduced in 1991, this fragrance was crafted by the talented trio of Jean-Louis Sieuzac, Nejla Barbir, and Dominique Ropion. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Brazilian Rosewood, Aldehydes, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, and Peony. Its heart reveals a floral blend of Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Wallflower, Jasmine, and Rose, while the base is a warm and inviting combination of Sandalwood, Amber, Benzoin, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Patchouli, and Musk.

title: Dior Dolce Vita Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dolce Vita by Dior is an alluring Amber Woody fragrance designed for women, introduced in 1994. The fragrance was crafted by the talented perfumers Pierre Bourdon and Maurice Roger. It opens with a vibrant blend of Peach, Cardamom, Lily, Grapefruit, Bergamot, and Rose. The heart unfolds with rich notes of Cinnamon, Apricot, Brazilian Rosewood, Lily, Heliotrope, and Magnolia, while the base is warm and comforting, featuring Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cedar, and Coconut.

title: Dior Diorissimo Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Dior Diorissimo is the classic lily of the valley floral.

Edmond Roudnitska created it in 1956. Bergamot and green leaves open fresh, ylang-ylang, lily, lilac, jasmine and lily of the valley form the heart, and civet and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

A timeless daytime scent for spring.

title: Dior Addict Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Dior Addict is a rich, sensual blend of orange blossom and vanilla.

François Demachy created it in 2012. Mandarin, orange blossom and silk tree blossom open bright, night-blooming cereus and Bulgarian rose form the heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Creed Viking Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Viking is a spicy, peppery fragrance with a fresh, minty opening.

Olivier Creed created it in 2017. Absinthe, pink pepper, bergamot, lemon, orange and spicy mint open bright, lavender, clove, allspice, jasmine and rose form the heart, and white musk, cedar, tonka bean and vetiver give it depth.

Versatile and confident, it works in every season, from the office to date night.

title: Creed Royal Water Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Royal Water by Creed is a refreshing Citrus Aromatic fragrance suitable for both men and women. Launched in 1997, this scent was crafted by perfumer Olivier Creed. It opens with vibrant top notes of citrus and mint, transitions into a heart of juniper berries and basil, and settles into a warm base of musk and ambergris.

title: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Royal Oud is a refined, airy oud with bright citrus and spice.

Olivier Creed and Julien Rasquinet created it in 2011. Sicilian bergamot, lemon and pink pepper open fresh, angelica, cedar and galbanum form a green, woody heart, and musk, oud and sandalwood give it a smooth, elegant finish.

A sophisticated oud for spring, fall and winter, and a great choice for date nights.

title: Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Original Santal is a warm, spiced sandalwood with vanilla.

Olivier Creed, Erwin Creed and Pierre Bourdon created it in 2005. Juniper berries, cinnamon, sandalwood and coriander open warm, ginger, lavender, rosemary and petitgrain form an aromatic heart, and vanilla and tonka bean give it a smooth finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, for the office and weekends.

title: Creed Neroli Sauvage Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Neroli Sauvage by Creed is a captivating Citrus Aromatic fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 1994, this scent was crafted by perfumer Olivier Creed. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Bergamot and Grapefruit, leading into a heartfelt blend of Verbena and Neroli at its core, and concludes with a rich base note of Ambergris.

title: Creed Love in White Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Creed Love in White is a soft, powdery white floral with a hint of rice.

Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2005. Orange peel opens bright, rice, iris, narcissus, magnolia, jasmine and rose form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and ambergris give it a soft finish.

Elegant for spring and summer days, the office and everyday wear.

title: Creed Himalaya Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Himalaya is a crisp, clean citrus with soft sandalwood and musk.

Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2002. Calabrian bergamot, grapefruit and Sicilian lemon open fresh, sandalwood forms a smooth heart, and cedar, musk and ambergris give it a clean finish.

Easy to wear from spring through fall, for the office, the gym and everyday.

title: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Green Irish Tweed is a classic of clean, green elegance.

Olivier Creed and Pierre Bourdon created it in 1985. Lemon verbena and iris open crisp and bright, violet leaf gives it a cool green heart, and sandalwood and ambergris settle into a soft, fresh-woody finish.

Green Irish Tweed feels timeless and effortlessly put together. It is an easy daytime scent for the office, weekends and even the gym, from spring through fall, and it never feels overpowering.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Légere Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Good Girl Legere by Carolina Herrera is an enchanting Amber Floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2018. Created by perfumer Louise Turner, this scent features an exquisite blend of top notes including Ylang-Ylang, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, and Lemon. The heart of the fragrance is composed of Tuberose, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, and Bulgarian Rose, while the base offers a rich combination of Dulce de leche, Praline, Tonka Bean, Cinnamon, Sandalwood, Cashmeran, Amber, Musk, Patchouli, and Cedar.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Carolina Herrera Good Girl is a seductive blend of tuberose, coffee and cacao.

Louise Turner created it in 2016. Almond, coffee, lemon and bergamot open warm, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, rose and tuberose form the heart, and cacao, vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood and praline give it a rich finish.

Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Prive Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: CH Men Prive, crafted by Carolina Herrera, is a sophisticated leather fragrance designed for men. Launched in 2015, this scent opens with vibrant notes of Whiskey, Grapefruit, and Pomelo. The heart of the fragrance features an intriguing blend of Cardamom, Lavender, Sage, and Red Thyme, while the base is composed of rich Leather, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, and warm Woody Notes.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Beasts Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: CH Beasts by Carolina Herrera is an Amber Spicy fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2020. The scent opens with top notes of Juniper Berries, Angelica, and Black Pepper, while the heart reveals refreshing Watery Notes, Balsam Fir, and Violet Leaf. The fragrance concludes with a base of Cashmere Wood, Madagascar Vanilla, and Labdanum.

title: Bvlgari Aqva Amara Eau de Toilette  for Men
description_html: Aqva Amara, a fragrance for men by Bvlgari, embodies a Woody Aquatic essence. Introduced in 2014, it was crafted by perfumer Jacques Cavallier. The scent opens with vibrant Sicilian Mandarin, transitions into refreshing middle notes of Watery Notes and Neroli, and concludes with a rich base of Olibanum and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf.

title: Bottega Veneta Pour Homme Extreme Eau de Toilette
description_html: Bottega Veneta Pour Homme Extreme is a sophisticated leather fragrance for men, introduced by Bottega Veneta in 2015. Crafted by perfumers Daniela (Roche) Andrier and Antoine Maisondieu, this scent opens with fresh notes of Pine Tree, Juniper Berries, and Bergamot. The heart features a warm blend of Fir, Nutmeg, and Pimento, while the base is enriched with rich Leather, Patchouli, and Labdanum.

title: Bond No 9 Wall Street Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Wall Street by Bond No. 9 is an Aromatic Aquatic scent designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2004, this fragrance was crafted by perfumer David Apel.

title: Bond No 9 So New York Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: So New York by Bond No 9 is a unisex fragrance that was introduced in 2003.

title: Bond No 9 The Scent Of Peace Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: The Scent of Peace by Bond No. 9 is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2006. Created by perfumer Michel Almairac, this scent features top notes of Black Currant and Grapefruit, a heart of Lily-of-the-Valley, and a base of Musk and Virginia Cedar.

title: Bond No 9 New York Secret Gardens Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: New York Secret Gardens by Bond No 9 is a captivating floral fragrance designed for both women and men. This newly introduced scent was launched in 2025. It opens with vibrant top notes of Kir Royal, Green Anjou Pears, Clementine, and Ivy, followed by a lush heart of Star Jasmine, Tuberose, and Grasse Rose. The fragrance concludes with warm base notes of Musk, Tuscan Iris, and Amber.

title: Bond No 9 Perfumista Avenue Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Perfumista Avenue by Bond No 9 is an alluring Amber Floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2013. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of Saffron, Nutmeg, Plum, and Artemisia. The heart features a rich blend of Rose, Rose Water, Peony, and Jasmine, while the base is a warm and inviting combination of Patchouli, Musk, Amber, and Mate.

title: Bond No 9 Fire Island Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Fire Island, crafted by Bond No 9, is an amber fragrance suitable for both women and men. It was introduced in 2006, with Michel Almairac serving as the perfumer behind this scent.

title: Bond No 9 Bryant Park Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Bryant Park by Bond No 9 is a Chypre Floral perfume designed for women. Introduced in 2007, it was created by perfumer Michel Almairac. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Rhubarb, Pink Pepper, and Lily-of-the-Valley, transitioning into a heart of Rose and Patchouli. The scent concludes with a warm base of Raspberry and Amber.

title: Bond No 9 Brooklyn Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Brooklyn by Bond No 9 is a captivating Amber Spicy fragrance suitable for both men and women. Launched in 2008, this scent was created by the talented perfumer Laurice Rahme. It opens with invigorating top notes of Cardamom and Grapefruit, followed by a complex heart of Cypress, Gin, Juniper, and Geranium. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of Cedar, Guaiac Wood, and Leather.

title: Giorgio Armani Sì Passione Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Sì Passione is a sweet, fruity blend of pear, black currant and rose.

Christine Nagel and Julie Massé created it in 2017. Pear, black currant, grapefruit and pink pepper open juicy, pineapple, heliotrope, rose and jasmine form the heart, and cedar, amberwood, vanilla and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Lively and feminine, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Sì Fiori Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Sì Fiori is a fresh, floral take on Sì with mandarin, cassis and rose.

Julie Massé created it in 2019. Green mandarin and black currant open bright, oakmoss, patchouli, rose and neroli form an elegant heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a soft finish.

Graceful and light, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profumo Parfum for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profumo is a deeper, incense-tinged take on Acqua di Giò.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2015. Sea notes and bergamot open fresh, sage, geranium and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and incense and patchouli give it a smoky, mineral finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, for everyday wear and date nights.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Absolu Instinct Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Absolu Instinct is a marine, woody take on Acqua di Giò.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Sea notes, lemon and bergamot open bright, seaweed and patchouli form an earthy heart, and ebony wood and amberwood give it a warm finish.

Fresh and polished, it is great for everyday wear and the office from spring through fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Absolu Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Armani Acqua di Giò Absolu is a deeper, woodier take on the fresh aquatic classic.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2018. Grapefruit, pear, sea notes, bergamot, lemon and apple open bright, geranium, lavender and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and woods, labdanum, amberwood, tonka bean and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Fresh yet grown-up, it is great for the office and everyday wear from spring through fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Eau Pour Homme Eau de Toilette
description_html:
Armani Eau pour Homme is a classic citrus cologne with herbs, spice and woods.

Roger Pellegrino created it in 1984. Basil, mandarin, bergamot, green orange and lemon open bright, lavender, rose, nutmeg, carnation, jasmine and cinnamon form the heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, cedar, patchouli, musk and oakmoss give it a clean finish.

Timeless and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Profumo Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Armani Code Profumo is a warm, ambery take on Code with a fresh, fruity start.

Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2016. Cardamom, green apple and green mandarin open bright, nutmeg, orange blossom and lavender form an aromatic heart, and amber, tonka bean and leather give it a smooth, sensual finish.

Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

title: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Ice Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Code Ice is a cool, aromatic blend of mint, lemon and ginger.

Launched in 2014, it opens with mint, lemon and ginger. Geranium and lavender form an aromatic heart, and woods give it a clean finish.

Fresh and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym from spring through fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Colonia Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Armani Code Colonia is a fresh, citrusy take on Code with a soft, sweet base.

Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2017. Mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, orange blossom and clary sage form a clean heart, and amberwood, tonka bean and heliotrope give it a warm finish.

Versatile and light, it works for the office, the gym, everyday wear and date nights in spring and summer.

title: Giorgio Armani Code A-List Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Armani Code A-List is a fresh blend of green mandarin, lavender and tonka bean.

Launched in 2018, it opens with green mandarin and bergamot. Lavender forms an aromatic heart, and tonka bean and guaiac wood give it a smooth, woody finish.

Easy and charming, it is great for date nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Armaf Oros Oud Limited Edition Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Oud by Armaf is a Amber Fougere fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Spicy Notes, Caraway, Sage and Bergamot; middle notes are Black Pepper, Cedar and iris; base notes are Amber, Vanilla, Leather and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Vaniglia Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Vaniglia Eau de Parfum, crafted by Acqua di Parma, presents a captivating Amber fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2019, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Heliotrope, Neroli, Calabrian bergamot, and Mandarin Orange. At its heart lie enchanting notes of Vanilla and Jasmine Sambac, while the fragrance concludes with a warm base of Cedar and Musk.

title: Ariana Grande Cloud Pink Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Cloud Pink by Ariana Grande is a warm and inviting Amber Vanilla scent for women. Newly introduced in 2023, this fragrance was crafted by perfumer Clement Gavarry. It opens with refreshing top notes of Pitahaya, Wild Berries, and Pineapple. The heart features a delightful blend of Coconut Water, Vanilla Orchid, and Ambrette, while the base is a rich combination of Praline, Musk, Amberwood, and Moss.

title: Acqua di Parma Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Leather Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a unisex fragrance that embodies the essence of leather. Introduced in 2019, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Raspberry, Brazilian Orange, and Sicilian Lemon. The heart features a floral blend of Rose, Red Thyme, Honeysuckle, and Petitgrain, while the base is enriched with warm notes of Leather, Guaiac Wood, and Cedar.

title: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino Nobile Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino Nobile is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2011. The scent was crafted by renowned perfumers Michel Almairac and Francois Demachy. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Mandarin Orange and Pink Pepper, leading into a heart of exquisite Jasmine, Tuberose, and Orange Blossom. The composition is anchored by a warm base of Musk and Cedar.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Quercia Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html: Colonia Quercia, crafted by Acqua di Parma, is an amber-spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2016, this scent opens with lively top notes of Bergamot, Lemon, Petitgrain, and Pink Pepper. The heart reveals a captivating blend of Geranium, Cedar, and Cardamom, while the base features deep, earthy notes of Oakmoss, Tonka Bean, and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Oud Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html: Colonia Oud, crafted by Acqua di Parma, is an enticing Amber Woody fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2012, this captivating scent was created by perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with fresh top notes of Calabrian bergamot and Italian orange, leading into a heart of agarwood (oud), amyris, and coriander. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of leather, Atlas cedar, sandalwood, musk, and Indonesian patchouli leaf.

title: Le Labo Tabac 28 Miami Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Tabac 28 is a warm, sweet blend of rum, tobacco and cardamom.

Frank Voelkl created it in 2019. Guaiac wood, rum, tobacco leaf, cardamom and cedar come together in a smooth, smoky and gently sweet scent.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Tom Ford Fleur de Chine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Fleur de Chine is a fresh, fruity floral with peach, peony and tea.

Rodrigo Flores-Roux created it in 2013. Hyacinth, clementine, tea, jasmine, magnolia, peony, white peach, bergamot, plum and wisteria meet amber, styrax, benzoin, hinoki and cedar for a light, fruity and woody scent.

Graceful and fresh, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: By Kilian Prelude to Love Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Prelude to Love by By Kilian is a captivating Floral Fruity fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2008, this scent was expertly crafted by perfumer Calice Becker. The fragrance opens with refreshing top notes of Bergamot, Amalfi Lemon, Orange, and Bitter Orange. Its heart reveals a harmonious blend of Neroli, Orange Blossom, Lavender, Freesia, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, and Rose. Finally, the base notes of Iris, Musk, Russian Leather, and Cypriol Oil (Nagarmotha) provide a rich and enduring finish.

title: Hermes Terre d’Hermes Intense Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Hermès Terre d'Hermès Intense is a warmer, darker take on Terre d'Hermès with coffee.

Christine Nagel created it in 2025. Bergamot and black pepper open bright, coffee and licorice form a rich heart, and woods, lava and stone give it a mineral finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Maison Martin Margiela Never Ending Summer Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Maison Margiela Replica Never Ending Summer is a bright, bittersweet blend of Aperol, orange and Earl Grey.

Launched in 2025, it opens with Aperol, bitter orange and pepper. Earl Grey tea, cardamom and nutmeg form an aromatic heart, and vetiver, cedarwood, patchouli, vanilla and cashmeran give it a warm finish.

Sunny and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hermes Eau de Rhubarbe Ecarlate Eau de Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Eau de Rhubarbe Écarlate is a bright, juicy blend of rhubarb and red berries.

Christine Nagel created it in 2016. Tart rhubarb meets sweet red berries for a sparkling, fruity heart, and white musk gives it a soft, clean finish.

Fresh and playful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum Intense for Men
description_html: K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum Intense is a men's fragrance that debuted in 2024. Crafted by perfumer Daphné Bugey, this new scent opens with refreshing top notes of Blood Orange and Sicilian Lemon. The heart features a captivating blend of Fig and Saffron, while the base is anchored by rich Leather and earthy Woody Notes.

title: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Feminine
description_html:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily is a creamy blend of coconut milk, tiger lily and mango.

Launched in 2024, it opens with coconut milk and bergamot. Tiger lily, jasmine and freesia form a floral heart, and mango and benzoin give it a sweet, warm finish.

Sunny and playful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Kajal Lamar Noir Unisex
description_html:
Kajal Lamar Noir is a dark, sweet blend of fruits, caramel and leather.

Patrick Müller created it in 2024. Tropical fruits, green apple, violet and bergamot open juicy, caramel, balsamic notes, vanilla, rose and geranium form a rich heart, and leather, cashmere wood, oud, amber and sandalwood give it a deep finish.

Seductive and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Paco Rabanne Phantom Elixir Men Parfum Intense
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Phantom Elixir is a marine, powdery blend of sea notes, oud and vanilla.

Launched in 2025, it opens with sea notes. Mineral notes and oud form a cool, woody heart, and vanilla bean gives it a soft, powdery finish.

Modern and smooth, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense for Women
description_html:
Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense is a sunny blend of banana flower, jasmine and sandalwood.

Launched in 2025, it opens with banana flower. Jasmine forms a soft floral heart, and amber and sandalwood give it a warm, creamy finish.

Bright and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Capri In Love Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Light Blue Capri In Love Pour Homme Eau de Parfum by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating Woody Aromatic fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2025, this new addition to the Light Blue collection features the creative touch of perfumer Alexandra Carlin. It opens with a vibrant top note of Black Pepper, transitions into a heart note of Fig, and concludes with a rich base note of Patchouli.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Devotion Pour Homme, created by Dolce & Gabbana, is a captivating Woody Spicy scent for men. Introduced in 2025, this fragrance is a fresh addition to their collection. Renowned perfumer Olivier Cresp crafted this alluring scent, featuring a zesty Lemon as the top note, rich Coffee at its heart, and a warm base of Patchouli.

title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky is a playful, candy-sweet blend of raspberry, peach and vanilla.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2025. Raspberry and peach open juicy, fruity notes and a gummy candy accord form a sweet heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a soft, powdery finish.

Fun and cheerful, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Bond No9 Greenpoint Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Greenpoint by Bond No 9 is a unisex fragrance that was introduced in 2025. Crafted by perfumer Claude Dir, this fresh scent presents a vibrant blend of notes. It opens with refreshing top notes of bergamot, pear, pimento leaf, and cardamom. The heart of the fragrance reveals a captivating mix of marine notes, star jasmine, magnolia, and rose. Finally, the scent is anchored by a warm base of cedar, roots, musk, amber, ambrettolide, moss, and vetiver.

title: Initio Parfums Power Self Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Initio Power Self is a soft, musky floral with pink pepper and white flowers.

Launched in 2025, it opens with pink pepper. White flowers form a gentle, powdery heart, and musk gives it a clean, sweet finish.

Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Parfum Unisex
description_html: Club de Nuit Precieux by Armaf is an Amber Woody scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance is a recent addition, having been introduced in 2024. The top notes feature a vibrant blend of Pineapple, Caramel, Pear, Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Lemon, and Black Pepper. The heart of the fragrance includes rich middle notes of oak moss, White Wood, Anise, Jasmine, and Lily of the Valley. Finally, the base notes offer a warm and captivating finish with Ambroxan, Vanilla, Leather, White Musk, Amber, Patchouli, and Cedar.

title: Dior Eau Sauvage Parfum 2017 for Men
description_html:
Dior Eau Sauvage Parfum is a refined blend of citron, lavender and vetiver.

François Demachy created it in 2017. Citron, bergamot and lavender open fresh, Haitian vetiver forms a smooth heart, and elemi gives it a resinous finish.

Elegant and versatile in every season, day or night.

title: Narciso Rodriguez All Of Me Eau de parfum Intense for Women
description_html:
Narciso Rodriguez All of Me Intense is a musky floral with black iris, rose and sandalwood.

Launched in 2024, it opens with black iris and jasmine sambac. Rose, rose geranium and tuberose form a floral heart, and musk, Australian sandalwood and vanilla give it a soft, powdery finish.

Sensual and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Cartier Must de Cartier Parfum for Women
description_html: Must de Cartier Parfum 2015, introduced by Cartier, is an Amber Floral fragrance designed for women. This captivating scent was launched in 2015, featuring top notes of Jasmine, a heart of Galbanum, and a warm base of Vanilla.

title: Cartier Must de Cartier Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Must de Cartier by Cartier is an enchanting amber perfume for women, first introduced in 1981. Created by perfumer Jean-Jacques Diener, this fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of top notes including Galbanum, Brazilian Rosewood, Aldehydes, Bergamot, Lemon, Green Mandarin, Peach, and Pineapple. The heart reveals a rich bouquet of middle notes featuring Leather, Carnation, Vetiver, Orris Root, Ylang-Ylang, Musk, Yellow Narcissus, Neroli, Rose, Jasmine, and Orchid. Finally, the scent settles into a warm and captivating base of Amber, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Civet, and Vetiver.

title: Cartier La Panthere women Elixir
description_html: La Panthere Elixir, a captivating Floral fragrance by Cartier, is crafted exclusively for women. Introduced in 2024, this enchanting scent is the creation of perfumer Mathilde Laurent. It opens with a delicate note of Jasmine, followed by a heart of Gardenia, and is anchored by a base of Musk.

title: Cartier La Panthere Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: La Panthere Eau de Toilette by Cartier is a captivating Chypre Floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2018. Crafted by perfumer Mathilde Laurent, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Grapefruit and Bergamot. The heart reveals a lush medley of Gardenia, Green Notes, Lily-of-the-Valley, Pineapple, Rose, Jasmine, and Pear. As the fragrance settles, it unveils a warm base composed of Musk, Patchouli, Leather, and Sandalwood.

title: Cartier La Panthere 2020 Extrait de Parfum for Women
description_html: La Panthere Parfum by Cartier is a captivating Chypre Floral fragrance designed for women. This scent, launched in 2020, showcases the artistry of perfumer Mathilde Laurent.

title: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Baiser Vole by Cartier is a floral scent designed for women, introduced in 2011. Crafted by perfumer Mathilde Laurent, this captivating fragrance features top notes of lily and citrus, a heart of pure lily, and a base that combines green lily with fresh green notes.

title: Nishane Favonius Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Favonius is a smoky, aromatic blend of incense, clary sage and oud.

Julia Rodriguez created it in 2021. Incense, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, clary sage, rose, cypriol, geranium and artemisia form an herbal heart, and cedar, oud, sandalwood and patchouli give it a deep, woody finish.

Refined and moody, it is made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Nishane Deziro Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Deziro is a fresh, aromatic blend of mandarin, sea notes and mint.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2024. Mandarin, sea notes and ambrox open bright, mint, geranium, cypriol, star anise and carrot seed form an aromatic heart, and sandalwood, Haitian vetiver and ambrettolide give it a woody finish.

Crisp and breezy, it is made for summer days.

title: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Unisex
description_html: Luce di Rosa by Acqua di Parma is a captivating Floral Woody Musk scent suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2024, this new fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Black Pepper, Mandarin, and Cardamom. The heart features a beautiful blend of Bulgarian Rose and Geranium, while the base is a warm and earthy combination of Guaiac Wood, Vetiver, Cedar, and Musk.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Elixir Masculine
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Elixir is a richer, leathery take on Acqua di Giò.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2025. Bergamot, green mandarin and nutmeg open bright, violet leaf and water notes form a fresh heart, and leather, patchouli, vetiver and labdanum give it a warm finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Gucci Guilty Love Pour Homme 2024 Masculine Eau de Parfum
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Love Pour Homme is a fresh, clean blend of juniper, orange blossom and Ambrofix.

Launched in 2024, it opens with crisp juniper. Orange blossom forms a bright, slightly sweet heart, and Ambrofix gives it a clean, woody-amber finish.

Modern and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Bold Citrus Eau de Parfum for Men

Boss Bottled Bold Citrus is a bright, zesty citrus with a clean woody base.

Honorine Blanc and Sophie Labbé created it in 2025. Bergamot and lemon open sparkling, bourbon geranium and elemi resin form an aromatic heart, and vetiver and patchouli give it an earthy finish.

Fresh and energetic, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir Masculine

Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir is a fruity, leathery aromatic.

Launched in 2025, it opens with raspberry, green mandarin and bergamot. Cardamom, lavender and clary sage form the heart, and leather, wolfwood and vetiver give it a smooth finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Tom Ford Vanille Fatale (2024) Eau de Parfum Unisex

Seductive and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Creed Fleur de The Rose Bulgare Eau de Parfum for Women

The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Third Generation. Top notes are Bergamot and Citruses; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose and Green Tea Flower; base note is Ambergris.

title: Byredo Blanche Absolu de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Byredo Blanche Absolu is a richer, creamier version of Blanche.

Launched in 2025, it opens with aldehydes, neroli and black pepper. Jasmine, violet and rose form a soft heart, and musk, ambroxan, cashmeran and cashmere wood give it a warm finish.

Clean and elegant in every season, day or night.

title: Tom Ford Plum Japonais Eau de Parfum for Women

Tom Ford Plum Japonais is a rich blend of plum, immortelle and oud.

Yann Vasnier created it in 2013. Cinnamon and saffron open spicy, Japanese plum, immortelle, plum blossom, liqueur, camellia and cypress form a fruity heart, and fir, vanilla, oud, benzoin and amber give it a warm finish.

Opulent and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Tom Ford Vert de Fleur Eau de Parfum Unisex
