Tom Ford Vert de Fleur is a green, earthy blend of vetiver, florals and galbanum.

Olivier Gillotin created it in 2016. Vetiver, florals and galbanum come together in a crisp, aromatic and earthy green scent.

Fresh and refined, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Tom Ford Shanghai Lily for Eau de Parfum Women
description_html:
Tom Ford Shanghai Lily is a spicy, musky floral with tuberose, incense and vanilla.

Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2013. Jasmine, tuberose and rose meet clove, pink pepper, black pepper and bitter orange, with guaiac wood, vetiver, vanilla, labdanum, olibanum, benzoin and castoreum for a warm, smoky depth.

Exotic and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Tom Ford Patchouli Absolu Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Patchouli Absolu is a rich, leathery patchouli with rosemary and woods.

Launched in 2014, it blends patchouli with leather, guaiac wood, cypriol, rosemary, cashmere wood, bay leaf, moss, amber, musk and tonka bean for a deep, aromatic and warm scent.

Bold and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Together Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: First Instinct Together Eau de Parfum For Her by Abercrombie & Fitch is a delightful Floral Fruity fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2020, this new scent features top notes of Pineapple and Red Currant, followed by a heart of Lily-of-the-Valley and Peony. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of Musk, Amber, and Sandalwood.

title: Creed Eladaria Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Creed Eladaria is a soft, powdery floral with a musky glow.

Launched in 2025, it opens with pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot. Rose, lily of the valley, powdery notes and peony form the heart, and ambroxan, cashmere wood, vanilla and musk give it a clean finish.

Elegant in every season, day or night.

title: Montale Oud Fool Roses Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Oud Fool Roses is a musky blend of tangerine, Taif rose and oud.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Tangerine and rose open bright, Taif rose, oud and cashmere wood form a rich heart, and amber, musk and labdanum give it a warm finish.

Opulent and sensual, it is made for winter nights.

title: Montale Bubble Forever Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Bubble Forever is a sweet, bright blend of citrus, pear and toffee.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Grapefruit, lemon, pear and neroli open sparkling, orange blossom, Bulgarian rose, jasmine and cinnamon form a floral heart, and toffee, vanilla, musk and amber give it a warm, sweet finish.

Fun and cheerful, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Montale Beast Love Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Beast Love is a fruity, leathery blend of pear, plum and rose.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Sicilian bergamot, pear and plum open juicy, cedar, leather, Turkish rose and vetiver form a rich heart, and amber, musk, vanilla and tonka bean give it a warm finish.

Seductive and bold, it is a great night scent.

title: Hugo Boss Boss The Scent Le Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss The Scent Le Parfum is a warm, leathery blend of maninka, ginger and iris.

Launched in 2022, it opens with maninka and ginger. Iris forms a smooth, powdery heart, and woods and leather give it a rich finish.

Seductive and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Night Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Authentic Night Femme by Abercrombie & Fitch is a captivating Chypre Floral fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2020, this new scent features an alluring blend of top notes including Black Currant, Apple, and Pink Pepper. The heart of the fragrance reveals floral notes of Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, and Magnolia, while the base is crafted from rich Patchouli, Sandalwood, and Cedar.

title: Jo Malone London Silk Blossom Cologne (2019)
description_html:
Jo Malone Silk Blossom is a soft, fruity floral with apricot, silk tree blossom and heliotrope.

Launched in 2019, it opens with white pepper, bergamot and apricot. Silk tree blossom, rose and jasmine form a delicate heart, and moss and heliotrope give it a soft finish.

Light and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Jo Malone London Orange Blossom (2019) Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Orange Blossom is a fresh, sweet blend of clementine, orange blossom and lotus.

Jean-Claude Delville created it in 2019. Green notes, clementine and citron open bright, lotus and orange blossom form a white floral heart, and orris, lilac and vetiver give it a soft finish.

Light and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Jo Malone London Amber & Patchouli for Men
description_html:
Jo Malone Amber & Patchouli is a warm, woody blend of patchouli, guaiac wood and amber.

Christine Nagel created it in 2010. Patchouli, guaiac wood and amber come together in an earthy, ambery and gently smoky scent.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Jo Malone London Whisky & Cedarwood for Men
description_html:
Jo Malone Whisky & Cedarwood is a warm, woody blend of pimento, whiskey and cedar.

Launched in 2018, it pairs spicy pimento with a smooth whiskey accord and dry cedarwood for a warm, polished and slightly smoky scent.

Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Hermes Concentré de Pamplemousse Rose Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Concentré de Pamplemousse Rose is a crisp blend of grapefruit, rose and vetiver.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2011. Grapefruit opens zesty, rose forms a soft heart, and vetiver gives it an earthy, aromatic finish.

Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hermes Hermessence Agar Ebene Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Agar Ébène is a fresh, woody blend of balsam fir and oud.

Christine Nagel created it in 2018. Balsam fir and oud come together in a sweet, aromatic and smooth woody scent with a cool, resinous feel.

Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Guerlain Oud Nude Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Oud Nude is a soft, sweet blend of oud, almond and raspberry.

Delphine Jelk created it in 2022. Sandalwood, oud, almond, Bourbon vanilla, rose, Atlas cedar and raspberry come together in a creamy, fruity and powdery woody scent.

Smooth and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Givenchy Irrésistible Eau de Toilette Fraiche for Women
description_html:
Givenchy Irrésistible Fraîche is a light, sweet blend of orange, iris and rose.

Launched in 2021, it opens with orange and pink pepper. Iris and rose form a soft floral heart, and cedar and musk give it a clean finish.

Fresh and pretty, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: By Kilian Sweet Redemption Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Sweet Redemption, created by By Kilian, is an Amber Floral scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance was introduced in 2011 and was crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.

title: By Kilian Love and Tears Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Love and Tears, crafted by By Kilian, is a captivating Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2010, this scent was created by perfumer Calice Becker. Its top notes feature Petitgrain, Bergamot, Galbanum, and Lavender, while the heart reveals a bouquet of Jasmine, Water Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley, Narcissus, Orange Blossom, and Ylang-Ylang. The fragrance concludes with earthy base notes of Oakmoss, Cedar, and Styrax.

title: By Kilian Imperial Tea Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Imperial Tea by By Kilian is an aromatic green fragrance designed for both women and men. Launched in 2014, this scent was crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.

title: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Splash of Neroli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Good Girl Gone Bad, crafted by By Kilian, is a Floral Fruity perfume designed for women. Introduced in 2012, this fragrance features top notes of Osmanthus, Jasmine, and May Rose, complemented by middle notes of Indian Tuberose and Narcissus, while the base settles into warm Amber and Cedar.

title: By Kilian Gold Oud Unisex
description_html: Gold Oud by By Kilian is an Amber Floral scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance was introduced in 2014.

title: By Kilian Cruel Intentions Unisex
description_html: Cruel Intentions by By Kilian is an Amber Woody fragrance designed for both women and men, launched in 2007. The scent is crafted by perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur. It opens with captivating top notes of Rose, Violet, Bergamot, and African Orange flower. The heart features rich middle notes of Agarwood (Oud), Guaiac Wood, and Papyrus. Finally, the fragrance is anchored by a deep base of Vetiver, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Castoreum, Styrax, and Musk.

title: By Kilian Black Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Black Oud by By Kilian is an enchanting Amber fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2014, this scent features top notes of Rose, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, and Geranium. The heart is composed of Papyrus, Patchouli, Cedar, and Methyl Pamplemousse, while the base notes include Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Moss, Sandalwood, Musk, and Labdanum.

title: By Kilian Beyond Love Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Beyond Love by By Kilian is a captivating floral scent designed for women. Introduced in 2007, this fragrance was expertly crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.

title: By Kilian A Taste of Heaven for Men
description_html: A Taste of Heaven, created by By Kilian, is an Amber Fougere scent designed for men. Introduced in 2007, this fragrance was crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.

title: M. Micallef Hypnotic Musk Eau de Parfum for Women

M. Micallef Hypnotic Musk is a fruity, musky blend of raspberry, lychee and vanilla.

Thierry Romeo created it in 2025. Iris, raspberry and bergamot open bright, lychee, violet, caramel and ginger form a sweet heart, and musk, vanilla, ambergris and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Playful and sensual, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Electimuss Caspian Cherry Parfum Unisex
description_html: Caspian Cherry by Electimuss is an Oriental Vanilla scent designed for both women and men. This new fragrance debuted in 2024, crafted by perfumer Kevin Mathys. Its top notes include Black Cherry, Amaretto, and Dark Chocolate, while the heart features Cinnamon, Coffee, Coconut, Honey, and Vetiver. The base is composed of White Chocolate, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, and Patchouli.

title: Jo Malone London Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense Unisex

Jo Malone Scarlet Poppy Intense is a soft blend of fig, poppy and barley.

Mathilde Bijaoui created it in 2020. Ambrette opens musky, fig, poppy and orris form a velvety heart, and barley, tonka bean and heliotrope give it a warm, sweet finish.

Cozy and gentle, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu Masculine
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu is a rich blend of lavender, plum and tonka.

Launched in 2025, it opens with lavender, moves into a juicy plum heart and settles into warm tonka bean.

Made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Xerjoff Alexandria II Anniversary Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Alexandria II Anniversary is an aromatic blend of lavender, oud and vanilla.

Opulent and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L’Eau Nue Parfum de Peau for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Eau Nue is a soft skin scent of citrus, orange blossom and lavender.

Launched in 2025, it opens with mandarin and lemon. Orange blossom forms a gentle floral heart, and lavender gives it a clean, aromatic finish.

Light and intimate, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Extradose Parfum for Men
description_html:
Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Extradose is a spicy, aromatic lavender with warm woods.

Launched in 2025, it opens with spicy notes, moves into a heart of wild lavender and settles into a warm, woody base.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Valentino Born in Roma Extradose Donna Parfum for Women
description_html:
Valentino Donna Born in Roma Extradose is a sweet blend of black currant, rum and vanilla.

Launched in 2025, it opens with black currant, moves into a warm rum heart and settles into a smooth vanilla.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Givenchy Gentleman Society Ambree Eau de Parfum for Men

Givenchy Gentleman Society Ambrée is a warm, ambery take on Gentleman Society.

Launched in 2025, it blends Madagascar vanilla, vetiver and French narcissus with Peru balsam, leather, tobacco and amber for a rich, smooth and slightly smoky scent.

A refined choice for evenings.

title: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Elixir Eau de Parfum for Women

It opens with top notes of Black Cherry and Bitter Almond, transitions to a heart of Rose and Tuberose, and settles into base notes of Vanilla and Cocoa.

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Elixir Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Bad Boy Elixir by Carolina Herrera is an Oriental Woody scent crafted for men. This is a recent addition to their fragrance line, having been introduced in 2025. The fragrance opens with a top note of sage, transitions to a heart of leather, and is grounded by a base note of cedarwood.

title: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Ultime Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Ultime is a bold blend of tuberose, cacao and tobacco.

Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Fanny Bal created it in 2023. Jasmine sambac, orange blossom and neroli open bright, tuberose and cacao pod form the heart, and vetiver, patchouli, ambroxan and tobacco give it a dark finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioia Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Armani Acqua di Gioia Intense is a fruity floral with red fruits, jasmine and rose.

Launched in 2024, it opens with red fruits and citrus. Jasmine and Damask rose form a soft floral heart, and musk and woods give it a smooth finish.

Fresh yet warm, it is a lovely evening scent from spring through fall.

title: By Kilian Angels' Share Paradis Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Angels' Share Paradis by By Kilian is a unisex Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance. Recently introduced in 2025, this new scent is crafted by perfumer Benoist Lapouza. It opens with top notes of Cognac, Liquor, and Raspberry, transitions into heart notes of Tonka Bean, Bulgarian Rose, and Oakmoss, and concludes with base notes of Praline, Oak, and Sandalwood.

title: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford F*cking Fabulous is a sweet, leathery blend of lavender, almond and vanilla.

Launched in 2017, it opens with clary sage and lavender. Orris, leather, vanilla and bitter almond form a creamy heart, and white woods, leather, tonka bean, cashmeran and amber give it a smooth finish.

Bold and polished, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Parfums de Marly Valaya Exclusif Parfum for Women
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Valaya Exclusif is a soft, creamy floral with almond and vanilla.

Launched in 2025, it opens with mandarin, almond and bergamot. Orange blossom, white flowers and powdery notes form the heart, and vanilla, akigalawood, ambroxan and sandalwood leave a smooth, warm finish.

Elegant and easy to wear in every season.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Wild Orange Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance Du Bois Wild Orange is a bright, juicy citrus with orange blossom and woods.

Shadi Samra created it in 2023. Orange, mandarin, lemon and bergamot open sparkling, orange blossom, lily-of-the-valley and cypress form a fresh heart, and sandalwood, cedar, patchouli and vetiver give it a smooth finish.

Uplifting and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Amouage Purpose 50 Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Purpose 50 is a refined extrait of incense, suede and warm woods.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2025. Frankincense, pimento, pink pepper and bergamot open bright and spicy, papyrus, sandalwood, vetiver and rose form a dry heart, and akigalawood, suede, vanilla and saffron give it a soft, luxurious base.

Sophisticated and calm, it suits special occasions and everyday luxury alike.

title: Tom Ford Velvet Gardenia Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Velvet Gardenia is a lush, honeyed gardenia with plum and incense.

Launched in 2007, it opens with gardenia and orange. Rose, honey, plum, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, tuberose and beeswax form a creamy heart, and labdanum and incense give it a warm, resinous finish.

Opulent and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum is a warm, salty and floral take on the 1 Million line.

Christophe Raynaud and Quentin Bisch created it in 2020. Tuberose, monoi oil, salt and solar notes meet ambergris, leather, cashmeran, pine and labdanum for a sunny, sensual and slightly animalic scent.

Bold and modern, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Paco Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Fame is a fruity, sweet blend of mango, jasmine and olibanum.

Alberto Morillas, Fabrice Pellegrin, Marie Salamagne and Dora Baghriche created it in 2022. Bergamot and mango open juicy, olibanum and jasmine form a creamy, smoky heart, and vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Modern and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Guerlain Samsara Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Samsara Eau de Toilette is a warm blend of ylang-ylang, jasmine and sandalwood.

Launched in 2021, it opens with citrus. Ylang-ylang and jasmine form a rich floral heart, and iris, vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a creamy, powdery finish.

Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Mancera French Riviera Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera French Riviera is a sunny, salty citrus with sea notes.

Pierre Montale created it in 2022. Tangerine, pepper, ginger, lemon and orange open bright, mimosa, vetiver, sea notes, pine and tiare form the heart, and white musk, amber and sea salt give it a fresh finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Mancera Eternal Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Eternal Wood is a sweet, woody blend of saffron, palo santo and toffee.

Pierre Montale created it in 2024. Saffron, Laotian oud and davana open warm, guaiac wood, copal, palo santo and cashmere wood form a resinous heart, and toffee, tonka bean, amber and oakmoss give it a sweet finish.

Cozy and rich, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Mancera Amberful Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Amberful is a fresh, mossy blend of bergamot, yuzu and amberwood.

Launched in 2024, it opens with Calabrian bergamot, yuzu, pink pepper and nutmeg. Amberwood, violet and patchouli form a woody heart, and cedar, amber and moss give it a dry finish.

Clean and versatile, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Clive Christian Private Collection L Red Tea Vetiver Parfum Unisex
description_html: L Red Tea Vetiver by Clive Christian is a unisex Woody Aromatic scent. This fresh addition to their lineup is set to debut in 2025. The fragrance opens with vibrant notes of Bergamot and Lemon, transitions to a heart of Rooibos Tea and Vetiver, and settles into a base of Musk and Sandalwood.

title: Bond No 9 Riverside Drive Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Riverside Drive by Bond No 9 is a men's fragrance with woody notes. Introduced in 2003, this scent was crafted by perfumer Maurice Roucel.

title: Bond No 9 Park Avenue South Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Park Avenue South from Bond No. 9 is a floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2015. It opens with the crisp scent of green apple, followed by the captivating blend of peach and jasmine at its heart. The fragrance is rounded off with a base of musk and amber.

title: Bond No 9 Chelsea Flowers Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Chelsea Flowers by Bond No 9 is a women's floral fragrance introduced in 2003. Crafted by perfumer Laurent Le Guernec, this scent captures the essence of blossoming elegance.

title: Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Guidance 46 is a rich, glowing extrait of pear, rose and creamy woods.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Pear, rose water, bitter almond, hazelnut, frankincense and pink pepper open warm and luminous, rose, osmanthus, saffron and jasmine sambac form a lush heart, and sandalwood, vanilla, labdanum and ambergris give it a deep, lasting base.

Opulent but wearable, it works day or night in any season.

title: Le Labo Eucalyptus 20 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Eucalyptus 20 is a fresh, resinous blend of eucalyptus, olibanum and thyme.

Launched in 2025, it blends eucalyptus, red thyme and hyssop with olibanum, gurjan balsam, cedarwood, labdanum and musk for an aromatic, woody and gently ambery scent.

Clean and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Rosé Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: 212 VIP Rose by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Fruity fragrance crafted for women, introduced in 2014. Created by perfumer Lucas Sieuzac, this scent opens with notes of Champagne Rose and Pink Pepper, unfolds with heart notes of Peach Blossom and Rose, and finishes with a base of White Musk and Woody Notes.

title: Dior Homme 2025 Parfum for Men

Made for fall and winter nights.

Made for fall and winter nights.

Vibrant and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Xerjoff Louis XV 1722 Parfum Unisex

Luxurious and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

Easy to wear day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Le Labo Lavande 31 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Lavande 31 is a soft, musky lavender with neroli and tonka.

Launched in 2023, it opens with neroli and bergamot. Lavender forms a clean, aromatic heart, and musk, amber and tonka give it a sweet finish.

Calm and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Le Labo Labdanum 18 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Labdanum 18 is a warm, animalic blend of labdanum, vanilla and musk.

Intimate and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Bond No 9 Madison Square Park Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Madison Square Park by Bond No 9 is a floral perfume designed for women, introduced in 2011. Crafted by perfumer Laurent le Guernec, this fragrance opens with top notes of Grass, Blueberry, and Hyacinth. The heart of the scent features notes of Rose and Pink Tulip, while the base is composed of Teak Wood and Vetiver.

title: Amouage Love Delight Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Love Delight by Amouage is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2024, this is a fresh addition to the fragrance scene. Created by perfumer Pascal Gaurin, the scent opens with top notes of ginger, mandarin orange, cinnamon, and rose water. The heart of the fragrance reveals heliotrope, jasmine, and rose, while the base is composed of vanilla, cacao, rum, and cypriol oil (also known as nagarmotha).

title: Dior Oud Ispahan Esprit De Parfum Unisex
description_html: Oud Ispahan Esprit De Parfum by Dior is an Oriental Floral fragrance suitable for both women and men. Released in 2024, this fragrance is a recent addition to the Dior collection. Crafted by the renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, it features top notes of cumin and clove, a heart of rose, and a base composed of oud intertwined with spicy notes.

title: Dior Gris Dior Esprit De Parfum Unisex
description_html: Gris Dior Esprit De Parfum by Dior is a Chypre Floral scent designed for both women and men. As a recent addition to Dior's fragrance collection, it debuted in 2024. The mastermind behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with a top note of Bulgarian Rose, followed by a heart note of Atlas Cedar, and concludes with base notes of Patchouli and Amber.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense for Women
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Le Parfum is a sunny floral with lily, frangipani and sea salt.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Solar notes and lily open bright, frangipani and sea salt form a tropical heart, and amber and benzoin give it a warm finish.

Radiant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Tom Ford Cafe Rose (2023) Eau de Parfum for Women

Elegant and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Made for spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Maison Crivelli Santal Volcanique Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:

Richard Ibanez created it in 2018. Sandalwood, ginger, ylang-ylang, cardamom, coffee, lime, cedar and musk come together in a warm, aromatic and slightly powdery woody scent.

Versatile and distinctive, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Maison Crivelli Patchouli Magnetik Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Crivelli Patchouli Magnetik is a rich blend of patchouli, white peach and leather.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2022. Leather, sandalwood, vanilla, white peach, gardenia, patchouli and benzoin come together in a warm, fruity and seductive woody scent.

Bold and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Maison Crivelli Osmanthe Kodoshan Eau de Parfum Unisex

Maison Crivelli Osmanthe Kodoshan is a fruity, woody blend of osmanthus, black tea and tobacco.

Distinctive and calm, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Maison Crivelli Fleur Diamantine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Crivelli Fleur Diamantine is a fresh, mossy blend of saffron, jasmine and mint.

Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2018. Saffron, jasmine, neroli, oakmoss, coumarin and mint come together in a crisp, aromatic and gently floral scent.

Fresh and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Maison Crivelli Citrus Batikanga Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Crivelli Citrus Batikanga is a bright blend of pomelo, rhubarb and chili pepper.

Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2019. Cardamom and bergamot open fresh, pomelo, rhubarb and chili pepper form a juicy, spicy heart, and myrrh, vetiver and fenugreek give it a warm finish.

Lively and distinctive, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Maison Crivelli Bois Datchaï Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Crivelli Bois Datchaï is a smoky, woody blend of black tea, incense and black currant.

Refined and calm, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

title: Maison Crivelli Absinthe Boreale Eau de Parfum Unisex

Crisp and invigorating, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum for Women

The heart unfolds with Ylang-Ylang, Rose, Carnation, Cistus Incanus, Orange Blossom, Tarragon, and Bay Leaf. The fragrance settles with base notes of Orris Root, Sandalwood, Amyris, and Guaiac Wood.

title: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Valentino Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Valentino Born in Roma Coral Fantasy is a fruity blend of orange, kiwi and jasmine.

Jacques Huclier and Nadège Le Garlantezec created it in 2022. Brazilian orange and kiwi open juicy, Indian jasmine, ambrette and rose form a soft heart, and white musk and Texas cedar give it a clean finish.

Fresh and playful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Clive Christian Jump Up And Kiss Me Hedonistic 2021 Parfum Unisex

Made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

A calm daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html: Colonia C.L.U.B. by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced as a fresh addition to the lineup in 2022, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Lemon, Bergamot, and Black Pepper. Its heart is enriched with Shiso and Rosemary, while the base features the grounding notes of Cedar and Musk.

title: Versace Woman Eau de Parfum
description_html:
Versace Woman is a fruity, musky blend of raspberry, plum and lotus.

Christine Nagel created it in 2000. Jasmine leaf, bergamot and rose open bright, lotus, cedar, raspberry and plum form a juicy heart, and musk and amber give it a soft finish.

Elegant and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Thierry Mugler Alien Édition Talisman Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Mugler Alien Édition Talisman is a soft, ambery blend of jasmine and cashmeran.

Launched in 2015, it opens with jasmine. Cashmeran and solar notes form a warm, woody heart, and white amber gives it a powdery, radiant finish.

Mysterious and warm, it is made for winter nights.

title: Mind Games Sans Voir Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Sans Voir is a salty, woody blend of grapefruit, incense and palo santo.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2023. Salt, grapefruit and cypress open fresh, rose, freesia and incense form an airy heart, and palo santo, musk and guaiac wood give it a dry, woody finish.

Calm and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Mind Games Gambit Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Gambit is a warm, aromatic blend of lavender, clove and patchouli.

Carlos Viñals created it in 2023. Lavender, clove and petitgrain open aromatic, cardamom, geranium and mimosa form the heart, and patchouli, Ambrostar and sandalwood give it a woody finish.

A confident choice for cooler days.

title: Bond No 9 New York Gardenia Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: New York Gardenia by Bond No 9 is a floral scent crafted for both women and men. Recently introduced in 2024, this fragrance opens with captivating top notes of tuberose, jasmine, and peony. At its heart, gardenia and rose offer a rich floral bouquet, while the base notes of vanilla and vetiver provide a warm and grounding finish.

title: Bond No 9 Beekman Place Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Beekman Place by Bond No. 9 is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2024. The scent features top notes of pear, pineapple, bergamot, and black currant, followed by a heart of watery notes, driftwood, lemon, basil, pepper, and geranium. Its base notes include sandalwood, musk, tonka bean, leather, patchouli, amber, and oakmoss.

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Sparkling Ice Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Bad Boy Sparkling Ice by Carolina Herrera is a fresh addition to the world of men's fragrances, characterized by its Woody Aromatic scent profile. Released in 2024, this innovative fragrance opens with the invigorating top notes of Grapefruit and White Pepper. At its heart, you'll find the earthy and sophisticated blend of Clary Sage and Vetiver. The scent concludes with rich base notes of Cocoa and Tonka Bean.

title: Baxter of California Pacific Cannabis Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Pacific Cannabis by Baxter of California is an Aromatic Aquatic fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2019, this scent opens with top notes of Pink Pepper, Rosemary, and Bergamot. The heart of the fragrance features Sage, Cannabis, and Lavender, while the base is composed of Driftwood, Patchouli, and Tonka Bean.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Absolu Parfum Intense for Men
description_html:
Hugo Boss Bottled Absolu is a dark, smoky leather built for evenings.

Annick Menardo and Suzy Le Helley created it in 2024. Leather and incense open bold and smoky, patchouli and myrrh deepen the heart, and davana and cedarwood leave a resinous, woody trail.

Bottled Absolu is moody and intense, a clear step away from the fresher Boss Bottled styles. It is made for fall and winter nights, when you want something dark and memorable.

title: Byredo Mojave Ghost Absolu Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Byredo Mojave Ghost Absolu is a deeper, creamier version of Byredo's soft desert floral.

Launched in 2024, it opens with ambrette and juicy sapodilla. Magnolia, sandalwood and violet form a soft, powdery heart, and musk, amber and cedarwood give it a warmer, fuller finish.

Gentle yet long-lasting, it is easy to wear in every season, day or night.

title: Mancera Amore Caffè Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Amore Caffè is a sweet, creamy coffee with amaretto and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with coffee and amaretto. Ice cream and vanilla form a creamy heart, and brown sugar, vanilla and ambergris give it a warm finish.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Parfums de Marly Palatine Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Palatine is a fresh, fruity blend of pear, mandarin and violet.

Launched in 2024, it opens with pear, mandarin and bergamot. Violet forms a soft, powdery heart, and musk and sandalwood give it a clean, creamy finish.

Light and elegant, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Bond No 9 Bond No.9's Island Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bond No.9's Island by Bond No 9 is an aromatic aquatic fragrance designed for both women and men. This new scent was introduced in 2024. Crafted by perfumer Claude Dir, the fragrance opens with top notes of white ginger, basil, and water mint. Its heart reveals middle notes of seaweed, champaca, and green nuances. The base consists of amber, moss, and sandalwood.

title: Tom Ford Eau d'Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Tom Ford Eau d'Ombré Leather is a lighter, spicier take on Ombré Leather.

Sonia Constant and Olivier Gillotin created it in 2024. Cardamom, ginger and coriander open fresh, vanilla and leather form a smooth heart, and Ambrofix gives it a clean finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma The Gold Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Valentino Uomo Born in Roma The Gold is a warm blend of solar notes, nutmeg and vanilla.

Launched in 2024, it opens with solar notes, spices and nutmeg. Virginia cedar forms a woody heart, and amber and vanilla give it a sweet, warm finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Penhaligon's The Omniscient Mr Thompson Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Penhaligon's The Omniscient Mr Thompson is a woody blend of lavender, orris and sesame.

Launched in 2023, it opens with pink pepper, elemi and lavender. Black pepper, geranium and orris form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, sesame and oak give it a warm finish.

Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Diptyque Tempo Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Tempo is a modern, aromatic patchouli.

Olivier Pescheux created it in 2018. Clary sage, pink pepper, maté, bergamot and violet leaf brighten a clean, refined patchouli.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Diptyque L'Eau de Neroli Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: L'Eau de Neroli by Diptyque is an invigorating Citrus Aromatic fragrance suitable for both women and men, introduced in 2008. Crafted by the renowned perfumer Olivier Pescheux, the fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Citruses, Bergamot, Lemon Verbena, Petitgrain, and Tarragon. The heart of the scent features delicate notes of Neroli, Orange Blossom, and Egyptian Pelargonium. The base is grounded with the warm and comforting aromas of Beeswax, White Musk, and Cedar.

title: Diptyque Eau de Lierre Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Diptyque's Eau de Lierre Eau de Toilette is a Floral Green fragrance designed for women. This exquisite scent made its debut in 2006.

title: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Versace Eros Energy is a bright, zesty citrus with a mossy base.

Launched in 2024, it opens with blood orange, grapefruit, lemon, lime, mandarin and Sicilian bergamot. Pink pepper, white amber and black currant form the heart, and musk, patchouli and oakmoss give it a fresh, lasting finish.

Energetic and versatile for everyday wear.

title: Creed Centaurus Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Centaurus is a warm, spicy blend of tobacco, cinnamon and vanilla.

Launched in 2024, it opens with cinnamon, tobacco, cardamom and black pepper. Sandalwood, heliotrope, patchouli and jasmine form the heart, and benzoin, Bourbon vanilla, tonka bean and ambroxan give it a rich finish.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Creed Delphinus Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Delphinus is a refined blend of iris, incense and vanilla.

Launched in 2024, it opens with iris, moves into an incense heart and settles into a smooth vanilla.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Byredo Desert Dawn Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Desert Dawn by Byredo is a Woody Spicy fragrance designed for both women and men. This new fragrance made its debut in 2024. The top notes feature a blend of Cardamom and Rose Petals, while the heart of the scent includes Carrot Seeds, Sandalwood, and Cedarwood. The base notes consist of Silk, Musk, Papyrus, and Vetiver.

title: Tom Ford Black Lacquer Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Black Lacquer is a dark, modern blend of ink, vinyl, rum and black pepper.

Launched in 2024, it opens with ink, vinyl, rum and black pepper. Ebony wood, peony, elemi and apricot form the heart, and olibanum gives it a smoky, resinous finish.

Edgy and distinctive, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Gucci Guilty Essence Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Essence Pour Homme is a fresh blend of lavender, orange blossom and patchouli.

Launched in 2024, it opens with lavender and coriander. Orange blossom and neroli form a bright heart, and patchouli and cedar give it a woody finish.

Easy and polished, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Givenchy L'Interdit Absolu Eau de Parfum Intense for Women
description_html:
Givenchy L'Interdit Absolu is a dark, rich floral with tuberose, tobacco and rum.

Launched in 2024, it opens with neroli, lavender and Guatemalan cardamom. Indian tuberose, jasmine sambac and orange blossom form a lush heart, and tobacco, rum, Haitian vetiver and patchouli give it a deep finish.

Seductive and intense, it is made for evenings.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Elixir Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Carolina Herrera introduces Good Girl Blush Elixir Eau de Parfum, a captivating new fragrance for women. Launched in 2024, this scent opens with refreshing top notes of Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. The heart of the fragrance blooms with alluring Ylang Ylang and Rose, while a warm base of Vanilla and Patchouli rounds out this exquisite perfume.

title: Dior Sauvage Eau Forte for Men
description_html: Sauvage Eau Forte by Dior is an aromatic fougère fragrance designed for men. This new addition to the Dior collection was introduced in 2024, crafted by the renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with invigorating top notes of Elemi resin and spices, followed by a heart of soothing lavender. The scent is grounded with base notes of musky and woody aromas.

title: Montale Infinity Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Infinity is a sweet, spicy blend of plum, black cherry, oud and tobacco.

Launched in 2023, it opens with saffron, cardamom, pink pepper, plum and black cherry. Oud, leather, rose, vetiver, sandalwood and tuberose form a rich heart, and tonka, tobacco leaf, vanilla sugar, musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Seductive and intense, it is made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Initio Parfums Prives Oud for Greatness Neo Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Initio Oud for Greatness Néo is a fresh, aromatic take on Oud for Greatness.

Launched in 2024, it blends bergamot, saffron and lavender with fir and agarwood for a bright, spicy and woody oud with a smooth, leathery feel.

Modern and confident, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Frederic Malle Acne Studios Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Frédéric Malle Acne Studios is a soft, fruity blend of peach, orange blossom and musk.

Suzy Le Helley created it in 2024. Orange blossom, rose, violet, peach and aldehydes meet musk, sandalwood, vanilla and frankincense for a bright, sweet and gently musky scent.

Fresh and charming, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

title: Clive Christian E Cashmere Musk Parfum Unisex
description_html: E Cashmere Musk by Clive Christian is a captivating Woody Spicy fragrance designed for both women and men. A fresh addition to the fragrance world, it made its debut in 2024. The scent opens with top notes of Bergamot, Ginger, Pink Pepper, Sichuan Pepper, and Blood Orange. The heart is an elegant blend of Flowers, Cashmeran, Green Leaves, and Egyptian Jasmine. The fragrance is rounded off with a rich base of Ambroxan, Musk, and Guaiac Wood.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers & Flames Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers & Flames is a sunny blend of lavender, lily and coconut.

Launched in 2024, it opens with bergamot and lavender. Orange blossom, lily, lavender, palm and coconut form a bright heart, and vanilla gives it a warm finish.

Radiant and cheerful, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather is a warm, spicy blend of leather and tobacco.

Launched in 2024, it opens with nutmeg and black pepper. Cinnamon and frankincense form a smoky, spicy heart, and black leather and tobacco give it a rich, sweet finish.

Bold and intense, it is a great choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum Parfum for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum is a warmer, spicier take on MYSLF.

Launched in 2024, it opens with black pepper, moves into a soft orange blossom heart and settles into amber, patchouli, Bourbon vanilla and woods for a smooth, sensual finish.

Versatile and polished, it works in every season, day or night.

title: Roja Parfums Isola Sol Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja Isola Sol is a sunny blend of peach, apricot, coconut and salt.

Roja Dove created it in 2024. Bergamot, petitgrain, lemon, mandarin, peach and apricot open juicy, jasmine sambac, coconut, neroli and ylang-ylang form a creamy heart, and musk, pink pepper, cedar, ambroxan, salt and sandalwood give it a breezy finish.

Warm and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Penhaligon's The Revenge Of Lady Blanche Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Penhaligon's The Revenge of Lady Blanche is a green, powdery blend of hyacinth, narcissus and iris.

Daphné Bugey created it in 2016. Hyacinth, narcissus and iris come together in a cool, earthy and elegant floral scent.

Refined and unusual, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Le Labo Vetiver 46 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Vetiver 46 is a dark, smoky vetiver with incense and spice.

Mark Buxton created it in 2006. Tahitian vetiver meets bergamot, pepper and clove, with cedar, guaiac wood, labdanum, olibanum, amber and vanilla adding warmth and smoky depth.

Intense and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Le Labo Ambrette 9 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Ambrette 9 is a soft, fruity musk built around ambrette seed.

Michel Almairac created it in 2006. Ambrette, musk and amber blend with Amalfi lemon, fruity notes and aldehydes for a light, sweet and powdery skin scent.

Gentle and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Dior Dioramour Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Dioramour by Dior is a unisex fragrance, designed to captivate both women and men. Introduced in 2018, this enchanting scent was crafted by the renowned perfumer Francois Demachy.

title: Burberry Snow Blossom Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Snow Blossom by Burberry is a newly released Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Debuting in 2023, this scent opens with top notes of Bergamot and Mate. The heart reveals middle notes of Violet Leaves and Mimosa, while the base is composed of Akigalawood, Suede, and Madagascar Vanilla.

title: Acqua di Parma Zafferano Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Zafferano by Acqua di Parma is an Amber Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2022, this modern scent opens with top notes of Bergamot, Bitter Orange, Mandarin Orange, and Coriander. The heart of the fragrance features a blend of Saffron, Orange Blossom, Geranium, Jasmine Sambac, and Rose. The base notes consist of Woody Notes, Vanilla, and Tonka Bean, creating a well-rounded and captivating aroma.

title: Giorgio Armani Ocean di Gioia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Armani Ocean di Gioia is a fresh, salty floral with pear and water jasmine.

Sonia Constant and Marypierre Julien created it in 2020. Green notes, pear and citrus open bright, lily-of-the-valley, salt, rose and water jasmine form a breezy heart, and musk and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Light and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Paco Rabanne Million Gold Eau de Parfum Intense for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Million Gold Intense is a warm, woody blend of mandarin, spice and sandalwood.

Launched in 2024, it pairs bright mandarin with warm spices, creamy sandalwood and cedarwood for a smooth, glowing scent.

Rich and polished, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Amouage Epic 56 Woman Parfum
description_html: Epic 56 Woman by Amouage is an Amber Spicy fragrance crafted for women. Introduced in 2021, this new fragrance is the creation of perfumer Cecile Zarokian. The scent opens with top notes of Cumin, Pink Pepper, and Cinnamon. Its heart features Damask Rose, Jasmine Tea, and Geranium. The rich base is a blend of Olibanum, Patchouli, Agarwood (Oud), Sandalwood, Amber, Guaiac Wood, Orris, Musk, and Vanilla.

title: Burberry Garden Roses Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Garden Roses by Burberry is a captivating Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2017, this exquisite scent is the creation of renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with refreshing top notes of Italian Lemon, Grapefruit, and Bergamot. The heart reveals a harmonious blend of Bulgarian Rose, Green Notes, Black Currant, Apple, and Lily-of-the-Valley. Finally, the base notes feature a soothing combination of Vetiver, White Musk, and Cedar.

title: Paco Rabanne Phantom Intense Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Phantom Intense is a warm blend of orange blossom, lavender and vanilla.

Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Paul Guerlain created it in 2024. Frosted orange blossom opens bright, lavender oil forms an aromatic heart, and vanilla bean gives it a creamy finish.

Modern and smooth, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Vibrant. Sparkling. Transportive.

Immerse yourself in the essence of the Italian Riviera with this exquisite fragrance by Tom Ford. Inspired by the enchanting coastal landscape, this scent captures the cool breezes, pristine azure waters, and lush greenery that define this Mediterranean paradise.

Tom Ford’s masterful reinvention of the classic eau de cologne is a sensory journey that begins with a burst of invigorating citrus. Crisp notes of lemon, bergamot, and mandarin mingle to create a refreshing and uplifting introduction. These sparkling top notes are delicately balanced with a surprising floral heart, where the delicate scents of jasmine, neroli, and orange blossom come into play, adding an unexpected layer of sophistication and elegance.

As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a deeper, more substantive character. Warm amber undertones blend seamlessly with earthy hints of vetiver and moss, evoking the sun-drenched cliffs and verdant hillsides of the Riviera. This rich, complex base ensures a lasting impression, leaving a trail that is both splashy and enduring.

Experience the luxury and allure of the Italian Riviera with every spritz. This scent is not just a fragrance; it is a transportive escape to a world of beauty, elegance, and timeless charm.

title: Bond No. 9 New York Forever Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: "New York Forever" by Bond No 9 is a contemporary unisex fragrance that debuted in 2023. The scent, crafted by perfumer Domitille Michalon Bertier, encapsulates the vibrant spirit of New York City. It opens with a spicy burst of cinnamon, setting a warm and inviting tone. The heart of the fragrance is a rich blend of patchouli and vanilla, adding depth and a touch of sweetness. The base is complex, featuring earthy notes alongside amber, labdanum, honey, moss, and musk, creating a multifaceted and enduring finish. This fragrance is a tribute to the timeless allure of New York, designed for both women and men.

title: Thomas Kosmala Arabian Passion Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala Arabian Passion is a warm blend of saffron, frankincense and oud.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2018. Cardamom and saffron open spicy, frankincense, patchouli and rose form a smoky heart, and amber, oud and sandalwood give it a rich finish.

Opulent and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Hermes Eau des Merveilles Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Hermès Eau des Merveilles is a sparkling blend of citrus, ambergris and woods.

Ralf Schwieger and Nathalie Feisthauer created it in 2004. Lemon, orange and elemi open bright, amber, violet and pepper form a salty, warm heart, and cedar, fir, vetiver and oakmoss give it a woody finish.

Unique and radiant, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Ex Nihilo Cologne 352 Eau de Parfum
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Cologne 352 is a fresh, musky blend of lemon, juniper and orange blossom.

Jacques Huclier created it in 2014. Italian lemon and juniper berries open bright, orange blossom, lily-of-the-valley and rose form a clean heart, and white cedar, white musk and guaiac wood give it a soft finish.

Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Dior J'adore L'Or Essence de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Dior J'adore L'Or Essence de Parfum for Women is a luxurious and opulent fragrance that embodies the essence of floral grandeur. Designed by Francis Kurkdjian, this perfume is a testament to the craftsmanship of Dior's fragrance creation. It features an exquisite composition of floral notes, primarily centered around orange blossom, jasmine grandiflorum, and centifolia rose absolutes. These core ingredients blend to create a voluptuous and powerful scent that evokes the imagery of pure, liquid gold.

The fragrance opens with the bright and fresh tones of orange blossom, lending it an elegant and feminine charm. The heart of the perfume is dominated by jasmine grandiflorum, known for its strong yet subtle fragrance with nuances of almond, mango, and banana, providing a unique fruity florality. The centifolia rose adds a compelling depth with its full and rich aroma, enhancing the overall composition's luxurious feel.

The bottle design complements the scent's opulence, inspired by Christian Dior's figure-eight motif. It features a flowing metallic gold necklace that elegantly embraces the glass bottle, reflecting the fragrance's warmth and intensity.

J'adore L'Or is more than just a fragrance; it's a symbol of femininity and sophistication, making it a perfect choice for those who appreciate the artistry behind a well-crafted perfume.

title: Dior Dioressence Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dioressence, a captivating Chypre Floral scent for women from Les Creations de Monsieur Dior by Dior, made its debut in 2009. The fragrance opens with the fresh, vibrant note of Geranium, unfolds into a warm heart of Cinnamon, and settles into the earthy depth of Patchouli at its base.

title: Clive Christian 20th Anniversary Collection Iconic Feminine Parfum
description_html: 20 Iconic Feminine by Clive Christian is a captivating Amber Floral scent designed for women. Released in 2019, this fragrance opens with the rich aroma of Saffron. At its heart, it features a harmonious blend of Plum, Violet, and Damask Rose, creating a deeply floral bouquet. The fragrance settles into a warm base of Amber and Honey, enveloping the wearer in a luxurious and comforting aroma.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Dazzling Garden Eau de Parfum
description_html: Carolina Herrera introduces Good Girl Dazzling Garden, a contemporary women's perfume. Freshly released in 2023, this scent opens with the luminous aromas of Jasmine and Tuberose. Almond delicately emerges as the heart note, while a rich blend of Cacao, Tonka Bean, and Coffee forms the base, creating a lasting impression.

title: Bond No. 9 New Haarlem Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Introduced by Bond No 9, New Haarlem presents itself as a captivating Amber Woody scent suitable for both women and men. First gracing the fragrance world in 2003, this scent was masterfully composed by the renowned perfumer Maurice Roucel. It begins with a refreshing blend of Lavender, Bergamot, and Green Leaves at the top. The heart of the fragrance pulses with rich notes of Coffee and Cedar, leading to a warm, indulgent base where Vanilla, Patchouli, Tonka Bean, and Amber richly entwine.

title: Giorgio Armani Eau de Cedre Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Eau de Cèdre is a woody, leathery blend of cedar, violet leaf and black tea.

Launched in 2015, it opens with bergamot, lemon and sage. Cardamom, cumin and violet leaf form a spicy heart, and woods, cedar, suede and black tea give it a smooth finish.

Refined and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Amouage Opus XV King Blue Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Opus XV King Blue is a fruity, leathery oud.

Hamid Merati-Kashani and Alexis Grugeon created it in 2023. Pink pepper, mandarin and black currant open bright, amber and frankincense form the heart, and oud, sandalwood, leather, oak and patchouli give it depth.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: The House of Oud Golden Powder Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The House of Oud Golden Powder is a warm, woody blend of cinnamon, papyrus and tobacco blossom.

Launched in 2016, it opens with cinnamon and nutmeg. Virginia cedar, guaiac wood, papyrus and sandalwood form a woody heart, and musk, labdanum, vanilla, tobacco blossom and coumarin give it a sweet finish.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Juliette Has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Vanilla Vibes is a salty, creamy vanilla with orchid and sandalwood.

Launched in 2019, it opens with salt. Vanilla absolute and orchid form a sweet heart, and tonka bean, sandalwood, musk and benzoin give it a warm, powdery finish.

Cozy and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Sun Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dolce & Gabbana's Light Blue Sun presents a delightful blend of floral and fruity scents, specifically crafted for women. This exquisite fragrance first graced the market in 2019. Upon the first encounter, one is greeted by the sweet essence of coconut nectar, the zest of lemon, the fresh ozonic whispers, and the crisp aroma of Granny Smith apples. Progressing into the heart of the fragrance, a bouquet blooms with the exotic allure of frangipani, the enchanting fragrance of jasmine, and the pure, subtle notes of white rose. Completing this olfactory journey, the base unfurls with the rich undertones of bourbon vanilla, the clean, soft scent of white musk, the woody warmth of cedar, and the intriguing maritime vibe of ambergris.

title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia is a fruity, creamy floral with coconut, dewberry and magnolia.

Daphné Bugey and Marie Salamagne created it in 2023. Coconut and dewberry open juicy, jasmine sambac, clary sage and magnolia form a bright heart, and musk, blonde woods and patchouli give it a soft finish.

Sunny and pretty, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Parfum for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum is a deep, salty marine with mimosa.

Launched in 2024, it opens with green mandarin and marine notes. Mimosa forms a soft heart, and patchouli and labdanum give it a warm finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Hermes H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Hermès H24 Herbes Vives is a fresh, cooling blend of herbs and pear.

Christine Nagel created it in 2024. Herbal notes open green, pear adds a juicy heart, and a cooling Physcool note gives it a crisp, refreshing finish.

Light and refreshing for warm days.

title: Armaf Tres Jour Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Armaf's Tres Jour is a women's scent that elegantly combines floral, woody, and musky elements. The initial burst of freshness comes from the top notes of Green Tea, zesty Lemon, and the slightly citrusy Neroli. At the heart of the fragrance lie the aromatic White Flowers, the intoxicating aroma of Jasmine, and the rich, creamy essence of Tuberose. Anchoring the scent, the base notes bring warmth and depth with the sensual Musk, the earthy Cedar, the sweet allure of Vanilla, and the exotic richness of Patchouli.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Armaf's Club de Nuit Man is a fragrance that features a woody and spicy scent profile designed for the modern gentleman. The scent opens with a fresh burst of Mandarin Orange, complemented by the cooling aroma of Mint and the zesty tang of Grapefruit. As it settles, the heart reveals a warm blend of aromatic Cinnamon, piquant Cloves, invigorating Ginger, and a hint of bold Pepper. Anchoring the fragrance, its foundation is built upon the rich warmth of Amber, a melange of spicy accords, the classic depth of Leather, the earthy essence of Patchouli, and a collection of woody notes that linger on the skin.

title: M. Micallef Red Colorado Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
M. Micallef Red Colorado is a resinous, woody blend of fir, pine and leather.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bergamot, cypress, fir, pine and green leaves. Woods, patchouli, rose, sandalwood, cedar and guaiac wood form a deep heart, and vanilla and leather give it a warm finish.

Rugged and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: M. Micallef GNTONIC Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
M. Micallef GNTonic is a sparkling gin and tonic accord with lime, ginger and mint.

Launched in 2023, it opens with pink pepper, gin, ginger, bitter orange, lime, tonic water and mint. Nutmeg, cypriol, cedar, orange blossom and lily-of-the-valley form the heart, and white musk, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and moss give it a clean finish.

Crisp and playful, it is made for spring and summer, day or night.

title: M. Micallef DesirToxic L'Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
M. Micallef DesirToxic L'Intense is an aromatic blend of citrus, saffron and cannabis.

Thierry Romeo created it in 2024. Bergamot, lemon, saffron and cardamom open bright, tonka bean, cinnamon, black currant and mint form a warm heart, and cannabis, moss, patchouli and musk give it an herbal, woody finish.

Bold and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Marc-Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Marc-Antoine Barrois Tilia is a sunny, green floral built around linden blossom.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Linden blossom, jasmine sambac, heliotrope and broom meet vetiver, Ambrofix and Georgywood for a soft, honeyed and slightly powdery scent.

Light and luminous, it is perfect for spring and summer days.

title: Orto Parisi Stercus Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Orto Parisi Stercus is a dark, sweet blend of anise, leather and oud.

Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2014. Anise, almond and aldehydes open sweet, rose forms the heart, and oud, leather, musk, vanilla, cedar and heliotrope give it a powdery, animalic finish.

Daring and unusual, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Mancera Cosmic Pepper Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Cosmic Pepper is a spicy blend of pink pepper, oud and Damask rose.

Launched in 2023, it opens with lemon, pink pepper, sage and tangerine. Oud, black pepper and Damask rose form the heart, and white musk, labdanum, tonka bean, ambergris and oakmoss give it a sweet, musky finish.

Bold and modern, it is a great night scent in summer and fall.

title: D.S. & DURGA Black Magenta Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Black Magenta, crafted by DS&Durga, is a unisex scent featuring Amber Woody tones. Recently introduced to the market in 2024, the creation of this fragrance is attributed to the olfactory expertise of perfumer David Seth Moltz. The scent's opening is characterized by a lively blend of Pineapple, Galbanum, and Black Pepper. At its heart, the perfume unveils a bouquet of Dianthus, Orris, and Orange Blossom. Anchoring the fragrance with depth and richness, the base notes consist of Black Amber, Tobacco, and Sandalwood.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Love Is Love Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dolce & Gabbana's Light Blue Love Is Love Pour Femme is a captivating scent for women that intertwines floral, woody, and musk essences. Recently introduced, this fragrance made its debut in 2020. It opens with the zesty brightness of lemon, the tart sweetness of Granny Smith apple, and the lush juiciness of red berries. At its heart is a delectable blend of creamy ice cream and tart raspberry, complemented by the delicate aroma of jasmine. The fragrance settles into a comforting finish of soft whipped cream paired with the sensual warmth of musk, complemented by the grounding presence of cedar and the rich, resinous tones of amber.

title: BDK Parfums 312 Saint Honore Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: BDK Parfums' 312 Saint-Honoré presents a contemporary Amber Floral scent that caters to both men and women. Recently introduced in 2024, this perfume marks the latest addition to the fragrance line. Crafted by perfumer Alexandra Carlin, the aroma opens with the spicy zing of Pink Pepper and the earthy essence of Angelica Root. At its heart, the blend showcases the rich texture of Iris, the sweet zest of Orange Blossom, and the creamy depth of Tonka Bean. It settles into a warm base where the gentle caress of White Musk meets the complexity of Ambroxan and the proprietary blend of Ambrostar™, culminating with the exotic woody touch of Thailand Oud.

title: Diptyque Eau Rose Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Diptyque's Eau Rose is a women's scent that falls within the Floral Fruity category. This fragrance made its debut in 2012. It opens with the sweet and tart blend of Litchi, Black Currant, and Bergamot. The heart of the scent is composed of a floral trio featuring Rose, Geranium, and Jasmine. The foundation of the perfume is built on the warm and soothing scents of Musk, white honey, and Virginia Cedar.

title: Diptyque Eau Rose Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Diptyque Eau Rose Eau de Parfum is a fresh, dewy rose with a lychee twist.

Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2022. Lychee opens juicy, Grasse rose, rose water, Damask rose, artichoke and chamomile form a fresh floral heart, and musk and woods give it a soft finish.

Light and pretty for spring and summer days.

title: Carolina Herrera True Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: True Oud, a recent addition by Carolina Herrera, is an aromatic blend categorized as a Floral Woody Musk scent, created for both men and women. Unveiled in 2022, the masterful composition of this fragrance was crafted by perfumer Jordi Fernandez. It opens with an inviting quartet of top notes, featuring Saffron, Olive, Osmanthus, and Freesia. The heart of the perfume is anchored by an exotic trio of Thailand Oud, Myrrh, and Jasmine. The fragrance's foundation is a robust harmony of base notes, composed of Akigalawood, Musk, Sandalwood, and Patchouli.

title: Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Parfum for Men
description_html:
Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Man is a dark, green blend of black hemlock, oud and cardamom.

Geza Schoen created it in 2004. Black hemlock and oud meet juniper berry, bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom and coriander, with vetiver, cedar, sandalwood and musk for a deep, woody and aromatic scent.

Distinctive and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Carolina Herrera Stallion Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Carolina Herrera introduces Stallion Leather, a unisex Leather scent that's freshly released. Debuting in 2023, the fragrance begins with bold top notes of Leather and Ginger. The heart explores a floral interplay of Jasmine and Osmanthus, while the foundation is rooted in the earthy trio of Olibanum, Labdanum, and Patchouli.

title: Carolina Herrera Sandal Ruby Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Carolina Herrera's Sandal Ruby is a unisex fragrance with an Amber Floral profile, introduced in 2019. This scent starts with spicy top notes of cinnamon and black pepper. Its heart blooms with the floral scents of tuberose and geranium. The fragrance settles into a rich foundation of patchouli, sandalwood, and Atlas cedar.

title: Carolina Herrera Mystery Tobacco Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Carolina Herrera's Mystery Tobacco presents an Amber Woody scent that’s designed to captivate both men and women. Unveiled in 2016, this fragrance is the creation of esteemed perfumer Quentin Bisch. The scent begins with an intriguing blend of top notes including zesty Citruses, spicy Ginger, floral Osmanthus, and the herbaceous touch of Artemisia. At its heart, the scent unfurls a rich tapestry of Tobacco and Patchouli, harmoniously combined with the woody essence of Guaiac Wood and the earthy sophistication of Vetiver. The experience is grounded by the creamy warmth of Tonka Bean as the base note, making it a complex and alluring aromatic journey.

title: Carolina Herrera Burning Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Burning Rose encapsulates elegance amidst adversity. This scent evokes a reminiscent aura of New York City's groundbreaking era during the 70s and 80s, a period marked by cultural shifts and bold innovations in the realm of pop culture and beyond. Merging the quintessential qualities of charm, sophistication, and allure, Burning Rose creates a fragrance that embodies the essence of grace and style.

title: Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Elixir Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Elixir is a sweet, woody blend of rose, saffron and balsams.

Olivier Cresp created it in 2023. Rose, musk, vanilla, saffron, orris root, fig, guaiac wood, oud, tolu and Peru balsam and ambroxan come together in a smooth, warm and creamy woody scent.

Rich and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: D.S. & DURGA Deep Dark Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: DS&Durga's Deep Dark Vanilla is a unisex Amber Vanilla scent that recently made its debut in 2023. Renowned perfumer David Seth Moltz crafted this alluring new scent. It opens with a delicate blend of Orchid, Cabreuva, and a hint of Pink Pepper for the top notes. The heart of the fragrance reveals a harmony of Cypress, the lushness of Vanilla Leaves, and a twist of Vine. Anchoring the fragrance are deep, rich base notes of pure Vanilla Absolute, the earthiness of Hay, and the intense aroma of Dark Patchouli.

title: Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Azzaro's The Most Wanted Intense is a masculine scent that falls within the Woody Aromatic category. Recently introduced to the market in 2024, this fragrance opens with the citrusy zing of Bergamot at the top. It then transitions into the heart of the scent, featuring the soothing aroma of Lavender. Anchoring the fragrance are base notes of rich Liquor and earthy Moss, adding depth and intensity to its olfactory profile.

title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum is a clean, musky blend of lavender, marine notes and woods.

Anne Flipo and Caroline Dumur created it in 2024. Lavender, pink pepper and marine notes open fresh, soap, violet leaf and myrtle form a clean heart, and cashmeran, musk and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.

Fresh and easy, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Creed Irisia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Creed's Irisia presents a symphony of Floral Green scents tailored for feminine allure, first introduced to the world in 1968. The olfactory artistry of James Henry Creed gives life to this timeless aroma. An invigorating opening of Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Peach, and Mimosa leads to a heart rich with the notes of iris, Violet, and Tuberose. Completing this elegant fragrance is a grounded finish featuring Oakmoss, Amber, Patchouli, Ambergris, Sandalwood, Cedar, and a whisper of Vanilla.

title: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum for Men
description_html:
Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum is a leathery blend of lemon, saffron and oak.

Launched in 2024, it opens with bright lemon. Saffron forms a warm, spicy heart, and amber and oak give it a smooth, woody finish.

Bold and refined, it is a great night scent.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Paradise Garden Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Paradise Garden is a fresh, watery blend of blue lotus, iris and vanilla.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Blue lotus opens cool and aquatic, iris forms a soft, powdery heart, and vanilla gives it a creamy finish.

Light and dreamy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Paco Rabanne XS (2018) Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne XS (2018) is a fresh, aromatic blend of citrus, mint and juniper.

Rosendo Mateu and Gérard Anthony created it in 2018. Bergamot, lemon and mint open crisp, geranium, coriander and juniper berries form an herbal heart, and sandalwood, rosemary and oakmoss give it a woody finish.

Clean and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Mugler Angel Nova Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Mugler Angel Nova is a fresh, fruity rose with litchi and cedar.

Quentin Bisch, Louise Turner and Sonia Constant created it in 2021. Bergamot and litchi open juicy, magnolia and rose form a pretty floral heart, and musk and Virginia cedar give it a clean finish.

Light and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Kajal Yasmina Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Kajal Yasmina is a rich blend of saffron, leather and whiskey.

Launched in 2018, it opens with rose, saffron and cardamom. Leather, jasmine, whiskey and orris form a smooth heart, and tonka bean, patchouli and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Bold and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Diptyque Eau Capitale Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Eau Capitale is a bright, modern chypre of bergamot, rose and patchouli.

Olivier Pescheux created it in 2019. Bergamot and pink pepper open sparkling, rose forms the heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Vitae Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Vitae Cologne Forte is a sunny blend of citrus, florals and sandalwood.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2021. Bergamot and mandarin open bright, florals and solar notes form a radiant heart, and musk and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Light and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Mancera Red Tobacco Intense Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Red Tobacco Intense is a rich, spicy blend of oud, tobacco and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with oud, saffron, cinnamon, nutmeg, incense and pear. Vetiver, patchouli, leather, tobacco and jasmine form a dark heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, guaiac wood, ambergris and musk give it a smooth finish.

Powerful and warm, it works day or night from summer through winter.

title: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Infrared is a fiery blend of chili pepper, cinnamon and leather.

Carlos Benaim, Nicolas Beaulieu and Jean-Christophe Hérault created it in 2023. Cinnamon, pink pepper and chili pepper open hot and spicy, leather forms a smooth heart, and resins and woods give it a warm finish.

Intense and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Triumph Elixir Parfum Intense for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Triumph Elixir is a green, earthy blend of violet leaf, vetiver and patchouli.

Annick Menardo and Suzy Le Helley created it in 2024. Violet leaf opens green and crisp, vetiver forms a smoky, earthy heart, and patchouli leaf gives it a deep finish.

Intense and modern, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Ralph Lauren Polo 67 is a juicy, fruity citrus with an earthy, woody finish.

Launched in 2024, it opens with bergamot, lemon and pineapple. Juniper, sage and rose hip form a fresh, aromatic heart, and vetiver, goldenrod and patchouli give it a clean, grounded base.

Bright and easygoing, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Creed Spring Flower 2023 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Spring Flower 2023 by Creed is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Spring Flower 2023 was launched in 2023.

Top notes are Grapefruit, Lemon, Bergamot and Green Notes.

Middle notes are White Flowers, Jasmine, Apricot and Peach.

Base notes are Ambergris, Musk and Cedar.

title: Dior Miss Dior Parfum (2024) for Women
description_html:
Dior Miss Dior Parfum is a juicy, sensual take on Miss Dior with wild strawberry.

Francis Kurkdjian and François Demachy created it in 2024. Mandarin, peach and apricot open bright, wild strawberry, florals and jasmine form the heart, and patchouli, amberwood, amber, moss and Atlas cedar give it a warm, chypre-like finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

title: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum is a warm, woody take on Luna Rossa Ocean.

Launched in 2023, it opens with grapefruit. Woods and frankincense form the heart, and vanilla and amber give it a smooth finish.

Versatile in every season, day or night.

title: Mancera Pearl Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Mancera Pearl is a fruity, musky blend of fig, green apple and peach.

Pierre Montale created it in 2016. Bergamot, fig, green apple and white peach open juicy, violet, Egyptian jasmine and rose form a soft heart, and white musk and ambergris give it a clean finish.

Fresh and pretty, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Maison Oud Sovereign Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Oud Sovereign is a powdery blend of rose, iris and amber.

Nutmeg, rose and musk open warm, iris, amber and orange blossom form a powdery heart, and apple blossom, lemon zest and ambroxan give it a fresh, radiant finish.

Elegant and smooth, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Maison Oud Aristocrat Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Oud Aristocrat is a soft, musky blend of herbs and woods.

Musk, herbal notes and woods come together in a clean, green and slightly powdery scent with a gentle, skin-like warmth.

Calm and versatile, it works day or night.

title: Maison Oud Amira Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Oud Amira is a soft, musky blend of peach, white flowers and patchouli.

Launched in 2021, it opens with peach and white flowers. Fruity notes form a sweet heart, and patchouli and musk give it a warm, woody finish.

Gentle and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Maison Oud Velvet Oud Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Oud Velvet Oud is a sweet, fruity blend of peach, passionfruit and amber.

Launched in 2021, it opens with amber, peach and passionfruit. Pear, raspberry and black currant form a juicy heart, and a sand accord and amber give it a warm finish.

Fun and smooth, it works day or night.

title: Maison Oud Khaltaat Rose Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Oud Khaltaat Rose is a soft, powdery blend of rose, vanilla and coconut.

Launched in 2021, it opens with rose, vanilla and white flowers. Citrus, florals and powdery notes form a fresh heart, and musk and coconut give it a creamy finish.

Soft and warm, it is made for winter nights.

title: Maison Oud Amber Oud Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Oud Amber Oud is a warm, leathery blend of oud, saffron and amber.

Launched in 2021, it opens with oud, saffron and geranium. Amber, leather and rose form a rich heart, and musk and incense give it a smoky finish.

Bold and refined, it is a great daytime scent in spring and winter.

title: Bond No. 9 Chelsea Nights Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bond No. 9's Chelsea Nights offers a unisex Amber Vanilla scent that has recently made its debut in the fragrance world. Unveiled in 2022, this contemporary aroma has been crafted by perfumer Miroslav Petkov. The fragrance opens with a tempting blend of Cacao, Hazelnut, and Saffron as its top notes. The heart of the scent features a unique mixture of Turmeric, Rose, and Sesame. Grounding the fragrance, the base is composed of a rich tapestry of Suede, Patchouli, Vanilla, Amber, Agarwood (Oud), Myrrh, and Tonka Bean, creating an olfactory experience that is both indulgent and inviting.

title: Bond No. 9 New York Flowers Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bond No. 9 introduces

title: Juliette Has a Gun Not A Perfume Superdose Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume Superdose is a clean, woody amber built around Cetalox.

Launched in 2019, it centers on Cetalox, a soft ambergris-like note that feels warm, woody and musky on the skin.

Minimal and easy, it works year-round as a daily signature.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Extra Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
212 VIP Black Extra is announced as an intense and fierce fragrance to be worn at night parties. Accords of Rum&Cola with citruses are combined with black leather, moss, and sensual cacao and musk notes.

"Why blend in when you can be EXTRA? An explosion of spectacular, 212 VIP Black Extra parades your inner superstar. Basics join the party, Extras own the party."

title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Party Fever Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: 12 Party Fever For Men by Carolina Herrera, 212 Party Fever for men was launched in 2018 and is fresh and spicy that is a lovely warm weather, perfect for a night out on the town spent partying with friends.
