It opens with the top notes of bittersweet tamarind, citrus notes, crisp red apple, refreshing juniper berries, and spicy ginger. It then transitions to the intriguing middle notes of nutty cannabis, peppery freesia, and light geranium. The base notes add a touch of warmth and contain hints of exotic tonka bean, earthy musk, woody cedar, smoky vetiver, and olibanum.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Fantastic Pink Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Good Girl Fantastic Pink by Carolina Herrera is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Good Girl Fantastic Pink was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Louise Turner. Top notes are almond, coffee, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are jasmine sambac, tuberose, orris, bulgarian rose and orange blossom; base notes are tonka bean, cacao pod, sandalwood, vanilla, praline, cinnamon, cedar, cashmere wood, patchouli, amber and musk.

title: Frederic Malle Vetiver Extraordinaire Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Frédéric Malle Vetiver Extraordinaire is a crisp, refined vetiver.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2002. Bergamot and bitter orange open bright, vetiver, pink pepper and clove form a woody heart, and cedar, oakmoss, myrrh, sandalwood and musk give it a clean finish.

A polished daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Frederic Malle Angeliques Sous La Pluie Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Frédéric Malle Angéliques sous la Pluie is a cool, airy blend of angelica, juniper and pink pepper.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2000. Angelica, juniper, pink pepper, cedar, coriander and musk come together in a fresh, aromatic and quietly woody scent.

Calm and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Italian Zest Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
A pure explosion of fresh bergamot boosts Light Blue Pour Homme’s signature contrast of coolness and sensuality. Italian Zest brightens the top notes of grapefruit and mandarin, while pepper and juniper add a spicy tang to the rosemary and rosewood heart notes. By contrast, the vibrant incense and musks of the drydown feel even more potent. Light Blue Italian Zest is an invitation to make Summer sparkle with zest.

 

Fragrance Family:
Fresh

Scent Type:
Fresh Citrus & Fruits

Key Notes:
Bergamot of Calabria, Rosemary, Oak Moss

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Gyan Men Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Gyan by Bvlgari is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Gyan was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. The fragrance features jasmine sambac, patchouli and incense.

title: Memo Paris Shams Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Memo Paris Shams Oud is a warm, spicy oud with saffron and balsams.

Launched in 2011, it opens with pepper, saffron and ginger. Cypriol and vetiver form an earthy heart, and oud, labdanum, tolu balsam, birch, styrax and tonka bean give it a rich, resinous finish.

Opulent and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Memo Paris Winter Palace Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Memo Paris Winter Palace is a warm, citrusy blend of red tea, vanilla and balsams.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2019. Orange, lemon, grapefruit and bergamot brighten red tea and maté, while tolu balsam, vanilla, tonka bean, amber, benzoin, labdanum and musk give it a cozy, glowing depth.

Comforting and easy, it works year-round as a daytime scent.

title: Memo Paris Siwa Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Memo Paris Siwa is an unusual blend of popcorn, narcissus and whiskey.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2007. Popcorn and musk open warm, narcissus, whiskey and cinnamon form a golden heart, and violet leaf and aldehydes give it a green, powdery finish.

Playful and distinctive, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Mancera Hindu Kush Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Hindu Kush is a smoky, resinous blend of incense, spices and amber.

Pierre Montale created it in 2018. Incense, cannabis, spices and labdanum open dark and aromatic, woods and patchouli leaf form an earthy heart, and amber, guaiac wood, vanilla pod and white musk give it a warm finish.

Moody and distinctive, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Memo Paris Ilha Do Mel Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Memo Paris Ilha do Mel is a sweet, honeyed floral with jasmine and orange blossom.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2015. Vanilla, jasmine, honey, orange blossom, broom, iris, hyacinth, mandarin and juniper come together in a golden, sunny and soft floral scent.

Warm and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Memo Paris Inle Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Memo Paris Inlé is a fresh floral with osmanthus, maté and mint.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2007. Bergamot, mint and artemisia open fresh, osmanthus, maté, jasmine and spices form a fruity heart, and iris, musk and cedar give it a soft finish.

Calm and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Clive Christian Crown Collection Matsukita Parfum Unisex
description_html: Matsukita by Clive Christian is a Woody Chypre fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Matsukita was launched in 2021. Top notes are Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Nutmeg; middle notes are Mate, Chinese Jasmine, Jasmine Sambac and Guaiac Wood; base notes are Musk, Woodsy Notes, Balsam Fir and Amber.

title: Memo Paris Oriental Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Memo Paris Oriental Leather is a spicy blend of lavender, chili pepper and leather.

Launched in 2019, it opens with lavender, red chili pepper and cilantro. Geranium, anise, cinnamon and tea form an aromatic heart, and leather, patchouli, clove, benzoin and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Bold and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Memo Paris Lalibela Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Memo Paris Lalibela is a warm floral with incense, tobacco and coconut.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2007. Incense, precious woods and tobacco leaf open smoky, vanilla, patchouli, jasmine and labdanum form a warm heart, and coconut, orchid, rose and peony give it a soft, sweet finish.

Exotic and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Memo Paris Ocean Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Memo Paris Ocean Leather is a fresh, aromatic leather with vetiver, sage and citrus.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2020. Vetiver, leather and nutmeg meet sage, elemi and cedar, while mandarin, basil and violet keep it bright and green.

Breezy yet substantial, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hermes Eau de Pamplemousse Rose Eau de Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Eau de Pamplemousse Rose is a sparkling cologne of grapefruit, rose and orange.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2009. Grapefruit, rose and orange come together in a crisp, juicy and lightly floral citrus scent.

Light and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: By Kilian Sacred Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: "Sacred Wood, a unisex Amber Woody scent by By Kilian, made its debut in 2014. The creation of this fragrance was orchestrated by the renowned perfumer Calice Becker."

title: Versace Atelier Safran Royal Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Versace Atelier Safran Royal is a leathery blend of saffron, amber and patchouli.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2021. Amber, leather, saffron, cypriol, patchouli, cistus and wormwood come together in a warm, earthy and spicy scent.

Bold and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Hermes Un Jardin Sur Le Nil Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Un Jardin sur le Nil is a fresh, green blend of green mango and lotus.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2005. Grapefruit, green mango, tomato and carrot open crisp, lotus, bulrush, orange, hyacinth and peony form the heart, and musk, iris, incense and labdanum give it a soft finish.

A refreshing daytime scent for spring and summer.

title: Ormonde Jayne Tsarina Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ormonde Jayne Tsarina is a soft, suede-like floral with cassis, iris and vanilla.

Geza Schoen created it in 2012. Bergamot, coriander, mandarin and cassis open bright, hedione, suede, iris, freesia and jasmine sambac form a smooth heart, and vanilla bean, labdanum, sandalwood, cedar and musk give it a warm finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Hermes Un Jardin a Cythere Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère is a fresh, green blend of olive tree, pistachio and citrus.

Christine Nagel created it in 2023. Olive tree, pistachio, citrus and a green accord come together in a calm, nutty and gently woody scent.

Relaxed and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Yves Saint Laurent M7 Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent M7 is a smoky, musky blend of citrus, vetiver and oud.

Alberto Morillas and Jacques Cavallier created it in 2002. Bergamot, mandarin and rosemary open fresh, vetiver and oud form a woody heart, and musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Bold and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Yves Saint Laurent In Love Again Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent In Love Again is a fruity, fresh blend of grapefruit, blueberry and vodka.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 1998. Grapefruit, apple, black currant, blueberry, cassia and vodka open juicy, water lily and rose form a fresh heart, and musk, blackberry, tomato leaf and sandalwood give it a green finish.

Playful and bright, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Xerjoff Alexandria Orientale Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Alexandria Orientale is a rich blend of leather, incense and green apple.

Chris Maurice created it in 2018. Leather, incense, green apple and basil open bold, coriander, Virginia cedar, Bulgarian rose and orris root form an elegant heart, and tobacco leaf, Madagascar vanilla, sandalwood, oud, musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Opulent and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Ex Nihilo Lust in Paradise Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Lust in Paradise is a juicy, airy blend of lychee and peony.

Louise Turner created it in 2019. Pink pepper opens bright, lychee, peony and petalia form a fresh floral heart, and white cedar, musk and amber give it a soft finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid is a fruity blend of peach, orchid and vanilla.

Domitille Michalon Bertier created it in 2021. Peach and vine leaves open juicy, orchid forms a lush heart, and vanilla bean gives it a warm, powdery finish.

Sweet and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Ex Nihilo Jasmin Fauve Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Jasmin Fauve is a lush white floral with jasmine, tuberose and leather.

Launched in 2014, it opens with lily-of-the-valley and lily. Orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine form a rich heart, and ambroxan and leather give it a sensual finish.

Radiant and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Mariage Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Mariage is a sweet floral with osmanthus, tea and orchid.

Olivier Polge, Domitille Michalon Bertier, Carlos Benaim and Dominique Ropion created it in 2021. Bergamot, osmanthus and tea open soft, rose, freesia, jasmine, orange blossom and orchid form a lush heart, and musk and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Romantic and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Ex Nihilo Iris Porcelana Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Iris Porcelana is a cool, powdery blend of violet leaf, iris and musk.

Dalia Izem created it in 2022. Violet leaf opens green, iris and rose form a soft, powdery heart, and cedar, musk and sandalwood give it a clean, woody finish.

Calm and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb In The Sky Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb in the Sky is a fresh blend of citrus, currant buds and rose.

Domitille Michalon Bertier created it in 2020. Grapefruit, bergamot and mandarin open bright, currant buds, lily-of-the-valley and rose form a green heart, and jasmine sambac and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Ex Nihilo Honoré Delights Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Honoré Delights is a soft, musky blend of neroli, orange blossom and iris.

Natalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2020. Bergamot and neroli open bright, orange blossom, iris and ambrette form a powdery heart, and cedar, musk and sandalwood give it a clean finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Thomas Kosmala Brume Radieuse Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala Brume Radieuse is a fruity floral with black currant, peach and coconut.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2018. Black currant syrup opens juicy, rose, peach, coconut and jasmine form a creamy heart, and amber, oud and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Sweet and radiant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Ex Nihilo Gold Immortals Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Gold Immortals is a sweet, fruity blend of pear, peony and vanilla.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2023. Bergamot and pear open juicy, peony and ylang-ylang form a floral heart, and amber, tonka bean and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Smooth and inviting, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Thomas Kosmala No. 4 Neon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala No. 4 Neon is a juicy, sunny blend of yuzu, melon and mango.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2023. Mandarin, yuzu and pomelo open bright, melon, mango and galbanum form a fruity, green heart, and ozonic notes, solar notes and aldehydes give it an airy finish.

Fresh and cheerful, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Ex Nihilo French Affair Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo French Affair is a fresh, mossy blend of litchi, rose and patchouli.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2017. Bergamot, violet leaf and litchi open bright, rose oil, angelica and Atlas cedar form an aromatic heart, and patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss give it an earthy finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring and fall.

title: Thomas Kosmala Crepuscule Ardent Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala Crépuscule Ardent is a warm leather with saffron, olibanum and suede.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2018. Saffron opens warm, olibanum and jasmine form a smoky heart, and amber, suede and leather give it a sensual finish.

Bold and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Ex Nihilo Explicite Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Explicite is a sweet, spicy blend of nutmeg, praline and peony.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2020. Nutmeg and pink pepper open spicy, praline, lily and peony form a soft, sweet heart, and amber, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Playful and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Thomas Kosmala Frenesie Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala Frénésie is a musky floral with magnolia, gardenia and oud.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2018. Magnolia, bergamot and saffron open bright, gardenia, peony, rose and osmanthus form a lush heart, and musk, amber, oud and incense give it a warm finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Ex Nihilo Devil Tender Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Devil Tender is a sweet, fresh rose with peach, grapefruit and suede.

Nadège Le Garlantezec created it in 2016. Bergamot, pink pepper, peach and pink grapefruit open bright, rose petals, rose water, Bulgarian rose and tea form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, white cedar, suede and heliotrope give it a soft finish.

Pretty and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Ex Nihilo Cuir Celeste Par Mathieu Cesar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Cuir Céleste is a soft, musky leather with osmanthus and tea.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Black pepper, galbanum, sage and violet leaf open green, osmanthus, ambrette, tea and jasmine form a soft heart, and Akigalawood, white musk, cypriol, leather and patchouli give it a smooth finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Jo Malone London Blue Agava & Cacao Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Blue Agava & Cacao is a sweet, spicy blend of grapefruit, orchid and cacao.

Jo Malone created it in 2006. Grapefruit, cardamom, linden blossom and red berries open bright, orchid, geranium and lily form a floral heart, and cinnamon, cacao, vetiver, musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Cozy and distinctive, it is a great daytime scent in fall and winter.

title: Boucheron Rose d'Isparta Eau de Parfum Unisex
Boucheron Iris de Syracuse Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Iris de Syracuse, a unisex scent by Boucheron, blends floral, woody, and musky aromas. Unveiled in 2017, this fragrance was crafted by perfumer Nathalie Lorson. It opens with a refreshing cocktail of pear, pepper, and mandarin orange. The heart blossoms with a harmonious mix of iris, heliotrope, and jasmine, leading to a warm finish of white musk, vanilla, and patchouli in the base notes.

title: Guerlain La Cologne Du Parfumeur Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain La Cologne du Parfumeur is a fresh cologne of orange flower, lemon and lavender.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2010. Orange flower, Amalfi lemon, lavender, mint, rosemary, citrus and white musk come together in a clean, aromatic and sparkling scent.

Bright and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Boucheron Feve Tonka de Canaima Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Canaima's Feve Tonka by Boucheron presents a unisex scent in the Amber Vanilla olfactory family. Recently introduced to the market in 2022, this novel scent is the creative work of perfumer Alexis Dadier. It opens with the crisp scents of Bitter Almond and delicate Violet. The heart of the fragrance is a rich blend of Tonka Bean, earthy Patchouli, and elegant Rose. Anchoring the composition are the warm and comforting base notes of creamy Vanilla, smooth Sandalwood, and resinous Labdanum.

title: Givenchy Faux Semblant Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Givenchy Faux Semblant is a warm, sweet blend of olibanum, honey and oud.

Launched in 2023, it opens with olibanum and angelica. Patchouli, amber, honey, orange blossom and labdanum form a rich heart, and white sandalwood and oud give it a smooth, woody finish.

Refined and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Bottega Veneta Parco Palladiano V: Lauro Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bottega Veneta's Parco Palladiano V: Lauro is a unisex scent with an aromatic green essence. This fragrance made its debut in 2016 and was crafted by the skilled perfumer Daniela (Roche) Andrier. It opens with fresh top notes of mint and labdanum, unfolds to a herbal heart featuring laurel, sage, rosemary, pepper, tea, and geranium, and settles into a rich vetiver base note.

title: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Viper Green is a sharp, green blend of mandarin, galbanum and vetiver.

Launched in 2017, it opens with mandarin. Galbanum forms a crisp, green heart, and vetiver gives it an earthy, woody finish.

Fresh and bold, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hugo Boss The Collection Confident Oud Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss The Collection Confident Oud is a fresh, spicy take on oud.

Launched in 2021, it centers on oud with an aromatic, fresh and spicy character for a smooth, modern woody scent.

Bold and refined, it is made for winter nights.

title: Ex Nihilo Vesper Glitz Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Vesper Glitz is a bright, sweet floral with neroli, mimosa and vanilla.

Nadège Le Garlantezec created it in 2023. Neroli, pink pepper and mandarin open sparkling, mimosa, ylang-ylang and jasmine form a sunny heart, and cedar, vanilla, musk and tonka bean give it a soft finish.

Glamorous and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled United Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled United is a fresh blend of blood orange, mint and vetiver.

Launched in 2021, it opens with blood orange and buchu. Mint and orris form a cool, powdery heart, and cashmeran, vetiver and patchouli give it a musky, woody finish.

Clean and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Ex Nihilo Outcast Blue Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Outcast Blue is a spicy, woody blend of saffron, cedar and tobacco.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2019. Saffron, black pepper and pink pepper open warm, cedar and lily-of-the-valley form the heart, and tobacco, sandalwood, vetiver, patchouli and oakmoss give it a deep, earthy finish.

Elegant and bold, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco is a warm, spicy tobacco with chestnut.

Launched in 2024, it opens with black pepper, cardamom, pink pepper, elemi and sage. Tobacco, chili pepper, chestnut and cinnamon leaf form the heart, and guaiac wood, Bourbon vanilla, benzoin and amber give it a rich finish.

Made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Ex Nihilo My Sweetest Morphine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo My Sweetest Morphine is a fresh, airy blend of bergamot, lilac and mimosa.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bergamot, lilac and ozonic notes. Mimosa, solar notes and rose form a bright heart, and musk, vetiver and patchouli give it a clean finish.

Light and uplifting, it works day or night in spring.

title: Giorgio Armani Prive Noir Kogane Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Armani Privé Noir Kogane is a warm, smoky blend of tobacco, saffron and leather.

Launched in 2024, it opens with tobacco and Haitian vetiver. Saffron and elemi form a spicy, resinous heart, and leather gives it a smooth, rich finish.

Refined and bold, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Ex Nihilo Musc Infini Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Musc Infini is a sweet, warm musk with grapefruit, rose and vanilla.

Launched in 2014, it opens with grapefruit, Calabrian bergamot and ambrette. Musk, patchouli and rose form the heart, and white musk, vanilla, tonka bean and benzoin give it a smooth finish.

Soft and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Burberry Hero Parfum for Men
description_html: Hero Parfum, crafted by Burberry, presents itself as a distinctively Amber Woody scent tailored for the modern man. A fresh addition to their fragrance lineup, Hero Parfum made its debut in 2024. Upon the first spritz, one is greeted with the inviting aroma of Amyris. The fragrance then unfolds into a robust heart of Cedarwood, before settling into the deep, earthy essence of Cypriol Oil, also known as Nagarmotha, which serves as its foundational base note.

title: Giorgio Armani Bois d'Encens Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Bois d'Encens is a dry, smoky blend of incense, cedar and vetiver.

Michel Almairac created it in 2004. Cedar, vetiver, labdanum and spices come together in a calm, musky and smoky woody scent with a warm, ambery depth.

Refined and meditative, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Giorgio Armani Prive Blanc Kogane Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Blanc Kogane is a clean, powdery blend of aldehydes, jasmine and white musk.

Launched in 2024, it opens with aldehydes and Indian jasmine. White musk and lily form a soft, airy heart, and vetiver and patchouli give it a smooth finish.

Elegant and subtle, it is a lovely night scent.

title: Parfums de Marly Perseus Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Perseus is a crisp, clean citrus with woody depth.

Launched in 2024, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot and black currant. Green mandarin, vetiver and geranium form a fresh heart, and dry woods, ambergris and cashmere wood give it a smooth finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Mancera Tonka Cola Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Tonka Cola is a fizzy, sweet blend of cola, cherry and cinnamon.

Launched in 2022, it opens with cinnamon, cherry, Sicilian lemon and nutmeg. A cola accord, patchouli leaf and orange blossom form the heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin and labdanum give it a warm finish.

Fun and cozy, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Iris Absolu Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Iris Absolu is a sweet, powdery take on La Vie Est Belle with iris.

Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion created it in 2023. Black currant, orange blossom and fig open fruity, orange blossom and jasmine form a floral heart, and iris, a gourmand accord and patchouli give it a soft, powdery finish.

Elegant and sweet, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa is a fresh, fruity rose with litchi and peony.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2018. Litchi, black currant, bergamot and lemon open juicy, rose and peony form a pretty heart, and white musk, Iso E Super, cedar and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Light and romantic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro is a woody rose with coriander and rosewood.

Delphine Jelk created it in 2023. Coriander, lemon and aldehydes open bright, Damask rose, rosewood and geranium form an aromatic heart, and sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Elegant and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Oud Yuzu Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Oud Yuzu is a bright, woody blend of yuzu, oud and cedar.

Delphine Jelk created it in 2023. Zesty yuzu opens fresh, oud forms a smooth, woody heart, and cedar gives it a dry, green finish.

Modern and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Bosca Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Bosca Vanilla is a woody, airy vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bergamot and eucalyptus. Solar notes and immortelle form a warm heart, and vanilla absolute, driftwood and musk give it a soft finish.

Comforting and easy to wear in any season.

title: Floris Lily Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Floris Lily is a fresh, watery floral with white tea and lily-of-the-valley.

Caterina Catalani created it in 2023. Watery notes and white tea open fresh, lily-of-the-valley, jasmine, Bulgarian rose and ylang-ylang form a soft heart, and white musk and cedar give it a clean finish.

Light and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Pasion Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Carolina Herrera introduces a fresh addition to their collection with CH Pasión for Her, a captivating Amber Floral scent crafted for the modern woman. This latest perfume, unveiled in 2023, is the brainchild of perfumers Quentin Bisch and Nisrine Bouazzaoui Grillié. It starts with a harmonious blend of Pear, Bergamot, and Violet Leaf at the top, transitioning into a heart composed of exotic Madagascar Pepper, refined Haitian Vetiver, alluring Jasmine Sambac, and the floral touch of Petalia. The fragrance settles on a rich foundation that fuses the creamy sweetness of Vanilla and Vanillin with the deep notes of Leather and Musk, creating an enchanting trail that lingers.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Pasion Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: CH Pasión for Him by Carolina Herrera embodies a bold Amber Woody scent crafted for the modern man. This freshly introduced cologne made its debut in the fragrance world in 2023. The creative minds behind its unique aroma are perfumers Antoine Maisondieu and Christophe Raynaud. The olfactory journey of CH Pasión for Him begins with invigorating top notes of aromatic Olibanum, vibrant Tunisian Neroli, and a hint of zesty Pink Pepper. As the scent evolves, the heart reveals a harmonious blend of elegant Iris, the warm, balsamic essence of Myrrh, and the woody tones of Texas Cedar. The fragrance gracefully settles into a rich and sensual base of smooth Australian Sandalwood, indulgent Bourbon Vanilla, delightful Tonka Bean, coupled with the deep resonance of Amberwood and mysterious dark woods.

title: Xerjoff Erba Pura Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Erba Pura is a juicy, sweet burst of Mediterranean citrus and fruit.

Christian Carbonnel and Laura Santander created it in 2019. Sicilian orange, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon open bright, a basket of fruits forms the heart, and white musk, Madagascar vanilla and amber leave a sweet, lasting trail.

Joyful and easy to love, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely is a sweet, spiced vanilla made for cooler nights.

Launched in 2019, it opens with pink pepper, juniper and violet. Toffee, cinnamon, lavender and sage form a warm, gourmand heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber and suede leave a soft, sweet finish.

Stronger With You Intensely is cozy, sweet and very easy to like. It is a go-to for fall and winter evenings and date nights.

title: Kayali Fragrances Oudgasm Smoky Oud 07 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Kayali Oudgasm Smoky Oud 07 is a warm blend of rum, saffron and oud.

Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2024. Rum and saffron open warm, geranium, labdanum and jasmine form a rich heart, and patchouli, guaiac wood, oud, vanilla and cedar give it a smoky finish.

Bold and sensual, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden is a green, tropical blend of coconut and fig.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Watery notes, green notes, mint and ginger open fresh, coconut, fig and salt form a creamy heart, and sandalwood and tonka bean give it a warm finish.

Fun and fresh, it is perfect for warm days.

title: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extreme for Men
description_html:
Givenchy Gentleman Society Extrême is a deeper take on Gentleman Society with coffee.

Launched in 2024, it opens with peppermint, clary sage and nutmeg. Coffee, narcissus, orris and vetiver form the heart, and Madagascar vanilla, Australian sandalwood and Himalayan cedar give it a smooth finish.

A refined choice for evenings.

title: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Green Stravaganza Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Green Stravaganza is a bright blend of bergamot, coffee and vetiver.

Launched in 2024, it opens with Calabrian bergamot, moves into a warm coffee heart, and settles into earthy vetiver.

Fresh and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Hawas Ice for Him Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Hawas Ice for Him is a cool, fruity aquatic with a bright citrus opening.

Launched in 2023, it opens with Italian lemon, star anise, apple and Sicilian bergamot. Plum, orange blossom and cardamom form the heart, and moss, driftwood, musk and amber give it a fresh finish.

A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

title: Hugo Boss The Scent Elixir Parfum for Men
description_html:
Hugo Boss The Scent Elixir is a warm, spicy blend of red pepper, lavender and sandalwood.

Launched in 2024, it opens with red pepper, moves into an aromatic lavender heart, and settles into smooth, creamy sandalwood.

Intense and modern, it is made for evenings in spring, fall and winter.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Narjesi Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Narjesi is a sweet, musky blend of rose, saffron and spun sugar.

Launched in 2017, it opens with bergamot, rose, oud, saffron, orange, cardamom, coffee and dried fruits. Patchouli, vetiver, Taif rose, honey, sandalwood, chamomile and vanilla form a warm heart, and civet, leather, spun sugar, castoreum, amber and incense give it a rich finish.

Opulent and sensual, it works day or night in spring and fall.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Haibah Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Haibah is a fruity, leathery blend of oud, saffron and Taif rose.

Launched in 2017, it opens with bergamot, leather, oud, saffron, ginger, peach, pear, pineapple and Taif rose. Ylang-ylang, moss, rose, amber, iris, truffle, jasmine and orchid form a lush heart, and woods, sandalwood, guaiac wood, cedar, Indian oud and patchouli give it a deep finish.

Opulent and intense, it is a great night scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Durra Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Durra is a complex blend of citrus, spices, oud and praline.

Launched in 2017, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot, saffron, cinnamon, cardamom, lavender, mint, raspberry, sea notes and coconut. Oud, ginger, rose, honey, incense, jasmine and leather form a rich heart, and tobacco, vanilla, sandalwood, immortelle, tonka bean and praline give it a sweet finish.

Bold and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Diwan Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Diwan is a fruity, smoky blend of rose, berries, coffee and oud.

Launched in 2017, it opens with grapefruit, rose, oud, cardamom, incense, peach, plum, raspberry and strawberry. Rhubarb, amber, coffee, honey, iris and Taif rose form a rich heart, and olibanum, vanilla, oud, sandalwood, myrrh, leather and tonka bean give it a warm finish.

Opulent and bold, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Baz Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Baz is a dark, rich blend of leather, coffee, incense and tobacco.

Launched in 2017, it opens with bergamot, leather, saffron, cinnamon, coffee, plum and red berries. Ylang-ylang, rose, honey, myrrh, incense and tuberose form a resinous heart, and tobacco, costus, civet, labdanum, vanilla, oud and leather give it a deep finish.

Intense and bold, it is a great night scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Sospiro Perfumes Deep Ocean Amber Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Sospiro Deep Ocean Amber is a musky, balsamic blend of elemi, violet and labdanum.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2023. Elemi and ambrette open aromatic, violet and styrax form a soft heart, and labdanum, benzoin and ambergris give it a warm, resinous finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Liquides Imaginaires Liquide Gold 2022 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Liquides Imaginaires Liquide Gold is a sunny, musky blend of saffron, carrot seed and jasmine.

Nisrine Bouazzaoui Grillié and Quentin Bisch created it in 2022. Saffron and mandarin open bright, coriander, carrot seed, jasmine, orange blossom and solar notes form a golden heart, and white musk, woods, labdanum, vanilla and ambroxan give it a warm finish.

Radiant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Electimuss Mercurial Cashmere Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Mercurial Cashmere is a sweet, musky blend of violet, tuberose and caramel.

Sofia Bardelli created it in 2021. Bergamot, cardamom and pink pepper open bright, violet, ambergris, tuberose and iris form a soft heart, and cashmere wood, vanilla, oud, caramel, cedar and tonka bean give it a warm finish.

Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Bortnikoff Rich Elixir Unisex
description_html: Bortnikoff's 'Rich' is a unisex scent that falls within the Woody Floral Musk olfactory family and represents the latest addition to their fragrance line, having been released in 2023. The creation of this scent is credited to the olfactory expertise of Dmitry Bortnikoff. It begins with an invigorating blend of top notes featuring Sichuan Pepper, Bergamot, and Cardamom, evolving into a heart composed of rich Oud, delicate Jasmine, and earthy Patchouli. The scent comes to a close with a robust base that includes the deep tones of Leather, the forest-like notes of Oakmoss, the warm allure of Amber, and the grassy nuances of Vetiver.

title: Diptyque Geranium Odorata Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Guaranteed to evoke mixed feelings, Geranium Odorata eau de toilette celebrates a flower typically seen adorning a lapel, rather than trailing in one's wake. It boldly challenges traditional norms by complementing men's skin with a blend of citrus fruits and spices. Simultaneously, akin to the versatility of a tuxedo, it stands out as an exquisite fragrance choice for women.

title: Xerjoff Torino23 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Torino23 is a musky floral with bergamot, tuberose and cashmere wood.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bergamot, rose, nutmeg and cardamom. Jasmine, neroli, tuberose and ylang-ylang form a lush heart, and cashmere wood, cedarwood, musk, amber and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Xerjoff Aurum Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Aurum is a sweet, rich blend of citrus, chocolate and strawberry.

Launched in 2023, it opens with lemon, Bulgarian rose, Calabrian bergamot and Brazilian orange. Labdanum, incense, chocolate and strawberry form a gourmand heart, and patchouli, Madagascar vanilla, oud, heliotrope and oakmoss give it a warm finish.

Luxurious and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Initio Parfums Prives Narcotic Delight Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Initio Narcotic Delight is a dark, boozy blend of cherry, cognac and tobacco.

Launched in 2024, it opens with black pepper, pink pepper and cherry. Cognac and hedione form the heart, and tobacco and vanilla give it a sweet, smoky finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Over Red Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Over Red is a juicy cherry take on Black Opium.

Nathalie Lorson, Honorine Blanc, Marie Salamagne and Olivier Cresp created it in 2024. Cherry and green mandarin open bright, jasmine, orange blossom and black tea form the heart, and vanilla, coffee and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Rasasi Orchid Prairie Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Rasasi Orchid Prairie is a musky blend of rose, cashmeran and oud.

Launched in 2013, it opens with rose, florals and geranium. Coumarin, cashmeran and oud form a woody heart, and musk, amber, vanilla and oud give it a warm finish.

Sensual and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Lady Million is a sweet, fruity floral with raspberry, gardenia and honey.

Béatrice Piquet, Anne Flipo, Bruno Jovanovic and Dominique Ropion created it in 2010. Neroli, Amalfi lemon and raspberry open juicy, gardenia, orange flower and jasmine form a white floral heart, and white honey, amber and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Glamorous and bold, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Creed Queen of Silk Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Creed Queen of Silk is a luxurious blend of magnolia, tuberose and oud.

Launched in 2024, it opens with magnolia, saffron and osmanthus. Passion fruit, tuberose, patchouli and oud form a rich heart, and myrrh, ambroxan, cedarwood, vanilla and incense give it a warm finish.

Elegant in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: House Of Sillage Whispers of Innocence for Women
description_html:
House of Sillage Whispers of Innocence is a soft, sweet blend of linden blossom, jasmine and vanilla.

Launched in 2017, it opens with violet leaf and linden blossom. Egyptian jasmine and beeswax form a honeyed heart, and amber and vanilla give it a warm, powdery finish.

Gentle and sweet, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: House Of Sillage Love is in the Air Parfum for Women
description_html:
House of Sillage Love Is in the Air is a fruity floral with plum, rose and jasmine.

Mark Buxton created it in 2012. Orange, green notes, plum and citrus open juicy, cedar, rose and jasmine form a floral heart, and white musk and patchouli give it a soft finish.

Romantic and pretty, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: House Of Sillage Benevolence Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
House of Sillage Benevolence is a sweet, soft blend of bitter almond, orange blossom and vanilla.

Francis Camail created it in 2012. Bergamot, star anise and bitter almond open bright, orange blossom, lavender and jasmine form a floral heart, and musk, sugar and Madagascar vanilla give it a powdery finish.

Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Amouage Honour Woman Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Honour Woman by Amouage is a sophisticated fragrance with an Amber Floral profile, skillfully crafted for women. This exquisite scent made its debut in 2011, brought to life by the creative perfumers Alexandra Carlin and Violaine Collas. The scent opens with a vibrant blend of top notes featuring the sharp tang of Rhubarb, spicy Pepper, and aromatic Coriander. As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a heart overflowing with the scents of lush Gardenia, creamy Tuberose, delicate Jasmine, the fresh florals of Lily-of-the-Valley, and the spicy sweetness of Carnation. The fragrance culminates in a rich base of warm Amber, mystical Incense, the exotic resin of Opoponax, earthy Vetiver, and the smoothness of Leather, ensuring a lasting impression.

title: Xerjoff Erba Gold Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Erba Gold is a sweet, sunny blend of citrus, fruits and vanilla.

Launched in 2016, it opens with Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon and orange. A basket of fruits forms the heart, and white musk, amber and Madagascar vanilla give it a smooth finish.

Joyful and easy to wear in every season.

title: Penhaligon's Clandestine Clara 2017 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Penhaligon's Clandestine Clara is a warm, sweet blend of rum, cinnamon and vanilla.

Launched in 2017, it blends amber, patchouli, vanilla, woods, cinnamon and rum into a rich, spicy and comforting scent.

Cozy and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Nishane Hacivat Oud Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Hacivat Oud is a fruity, smoky blend of pineapple, frankincense and oud.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2023. Black pepper, pink pepper, pineapple and citrus open bright, frankincense, olibanum and jasmine form a smoky heart, and oud, Haitian vetiver, vanilla and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Bold and versatile, it works day or night from summer through winter.

title: Montale Herbal Aquatica Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Herbal Aquatica is a fresh blend of herbs, mint and sea notes.

Launched in 2022, it opens with herbal notes, mint, sage and Calabrian bergamot. Papyrus, caramel, sea notes, lotus and green tea form a breezy heart, and vanilla sugar, amber and Australian sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Fresh and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Liquides Imaginaires Phantasma Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Liquides Imaginaires Phantasma is a fresh, musky blend of yuzu, rice and black tea.

Anne-Sophie Behaghel created it in 2020. Musk, ginger, juniper, rice, woods, yuzu and black tea come together in a light, sweet and airy scent.

Calm and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Liquides Imaginaires Lacrima Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Liquides Imaginaires Lacrima is a soft, leathery blend of benzoin, castoreum and rosewood.

Anne-Sophie Behaghel created it in 2020. Benzoin, castoreum, pink pepper, moss, rosewood and elemi come together in a warm, musky and woody leather scent.

Smooth and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Liquides Imaginaires Bête Humaine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Liquides Imaginaires Bête Humaine is an earthy blend of cumin, chestnut and woods.

Amélie Bourgeois created it in 2021. Cumin, violet leaf, chestnut and mastic open green, labdanum, woods, cedar and sandalwood form a warm heart, and pine, cypriol, papyrus, guaiac wood and vetiver give it a balsamic finish.

Natural and grounded, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Liquides Imaginaires Beaute du Diable Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Liquides Imaginaires Beauté du Diable is an aromatic blend of absinthe, gin and vetiver.

Louise Turner created it in 2019. Absinthe, coriander, gin, Italian lemon and bitter orange open bright, ylang-ylang, clove, cypress, geranium and carnation form a spicy heart, and Haitian vetiver, labdanum and guaiac wood give it a woody finish.

Bold and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Kajal Masa Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Kajal Masa is a fresh, fruity blend of grapefruit, mirabelle and ginger.

Marc Daniel Heimgartner created it in 2023. Grapefruit, bergamot, ginger and mirabelle open bright, cardamom, watery notes, patchouli and petitgrain form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, violet, vetiver, guaiac wood and cedar give it a soft finish.

Light and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Kajal Faris Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Kajal Faris is a fresh, aromatic blend of citrus, lavender and spice.

David Chieze and Urs Castelletti created it in 2022. Bergamot, lemon, orange, lavender, juniper berries and apple open bright, clove, rose, coriander, nutmeg and jasmine form a spicy heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean, patchouli and amber give it a warm finish.

Versatile and polished, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Gritti Noctem Arabs Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Gritti Noctem Arabs is a warm, woody blend of tobacco, oud and myrrh.

Launched in 2014, it opens with patchouli, tobacco and cedar. Oud and sandalwood form a woody heart, and musk, myrrh and amber give it a sweet, resinous finish.

Rich and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Gritti Gossip Night Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Gritti Gossip Night is a creamy gourmand of litchi, whipped cream and caramel.

Luca Gritti created it in 2023. Heliotrope, litchi and mango blossom open fruity, whipped cream, white peach and caramel form a sweet heart, and white musk, Madagascar vanilla and cashmeran give it a soft finish.

Playful and cozy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Gritti Fenice Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Gritti Fenice is a fruity blend of peach, passionfruit and orange blossom.

Luca Gritti created it in 2020. Peach and passionfruit open juicy, amber, orange blossom, lily and magnolia form a floral heart, and musk, woods and jasmine give it a soft finish.

Bright and pretty, it is a lovely scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Gritti Chantilly Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Gritti Chantilly is a sweet, fruity blend of melon, strawberry and vanilla.

Luca Gritti created it in 2018. Bergamot, orange, mandarin, melon and strawberry open juicy, apple, florals, cassis and coconut form a creamy heart, and musk, vanilla and powdery notes give it a soft finish.

Cheerful and light, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Heritage Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance du Bois Heritage is a fresh, powdery blend of bergamot, incense and oud.

François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2016. Bergamot and aldehydes open bright, incense, florals, orris root and jasmine form an elegant heart, and woods, vanilla, oud, sandalwood and cedar give it a smooth finish.

Refined and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Ex Nihilo Atlas Fever Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Atlas Fever is a sweet, woody blend of incense, red berries and vanilla.

Shyamala Maisondieu created it in 2017. Incense and red berries open bright, narcissus forms a floral heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, guaiac wood, cedar, tonka bean and oak give it a warm finish.

Smooth and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Ex Nihilo Amber Sky Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Amber Sky is a warm, aromatic blend of bergamot, nutmeg and vanilla.

Olivier Pescheux created it in 2016. Bergamot and coriander open fresh, nutmeg and geranium form a spicy heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, cedar, tonka bean and amber give it a smooth finish.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Diptyque L'Eau des Hesperides Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: L'Eau des Hesperides, crafted by Diptyque, presents a unisex aromatic scent that made its debut in 2008. Perfumer Olivier Pescheux is the mastermind behind its creation. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of top notes, including bitter orange, fresh grass, petitgrain, Mandarin orange, fragrant rosemary, zesty lemon, aromatic caraway, and a hint of pepper. At its heart lies a refreshing mix of mint along with a bouquet of floral notes. The scent concludes on a warm and earthy base with the distinct presence of immortelle, soft musk, and rich cedar.

title: Bortnikoff Marrakesh Elixir Unisex
description_html: Bortnikoff's Marrakesh is a unisex scent characterized by its Woody Spicy profile. Recently introduced to the market in 2023, this fresh fragrance has been expertly crafted by perfumer Dmitry Bortnikoff. It opens with an invigorating blend of Black Pepper, Nutmeg, and Tunisian Orange Blossom at the top. The heart of the scent is a harmonious fusion of elemi, succulent Nectarine, airy Hedione, and intoxicating Jasmine. Anchoring the composition are the rich and deep base notes of Oud, luscious Vanilla Absolute, and warm Benzoin.

title: Bortnikoff Dream Elixir Unisex
description_html: Dream, crafted by Bortnikoff, is a unisex scent with a rich Amber Floral profile. Freshly unveiled in 2023, this fragrance is an avant-garde addition to the olfactory world. The creative force of perfumer Dmitry Bortnikoff is palpable in its composition. The fragrance greets you with an opening of Mysore Sandalwood and Champaca. At its heart, a harmonious blend of Pistachio and Black Currant unfolds. Laying the foundation, the base is composed of luxurious Vanilla Absolute, Caraway, and Benzoin.

title: Atelier des Ors Choeur Des Anges Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Atelier des Ors' Choeur Des Anges is a unisex scent with a floral essence. This fragrance made its debut in 2018. It opens with the zesty sweetness of Blood Orange, complemented by the freshness of Pear and the tartness of Black Currant. At the heart, you'll find a delicate blend of Osmanthus, earthy Carrot Seeds, and the gentle aroma of Orange Blossom. The scent settles into a rich base of warm Honey, deep Amber, and woody Cedar notes.

title: Amouage Lineage Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Lineage, crafted by the prestigious brand Amouage, is a bold Amber and Spicy scent suitable for both women and men. Recently unveiled in 2023, this fragrance is the creative brainchild of perfumer Karine Vinchon Spehner. Its composition begins with an invigorating medley of top notes, featuring the zest of Ginger, the bite of Sichuan Pepper, the exotic richness of Saffron, and the warmth of Peruvian Pepper. The heart of the fragrance is a resonant blend of sacred Olibanum, aromatic Fenugreek, and the deep, mystical essence of Myrrh. The scent concludes with a robust foundation of base notes, including the reverent duo of Olibanum and Myrrh, complemented by earthy Vetiver, resinous Labdanum, sweet Benzoin, and the grounding touch of Patchouli.

title: Akro Bake Eau de Parfum Unisex
Yves Saint Laurent Y Elixir for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Elixir is a deep, smoky blend of lavender, oud and frankincense.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2024. Lavender opens aromatic, geranium forms a fresh heart, and oud and frankincense give it a rich, resinous finish.

Intense and modern, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir for Men
description_html: Carolina Herrera introduces Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir, an alluring new scent for men, which debuted in 2024. The fragrance begins with a vibrant blend of Black Pepper and Sage at the top. Its heart is a sophisticated mix featuring the rich, earthy aroma of Truffle, accompanied by the essence of Woodsy Notes. Anchoring the fragrance, the base reveals a warm and inviting combination of Vanilla and Frankincense.

title: Mind Games Lionora Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Lionora is a soft, fruity floral with passionfruit, apricot and osmanthus.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2023. Passionfruit, tonka bean and Madagascar ginger open bright, apricot skin, osmanthus and freesia form a velvety heart, and sandalwood and musk give it a smooth finish.

Warm and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Mancera Wild Cherry Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Wild Cherry is a sweet, musky blend of cherry, heliotrope and vanilla.

Pierre Montale created it in 2016. Bergamot, lemon and cherry open juicy, heliotrope, patchouli, orris and jasmine form a powdery heart, and white musk and Madagascar vanilla give it a soft finish.

Playful and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Clive Christian X Twist Patchouli Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: X Patchouli is an exclusive fragrance from Clive Christian, crafted for men and debuted in 2018. Characterized by its earthy and spicy aroma, this perfume boasts superior longevity. It remains in production to this day.

title: Clive Christian L for Women
description_html: Clive Christian's L for Women is an aromatic blend that falls under the Floral Fruity category, crafted specifically for the feminine olfactory experience. This scent was first introduced to the world in the year 2014. It opens with a spirited burst of Pink Pepper, Artemisia, Black Pepper, and White Pepper at the top. Progressing to the heart of the fragrance, one is enveloped in the luxurious essence of Damask Rose paired with the delicate allure of Jasmine. Concluding its fragrant journey, the base is anchored by the earthy richness of Patchouli and Vetiver, the woody tones of Cedar, and a final whisper of sweet Vanilla.

title: Tom Ford Oud Minerale 2023 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Oud Minérale is a salty, marine take on oud.

Launched in 2023, it blends marine notes and oud with a soft ambergris accord for a cool, mineral and gently woody scent.

Unusual and refreshing, it works for days and evenings alike.

title: Versace Atelier Gingembre Petillant Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Versace Atelier Gingembre Pétillant is a sweet blend of ginger, white flowers and praline.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2021. Ginger opens sparkling, white flowers form a soft heart, and vanilla and praline give it a sweet finish.

Fresh and cozy, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Tom Ford Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Vanilla Sex is a creamy vanilla with bitter almond and sandalwood.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bitter almond. Florals and vanilla form a soft heart, and tonka bean, sandalwood, vanilla absolute and Ultravanil give it a rich, powdery finish.

Indulgent and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Hyakutake Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Hyakutake is an aromatic blend of eucalyptus, orris and tobacco.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2023. Lemon, cardamom, eucalyptus and bergamot open fresh, orris, ambergris, incense and pansy form a soft heart, and tobacco, Australian sandalwood, musk, Haitian vetiver and larch give it a woody finish.

Distinctive and smooth, it works day or night.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Chiron Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Chiron is a sweet, woody blend of tonka, tobacco and palo santo.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2021. Musk, tonka bean and vanilla orchid open soft, tobacco and ambergris form a warm heart, and sandalwood, white oud, palo santo and Bourbon vanilla give it a smooth finish.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Burdel Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Burdel is a warm, woody blend of labdanum, cardamom and oud.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2020. Labdanum, cumin, bergamot and cardamom open spicy, gurjan balsam, cypriol, guaiac wood and lily-of-the-valley form a woody heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, ambergris, Indian oud and musk give it a rich finish.

Refined and warm, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Borelli Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Borelli is a fresh floral with frangipani, violet and sandalwood.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2023. Calabrian bergamot, aldehydes, frangipani and Sicilian mandarin open bright, ylang-ylang, violet, lily-of-the-valley, Bulgarian rose and tuberose form a lush heart, and birch, sandalwood, vanilla, ebony and musk give it a warm finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Akragas Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Akragas is a salty, aromatic blend of grapefruit, myrtle and thyme.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2022. Grapefruit, neroli, myrtle and seaweed open fresh, geranium, red thyme, salt and Atlas cedar form a Mediterranean heart, and patchouli, musk, benzoin and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Breezy and refined, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Roja Parfums H The Exclusive Black Tier Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja H The Exclusive Black Tier is a dark, leathery blend of violet, raspberry and oud.

Roja Dove created it in 2016. Bergamot opens bright, violet, raspberry, rose de mai and jasmine form a fruity heart, and orris root, birch, pepper, saffron, labdanum, vanilla, oud, sandalwood, suede, ambergris and myrrh give it a rich finish.

Luxurious and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Roja Parfums Harrods Pour Homme Parfum for Men
description_html:
Roja Harrods Pour Homme is a fresh, classic blend of citrus, neroli and oakmoss.

Roja Dove created it in 2019. Bergamot, neroli, lemon, bitter orange, lime, geranium, violet and juniper meet musk, patchouli, vetiver, vanilla, labdanum, cashmere wood and oakmoss for a bright, aromatic and woody scent.

Polished and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Roja Parfums Harrods Aoud Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja Harrods Aoud is a rich, resinous blend of rose, olibanum and oud.

Roja Dove created it in 2019. Artemisia, aldehydes and citrus open bright, rose de mai forms a lush heart, and olibanum, cinnamon, cashmere wood, labdanum, vanilla, oud, sandalwood, benzoin, myrrh and musk give it a deep finish.

Opulent and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Ralph Lauren Polo Cologne Intense Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Ralph Lauren Polo Cologne Intense is a fresh, green blend of grapefruit, mint and vetiver.

Launched in 2021, it opens with grapefruit, mint and basil. Violet leaf, clary sage and thyme form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, vetiver and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Crisp and confident, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Golden Oud Parfum for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Golden Oud is a spicy, leathery oud with saffron and sandalwood.

Christophe Raynaud created it in 2023. Bergamot, saffron, nutmeg and black pepper open bright, labdanum, iris, gurjan balsam and cedarwood form the heart, and oud, sandalwood, leather and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Bold and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Ormonde Jayne Nawab of Oudh Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ormonde Jayne Nawab of Oudh is a bright, spicy oud with rose and orchid.

Geza Schoen created it in 2012. Bergamot, orange, cardamom, green notes and aldehydes open fresh, hedione, rose, magnolia, pimento, orchid, bay leaf and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and labdanum, oud, vetiver, ambergris and musk give it a rich finish.

Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Ormonde Jayne Indus Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ormonde Jayne Indus is a fruity, spicy blend of litchi, rose and plum.

Linda Pilkington created it in 2020. Nutmeg, black currant blossom and litchi open bright, rose forms a floral heart, and musk, patchouli, plum and incense give it a warm finish.

Elegant and warm, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Montblanc Starwalker Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Montblanc Starwalker is a fresh, musky citrus with bamboo and soft spice.

Michel Almairac created it in 2005. Bergamot, mandarin and bamboo open bright, cedar, white musk and sandalwood form a smooth heart, and ginger, amber, nutmeg and fir resin give it a warm finish.

Clean and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Montblanc Individuel Tonic Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Montblanc Individuel Tonic is a fresh, aromatic blend of herbs, citrus and oakmoss.

Pierre Bourdon created it in 2018. Bergamot, cinnamon, coriander, cardamom, lavender, juniper, mint, rosemary and pineapple open bright, violet, orange blossom, geranium and jasmine form the heart, and vanilla, amber, sandalwood, vetiver, chocolate and oakmoss give it a mossy finish.

Fresh and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Montblanc Emblem Absolu Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Montblanc Emblem Absolu is a fruity, aromatic blend of pear, honey and lavender.

Launched in 2017, it opens with cardamom, mandarin and pear. Honey, fruits, lavender and pink pepper form a sweet heart, and moss, vetiver and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Mizensir Very Musc Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mizensir Very Musc is a sweet, musky blend of lemon, clary sage and vanilla.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Lemon, ambroxan and clary sage open fresh, musk, tonka bean, animalic notes and ylang-ylang form a warm heart, and Madagascar vanilla and incense give it a sweet finish.

Sensual and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Mizensir Tender Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mizensir Tender Oud is a fresh, musky oud with grapefruit, saffron and maté.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Grapefruit, saffron and cardamom open bright, sea notes, cypriol and maté form an airy heart, and musk and Atlas cedar give it a woody finish.

Light and versatile, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

title: Mizensir Incensum Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mizensir Incensum is a dark, smoky blend of ginger, myrrh and incense.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Ginger opens warm, myrrh and incense form a resinous heart, and woods, papyrus and leather give it a smoky finish.

Deep and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood is a woody blend of grapefruit, cedar and apricot.

Launched in 2019, it opens with grapefruit, cardamom and elemi. Virginia cedar, apricot, sandalwood and ambroxan form a warm heart, and Haitian vetiver, patchouli and woods give it an earthy finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Shades of Kolam Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Shades of Kolam is a fresh citrus with green tea and cedar.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2020. Grapefruit, bergamot and cardamom open bright, green tea and coriander form a calm heart, and cedar and cashmeran give it a soft, musky finish.

Clean and relaxed, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Issey Miyake Nuit d’Issey Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Issey Miyake Nuit d'Issey is a dark, leathery blend of grapefruit, pepper and incense.

Dominique Ropion and Loc Dong created it in 2014. Grapefruit and bergamot open bright, spices, woods, vetiver, leather and black pepper form the heart, and tonka bean, ebony, incense and patchouli give it a smoky finish.

Bold and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Issey Miyake LEau dIssey Pour Homme Vetiver Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Vétiver is a fresh blend of clary sage, ginger and vetiver.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2023. Clary sage, ginger, Haitian vetiver and watery notes come together in a clean, green and lightly spicy scent.

Fresh and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Issey Miyake Fusion d'Issey Extrême Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Issey Miyake Fusion d'Issey Extrême is a sweet, aromatic blend of lavender, mint and coconut.

Nathalie Lorson created it in 2021. Bergamot and cardamom open fresh, lavender, mint, coconut and mineral and solar notes form the heart, and sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, woody finish.

Easy and bright, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Guerlain Bois Mysterieux Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Bois Mystérieux is a dark, woody blend of neroli, patchouli and leather.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Neroli and laurel open fresh, patchouli, Atlas cedar and jasmine form a woody heart, and leather and myrrh give it a smoky, resinous finish.

Elegant and moody, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: EIGHT & BOB Annicke 3 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Launched in 2018, Annicke 3 from EIGHT & BOB is a sophisticated Chypre Floral scent specifically crafted for women. This enticing fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of top notes including succulent Red Berries, zesty Bergamot, and the citrusy tang of Mandarin Orange. At its heart lies a floral bouquet of pure White Rose, lush Gardenia, and the exotic allure of Jasmine. The composition gracefully settles into a warm and creamy foundation featuring opulent Cashmere Wood and smooth Sandalwood, enriched by the sweet whisper of Meringue notes in the base.

title: EIGHT & BOB Annicke 2 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Annicke 2, crafted by EIGHT & BOB, is a women's fragrance with an Amber Floral scent profile. Introduced in 2018, this perfume opens with top notes of Hazelnut, Fig, and Mandarin Orange, transitions into a heart of Immortelle, Ylang-Ylang, and Tuberose, and settles into a warm base of Sandalwood, Vanilla, and Cedar.

title: EIGHT & BOB Annicke 1 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Annicke 1 from EIGHT & BOB is a sophisticated women's scent that belongs to the Floral Woody Musk olfactory family. This fragrance made its debut in the year 2018. It opens with the fresh and inviting aromas of Peony, Ivy, and Mandarin Orange at the top. Progressing to the heart of the perfume, one encounters the delicate and aromatic blend of Cyclamen, Jasmine, and Lily-of-the-Valley. The scent settles with a grounding harmony of Driftwood and White Musk serving as the base notes.

title: Dunhill Nordic Fougere Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Nordic Fougère, a men's fragrance with aromatic fougere qualities, is a recent creation from Alfred Dunhill. Introduced in 2022, this scent is the collaborative brainchild of perfumers Michel Almairac and Jérôme Epinette. It opens with an invigorating blend of basil, cardamom, and black pepper at the top. The heart is a refreshing composition of bamboo leaf, kumquat, and geranium. The scent settles into a warm and earthy base where vanilla, sandalwood, and patchouli provide a rich finish.

title: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Alfred Dunhill's Mongolian Cashmere is a contemporary men's scent marked by its floral character. Recently introduced in 2022, this scent is the creative invention of perfumer Julie Pluchet. It opens with the crisp, citrusy aroma of Mandarin Orange, coupled with the spicy zing of Pink Pepper. The heart of the fragrance is a harmonious blend of Orris, Geranium, and Rose, leading to a rich base that combines the luxurious softness of Suede with the warmth of Musk and Amber.

title: D.S. & DURGA Durga Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Durga, crafted by DS&Durga, is a women's fragrance that radiates with floral and green scents. It made its debut in 2017, with the olfactory expertise of perfumer David Seth Moltz. This scent opens with the fresh top notes of melon, tuberose, and chrysanthemum. It then transitions into a heart featuring the smooth blends of orris, ylang-ylang, and orange blossom. Anchoring the fragrance are the base notes, drawing upon the richness of tuberose, the sweet intensity of jasmine sambac, and the warmth of musk.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Incenso Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Velvet Incenso by Dolce & Gabbana presents itself as a masculine scent with an Amber Woody profile. Unveiled in 2018, its olfactory journey commences with the spicy warmth of black pepper and the citrus-like freshness of elemi at the top. As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a heart rich with the sacred aromas of incense and the sweet, leathery nuances of labdanum. Anchoring this sophisticated blend are the comforting and deep base notes of resinous benzoin, the modern touch of amberwood, creamy vanilla, earthy patchouli, and the luxurious softness of cashmere wood.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Cypress Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Velvet Cypress, a creation by Dolce & Gabbana, is a unisex scent that belongs to the Woody Aromatic olfactory category. This fragrance made its debut in 2017. It features an opening with the zesty freshness of Sicilian Lemon and the citrusy tang of Bergamot. At its heart lies a blend of the lush, evergreen Cypress, the green sharpness of Galbanum, and the herbaceous warmth of Clary Sage. Anchoring the scent is the grounding essence of Cedar in its base note.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Black Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Introducing Velvet Black Patchouli, a new and captivating unisex scent from Dolce & Gabbana, falling within the Amber Woody olfactory family. Unveiled to the world in 2021, this aromatic creation carries the masterful signature of perfumer Rodrigo Flores-Roux. At its opening, a blend of Davana, Blood Orange, and Papyrus greets the senses, heralding the heart where Patchouli mingles seamlessly with Clary Sage and a hint of Coriander. The experience culminates in a rich base of Vanilla, intertwined with the sweetness of Caramel and the depth of Tonka Bean.

title: Christian Dior Ambre Nuit Limited Edition 2022 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The new limited edition Ambre Nuit New Look by Dior presents a unisex scent, belonging to the Amber Floral olfactory family. Freshly introduced to the world in 2022, this latest creation carries the signature craftsmanship of perfumer Francois Demachy. It starts with vibrant top notes of Bergamot and Grapefruit, leading into a heart of exquisite Turkish Rose paired with the spicy zing of Pink Pepper. The scent culminates in a rich base featuring warm Amber, the woody essence of Guaiac Wood, alongside earthy Patchouli, and the soft, balsamic tones of Cedar.

title: Carolina Herrera Virgin Mint Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Carolina Herrera introduced Virgin Mint, a unisex aromatic scent, in 2017. This fragrance opens with the citrusy zest of Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. At its heart, it features a harmonious blend of Geranium and Vetiver. The composition is rounded off with a refreshing base of Mint and the clean aroma of White Musk.

title: Carolina Herrera Orange Affair Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Carolina Herrera's Orange Affair is a unisex scent belonging to the Floral Fruity olfactory family, unveiled in 2017. The fragrance opens with zesty top notes of Citron, Petitgrain, and Mandarin Orange. At its heart, a harmonious blend of Orange Blossom, Rhubarb, and Almond unfolds. The scent concludes with a warm foundation of Tonka Bean and Musk.

title: BYREDO Deep Viola Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: "Byredo's Deep Viola is a contemporary unisex scent that belongs to the Amber Floral olfactory family. It represents one of the brand's recent creations, having been introduced in the year 2020. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of top notes including the earthy green of Angelica, the rich warmth of Saffron, and the citrusy zest of Bergamot. At its heart, it features a harmony of floral and refined notes with Violet and Iris, accompanied by the bold character of Leather. The scent culminates in a deep, enchanting base where the resinous essence of Olibanum meets the exoticism of Agarwood (Oud) and the sweet, creamy undertones of Vanilla."

title: Brioni Eclat Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Brioni's Eau de Parfum Eclat is a contemporary men's scent, freshly released in 2022. Conceived by the renowned perfumer Michel Almairac, this modern fragrance opens with the zesty and invigorating scents of Grapefruit, the mystic allure of Olibanum, and a hint of spicy Pink Pepper. At its heart lies a harmonious blend of earthy Patchouli with the subtle elegance of Rose. The scent deepens into a warm, sensual base where the softness of Musk, the modern touch of Ambroxan, and the rich woody tones of Sandalwood culminate. This nuanced and exquisitely crafted cologne by Brioni represents a new chapter in their fragrance line.

title: Giorgio Armani Santal Dan Sha Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Santal Dan Sha is a musky, woody blend of cardamom, olibanum and sandalwood.

Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2022. Violet leaf, Calabrian bergamot and cardamom open fresh, musk, elemi and olibanum form a soft heart, and Dreamwood, cedar and sandalwood give it a creamy finish.

Calm and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Giorgio Armani Cuir Amethyste Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Cuir Améthyste is a soft leather with violet, birch and vanilla.

Michel Almairac created it in 2005. Bergamot, rose and coriander open bright, violet, birch and patchouli form a smoky heart, and labdanum, benzoin and Bourbon vanilla give it a warm finish.

Elegant and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Acqua di Parma Sakura Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Acqua di Parma's Sakura Eau de Parfum is a unisex Citrus scent, unveiled in 2019. Its composition begins with top notes of zesty Calabrian bergamot, vibrant Yellow Mandarin, and a hint of spicy Pink Pepper. The heart of the fragrance blooms with delicate Cherry Blossom and exotic Jasmine Sambac, while a warm base of Musk rounds out the olfactory experience.

title: Jimmy Choo Rose Passion Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Jimmy Choo Rose Passion is a sweet, creamy floral with frangipani, coconut milk and vanilla.

Nathalie Lorson created it in 2023. Jasmine and frangipani open bright, orchid and coconut milk form a creamy heart, and vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm, powdery finish.

Sunny and pretty, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever is a sweet, fruity blend of cherry, almond and vanilla.

Louise Turner and Sonia Constant created it in 2022. Rose and bitter almond open soft, cherry, vetiver and jasmine form a fruity heart, and vanilla, amber, tonka bean and oakmoss give it a warm finish.

Glamorous and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Amouage Purpose Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Purpose is a refined blend of incense, papyrus and suede.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Bergamot, olibanum, pimento and pepper open bright and spicy, papyrus, vetiver, rose and sandalwood form a dry heart, and saffron, akigalawood, suede and Mystikal give it a soft finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: M. Micallef Ananda Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
M. Micallef Ananda is a fruity floral with pear, plum and mimosa.

Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2005. Lemon, pear, plum and black currant open juicy, mimosa, ylang-ylang, rose, violet and jasmine form a soft heart, and white musk, vanilla and mimosa give it a powdery finish.

Fresh and pretty, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Roja Parfums Taif Aoud Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja Taif Aoud is a fresh, rich blend of Taif rose, cassis and oud.

Roja Dove created it in 2023. Bergamot and aldehydes open bright, ylang-ylang, clove, cassis, geranium, jasmine and Taif rose form a lush heart, and labdanum, vanilla, oud, benzoin, patchouli, musk and incense give it a warm finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: By Kilian A Kiss from a Rose Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: "A Kiss from a Rose by By Kilian presents itself as a freshly introduced floral scent tailored for women. Unveiled in 2021, this fragrance is a recent addition to the olfactory world. The creative perfumer Alberto Morillas is credited with its conception. The scent captivates with initial top notes of verdant Green Notes and ripe Black Currant. At its heart, the enchanting scents of May Rose and Jasmine Sambac bloom. It culminates in a delicate foundation, where the woody essence of Cypriol Oil, also known as Nagarmotha, intertwines with the purity of White Musk."

title: Kajal Kajal IV Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Kajal IV is a rich blend of davana, rum, leather and dates.

Kevin Mathys created it in 2023. Davana, cardamom, cassis and rum open fruity, jasmine, leather and palm flower form a smooth heart, and Khalas dates, musk, woods and vanilla give it a sweet finish.

Bold and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Kajal Kajal III Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Kajal III is a sparkling blend of grapefruit, lemon soda and ginger.

Kevin Mathys created it in 2023. Grapefruit, lemon zest and a fizzy lemon soda accord open bright, ginger, rosemary, neroli and lavender form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, patchouli, musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Fresh and energizing, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Serge Lutens Serge Noire Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Serge Noire is a dark, smoky blend of ebony wood, spice and incense.
