Christopher Sheldrake and Serge Lutens created it in 2008. Amber, ebony wood, patchouli, woods, cinnamon, incense, spices and clove come together in a deep, balsamic and smoky scent.

Bold and mysterious, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Serge Lutens Un Bois Vanille Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Un Bois Vanille is a creamy, woody vanilla with licorice and coconut milk.

Christopher Sheldrake created it in 2003. Vanilla, black licorice, coconut milk, bitter almond, beeswax and tonka bean meet sandalwood, guaiac wood, benzoin and musk for a smooth, sweet and woody scent.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Serge Lutens Santal Majuscule Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Santal Majuscule is a creamy blend of sandalwood, rose and cacao.

Launched in 2012, it pairs smooth sandalwood with Damask rose and a touch of cacao for a warm, powdery and gently sweet woody scent.

Refined and comforting, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Serge Lutens Poivre Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Poivre Noir is a bold, spicy black pepper.

Launched in 2022, it centers on black pepper and pepper for a sharp, warm and dry scent with a fresh, spicy bite.

Distinctive and lively, it works day or night in spring and fall.

title: Serge Lutens Perilleusement Votre Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Périlleusement Vôtre is a rich blend of rose and oud.

Launched in 2020, it pairs rose with oud for a deep, smooth and quietly smoky floral wood.

Elegant and moody, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Serge Lutens Chergui Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Chergui is a warm blend of tobacco leaf, honey and hay.

Christopher Sheldrake created it in 2005. Iris, rose, amber, musk, sandalwood, incense, honey, tobacco leaf and hay come together in a sweet, dry and glowing scent.

Cozy and iconic, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Juliette Has A Gun Ego Stratis Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Ego Stratis is a fresh, fruity blend of citrus, peach and sea notes.

Launched in 2022, it opens with bergamot, lemon and mandarin. Calone, peach, blueberry, neroli and sea notes form a breezy heart, and cedar, musk and ambroxan give it a clean finish.

Light and airy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Goutal Eau du Sud Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Goutal Eau du Sud is a sunny, aromatic citrus with basil, verbena and oakmoss.

Annick Goutal created it in 1996. Grapefruit, bergamot, mandarin and basil open bright, lemon verbena, mint, lime and jasmine form a fresh heart, and patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss give it a mossy finish.

Crisp and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Goutal Eau d'Hadrien Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Goutal Eau d'Hadrien is a classic, sparkling citrus with lemon and cypress.

Annick Goutal and Francis Camail created it in 1980. Grapefruit, lemon, cypress, mandarin, ylang-ylang, Sicilian lemon, aldehydes and citron come together in a bright, aromatic and lightly woody scent.

Fresh and timeless, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Affinessence Collection Notes de Fond Vanille Benjoin Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Affinessence introduced Vanille Benjoin, a unisex Amber Vanilla scent, in 2015. The olfactory creation of Vanille Benjoin is the expert work of perfumer Corinne Cachen.

title: Affinessence Collection Notes de Fond Musc Ambre Gris Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Launched in 2017, Musc Ambre Gris by Affinessence is a unisex fragrance with a rich amber base. Designed to appeal to both women and men, this scent embodies the essence of ambergris, offering a luxurious olfactory experience.

title: Affinessence Collection Notes de Fond Cuir Curcuma Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Launched in 2017, Cuir Curcuma by Affinessence is a unisex Leather perfume. The olfactory creation is the handiwork of perfumer Alexandra Carlin.

title: Affinessence Collection Notes de Tete Combava Cedrat Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Affinessence introduces Combava Cedrat, a unisex scent under the Citrus Aromatic category. Freshly released, this fragrance made its debut in 2022 with the creative expertise of perfumer Nicolas Bonneville. It opens with the invigorating essence of Kaffir Lime at the top, followed by a harmonious blend of Lime and Mint at the heart. The base is a warm fusion of Cardamom and Wood notes, grounding the scent with depth and character.

title: Affinessence Collection Notes de Fond Cedre Iris Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Affinessence's Cedre Iris is a unisex scent that falls within the Woody Floral Musk olfactory family. This fragrance was introduced to the market in 2015, with its creation attributed to perfumer Nicolas Bonneville.

title: Affinessence Collection Notes de Tete Bergamote Racines Eau de Parfum Unisex
Xerjoff Groove Xcape Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Groove Xcape is a spicy, resinous blend of cardamom, myrrh and incense.

Launched in 2023, it opens with cardamom, ginger, pepper and elemi. Myrrh, mimosa, incense and rose form a warm heart, and cedar, labdanum, benzoin and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Bold and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: M. Micallef Secrets of Love Spiritual Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
M. Micallef Secrets of Love Spiritual is a warm blend of bergamot, cedar and benzoin.

Launched in 2018, it opens with bergamot and pink pepper. Cedar and jasmine form a woody heart, and benzoin, vanilla and ambergris give it a sweet, warm finish.

Calm and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: M. Micallef Secrets of Love Sensual Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
M. Micallef Secrets of Love Sensual is a fresh, musky blend of citrus, orange blossom and vanilla.

Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2016. Lemon, nutmeg, galbanum and grapefruit open bright, orange blossom and jasmine form a white floral heart, and musk, vanilla and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Smooth and sensual, it works day or night in spring and fall.

title: M. Micallef Royal Muska Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
M. Micallef Royal Muska is a soft, fruity musk with peach, raspberry and rose.

Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2008. Peach, raspberry and Turkish rose open juicy, musk, precious woods and ylang-ylang form a soft heart, and musk and benzoin give it a warm finish.

Pretty and gentle, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: M. Micallef Pure Extreme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
M. Micallef Pure Extrême is a soft, musky floral with rose, gardenia and jasmine.

Geoffrey Nejman and Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2015. Rose and gardenia open soft, jasmine forms a luminous heart, and white musk, precious woods and amber give it a powdery finish.

Clean and elegant, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: M. Micallef Osaïto Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
M. Micallef Osaïto is a fresh, aquatic blend of grapefruit, sea notes and myrtle.

Geoffrey Nejman and Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2016. Grapefruit, sea notes and citrus open bright, marigold and myrtle form an aromatic heart, and musk, amber, sandalwood and exotic woods give it a clean finish.

Breezy and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: M. Micallef Mon Parfum Pearl Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
M. Micallef Mon Parfum Pearl is a soft, fruity floral with blackberry, peony and vanilla.

Launched in 2018, it opens with rose, mandarin and blackberry. Heliotrope, peony and May rose form a soft heart, and white musk, powdery notes and vanilla pod give it a gentle finish.

Pretty and fresh, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: M. Micallef Mon Parfum Gold Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
M. Micallef Mon Parfum Gold is a warm, sweet floral with plum, tuberose and incense.

Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2014. Pink pepper, plum, ylang-ylang and tangerine open bright, orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine form a lush heart, and woods, vanilla, incense, musk, amber and smoke give it a warm finish.

Opulent and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: M. Micallef EdenFalls Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
M. Micallef EdenFalls is a soft blend of neroli, coriander and milk mousse.

Geoffrey Nejman created it in 2021. Bergamot, pink pepper and tangerine open bright, neroli, coriander and jasmine form an aromatic heart, and musk, vanilla, milk mousse and patchouli give it a creamy finish.

Light and cozy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: M. Micallef Secrets of Love Delice Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
M. Micallef Secrets of Love Délice is a spicy, fruity blend of plum, cinnamon and oud.

Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2016. Nutmeg, orange and bay leaf open warm, rose, cinnamon and plum form a fruity heart, and vanilla and oud give it a rich finish.

Cozy and seductive, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: D.S. & DURGA Steamed Rainbow Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: DS&Durga's Steamed Rainbow is a unisex scent with aromatic qualities that has only recently been released. The debut of this fragrance was marked in 2023. Created by perfumer David Seth Moltz, the composition opens with zesty top notes of Blood Mandarin, Orange, and Elemi. The heart of the fragrance features a blend of fresh Grass, delicate Almond Blossom, and robust Cedar. Completing the scent profile, the base is anchored by the gentle floral tone of Violet paired with the earthy essence of Vetiver.

title: Daniel Josier Tuberose Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Daniel Josier's Tuberose is a unisex scent that belongs to the Chypre Floral family of fragrances. Crafted by the perfumer Daniel Josier himself, this aroma opens with a vibrant blend of spice-driven top notes, featuring Nutmeg, Tagetes, zesty Grapefruit, and a hint of Pink Pepper. Transitioning into the heart of the fragrance, a lush bouquet emerges with the richness of Tuberose, the purity of White Flowers, the exotic allure of Ylang-Ylang, the sweet comfort of Heliotrope, and the subtle fruitiness of Osmanthus. The experience concludes with a warm and creamy base where Vanilla Flower dances with White Musk, deep Amber, and the earthy touch of Oakmoss.

title: Daniel Josier Mystery Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Mystery Oud, crafted by Daniel Josier, is a unisex Amber Woody scent. The creator of this enchanting aroma is none other than Daniel Josier himself. It opens with a top note quartet composed of Violet, Cumin, Angelica, and Carrot Seeds. The heart of the fragrance beats with a blend of precious Agarwood (Oud), spicy Nutmeg, elegant Iris, mystical Incense, and warming Pimento. The scent culminates in a rich base where Agarwood (Oud) reemerges alongside Amber, supple Leather, resinous Labdanum, and sensual Musk.

title: Daniel Josier Magnolia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Daniel Josier's Magnolia is a blossoming scent crafted specifically for women, emanating a distinctly floral aroma. Conceived by the perfumer Daniel Josier himself, it opens with the zest of Bergamot, the tang of Lemon, and a burst of verdant Green Notes. Its heart flourishes with the soft and creamy petals of Magnolia, the exotic allure of Jasmine, the subtle rarity of Nard Himalayan (Jatamansi), and the classic romance of Rose. The fragrance then settles into an earthy foundation with the woody notes of Vetiver, the musky depth of Patchouli, the sweet whisper of Vanilla, and the rich warmth of Sandalwood.

title: Daniel Josier Le Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Le Musk, crafted by Daniel Josier, is a unisex fragrance that falls under the Floral Woody Musk olfactory category. Created with the artistry of Daniel Josier himself, the fragrance opens with the clean and airy scent of White Musk intertwined with the subtle herbal touch of Angelica. At its heart, the perfume balances the potent essence of Musk with the romantic allure of Rose and the depth of Woody Notes. Anchoring the scent, the base combines the rich warmth of Musk, the sweet balsamic tones of Tonka Bean, and the resinous complexity of Labdanum.

title: Daniel Josier Josune Eau de Parfum Unisex
Daniel Josier Interdit Absente Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Interdit Absente, crafted by the perfumer Daniel Josier, is a unisex scent that falls within the aromatic fruity category. Daniel Josier himself is credited with the fragrance's creation. It opens with a refreshing blend of top notes consisting of mint, zesty pomelo, artemisia, and spicy pimento. The heart of the fragrance features a warming mixture of sharp ginger, aromatic fennel, juicy orange, and a touch of pink pepper. The base concludes with a soothing combination of frosty sorbet, creamy white woods, rich sandalwood, and sensual musk.

title: BORNTOSTANDOUT Unholy Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
BORNTOSTANDOUT Sex & Cognac Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Sex & Cognac, a distinctive unisex scent from BORNTOSTANDOUT®, represents the brand's latest olfactory creation. Introduced to the world in 2022, the artisan behind this aromatic journey is Hamid Merati-Kashani. The fragrance opens with an inviting top note of Saffron, progresses into a heart that seamlessly blends Leather with Papyrus, and finishes with a rich foundation of Cognac and Laotian Oud.

title: BORNTOSTANDOUT Naked Neroli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Unveiled by BORNTOSTANDOUT®, Naked Neroli is a contemporary unisex scent, freshly introduced in 2022. This fragrance was artfully composed by perfumer Daphné Bugey. It opens with a refreshing array of top notes, including zesty Citron, cool Mint, crisp Bergamot, and sweet Mandarin Orange. At its heart lies a rich blend of middle notes featuring the eponymous Neroli, delicate Bulgarian Rose, creamy Tuberose, aromatic Petitgrain Paraguay, and the fragrant Orange Blossom. The scent settles into a warm and inviting base of exotic Jasmine, herbal Basil, smooth Musk, and the woody essence of Guaiac Wood.

title: BORNTOSTANDOUT Hinoki Shower Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The Hinoki Shower scent from BORNTOSTANDOUT® offers a unique olfactory experience designed to appeal to both men and women. As a recent addition to the world of perfumery, it made its debut in 2022 with the expertise of perfumer Frank Voelkl. The fragrance starts with a refreshing blend of top notes, including cypress, pine, and camphor. It then transitions into a heart characterized by the aromas of cedar, assorted woodsy elements, and a hint of thyme. The scent culminates in a rich base comprised of tobacco, vetiver, and the earthy touch of moss.

title: BORNTOSTANDOUT Drunk Lovers Eau de Parfum Unisex
BORNTOSTANDOUT Burnt Roses Eau de Parfum Unisex
Akro Ink Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Ink by Akro is a unisex Floral scent that has recently entered the market. Released in 2022, this fresh addition to the fragrance world was expertly crafted by perfumer Olivier Cresp.

title: Akro Haze Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Haze, crafted by Akro, is a unisex scent with an aromatic, green essence. This fragrance made its debut in 2018 and was created by esteemed perfumer Olivier Cresp. It opens with a refreshing blend of mint, eucalyptus, and absinthe, leading into a singular heart of clary sage. The composition concludes with a rich foundation of patchouli and leather.

title: Xerjoff Cruz del Sur II Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Cruz del Sur II is a juicy, tropical blend of pineapple, guava and mango.

Launched in 2017, it opens with pineapple, apple blossom, guava and mango. Violet leaf, black currant and exotic florals form a lush heart, and milk, vetiver, cedar, dried fruits and musk give it a creamy finish.

Sunny and vibrant, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Serge Lutens Cuir Mauresque Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Cuir Mauresque is a rich, spicy leather with orange flower and amber.

Christopher Sheldrake created it in 1996. Orange flower, amber, musk, styrax, leather, oud, cinnamon, nutmeg, cedar, incense, myrrh, mandarin, caraway, clove and civet come together in a warm, animalic and spicy scent.

Bold and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Vert Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance du Bois Oud Vert Intense is a fresh, green oud with ginger and vetiver.

Olivier Pescheux created it in 2013. Bergamot, cardamom and ginger open bright, nutmeg, coriander and geranium form an aromatic heart, and cedar, musk, oud and vetiver give it a woody finish.

Fresh and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette is the iconic musky floral with orange flower and osmanthus.

Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2003. Orange flower, bergamot and osmanthus open soft, amber and musk form a sensual heart, and vanilla, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Elegant and intimate, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Alfred Dunhill's Icon is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men, released in 2015 and crafted by Carlos Benaim. Opening with Neroli, Bergamot, Black Pepper, and Petitgrain, the scent moves to a heart of Black Pepper, Lavender, Cardamom, Juniper Berries, and Sage before rounding off with a base of Vetiver, Oakmoss, Iris, Leather, and Agarwood (Oud).

title: The Harmonist Desired Earth Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Desired Earth Parfum is a richer take on violet leaf, ambrette and patchouli.

Launched in 2015, it opens green with violet leaf and shiso. Ambrette, juniper and patchouli form a musky, woody heart, and tolu balsam gives it a soft, resinous finish.

Natural and refined, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: The Harmonist Velvet Fire Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Velvet Fire is an aromatic blend of lavender, tobacco leaf and oud.

Launched in 2015, it opens with coriander, lavender and clary sage. Saffron, cypress, tobacco leaf and petitgrain form a warm heart, and musk, tonka bean and oud give it a smooth finish.

Refined and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: The Harmonist Sun Force Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Sun Force is a warm blend of saffron, honey and olibanum.

Guillaume Flavigny created it in 2020. Saffron, Bulgarian rose and pomelo open bright, honey, cardamom and olibanum form a golden heart, and musk, benzoin, sandalwood and vetiver give it a warm finish.

Radiant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: The Harmonist Royal Earth Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Royal Earth is a warm, earthy blend of iris, carrot seed and sandalwood.

Launched in 2015, it opens with bergamot, angelica and carrot seed. Tuscan iris forms a soft, powdery heart, and sandalwood and neroli give it a smooth finish.

Grounded and refined, it works year-round, day or night.

title: The Harmonist Metal Flower Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Metal Flower Eau de Parfum is a fresh rose with aldehydes and patchouli.

Guillaume Flavigny created it in 2015. Rose oxide, aldehydes and orange blossom open sparkling, rose de mai, Bulgarian rose and ylang-ylang form a lush heart, and patchouli and white musk give it a powdery finish.

Elegant and modern, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: The Harmonist Magnetic Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Magnetic Wood Eau de Parfum is a green blend of mandarin, osmanthus and iris.

Guillaume Flavigny created it in 2015. Green mandarin, bergamot and osmanthus open bright, mimosa, daffodil and iris form a soft heart, and cedar, sandalwood and guaiac wood give it a woody finish.

Fresh and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: The Harmonist Golden Wood Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Golden Wood is a sweet, leathery blend of barley, oak and birch.

Launched in 2015, it opens with barley, elemi and yellow mandarin. Cabreuva, black pepper and oak form a woody heart, and birch, tonka bean and leather give it a warm finish.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Nasomatto Sadonaso Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasomatto Sadonaso is a dark, sweet blend of coffee, tobacco and vanilla.

Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2023. Coffee opens rich and roasted, musk, sandalwood and tobacco form a smoky heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, amber and animalic notes give it a warm, powdery finish.

Intense and seductive, it is made for nights out.

title: Amouage Search Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Search is a bright, smoky citrus with pepper and incense.

Alexis Grugeon created it in 2023. Lemon, mandarin and lime open fresh, black pepper, elemi and olibanum form a spicy heart, and cade oil, vetiver and guaiac wood give it a smoky finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

title: Creed Millesime 1849 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Launched in 2013, Millesime 1849 by Creed is a Woody Aromatic fragrance crafted by the renowned nose Olivier Creed. It is designed for both women and men and its top note is Calabrian bergamot. Its middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Patchouli and Cedar, while its base notes are Sandalwood, Bourbon Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud) and Musk.

title: Kayali Eden Sparkling Lychee 39 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Kayali Eden Sparkling Lychee 39 is a juicy, fruity floral with lychee, rose and violet.

Gabriela Chelariu created it in 2023. Black currant, lychee, Italian lemon and red apple open sparkling, Damask rose, candied violet and jasmine sambac form a sweet heart, and sugared amber, cedarwood, musk, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Fun and pretty, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Viktor&Rolf Bonbon Couture Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Viktor&Rolf Bonbon Couture is a sweet blend of peach, caramel and white tobacco.

Cécile Matton and Serge Majoullier created it in 2016. Neroli, mandarin and peach open bright, jasmine sambac, orange blossom and caramel form a sweet heart, and white tobacco, vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Indulgent and playful, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Ajyal Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Ajyal is a bright, fruity floral with citrus, mimosa and loukoum.

Launched in 2023, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot, lemon, mint, sea notes, apple, rhubarb, pear and plum. Jasmine sambac, lavender, mimosa, heliotrope, osmanthus, magnolia, loukoum and cherry blossom form a lush heart, and cedarwood, brown sugar, vanilla, tonka and musk give it a sweet finish.

Fresh and cheerful, it is a great everyday scent.

title: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Eau Fraiche Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: By Kilian's Good Girl Gone Bad Eau Fraiche is a brand new Floral fragrance specifically created for women in 2020. Masterfully crafted by Alberto Morillas, this scent is a blend of Tunisian Orange Blossom, Turkish Rose, Moroccan Rose, Watery Notes, Egyptian Jasmine, Tuberose, and Musk.

title: Maison Margiela REPLICA Under the Stars Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Maison Margiela Replica Under the Stars is a smoky leather with black pepper and labdanum.

Launched in 2023, it opens with black pepper. Leather forms a smooth, musky heart, and labdanum and oud give it a warm, animalic finish.

Moody and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Maison Margiela REPLICA From the Garden Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Maison Margiela Replica From the Garden is a green, fresh blend of tomato leaf and mandarin.

Olivier Cresp created it in 2023. Tomato leaf and green mandarin open crisp, geranium forms an aromatic heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy finish.

Natural and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Lalique Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Lalique Pour Homme Eau de Toilette is a fresh, mossy blend of citrus, lavender and cedar.

Maurice Roucel created it in 1997. Grapefruit, bergamot, lavender, mandarin, rosemary and pomelo open bright, cedar, iris, lily-of-the-valley and jasmine form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, patchouli, amber and oakmoss give it a woody finish.

Classic and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Dazzling Garden for Men
description_html: Carolina Herrera's Bad Boy Dazzling Garden is a brand-new fragrance designed specifically for men. Launched in 2023, this fragrance is composed of top notes of White Pepper, Black Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes of Sage and Cedarwood; and base notes of Cacao, Tonka Bean and Amber.

title: Rasasi Fattan Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
description_html:
Rasasi Fattan Pour Femme is a fresh, woody blend of citrus, cedar and vetiver.

Launched in 2012, it opens with bergamot, lemon and pink pepper. Cedar, vetiver, lily-of-the-valley and patchouli form a woody heart, and amber, benzoin and oakmoss give it a warm finish.

Refined and easy, it is a lovely daytime scent in fall.

title: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme is a sweet floral with peach, tuberose and caramel.

Bergamot, orange, green notes and peach open bright, heliotrope, lily-of-the-valley, jasmine, orchid and tuberose form a soft heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, caramel, patchouli, musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Pretty and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Fabulous Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Lady Million Fabulous is a warm floral with tuberose, ylang-ylang and vanilla.

Anne Flipo created it in 2021. Pink pepper and mandarin open bright, ylang-ylang, tuberose, solar notes and jasmine form a sunny heart, and tonka bean, vanilla and moss give it a warm finish.

Glamorous and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Montale Vetiver Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Vetiver Patchouli is an earthy blend of pink pepper, vetiver and patchouli.

Pierre Montale created it in 2019. Pink pepper and carrot open spicy, vetiver and jasmine form a woody heart, and patchouli leaf gives it an earthy finish.

Natural and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Montale Oud Tobacco Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Oud Tobacco is a warm blend of cumin, oud and tobacco.

Pierre Montale created it in 2020. Cumin, citrus and sumac open spicy, orange blossom, incense and oud form a smoky heart, and tobacco, tonka bean and oud give it a sweet finish.

Rich and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Montale Oudrising Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Oudrising is a smoky leather with black tea, oud and tobacco.

Pierre Montale created it in 2020. Bergamot, leather, pepper and pink grapefruit open bright, labdanum, woods, patchouli, rose, black tea, oud and smoke form a dark heart, and tobacco, vanilla, sandalwood, musk and incense give it a warm finish.

Bold and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Montale Oud Pashmina Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Oud Pashmina is a soft, powdery blend of rose, oud and vanilla.

Pierre Montale created it in 2021. Rose, oud, vanilla and gray musk come together in a smooth, musky and velvety floral scent.

Cozy and elegant, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Hermes Twilly d'Hermes Eau Ginger Hermes Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Ginger is a fresh blend of peony, candied ginger and cedar.

Christine Nagel created it in 2021. Peony opens soft, candied ginger and ginger form a sweet, spicy heart, and cedar gives it a clean, woody finish.

Playful and light, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Gucci Guilty Absolute Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Absolute Pour Femme is a fruity, woody blend of blackberry, rose and patchouli.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2018. Bergamot, pink pepper and blackberry open juicy, woods, Bulgarian rose, cypress and vetiver form the heart, and amber and Indian patchouli give it a warm finish.

Bold and modern, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Dior J'adore Parfum d'Eau Eau de Parfum for Women
Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Eternity For Men by Calvin Klein, an Aromatic Fougere scent for men, was introduced to the world in 1990. The creator of this fragrance is Carlos Benaim, who designed the aroma to begin with Lavender, Lemon, Bergamot, and Mandarin Orange and be followed by Sage, Juniper Berries, Basil, Geranium, Coriander, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Lily, and Lily-of-the-Valley as its middle notes. Finally, the base notes of Sandalwood, Vetiver, Musk, Brazilian Rosewood, and Amber complete the composition.

title: Cartier L'Envol de Cartier Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Cartier's L'Envol de Cartier Eau de Parfum, created by master perfumer Mathilde Laurent, is an amber woody fragrance designed for men and released in 2016. Its top notes include lavender, artemisia and sage, followed by a heart of violet leaf and pepper. The base notes are comprised of honey, iris, guaiac wood, musk, patchouli, amberwood, cedar and vetiver.

title: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette is a fresh, woody fragrance built on three cedars.

Aurélien Guichard created it in 2021. Bergamot opens bright, black pepper and juniper form the heart, and Virginian, Himalayan and Atlas cedar give it a dry, clean finish.

A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

title: Bond No. 9 My New York Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: My New York by Bond No 9 is a unique and fresh Amber Floral scent for both men and women, released in 2020. Michel Almairac, the nose behind this fragrance, has crafted a blend of top notes including Ginger, Pink Pepper and Elemi, middle notes of Rose and Papyrus, and base notes of Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cashmeran.

title: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Code for Women is a smooth blend of lavender, tonka and suede.

Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2021. Bergamot, lemon and lavender open fresh, tonka bean forms a sweet heart, and cedar, musk, vanilla and suede give it a soft, leathery finish.

Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Armaf Odyssey Aqua Edition Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Launched in 2023, Armaf's Odyssey Aqua Edition is a refreshing new Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This one-of-a-kind scent opens with top notes of Artemisia, Orange and Grapefruit, followed by heart notes of Lavender and Mint, and finally finishing with base notes of Patchouli, Ambroxan and Cypress.

title: Armaf Aura Fresh Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Armaf's new Aura Fresh is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for both men and women, released in 2023. The top notes consist of Bergamot, Carambola (Star Fruit), Cardamom and Lemon, followed by Pepper and Sage at its middle, and Amber, Cedar, Musk, Saffron and Woody Notes at the base.

title: Amouage Blossom Love Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Amouage's Blossom Love is a Floral fragrance designed for women, released in 2017. Upon application, the scent opens up with the top notes of Heliotrope and Bergamot, followed by the middle notes of Amaretto, Cherry Blossom, Ylang-Ylang and Rose. The base notes of Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Suede and Amber linger on the skin afterwards.

title: Beyonce Ce Noir Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Introducing Cé Noir by Beyoncé, an enchanting new fragrance designed 
exclusively for women. Launched in 2023, this exquisite scent is a 
symphony of carefully selected notes, beginning with the sweet allure of
 Honey and the zesty freshness of Clementine. At its heart lies a 
captivating blend of Jasmine Sambac and Rose, evoking an essence of 
feminine elegance. The fragrance elegantly concludes with the deep, warm
 undertones of Myrrh and Amber, leaving a lasting impression of 
sophistication and allure. Experience the magic of Cé Noir, a modern 
classic in the making.

title: Montale Vanille Absolu Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Montale Vanille Absolu is a warm, spicy vanilla with cinnamon and clove.

Pierre Montale created it in 2008. Vanilla, cinnamon, clove and woods come together in a rich, powdery and comforting scent.

Cozy and warm, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Ariana Grande Mod Vanilla Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Mod Vanilla, a new Amber Vanilla fragrance from Ariana Grande, was released in 2022. Its top notes consist of Musk, Plum, and Pink Freesia; Praline and Orris Root make up the middle notes; and its base notes are Vanilla and Coconut.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Poggia Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Poggia is a sweet, fruity blend of citrus, passionfruit and vanilla.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2020. Bergamot, lemon, orange and peach open bright, ylang-ylang, passionfruit, green apple, rosemary and Turkish rose form a juicy heart, and musk, vanilla and ambergris give it a soft finish.

Cheerful and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide is a fruity, floral blend of passionfruit, rose and tuberose.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2020. Rose, narcissus, tuberose, Calabrian bergamot and passionfruit come together in a juicy, green and sunny scent.

Vibrant and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Turath Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Turath is a fruity, spicy blend of rose, saffron and balsams.

Launched in 2019, it opens with bergamot, cinnamon, cardamom, coffee, Damask rose, peach, pineapple, black currant and strawberry. Rose, violet, saffron, iris, oud and sandalwood form a rich heart, and civet, Peru and tolu balsam, labdanum, vanilla, ambergris and incense give it a warm finish.

Opulent and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Roja Parfums A Midsummer Dream Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja A Midsummer Dream is a fresh, mossy blend of citrus, rose and cardamom.

Roja Dove created it in 2016. Grapefruit and bergamot open bright, patchouli, moss, rose, cardamom, elemi, pink pepper and orange blossom form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, vetiver, cedar, carrot seed, benzoin, musk and orris give it a woody finish.

Fresh and refined, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Parfum is a sensual blend of rose, peach and musk.

Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2006. Rose and peach open soft, amber and musk form a warm heart, and sandalwood and patchouli give it a smooth finish.

Elegant in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: The Harmonist Royal Earth Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Royal Earth is a warm blend of carrot seed, iris and vanilla.

Launched in 2022, it opens with angelica, carrot seed and passionfruit. Iris, Egyptian rose and ylang-ylang form a powdery heart, and white musk, vanilla and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: The Harmonist Matrix Metal Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Matrix Metal is a fresh, woody blend of juniper, aldehydes and pine.

Launched in 2015, it opens with juniper berries and aldehydes. Amber and woods form a smooth heart, and vetiver, pine, amber and myrrh give it a green, resinous finish.

Crisp and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: BYREDO Rouge Chaotique Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Introducing Byredo's Rouge Chaotique, a brand-new Woody Spicy fragrance for both men and women, that was launched in 2023. This exhilaratingly unique scent features top notes of Saffron, Cassis, Bergamot and Lemon; followed by middle notes of Plum, Praline and Oak; before ending in a grounding blend of Agarwood (Oud), Papyrus and Patchouli.

title: Bortnikoff Cologne de Feu Extrait de Cologne Unisex
description_html: The new Citrus Gourmand fragrance for both women and men, Cologne de Feu by Bortnikoff, was released in 2022. Created by Dmitry Bortnikov, the top notes of this fragrance are Blood Orange, Bigarade, Tangerine, Litsea Cubeba, Bitter Orange, Lemon and Petitgrain; middle notes consist of Tea, Sorbet, Peach, Raspberry and Jasmine; while the base notes are Oakmoss, Cedar, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood and Woody Notes.

title: The Spirit of Dubai Abjar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Spirit of Dubai Abjar is a rich, leathery blend of spices, oud and tobacco.

Launched in 2017, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot, saffron, cinnamon, cardamom, lavender and apple. Cashmeran, cedar, honey, incense, Indian oud, jasmine, leather and rose form a dense heart, and tobacco, civet, vanilla, oud, sandalwood and praline give it a sweet finish.

Opulent and bold, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Mind Games Vieri Pawn Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Vieri Pawn is a smoky citrus with lemongrass, camellia tea and incense.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2023. Red lemongrass, lemon and pink pepper open bright, peony, camellia tea and red currant form a fresh heart, and incense, musk and amberwood give it a smoky finish.

Crisp and distinctive, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Mind Games The Forward Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games The Forward is a bright blend of citrus, salt and sandalwood.

Nathalie Benareau created it in 2023. Lemon, Madagascar mandarin and pomelo open zesty, jasmine sambac, tonka bean and a salt accord form a soft heart, and Madagascar vanilla, sandalwood and cashmeran give it a warm finish.

Fresh and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Mind Games Sissa Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Sissa is a creamy blend of sesame, milk and roasted tonka.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2022. Ambrette seed, sesame oil and coumarin open warm, a milk accord, roasted tonka bean and jasmine sambac form a creamy heart, and labdanum, Madagascar vanilla and musk give it a soft finish.

Cozy and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Mind Games Queening Pawn Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Queening Pawn is a clean, creamy blend of cotton, apple and vanilla.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2023. A clean cotton accord, cypress and apple open fresh, orris, rum and saffron form the heart, and whipped vanilla, fluffy musk and coconut give it a soft finish.

Comforting in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Mind Games Ruy Lopez Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Ruy Lopez is a breezy blend of bergamot, sea salt and lotus.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2022. Bergamot, fig leaf and sea salt open fresh, lotus, iris and freesia form an airy heart, and woods, vanilla, vetiver, sandalwood and musk give it a soft finish.

Clean and calm, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Mind Games Checkmate Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Checkmate is a fruity rose with davana, champagne and tobacco.

Launched in 2022, it opens with davana, champagne and red currant. May rose, Bulgarian rose and magnolia form a lush heart, and tobacco, moss and patchouli give it an earthy finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Mind Games Blockade Silver Knight Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Blockade Silver Knight is a fruity, fresh blend of mango, lavender and oud.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2022. Bergamot, pink pepper, mango and tomato leaf open bright, mango blossom, star anise, lavender and cyclamen form the heart, and amber, suede, oud and patchouli give it depth.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Guerlain Samsara Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Samsara is a rich, opulent sandalwood and jasmine classic.

Jean-Paul Guerlain created it in 1989. Bergamot, lemon, green notes, peach and ylang-ylang open bright, rose, violet, iris, narcissus and jasmine form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean, musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: The Harmonist Hypnotizing Fire Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Hypnotizing Fire is a warm, sweet blend of spice, rose and praline.

Launched in 2015, it opens with pink pepper, pimento and clove. Bulgarian rose, patchouli and praline form a rich heart, and vanilla, benzoin and opoponax give it a warm finish.

Seductive and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: The Harmonist Guiding Water Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Guiding Water Eau de Parfum is an airy blend of lotus, watermelon and musk.

Launched in 2015, it opens with pink pepper and ozonic notes. Lotus, cyclamen and watermelon form a fresh, aquatic heart, and musk, jasmine and lily give it a soft finish.

Light and serene, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: The Harmonist Yin Transformation Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Yin Transformation is a soft, powdery floral with rose, orchid and iris.

Launched in 2022, it opens with mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper. Bulgarian rose, orchid and maté form a delicate heart, and iris, white musk and sandalwood give it a clean finish.

Elegant and serene, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Paco Rabanne Genius Me Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Genius Me is a fresh blend of orange peel, rosemary and moss.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2019. Orange peel opens bright, rosemary forms an aromatic heart, and metallic notes and moss give it a cool, woody finish.

Crisp and distinctive, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Paco Rabanne Fabulous Me Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Fabulous Me is an unusual blend of pumpkin, rhubarb and sandalwood.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2019. Pumpkin opens sweet and earthy, rhubarb forms a tangy heart, and sandalwood gives it a smooth, woody finish.

Cozy and distinctive, it is a lovely daytime scent in fall.

title: Paco Rabanne Erotic Me Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Erotic Me is a sweet, milky blend of leather, osmanthus and fruit.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2019. Leather, florals, milk, osmanthus and fruits come together in a soft, fruity and creamy leather scent.

Sensual and playful, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Paco Rabanne Dangerous Me Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Dangerous Me is a warm blend of ambergris, cedar and vanilla.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2019. Ambergris, cedar, vanilla and ginger come together in a smooth, powdery and slightly animalic woody scent.

Sensual and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Givenchy Play Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Givenchy Play Intense for Her is a warm, sweet blend of peach, orchid and tonka.

Lucas Sieuzac and Émilie Bevierre-Coppermann created it in 2010. Orange blossom, pink pepper and peach open bright, amyris, orchid, magnolia and tiare form a soft heart, and benzoin, tonka bean, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Cozy and feminine, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Rockstud Noir Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Rockstud Noir is a fresh blend of bergamot, sage and ambergris.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bergamot. Sage forms an aromatic heart, and ambergris gives it a clean, salty finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Kayali Oudgasm Vanilla Oud 36 Eau de Parfum Intense Unisex
description_html:
Kayali Oudgasm Vanilla Oud 36 is a sweet, rich blend of praline, rose and oud.

Praline, saffron and pear open warm and fruity, Bulgarian rose forms the heart, and vanilla sugar, white musk, cashmere wood, oud and oakmoss give it a creamy, smoky finish.

Indulgent and intense, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Kayali Oudgasm Tobacco Oud 04 Eau de Parfum Intense Unisex
description_html:
Kayali Oudgasm Tobacco Oud 04 is a rich blend of honey, tobacco and oud.

White honey, mandarin, clary sage, geranium and plum open sweet, saffron and clove form a spicy heart, and tobacco, praline, oud, vanilla, benzoin and patchouli give it a deep finish.

Opulent and warm, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Kayali Oudgasm Rose Oud 16 Eau de Parfum Intense Unisex
description_html:
Kayali Oudgasm Rose Oud 16 is a fruity rose with pear, peony and oud.

Geranium, lemon and pear open fresh, Bulgarian rose and peony form a lush heart, and oud, vanilla and cashmere wood give it a warm finish.

Romantic and rich, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Kayali Oudgasm Cafe Oud 19 Eau de Parfum Intense Unisex
description_html:
Kayali Oudgasm Café Oud 19 is a warm blend of cappuccino, rose and oud.

Cappuccino, mandarin and bergamot open rich and bright, geranium and rose form a floral heart, and oud, vanilla, white musk and patchouli give it a smooth, woody finish.

Cozy and bold, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
The Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum fragrance is a sensory 
journey, seductive and reassuring, capable of evoking the positive 
values to which Dolce&Gabbana hold dear, symbolized by the Sacred 
Heart seal. An olfactory creation of exquisite contrasts, bright top 
notes, sensual base notes.

title: Amouage Opus XIV Royal Tobacco Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Opus XIV Royal Tobacco is a rich, layered tobacco with spice and resins.

Cécile Zarokian created it in 2022. Anise, bergamot, olibanum, cardamom and basil open aromatic, lavender, rose, licorice, tobacco and osmanthus form the heart, and Peru balsam, labdanum, oud, vetiver, tonka bean and vanilla give it a deep finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Amouage Honour 43 Extrait de Parfum for Women
description_html: Amouage introduces their Floral fragrance for women - Honour 43 Woman - released in 2021. Created by Alexandra Carlin, the scent opens with Rhubarb Leaf, Pepper and Coriander, followed by Tuberose, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Carnation, concluding with Sandalwood, Vetiver, Labdanum, Opoponax, Olibanum and Leather.

title: Maison Margiela REPLICA On A Date Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Maison Margiela Replica On a Date is a fruity, woody blend of black currant, davana and rose.

Carlos Benaim created it in 2022. Bergamot, pink pepper and black currant syrup open juicy, davana, geranium and rose form a floral heart, and musk, moss, vetiver and patchouli give it an earthy finish.

Romantic and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Creed Absolu Aventus Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: The latest scent from Creed, Absolu Aventus, was released in 2023. It is a scent crafted specifically for men. The top notes of Absolu Aventus are comprised of Black Currant, Grapefruit and Bergamot, while the middle notes are Ginger, Cardamom, Cinnamon and Citron. Finally, the base notes of patchouli, Pink Pepper and Vetiver linger to make a lasting impression.

title: Spirit Of Kings Zaurac Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Zaurac is a spicy, woody blend of oud, cardamom and Sichuan pepper.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Oud, cardamom and Sichuan pepper open bright, tonka bean, vetiver and sandalwood form a smooth heart, and amber and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Confident and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Spirit Of Kings Tabana Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Tabana is a spicy leather with oud, saffron and cardamom.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Bergamot, oud, saffron and cardamom open spicy, pepper and leather form a rich heart, and ambergris gives it a warm, salty finish.

Bold and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Spirit Of Kings Sagira Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Sagira is a sweet, fruity blend of peach, toffee and rose.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Grapefruit, mandarin, peach and toffee open sweet, violet, patchouli and Damask rose form a floral heart, and musk and moss give it a soft finish.

Pretty and easy, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Spirit Of Kings Matar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Matar is a fruity, smoky blend of pineapple, birch and musk.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Bergamot, pineapple, apple and black currant open juicy, birch, Moroccan jasmine, patchouli and rose form a smoky heart, and musk, vanilla, ambergris and oakmoss give it a warm finish.

Bold and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Spirit Of Kings Kursa Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Kursa is a musky blend of rose, labdanum and oud.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Rose, musk and patchouli open soft, mandarin and labdanum form a warm heart, and oud gives it a deep, woody finish.

Sensual and refined, it is a great night scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Spirit Of Kings Hadar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Hadar is a sweet, musky blend of lemon, sugared rose and vanilla.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Lemon and water notes open fresh, sugar and rose form a sweet heart, and white musk, vanilla, cedar and sugar give it a soft finish.

Cozy and light, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Spirit Of Kings Errai Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Errai is a musky blend of citrus, passionfruit and iris.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Bergamot, rose, lemon and ozonic notes open fresh, passionfruit, iris, cedar and green notes form the heart, and vanilla, vetiver, patchouli, musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Spirit Of Kings Aludra Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Aludra is a fresh, fruity blend of rhubarb, litchi and peony.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Bergamot, nutmeg, rhubarb and litchi open juicy, musk, peony, Turkish rose and vanilla form a soft heart, and cedar, Haitian vetiver, cashmeran and incense give it a woody finish.

Light and versatile, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

title: Spirit Of Kings Acamar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spirit of Kings Acamar is a musky, woody blend of citrus, violet and patchouli.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2019. Bergamot and lemon open bright, violet, patchouli and rose form an earthy heart, and musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Sospiro Perfumes Ouverture Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Sospiro Ouverture is a warm blend of magnolia, cinnamon and incense.

Chris Maurice created it in 2016. Magnolia, orange and fig leaf open bright, Indian jasmine, ylang-ylang, Bulgarian rose and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and cashmere wood, vanilla, sandalwood, amber and incense give it a warm finish.

Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger is a bright, sunny blend of ginger, citrus and creamy woods.

Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2023. Bergamot, lemon and ginger flower open zesty, mandarin, magnolia, rose and jasmine form a soft floral heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, cashmeran, patchouli, musk and amber give it warmth.

Uplifting and easy to wear, it works in every season.

title: Mugler Alien Goddess Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Mugler Alien Goddess Intense is a warm, sunny blend of coconut, jasmine and vanilla.

Nathalie Lorson and Marie Salamagne created it in 2022. Bergamot and coconut open bright, jasmine tea and jasmine form a luminous heart, and benzoin, vanilla and cashmere wood give it a creamy finish.

Radiant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Gucci Rush Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Gucci Rush is a bold, fruity blend of peach, gardenia and vanilla.

Michel Almairac created it in 1999. Peach, Californian gardenia and freesia open bright, jasmine, coriander and Damask rose form a spicy floral heart, and natural vanilla, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Sensual and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Intense Eau de Parfum
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Intense is a fruity, floral blend of lychee, tuberose and vanilla.

Launched in 2022, it opens with violet, lychee and mandora. Ylang-ylang, tuberose and plum form a rich heart, and vanilla, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm, earthy finish.

Elegant and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Giorgio Armani Vetiver d'Hiver (Vetiver Babylone) Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Vetiver d'Hiver is a fresh, spicy vetiver with citrus and cardamom.

Launched in 2008, it opens with bergamot, lemon and mandarin. Cardamom, coriander and pink pepper form a spicy heart, and vetiver and patchouli give it an earthy finish.

Clean and refined, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Giorgio Armani Rose Alexandrie Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Rose Alexandrie is a fresh, airy rose with citrus, neroli and mimosa.

Launched in 2008, it blends bergamot, rose, neroli, mandarin and mimosa into a light, green and gently powdery floral scent.

Light and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Roja Parfums Aoud Crystal Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja Aoud Crystal is a fresh, rich blend of lemon verbena, rose and oud.

Launched in 2010, it opens with bergamot, lemon and lemon verbena. Geranium, jasmine, May rose and ylang-ylang form a floral heart, and oud, cashmere wood, cedar, cinnamon, saffron, sandalwood, ambergris, leather and vanilla give it a deep finish.

Luxurious and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Oud Saffron Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Oud Saffron is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, cacao and vanilla.

Roja Dove created it in 2016. Lemon opens bright, heliotrope, rose, violet, jasmine and tuberose form a floral heart, and orris root, ginger, cacao, saffron, vanilla, coffee and ambergris give it a rich finish.

Smooth and luxurious, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Sublime Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Dolce&Gabbana's Velvet Sublime, a unisex Floral fragrance, was released in 2011 and crafted by renowned nose Rodrigo Flores-Roux.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Fruit Collection Lemon Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Introducing Lemon by Dolce&Gabbana, the citrus fragrance for him and her. Unveiling in 2020, this new scent was skillfully created by the nose of Jerome Epinette. An invigorating blend of Sicilian Lemon, Calabrian bergamot and Petitgrain start off the scent, followed by a zesty hint of Ginger. Haitian Vetiver provides a long-lasting base note.

title: Dunhill Icon Racing Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
The latest fragrance in our Icon collection, Racing is inspired by the speed, colour and history of British motoring. The bottle is classic dark green, finished in our signature Engine Turn Design. Icon Racing is a truly masculine scent. 

 

  • Brand : Alfred Dunhill
  • Fragrance Type : Eau de Parfum
  • Targeted Group : Men
  • Fragrance Family : Woody & Musky

title: Cartier Declaration Essence Eau de Toilette For Men
description_html: Declaration Essence by Cartier is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. Declaration Essence was launched in 2001. Top notes are Tea, Orange Blossom and Lavender; middle notes are Geranium, Lemon and Sicilian Lemon; base notes are Vetiver, Sandalwood, Musk and Amber.

title: By Kilian Smoking Hot Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: In 2023, By Kilian released the new fragrance

title: By Kilian Fievre Verte Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The newest Woody Aromatic fragrance for both men and women, Fièvre Verte by By Kilian, was released in 2023 and was crafted by Mathieu Nardin. Its top notes are Wormwood and Cypress, its middle notes are Licorice and Violet Leaf, and its base notes are Vetiver, Patchouli, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Tonka.

title: Frederic Malle Heaven Can Wait Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Frederic Malle Heaven Can Wait is a soft, fruity blend of plum, iris and musk.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2023. Plum, carrot seed, clove, pimento and ambrette open warm, iris, vetiver and magnolia form an elegant heart, and musk, peach and vanilla give it a gentle finish.

Light and refined, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: BYREDO Animalique Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The newest fragrance from Byredo, Animalique, is a luxurious scent meant for both men and women. Launched in 2023, the top notes of Bergamot and Lemon blend into the heart of Violet and Mimosa. The base is comprised of Suede, Tobacco Leaf and Amber for a truly alluring aroma.

title: BDK Parfums Vanille Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Vanille Leather by BDK Parfums is a brand-new Amber Floral fragrance for both women and men, which was launched in 2023. Its top notes consist of Pink Pepper and Violet; middle notes of Orange Blossom, Tuberose and Jasmine; and base notes of Vanilla, Benzoin, Leather, Patchouli, Oak and Orris.

title: BDK Parfums Pas Ce Soir Extrait Unisex
description_html: The newly released Pas Ce Soir Extrait by BDK Parfums is a captivating Amber Floral scent, suitable for both men and women. Launched in 2023, this fragrance was crafted by the talented nose Violaine Collas. Its top notes of Mandarin Orange, Pear, Ginger, Black Pepper and Cacao Pod are wonderfully complemented by middle notes of Quince, Moroccan Jasmine, Orange Blossom and Peach. Finishing off this aroma are base notes of Cashmeran, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Ambroxan, Vanilla and Benzion.

title: Nishane Wulong Cha X Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Wulong Cha X is a zesty, green tea fragrance with a bright citrus sparkle.

Julien Rasquinet created it in 2023. Bergamot, mandarin, yuzu and litsea cubeba open fresh and juicy, green tea, thyme and magnolia form a calm heart, and musk and fig give it a soft, clean finish.

Light and uplifting, it is perfect for daytime from spring through fall.

title: Nishane Hundred Silent Ways X Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Hundred Silent Ways X is a sweet, creamy floral with peach, tuberose and vanilla.

Launched in 2016, it opens with mandarin, peach and tuberose. Gardenia, orris and jasmine form a powdery heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and vetiver give it a warm, woody finish.

Elegant and sensual, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Nishane Hacivat X Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Hacivat X is a bright, juicy pineapple chypre.

Jorge Lee created it in 2017. Grapefruit, bergamot and pineapple open sparkling, cedar, patchouli and jasmine form the heart, and woods and oakmoss give it a classic finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

title: Nishane Fan Your Flames X Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Fan Your Flames X is a sweet, boozy blend of rum, coconut and tobacco.

Launched in 2016, it opens with rum and coconut. Tonka bean and tobacco form a warm heart, and Chinese cedar and oakmoss give it a mossy, woody finish.

Cozy and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Nishane Ani X Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Ani X is a fruity, spicy take on the popular Ani.

Cécile Zarokian created it in 2019. Bergamot, pink pepper, ginger and green notes open bright, Turkish rose, cardamom and black currant form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, cedar, benzoin and ambergris give it a warm finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

title: Parfums de Marly Althair Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Althaïr is a creamy vanilla-praline gourmand lifted by orange blossom and spice.

Created in 2023 by Hamid Merati-Kashani and Ilias Ermenidis, it opens with orange blossom, bergamot, cinnamon and cardamom. Bourbon vanilla and elemi make a smooth heart, and praline, ambroxan, musk and guaiac wood give it a sweet, airy finish.
