A rich choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Bortnikoff Triad Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Triad, a new Amber Woody fragrance for both women and men created by Dmitry Bortnikov, was released in 2020. Its top note is Agarwood (Oud), while the middle notes consist of Rose de Mai, Agarwood (Oud) and Magnolia. The base notes of Triad are Thailand Oud, Hyrax, Benzoin and Tonka Bean.

title: Bortnikoff Oud Monarch Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bortnikoff's Oud Monarch is an exquisite fragrance for both men and women, released in 2019. Created by the renowned perfumer Dmitry Bortnikov, this scent opens with the inviting top notes of Frangipani and Magnolia. The heart is a spicy blend of Cinnamon, Rose de Mai, Rose and Tobacco, while the base notes of Cacao Pod, Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Castoreum, Civet and Labdanum round off this beautiful fragrance.

title: Bortnikoff Oud Maximus Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Released in 2018, Oud Maximus by Bortnikoff is a unisex Amber Woody fragrance composed by nose Dmitry Bortnikov. Sweet Orange, Jasmine Sambac, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Cardamom make up the top notes, while the middle notes consist of Rose, Rose de Mai, Tea Rose, Frangipani, Magnolia, Clove and Tonka Bean. Indian Oud, Agarwood (Oud), Civet, Natural Musk, Birch Tar, Tolu Balsam and Vanilla make up the base.

title: Bortnikoff Oud Loukoum Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bortnikoff's Oud Loukoum is a combination of Amber and Woody aromas, suitable for both women and men. Launched in 2020, the fragrance was created by Dmitry Bortnikov. It opens with a blend of Dried Fruits and Tobacco, the heart of Ylang-Ylang, and the deep base of Peru Balsam, Agarwood (Oud), Guaiac Wood, Cedar and Indian Oud.

title: Bortnikoff Oud Cologne Parfum Unisex
description_html: Created by Dmitry Bortnikov, Oud Cologne is a unisex Citrus Aromatic fragrance that was released in 2021. Refreshing top notes of Bitter Orange, White Grapefruit, Bergamot, Juniper Berries and Pink Pepper introduce the scent, followed by Pine needles, Geranium, Nutmeg and Rose in the middle. Finishing off the scent are the base notes of Ambergris, Thailand Oud, Tonka Bean, Siam Benzoin and Vetiver.

title: Bortnikoff Mysterious Oud Parfum Unisex
description_html: Launched in 2018, Bortnikoff's Mysterious Oud is a unisex fragrance created by the talented Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes of Orange, Amber, Cardamom and Bergamot blend into a heart of Castoreum, Myrrh, Cinnamon, Cloves, Tonka Bean, Rose, Nutmeg, Jasmine and Pink Pepper, before settling onto base notes of Agarwood (Oud), Opoponax, Indian Oud, Tolu Balsam, Labdanum, Cedar, Sandalwood, Lotus and Vanilla.

title: Akro Smoke Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Akro's Smoke is a woody, amber-scented fragrance for both men and women, released in 2018. The mastermind behind the perfume is Olivier Cresp.

title: Akro Night Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Akro's Smoke, created by nose Olivier Cresp and released in 2018, is a unisex fragrance with an Amber Woody scent.

title: Akro Malt Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Malt, a Leather-scented fragrance for both men and women, was released in 2018 by Akro. It was created by renowned perfumer Olivier Cresp.

title: Agatho Parfum Adone Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: In 2019, Maurizio Cerizza released Adone, an exquisite fragrance for both men and women, as part of Agatho Parfum's line of scents.

title: Afnan Tobacco Rush Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: A new addition to the world of fragrances, Tobacco Rush by Afnan was released in 2022. Described as a Leather scent, it is suitable for both women and men. Its fragrance notes are comprised of a heady mix of Tobacco, Spicy Notes, Woody Notes, Sweet Notes, Lavender, Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Cedar.

title: Montale Amber & Spices Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Amber & Spices is a warm blend of rose, nutmeg and oud.

Pierre Montale created it in 2009. Rose and nutmeg open spicy, oud and caraway form a woody heart, and amber, ebony wood and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Rich and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Montale Amber Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Amber Musk is a soft, powdery blend of white musk, ambergris and amber.

Launched in 2018, it blends white musk, ambergris, amber, powdery notes and cedar into a warm, clean and slightly animalic scent.

Intimate and cozy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Bottega Veneta Illusione Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Launched in 2019, Illusione for Him by Bottega Veneta is a Woody fragrance created by the renowned nose Antoine Maisondieu. Enticing top notes of Bitter Orange and Lemon greet the wearer, complemented by the warm middle notes of White Cedar Extract and Fir Resin. Finally, the enticing combination of Vetiver and Tonka Bean linger as the base note of this captivating scent.

title: Calvin Klein Defy Parfum for Men
description_html: Calvin Klein's Defy Parfum is a fresh Woody Aromatic scent for men, which was released in 2023 by the perfume-maker Pascal Gaurin. This captivating cologne features top notes of Pink Pepper, middle notes of Lavender, and base notes of Cacao.

title: Bharara Viking Rio Parfum Unisex
description_html: Niche by Bharara is a unisex scent that released in 2021. The top notes feature Citruses and Juniper, leading to a heart of Jasmine, Chocolate and Balsam Fir. The base of this fragrance is comprised of Amberwood and Moss.

title: Bharara Viking Dubai Parfum Unisex
description_html: Niche by Bharara is an enchanting scent for all genders, which was launched in 2021. Its delightful top notes feature a blend of Citrus and Juniper, complemented by Jasmine, Chocolate and Balsam Fir in the heart. Finally, the scent is rounded off with warm notes of Amberwood and Moss.

title: Bharara Viking Cairo Parfum Unisex
description_html: Niche, a Floral fragrance for both men and women, was released in 2021. The opening notes are an enticing blend of Citruses and Juniper, which then give way to the heart of Jasmine, Chocolate and Balsam Fir. Finally, the fragrance endures with a base of Amberwood and Moss.

title: Tom Ford Myrrhe Mystere Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Myrrhe Mystère is a warm, powdery blend of myrrh, sandalwood and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it pairs resinous myrrh with creamy sandalwood, soft vanilla and musk for a smooth, glowing and gently spicy scent.

Elegant and cozy, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Men Hot! Hot! Hot! Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Carolina Herrera presents a new fragrance for men, CH Men Hot! Hot! Hot!, which was launched in 2022. Created by perfumer Emilie Bevierre-Coppermann, the scent opens with scintillating top notes of Grapefruit, Rhubarb Leaf and Violet Leaf, followed by Sichuan Pepper and Angelica in the middle, and settling into leathery, woody base notes of Sandalwood and Madagascar Vetiver.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber is a warm blend of amber, vanilla and lavender.

Launched in 2023, it pairs glowing amber with Madagascar vanilla and a touch of lavender for a smooth, powdery and cozy scent.

Warm and inviting, it is a great choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Thomas Kosmala No. 4 Apres L'Amour Elixir de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala No. 4 Après l'Amour Elixir is a musky blend of lemon zest, orange blossom and amber.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2018. Lemon zest and bitter orange blossom open bright, aromatic spices form a warm heart, and musk, woods and amber give it a sensual, skin-like finish.

Intimate and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Thomas Kosmala No. 11 Super Amber Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala No. 11 Super Amber is a warm, woody blend of amber, labdanum and incense.

Launched in 2022, it blends amber, benzoin, labdanum, woods, incense and amberwood into a smooth, resinous and glowing scent.

Warm and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Thomas Kosmala Candy Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala Candy is a sweet, fruity blend of cherry, cotton candy and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with cherry and red fruits. Raspberry bloom and tiare flower form a juicy floral heart, and cotton candy, caramel and vanilla give it a playful, sugary finish.

Fun and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: The Different Company White Zagora Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
The Different Company White Zagora is a fresh blend of neroli, peach blossom and osmanthus.

Émilie Bevierre-Coppermann created it in 2013. Bergamot, neroli and citrus open bright, peach blossom, orange blossom and tuberose form a floral heart, and white musk, amber and osmanthus give it a soft finish.

Light and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: The Different Company South Bay Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
The Different Company South Bay is a fresh, woody blend of grapefruit, tamarind and suede.

Émilie Bevierre-Coppermann created it in 2013. Grapefruit, petitgrain and tamarind open bright, woods, freesia and rose hip form a soft heart, and sandalwood, vetiver and white suede give it a smooth finish.

Relaxed and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: The Different Company Kashan Rose Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
The Different Company Kashan Rose is a fresh, spicy rose with litchi and peony.

Émilie Bevierre-Coppermann created it in 2013. Cardamom, pink pepper, sage and litchi open bright, hawthorn, peony and rose form a floral heart, and musk, ambrette and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Light and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Serge Lutens Ecrin de Fumee Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Écrin de Fumée is a smoky blend of tobacco, rum and cacao.

Launched in 2023, it blends woods, tobacco, rum, smoke and cacao into a sweet, dark and warm scent.

Moody and cozy, it is a great night scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Serge Lutens Dans Le Bleu Qui Petille Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Dans le Bleu Qui Pétille is a woody blend of coriander, incense and algae.

Launched in 2022, it blends coriander, incense, driftwood and algae into an aromatic, salty and gently spicy scent.

Calm and unusual, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Penhaligon's Eau Sans Pareil Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Penhaligon's Eau Sans Pareil is a fruity, classic floral with citrus, licorice and orris.

Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2011. Bergamot, neroli, cypress, mandarin, raspberry, pineapple and aldehydes open bright, ylang-ylang, clove, rose, orange flower, licorice, jasmine and orris form a rich heart, and oakmoss, labdanum, vetiver, benzoin and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Elegant and lively, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Moncler Les Roches Noires Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Moncler Les Roches Noires is an aromatic blend of lemon, black pepper and patchouli.

Launched in 2023, it blends lemon, patchouli, labdanum, black pepper, tonka bean and geranium into a fresh yet warm, musky and spicy scent.

Bold and smooth, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Moncler Le Solstice Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Moncler Le Solstice is a soft, musky blend of sandalwood, violet and iris.

Launched in 2023, it blends sandalwood, violet, white musk and iris into a powdery, woody and quietly earthy scent.

Calm and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Moncler La Cordee Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Moncler La Cordée is a fresh, woody blend of bergamot, cypress and black tea.

Launched in 2023, it brings together bergamot, cypress, geranium and black tea for a crisp, aromatic scent with a clean, outdoorsy feel.

Easy and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Haute Fragrance Company Private Code Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Haute Fragrance Company Private Code is a rich blend of plum, sour cherry, dates and oud.

Vincent Ricord created it in 2022. Olibanum, osmanthus, plum and sour cherry open juicy, rose, dates, leather and orris root form a warm heart, and tolu balsam, oud, benzoin, musk and incense give it a deep finish.

Opulent and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: The Harmonist Desired Earth Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Harmonist Desired Earth Eau de Parfum is a musky, woody blend of violet leaf, shiso and patchouli.

Launched in 2015, it opens with violet leaf and shiso. Ambrette, juniper and patchouli form an earthy heart, and tolu balsam gives it a warm, balsamic finish.

Calm and grounded, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Frederic Malle Uncut Gem Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Frédéric Malle Uncut Gem is a musky, aromatic blend of citrus, ginger and olibanum.

Maurice Roucel created it in 2022. Bergamot, nutmeg, mandarin, ginger and angelica open bright, olibanum, vetiver and leather form a woody heart, and musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Dolce&Gabbana introduces the new Floral Fruity fragrance, Dolce Shine, launched in 2020. Created by fragrance expert Marie Salamagne, this scent will captivate your senses. Top notes of Mango, Quince and Grapefruit mix with Solar, Ozonic, Sea Salt, Tuberose, Jasmine and Orange Blossom at the heart. Finally, White Musk, Australian Sandalwood and White Woods at the base round off this delightful composition.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Rose Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dolce Rose, the newest fragrance from Dolce&Gabbana, is a Floral Fruity scent, perfect for women. Released in 2021, its top notes consist of Red Currant, Green Apple and Mandarin Orange; with a heart of Rose, May Rose, White Peach and Magnolia; and a base of Musk, White Wood and Sandalwood.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Garden Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Dolce&Gabbana's Dolce Garden is a luxurious Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance created for women in 2018. Violaine Collas is credited as the nose behind this sophisticated scent which combines Magnolia, Mandarin Orange and Neroli as top notes; Coconut, Frangipani and Ylang-Ylang as middle notes; as well as Vanilla Absolute, Almond Milk and Sandalwood as base notes.

title: Cartier Santos de Cartier Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Cartier's Santos de Cartier is a masculine Amber Woody scent released in 1981. Expertly crafted by perfumer Daniel Moliere, the scent opens with a bright mix of Lavender, Juniper Berries, Basil, Lemon Verbena, Bergamot, Galbanum and Neroli. This transitions into a spicier medley of Pepper, Nutmeg, Vetiver, Rosemary, Geranium, Clary Sage and Cloves. Finally, the scent is finished off with a warm blend of Sandalwood, Amber, Coconut, Patchouli, Vanilla and Cedar.

title: Cartier L'Envol de Cartier Parfum for Men
description_html: Cartier's L'Envol de Cartier Eau de Parfum is a captivating Amber Woody scent designed for men and launched in 2016. The mastermind behind this fragrance is Mathilde Laurent. The top notes are a tantalizing blend of Lavender, Artemisia and Sage, followed by heart notes of Violet Leaf and Pepper. The base notes of Honey, Iris, Guaiac Wood, Musk, Patchouli, Amberwood, Cedar and Vetiver complete this unique scent.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Men Under The Sea Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Carolina Herrera introduces a new Woody Aromatic scent for men, CH Men Under The Sea, released in 2021. This fragrance opens with Juniper and Angelica, and develops into a heart of Sea Notes and Violet Leaf, all lying on a warm base of Cashmeran and Vanilla.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Hot! Hot! Hot! Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: CH Hot! Hot! Hot! by Carolina Herrera is a new fragrance specifically designed for women. It was launched in 2022 and created by Veronique Nyberg and Violaine Collas. The scent is a mix of top notes such as Neroli, Grapefruit and Aloe Vera; middle notes include Ylang-Ylang, Raspberry and Coconut; while base notes consist of Vanilla, Sandalwood and Myrhh.

title: BYREDO Cuir Obscur Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Cuir Obscur by Byredo is an aromatic Leather scent designed for both women and men. Its release date was in 2016, with Amaretto and Nutmeg as the opening notes, Rose and Ylang-Ylang in the middle, and Leather, Patchouli and Musk as the base.

title: Bvlgari Onekh Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Launched in 2016, Onekh by Bvlgari is a Leather scent for men crafted by renowned perfumer Jacques Cavallier.

title: Bvlgari Kobraa Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Bvlgari's Kobraa is a Fougere Amber men's fragrance created by the esteemed nose Jacques Cavallier and launched in 2020. The top note of this scent is Geranium, the middle note is Olibanum, and the base note is Agarwood (Oud).

title: Bond No. 9 Harrods Rose Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: In 2010, Bond No 9 released a Floral fragrance for women called Harrods Rose.

title: Bond No. 9 Harrods for Him Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: In 2009, Bond No 9 released its menswear fragrance, Harrods for Him, masterfully created by the talented nose Laurent Le Guernec.

title: Francesca Bianchi Libertine Neroli Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Francesca Bianchi Libertine Neroli is a leathery, musky take on neroli.

Francesca Bianchi created it in 2022. Bergamot and petitgrain open bright, Tunisian neroli, iris and geranium form a floral heart, and labdanum, leather, benzoin, animalic notes and oakmoss give it a sensual finish.

Distinctive and versatile, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

title: Acqua di Parma Ambra Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The 2019 Ambra Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance meant to be worn by both men and women. At first, it carries with it a blend of Orange, Calabrian Bergamot and Petitgrain. Followed by a combination of Cedar, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Rose and Patchouli at the heart of the fragrance. Finally, the scent complements the aroma with Ambergris, Sandalwood, Musk, Vanilla and Labdanum at the base.

title: Sospiro Perfumes Diapason Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Sospiro Diapason is a woody, aromatic blend of rose, guaiac wood and vetiver.

Chris Maurice created it in 2017. Bulgarian rose and geranium open fresh, guaiac wood and Atlas cedar form a woody heart, and musk, Haitian vetiver and amber give it an earthy finish.

Refined and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Montale Ginger Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Ginger Musk is a fruity, spicy musk with ginger and blackberry.

Pierre Montale created it in 2006. Musk, ginger, blackberry and red berries come together in a sweet, fresh and gently spicy scent.

Playful and easy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: MiN New York Stardust Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
MiN New York Stardust is a mossy floral with carnation, rose and oakmoss.

Launched in 2019, it opens with carnation, violet and aldehydes. Egyptian jasmine, Turkish rose and orange blossom form a rich heart, and musk, tonka bean and oakmoss give it an earthy finish.

Elegant and classic, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: MiN New York Plush Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
MiN New York Plush is a soft, musky blend of jasmine, vanilla and cashmere wood.

Launched in 2015, it opens with jasmine, orange blossom, vanilla and ylang-ylang. Musk, violet root, patchouli and cashmere wood form a velvety heart, and amber and aldehydes give it a warm finish.

Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: MiN New York Coda Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
MiN New York Coda is a fruity, leathery blend of aldehydes, plum and musk.

Launched in 2015, it opens with sparkling aldehydes. Woods, florals and plum form a fruity heart, and musk and leather give it a smooth finish.

Distinctive and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: MiN New York Astronomy Domine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
MiN New York Astronomy Domine is a woody blend of cardamom, sandalwood and iris.

Launched in 2019, it opens with cardamom, white pepper and Sicilian bergamot. Woods, sandalwood, patchouli and jasmine form a warm heart, and iris, white musk and amber give it a powdery finish.

Refined and calm, it is a lovely scent for fall.

title: Electimuss Vixere Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Vixere is a sweet, sunny floral with citrus, heliotrope and vanilla.

Sofia Bardelli created it in 2020. Grapefruit, orange blossom, bergamot, mandarin and ylang-ylang open bright, heliotrope, violet, iris, jasmine and gardenia form a soft heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.

Radiant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: Electimuss Vici Leather Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Vici Leather is a spicy leather with cinnamon, wormwood and tuberose.

Julien Rasquinet created it in 2022. Cinnamon, pink pepper and wormwood open aromatic, tuberose and leather form a rich heart, and balsamic notes and amber give it a warm finish.

Bold and refined, it is made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Electimuss Patchouli of the Underworld Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Patchouli of the Underworld is a dark blend of patchouli, leather and labdanum.

Kevin Mathys created it in 2022. Black pepper, pink pepper, mandarin and cistus open spicy, patchouli, leather and carnation form a deep heart, and labdanum, castoreum and styrax give it a rich, animalic finish.

Intense and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Electimuss Gladiator Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Electimuss released its newest scent, Gladiator Oud, in 2023. Created by renowned perfumer Julien Rasquinet, the woody fragrance for women and men is an invigorating blend of cumin and saffron in the top notes, followed by honey, hay, immortelle and geranium in the middle. The base notes are a deep combination of agarwood (oud), patchouli, Atlas cedar, Haitian vetiver and ambergris.

title: Electimuss Celestial Parfum Unisex
description_html: Electimuss released their newest fragrance, Celestial, in 2020, which can be enjoyed by both women and men.

title: D.S. & DURGA Sweet Do Nothing Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The 2021 launch of Sweet Do Nothing by perfume creators DS&Durga is a unique Floral Woody Musk scent for both men and women. Composed by nose David Seth Moltz, this fragrance promises to be an exciting new addition to the world of scent.

title: D.S. & DURGA Leatherize Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: In 2022, David Seth Moltz created Leatherize, a new Leather fragrance for both women and men, released by DS&Durga.

title: BillyXClub Silver Chill Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The fragrance Pashadina, created by BillyXClub, is an aromatic blend of floral, woody, and musk scents. It is suitable for both men and women.

title: BillyXClub Pashadina Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: BillyXClub's Pashadina is a unisex scent combining woody, musky, and floral aromas.

title: BillyXClub Indigo Swing Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: BillyXClub's Indigo Swing is an aromatic combination of floral, woody, and musky scents, specifically created for women.

title: BillyXClub Conga Beatz Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: BillyXClub's Conga Beatz is an uplifting Citrus Aromatic scent, created for both men and women.

title: BillyXClub Beatnik Boulevard Eau de Parfum for Men
Bvlgari Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Released in 1996, Bvlgari Pour Homme is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance created for men by Jacques Cavallier. At the top of this scent, you'll detect Tea, Aldehydes, Bergamot, Lavender, Nutmeg Flower, Orange Blossom and Mandarin Orange. The middle notes include Pepper, Iris, Guaiac Wood, Brazilian Rosewood, Coriander, Geranium, Cyclamen, Cardamom and Carnation. The bottom of the composition contains Musk, Vetiver, Cedar, Oakmoss, Amber and Tonka Bean.

title: Bvlgari Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Bvlgari's Omnia Coral is a floral, fruity scent intended for women, released in 2012. Perfumer Alberto Morillas composed this fragrance, which combines top notes of bergamot and goji berries, middle notes of pomegranate, hibiscus, and water lily, and base notes of musk and Virginia cedar.

title: Creed Carmina Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Creed Carmina is a rich, spicy rose with black cherry and saffron.

Launched in 2023, it opens with saffron, black cherry and pink pepper. May rose, peony, cashmere wood and violet form a lush heart, and myrrh, frankincense, amber and musk give it a warm finish.

Elegant and warm, it suits special evenings.

title: Brioni Eau de Parfum Brioni for Men
description_html: The Brioni Eau de Parfum for men, released in 2021, is an enticing Woody Spicy scent created by Michel Almairac. Its unique blend of Ozonic notes, Pink Pepper, Green Apple, Violet, Ambroxan, Cedar, Musk and Tonka Bean provide a truly captivating experience.

title: Lattafa Perfumes Al Qiam Gold Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Lattafa Al Qiam Gold is a fruity, leathery blend of raspberry, saffron and oud.

Raspberry and saffron open bright, leather and patchouli form a dark heart, and oud, vetiver, benzoin, guaiac wood and amber give it a warm, woody finish.

Bold and rich, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Xerjoff XJK Tempest Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Tempest is a fresh, woody blend of citrus, rose and oud.

Launched in 2023, it opens with elemi, Brazilian orange, ginger, lemon, petitgrain, lavender and bergamot. Bulgarian rose, jasmine sambac, Atlas cedar, amberwood and cypriol form a rich heart, and Haitian vetiver, amber, sandalwood, Laotian oud and musk give it a deep finish.

Refined and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Mamluk Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Mamluk is a rich gourmand of honey, caramel and oud.

Chris Maurice created it in 2012. Honey, caramel, oud, jasmine, benzoin, amber, vanilla, osmanthus, musk and bergamot come together in a sweet, golden and opulent scent.

Indulgent and warm, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Xerjoff XJK Luna Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Luna is a powdery blend of patchouli, rose and caramel.

Launched in 2023, it opens with Singapore patchouli, Calabrian bergamot, lemon and mandarin. Atlas cedar, Bulgarian rose, jasmine sambac, orris and violet form a soft heart, and amber, caramel and musk give it a warm finish.

Elegant and cozy, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Xerjoff XJK Layla Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Layla is a warm blend of nutmeg, ylang-ylang and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with nutmeg and clove. Ylang-ylang, patchouli and Atlas cedar form a woody floral heart, and Madagascar vanilla, musk and amber give it a powdery finish.

Cozy and elegant, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Xerjoff XJK Kemi Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Kemi is an animalic blend of oud, castoreum and civet.

Launched in 2023, it opens with Laotian oud and Atlas cedar. Castoreum, civet, cedar and gurjan balsam form a leathery heart, and Madagascar vanilla and Australian sandalwood give it a creamy finish.

Daring and intense, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Xerjoff XJK Jabir Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Jabir is a fresh floral with violet, peony and oud.

Launched in 2023, it opens with freesia, pink pepper and violet. Lily-of-the-valley, peony and Bulgarian rose form a soft heart, and Laotian oud, patchouli, musk, vanilla and Haitian vetiver give it a woody finish.

Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff XJK Ilm Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Ilm is a rich, woody blend of Laotian oud and sandalwood.

Launched in 2023, it opens with gurjan balsam, Laotian oud and Australian sandalwood. Laotian oud, ambergris, Atlas cedar and oakmoss form a deep heart, and Laotian oud and amber give it a warm, animalic finish.

Intense and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Xerjoff XJK Hayat Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Hayat is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, cinnamon and oud.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bitter orange, saffron and lavender. Ceylon cinnamon, cardamom and amber form a spicy heart, and oud, cypriol, Atlas cedar and patchouli give it an earthy finish.

Opulent and warm, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Xerjoff Ether Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Ether is a citrusy, woody blend of orange, pine and oud.

Launched in 2023, it opens with Brazilian orange, Calabrian bergamot, mandarin, Amalfi lemon, Bulgarian rose and cumin. Benzoin, gurjan balsam, Siberian pine, cypriol, clary sage and lavender form a resinous heart, and oud, caramel, vanilla, musk and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Opulent and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Xerjoff XJK Blue Empiryan Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Blue Empiryan is a warm blend of tobacco leaf, incense and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with tobacco leaf and cypriol. Incense, Atlas cedar and patchouli form a smoky heart, and labdanum, amber and Madagascar vanilla give it a balsamic finish.

Cozy and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Xerjoff XJK Blue Holysm Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Blue Holysm is a smoky blend of clary sage, cade and tobacco.

Launched in 2023, it opens with clary sage, cade oil, balsam fir and thyme. Tobacco, cedar, caraway and labdanum form a warm heart, and sandalwood, patchouli and Vietnamese oud give it a deep finish.

Bold and distinctive, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Xerjoff XJK Blue Astaral Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Blue Astaral is a rich blend of anise, rose and oud.

Launched in 2023, it opens with shamama attar, pink pepper and anise. Rose, labdanum, amberwood and violet form a warm heart, and oud, amber, moss, patchouli and cedar give it a deep finish.

Opulent and bold, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Xerjoff XJK Aqua Regia Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff XJK Aqua Regia is a powdery leather with violet, orris and caramel.

Launched in 2023, it opens with leather, Calabrian bergamot and black currant. Violet, patchouli, orris root and caramel form a soft heart, and cedar, musk and Madagascar vanilla give it a warm finish.

Elegant and smooth, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Prada Paradoxe is a luminous blend of neroli, amber and vanilla.

Nadège Le Garlantezec, Antoine Maisondieu and Shyamala Maisondieu created it in 2022. Pear, tangerine and bergamot open bright, orange blossom, neroli and jasmine sambac form the heart, and Bourbon vanilla, white musk, amber and benzoin give it a warm finish.

Elegant and easy to wear every day.

title: Memo Paris Sintra Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Memo Paris Sintra is a sweet, milky blend of orange blossom, marshmallow and caramel.

Philippe Paparella-Paris created it in 2020. Neroli, petitgrain, red fruits and bergamot open bright, milk, orange blossom, cinnamon, jasmine and rose form a creamy heart, and marshmallow, vanilla, caramel, musk and cedar give it a soft finish.

Sweet and comforting, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Atelier Des Ors Bois Sikar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bois Sikar by Atelier des Ors is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. Bois Sikar was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Marie Salamagne. Top notes are Precious Woods and Nutmeg; middle notes are Styrax, Guaiac Wood, Cedar Needles and Cedar; base notes are Tobacco Leaf and Vetiver.

title: Dior Homme Parfum for Men
description_html: Dior Homme Parfum, a leather based scent designed specifically for men, hit. Created by François Demachy, the fragrance has top notes of Tuscan Iris and Italian Orange, followed by middle notes of Leather and Rose, and finishing off with a base of Sandalwood, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Agarwood (Oud) and Cedar.

title: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Gucci Bamboo is a soft, elegant floral with lily, ylang-ylang and vanilla.

Launched in 2015, it opens with bergamot. Casablanca lily, ylang-ylang and orange blossom form a creamy floral heart, and sandalwood, Tahitian vanilla and amber give it a warm finish.

Graceful and modern, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Absolu Platine Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Absolu Platine is an aldehydic blend of lavender, orange blossom and amber.

Launched in 2023, it opens with aldehydes, bergamot and mandarin. Lavender, blue lavender and orange blossom form a crisp heart, and amber and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Bright and confident, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum is an aromatic blend of cardamom, lavender and vanilla.

Juliette Karagueuzoglou, Dominique Ropion and Anne Flipo created it in 2023. Cardamom, rhubarb, bergamot and lemon open bright, lavender, patchouli, geranium and cedarwood form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, Haitian vetiver and tolu balsam give it a warm finish.

Smooth and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia is a sweet, sunny white floral with pear blossom and brown sugar.

Honorine Blanc and Alberto Morillas created it in 2021. Pear blossom, red berries and Italian mandarin open bright, gardenia, jasmine and frangipani form a lush heart, and brown sugar and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Joyful and feminine, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia (2012) is a sweet, fruity blend of pear, gardenia and frangipani.

Launched in 2012, it opens with pear and red berries. Gardenia and frangipani form a creamy white floral heart, and patchouli gives it a soft, earthy finish.

Pretty and cheerful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Sport Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Sport is a fresh, aromatic blend of grapefruit, lavender and vetiver.

Calice Becker created it in 2012. Grapefruit and aldehydes open bright, lavender and cardamom form an aromatic heart, and vetiver gives it a clean, woody finish.

Sporty and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF is a modern, luminous blend of orange blossom and woods.

Christophe Raynaud created it in 2023. Calabrian bergamot opens bright and clean, Tunisian orange blossom gives it a soft floral heart, and Ambrofix and patchouli leave a warm, woody trail.

MYSLF is clean, modern and polished, an easy signature for everyday wear. It suits the office, weekends and evenings alike.

title: Rasasi Sotoor Taa Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Sotoor Taa is a fresh, aromatic blend of neroli, lavender and sea notes.

Launched in 2017, it opens with neroli, lavender, pink pepper and cardamom. Orange blossom, sea notes and geranium form a breezy heart, and vanilla, cedar, amber and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Fresh and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Sotoor Seen Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Sotoor Seen is a fruity floral with pear, guava and honey.

Launched in 2017, it opens with pear and guava. Orange blossom, honey, lily-of-the-valley and rose form a sweet heart, and musk, patchouli, vanilla and oakmoss give it a soft finish.

Light and cheerful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Sotoor Raa' Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Sotoor Raa' is a fresh, musky blend of citrus, nutmeg and jasmine.

Launched in 2017, it opens with bergamot and lemon. Nutmeg, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley form a soft floral heart, and musk and patchouli give it a powdery finish.

Clean and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Soryani Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Soryani is a clean blend of citrus, rose, lavender and musk.

Lemon, bergamot and orange open bright, rose, sandalwood, lavender, orris and lily-of-the-valley form a soft heart, and amber, musk and vetiver give it a warm finish.

Fresh and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Rumz Al 9459 Pour Lui Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Rumz Al Rasasi 9459 Pour Lui is an aromatic blend of citrus, lavender and oak.

Pink pepper, bergamot, elemi, grapefruit, mandarin, apple and coriander open bright, lavender, geranium, heliotrope, rose, almond and jasmine form the heart, and oak, amber, moss, sandalwood, vetiver, cedar and tonka bean give it a woody finish.

Polished and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Rumz Al 9325 Pour Lui Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Rumz Al Rasasi 9325 Pour Lui is a fruity, woody blend of pineapple, plum and leather.

Launched in 2013, it opens with pineapple, lime, lemon, bergamot, black pepper, plum and pear. Jasmine, freesia and lily-of-the-valley form a fresh heart, and ambergris, cedar, leather, white musk, oakmoss and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Bold and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Qasamat Rasana Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Qasamat Rasana is a woody blend of apple, leather and oud.

Launched in 2020, it opens with apple, bergamot and lemon. Cypriol, leather and sandalwood form a woody heart, and musk, cedar, amber and oud give it a powdery finish.

Refined and smooth, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Qasamat Mohraf Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Qasamat Mohraf is a fruity rose with raspberry, oud and vanilla.

Launched in 2020, it opens with raspberry, lemon and bergamot. Rose, geranium, jasmine, white flowers and lily-of-the-valley form a floral heart, and oud, vanilla, patchouli, amber, musk, guaiac wood and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Romantic and rich, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Rasasi Qasamat Ebhar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Qasamat Ebhar is a sweet blend of green apple, orris and praline.

Launched in 2020, it opens with green apple and lemon. Orris root, Damask rose, jasmine and lotus form a powdery heart, and vanilla, praline, tonka bean and musk give it a sweet finish.

Cozy and pretty, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Oud Al Mubakhar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Oud Al Mubakhar is a powdery blend of saffron, rose and sandalwood.

Saffron and bergamot open warm, Turkish rose, geranium and violet form a soft floral heart, and musk, sandalwood, tonka bean and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Elegant and warm, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Nafaeis Shaghaf Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Nafaeis Shaghaf Pour Homme is a sweet, powdery blend of fruits, ylang-ylang and vanilla.

Launched in 2018, it blends fruity florals, musk, ylang-ylang, rose, tonka bean, sandalwood, orchid and vanilla into a soft, sweet and musky scent.

Smooth and cozy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Musk Sharqi Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Musk Sharqi is a warm floral with rose, tuberose and oud.

Bergamot, orange and rose open bright, tuberose, cashmeran, jasmine and patchouli form a rich heart, and amber, vanilla, white musk, sandalwood and Indian oud give it a warm finish.

Opulent and smooth, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Rasasi Musk Hareer Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Musk Hareer is a soft rose with raspberry, sandalwood and white musk.

Sparkling lemon and raspberry open bright, Turkish, Egyptian and Damask rose form a romantic heart, and Indian sandalwood, amber and white musk give it a smooth finish.

Gentle and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Entebaa Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Entebaa is a fruity, warm blend of plum, pineapple and praline.

Plum, lime, pineapple and black pepper open juicy, guaiac wood, patchouli and vetiver form a woody heart, and praline, vanilla and tonka bean give it a sweet finish.

Smooth and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Egra Men Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Egra Men is a fresh, green blend of violet leaf, juniper and fir.

Violet leaf, juniper berries, spruce and grapefruit open crisp, fir, iris and galbanum form a green heart, and ambergris, sandalwood, musk and oakmoss give it a woody finish.

Fresh and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Rasasi Daarej pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Rasasi Daarej Pour Homme is a warm, spicy blend of cumin, orris and vanilla.

Cumin, cardamom and artemisia open spicy, rose and orris root form a powdery heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber, sandalwood, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.

Smooth and confident, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Mugler Angel is the legendary gourmand of cotton candy, patchouli and chocolate.

Olivier Cresp and Yves de Chirin created it in 1992. Cotton candy, coconut, cassis, melon and bergamot open sweet, honey, red berries, plum, peach and jasmine form a fruity heart, and patchouli, chocolate, caramel, vanilla and tonka bean give it a bold finish.

Iconic and powerful, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Coach Open Road Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Coach's Open Road is a brand new Woody Aromatic fragrance for men, released in 2022. This scent was created by Jean-Christophe Hérault, with top notes of Lemon and Red Apple, middle notes of Sichuan Pepper, Clary Sage, and Lavender, and base notes of Vetiver, Cedar, and Patchouli.

title: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Absolu Femme for Women
description_html:
Armani Code Absolu Femme is a creamy white floral with tuberose, orange blossom and vanilla.

Launched in 2019, it opens with neroli, ginger and mandarin. Tuberose, orange blossom and jasmine form a lush heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Elegant and sensual, it is a great choice for evenings.

title: Armaf Tres Nuit Lyric Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Armaf's Tres Nuit Lyric is an invigorating Floral Aquatic scent made for men, released in 2020. Its heady blend of Bergamot, Watery Notes, Mandarin Orange, Rosemary, Lavender, Cypress, Musk, Patchouli, and Amber gives the fragrance an unforgettable aroma.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Club de Nuit Untold, a fragrance for both men and women, was introduced in 2022. Its top notes consist of Saffron and Jasmine, followed by Amberwood and Ambergris in the middle, and ending with Fir Resin and Cedar at the base.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Iconic Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Club de Nuit Blue Iconic for men, a new fragrance by Armaf, was launched in 2022. Featuring top notes of Grapefruit, Mint, Lemon, Pink Pepper and Coriander; middle notes of Ginger, Melon, Nutmeg and Jasmine; and base notes of Sandalwood, Incense, Amber, Woody Notes, Cedar, Patchouli and Labdanum, this scent is sure to make a statement.

title: Abercrombie & Fitch Away Man Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: The new fragrance for men, Away Man by Abercrombie & Fitch, was released in 2021 and features an invigorating Woody Aromatic scent. Atop this base are Violet, Pineapple and Grapefruit top notes, and the depths are filled with Geranium, Ginger, Pepper, Vetiver, Woody Notes and Sandalwood middle and base notes.

title: Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Moment Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Abercrombie & Fitch's Authentic Moment Man perfume for men is the latest scent in the market. Launched in 2022, the fragrance was created by the expert nose of Yves Cassar. Its top notes are Cinnamon, Apple, Cypress, and Bergamot, complemented by Neroli as its middle note, and a base of Amberwood, Sandalwood, Musk, and Vanilla.

title: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Tres Nuit by Armaf is an aromatic and spicy scent designed for men. Its top notes consist of lemon verbena, iris, and lemon, while its middle notes include lavender, violet, and spicy notes. The fragrance is completed by Ambergris and sandalwood as its base notes.

title: Giorgio Armani My Way Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani My Way Intense is a rich white floral with tuberose and vanilla.

Carlos Benaim created it in 2021. Orange blossom and bitter orange open bright, Indian tuberose forms a creamy heart, and Madagascar vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Elegant and sensual, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Ajmal's Evoke Gold For Him is a masculine Woody Aromatic scent that debuted in 2018. Its opening notes are Neroli and Pepper, while its middle notes are a combination of Orris Root, Amber, and Geranium. To complete the fragrance, its base is composed of Cedar and Patchouli.

title: Afnan Supremacy Purple Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Afnan's Supremacy Purple is an Amber-scented perfume for women, featuring top notes of Fruits and Citruses, middle notes of Musk and Amber, and base notes of Musk and Vanilla.

title: Amouage Guidance Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Amouage Guidance is a luminous blend of pear, hazelnut and osmanthus.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Pear, hazelnut and olibanum open warm and glowing, osmanthus, rose, saffron and jasmine sambac form a rich floral heart, and sandalwood, vanilla, akigalawood and ambergris give it a creamy finish.

Opulent but easy to wear, it is a luxurious everyday signature.

title: Afnan 9pm Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Afnan 9PM is a sweet, warm blend of apple, cinnamon and vanilla.

Launched in 2020, it opens with apple, cinnamon, lavender and bergamot. Orange blossom and lily of the valley form the heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber and patchouli give it a rich finish.

A fun, cozy choice for evenings out.

title: Afnan Mirsaal of Trust Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Afnan's Mirsaal of Trust is a warm and spicy fragrance specifically created for men and released in 2020. Its top notes are composed of Vetiver and Ambroxan, while the middle notes blend Raspberry and Saffron. Finally, a luxurious blend of Cashmere Wood, Carnation and Amber form the base of this scent.

title: Al Haramain Amber Oud (Original Edition) Eau the Parfum Unisex
description_html: Amber Oud by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Amber Oud was launched in 2018. Top notes are Rosemary, Bergamot, Cedar and Lemon; middle notes are Spices, Cedar and Guaiac Wood; base notes are resins, Amber and Musk.

title: Armaf Ventana Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Ventana Pour Homme by Armaf is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Ventana Pour Homme was launched in 2017. Top notes are Grapefruit, Lemon and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lavender, Geranium, Vetiver and Patchouli; base notes are Cedar, Amber and Precious Woods.

title: Montale Fantastic Basilic Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Fantastic Basilic is a green blend of basil, kumquat and frangipani.

Launched in 2022, it opens with basil, kumquat and pear. Frangipani and tuberose form a creamy floral heart, and tonka bean and benzoin give it a soft, warm finish.

Fresh and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: John Varvatos Dark Rebel Eau de Toilette
description_html:
John Varvatos Dark Rebel is a rich, boozy blend of rum, leather and tobacco.

Rodrigo Flores-Roux created it in 2015. Rum, sugar cane, cardamom, artemisia and clary sage open sweet and aromatic, leather, fir resin, pepper and styrax form a smoky heart, and tobacco leaf, castoreum, Akigalawood, Mexican vanilla and juniper give it a warm finish.

Bold and moody, it is a great choice for cooler evenings.

title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Cologne Eau de Toilette
description_html:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Cologne is a fresh, citrusy take on L'Homme Idéal with almond.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2015. Grapefruit, orange, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, almond and neroli form a soft heart, and vetiver and white musk give it a clean finish.

Light and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Gold Fantasy Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Carolina Herrera's Good Girl Gold Fantasy is an alluring Amber Floral fragrance created for women. Launched in 2022, this new scent is crafted by renowned perfumer Louise Turner. Opening with the scents of Almond and Coffee, its heart blooms with Jasmine Sambac and Tuberose. This captivating aroma is settled on a soft base of Tonka Bean and Cacao.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Tuxedo by Yves Saint Laurent is a Chypre fragrance for women's and men. Tuxedo was released in 2015. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Juliette Karagueuzoglou. Top notes are Violet Leaf, Coriander and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Rose, Black Pepper and Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes are Ambergris, Patchouli and Bourbon Vanilla.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Supreme Bouquet Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Supreme Bouquet is a lush, fruity white floral with tuberose and pear.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2013. Fruity notes, pear and pink pepper open bright, tuberose, ylang-ylang and jasmine form a rich heart, and amber, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.

Glamorous and radiant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Elixir for Men
description_html:
Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Elixir is a rich, aromatic blend of sage, orris and leather.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2023. Green mandarin, grapefruit and cardamom open bright, sage, lavandin, geranium and orris butter form an elegant heart, and patchouli, fir balsam, leather and olibanum give it a warm finish.

Smooth and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Montblanc Explorer Platinum is a fresh, airy blend of violet leaf, clary sage and cedar.

Launched in 2023, it opens with green violet leaves, moves into an aromatic clary sage heart, and settles into clean cedarwood.

Cool and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Coach Green Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: In 2023, Coach released a fresh fragrance for men, Coach Green. Created by the expert nose, Marie Salamagne, this scent is an inviting mix of top notes of Kiwi and Bergamot, Rosemary and Geranium as middle notes, and Cedar and Moss as base notes.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Parfum is a deep, aromatic marine with incense.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2023. Marine notes and bergamot open fresh, rosemary, geranium and clary sage form an aromatic heart, and olibanum and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Fresh yet refined, it works for days and evenings alike.

title: Kayali The Wedding Velvet Santal 35 Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Kayali The Wedding Velvet Santal 35 is a soft, woody blend of tea, white musk and sandalwood.

Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2023. Tea and jasmine open fresh, white musk and cedarwood form a clean heart, and benzoin and sandalwood give it a warm, powdery finish.

Smooth and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Kayali The Wedding Silk Santal 36 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Kayali The Wedding Silk Santal 36 is a sweet, creamy blend of champagne, praline and sandalwood.

Gabriela Chelariu created it in 2023. Champagne, freesia and black currant open sparkling, nectarine, praline, jasmine, orange blossom and May rose form a sweet heart, and vanilla, sugar, musk, sandalwood and oakmoss give it a soft finish.

Romantic and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Hugo Boss The Collection Silk & Jasmine Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Boss The Collection Silk & Jasmine is a sweet, honeyed blend of jasmine, vanilla and clove.

Launched in 2011, it blends white honey, jasmine, vanilla and clove into a warm, smooth and gently spicy floral scent.

Elegant and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Hugo Boss The Collection Sensual Geranium Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss The Collection Sensual Geranium is an herbal blend of artemisia, geranium and sandalwood.

Olivia Giacobetti created it in 2021. Artemisia and angelica open green, geranium and rose form a fresh floral heart, and sandalwood and white musk give it a soft, powdery finish.

Calm and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Hugo Boss The Collection Daring Saffiano Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss The Collection Daring Saffiano is an aromatic blend of davana, osmanthus and leather.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2021. Davana opens fruity, osmanthus and geranium form a floral heart, and leather and patchouli give it a smooth, warm finish.

Refined and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Hugo Boss The Collection Cotton & Verbena Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Boss The Collection Cotton & Verbena is a fresh, mossy blend of verbena, vetiver and oakmoss.

Launched in 2011, it blends lemon verbena, vetiver and oakmoss into a crisp, earthy and aromatic citrus scent.

Clean and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Intenso Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Intenso is a bright, fruity blend of citrus, black currant and violet.

Launched in 2023, it opens with mandarin, Italian lemon, black currant and white amber. Florals, ylang-ylang and violet form the heart, and patchouli, dry woods, white musk and sandalwood give it a clean finish.

Fresh and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Gold Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Gold is a warm, woody blend of oud, rosewood and vanilla.

Launched in 2018, it blends oud, Brazilian rosewood, sandalwood, cardamom, vanilla, Sichuan pepper, vetiver, tonka bean and amber into a smooth, spicy and sweet woody scent.

Rich and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Fiori Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Fiori is a musky, powdery blend of saffron, jasmine and caramel.

Launched in 2018, it opens with saffron. Jasmine, moss and caramel form a soft, slightly sweet heart, and musk, white cedar and ambroxan give it a clean, radiant finish.

Smooth and modern, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Montale Pure Love Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Pure Love is a warm blend of rose, sandalwood and leather.

Launched in 2019, it opens with rose. Sandalwood and vetiver form a woody heart, and vanilla, leather and ambergris give it a warm, animalic finish.

Smooth and sensual, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Venice Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Venice is a spicy rose with black pepper and cedar.

Launched in 2023, it opens with black pepper. Rose forms a fresh floral heart, and cedarwood gives it a dry, woody finish.

Simple and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Prive Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Privé is a sweet white floral with orange, tuberose and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with orange, petitgrain and pink pepper. Jasmine, ylang-ylang, tuberose and lily-of-the-valley form a lush heart, and benzoin, vanilla and woods give it a warm finish.

Elegant and smooth, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Ocean Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Ocean is a fresh, woody blend of citrus, pink pepper and iris.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bergamot, grapefruit and citrus. Cedar, pink pepper and patchouli form a woody heart, and amber and iris give it a powdery finish.

Crisp and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris New York Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris New York is a fresh, fruity blend of lemon, apple and rose.

Launched in 2023, it opens with lemon, citron and apple. Rose and jasmine form a floral heart, and musk, amber and cedar give it a clean finish.

Light and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Milano Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Milano is a creamy white floral with lime, gardenia and coconut.

Launched in 2023, it opens with lime and apple sherbet. Gardenia, tuberose and orchid form a lush heart, and sandalwood, amber, coconut and woods give it a creamy finish.

Fresh and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris London Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris London is a warm, fruity blend of peach, rum and vanilla.

Launched in 2023, it opens with peach, orange and cardamom. Jasmine, davana, heliotrope and rum form a sweet heart, and patchouli, vanilla, tonka bean, benzoin and labdanum give it a warm finish.

Cozy and smooth, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Night de Paris Black Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Night de Paris Black is a fruity, smoky blend of pineapple, birch tar and ambergris.

Launched in 2023, it opens with pineapple, apple, bergamot and black currant. Birch tar, jasmine and juniper berries form a smoky heart, and ambergris, oakmoss and musk give it a warm, leathery finish.

Bold and confident, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: L'Orientale Fragrances Hypnos Phantom Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
L'Orientale Hypnos Phantom is a sweet, watery blend of lemon, rose and vanilla.

Launched in 2020, it opens with watery notes and lemon. Rose and sugar form a sweet heart, and cedar, vanilla, sugar and white musk give it a soft finish.

Light and cozy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Shooting Stars Allende Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Allende is a rich vanilla with magnolia and cacao.

Chris Maurice created it in 2018. Madagascar vanilla and magnolia open soft and floral, vanilla and cacao form a gourmand heart, and more vanilla gives it a deep, creamy finish.

Cozy and indulgent, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Penhaligon's Night Scented Stock Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Penhaligon's Night Scented Stock is a warm, spicy floral with clove and vanilla.

Launched in 1976, it opens with clove and cinnamon. Ylang-ylang, lily, heliotrope, violet and jasmine form a soft, powdery heart, and tonka bean, benzoin, musk, sandalwood and vanilla give it a cozy finish.

Gentle and comforting, it is lovely for evenings and cooler days.

title: Penhaligon's Jubilee Bouquet Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Penhaligon's Jubilee Bouquet is a classic, powdery floral with rose, violet and oakmoss.

Launched in 1977, it opens with chamomile, bergamot and clove. Rose, violet, iris, ylang-ylang and jasmine form a soft heart, and oakmoss, musk, sandalwood and amber give it a mossy finish.

Timeless and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Penhaligon's Amaranthine Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Penhaligon's Amaranthine is a spicy, milky floral with tea, carnation and sandalwood.

Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2009. Palm leaf, cardamom, freesia, coriander and tea open green, ylang-ylang, carnation, clove, jasmine, orange flower and rose form a spicy heart, and milk, vanilla, sandalwood, musk and tonka bean give it a creamy finish.

Sensual and unusual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Invictus is a fresh, marine blend of grapefruit, bay leaf and ambergris.

Véronique Nyberg, Anne Flipo, Olivier Polge and Dominique Ropion created it in 2013. Sea notes, grapefruit and mandarin open bright, bay leaf and jasmine form an aromatic heart, and ambergris, guaiac wood, oakmoss and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Sporty and confident, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Jovoy Paris Touche Finale Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Jovoy Touche Finale is a soft, powdery blend of mimosa, violet leaf and heliotrope.

Vanina Muracciole created it in 2019. Mimosa and pink pepper open bright, violet leaf, rose, jasmine and cedar form an airy heart, and heliotrope, white musk and sandalwood give it a powdery finish.

Gentle and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: BDK Parfums Ambre Safrano Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The newest scent from BDK Parfums, Ambre Safrano, is a unisex perfume of woody and spicy notes, released in 2022.

title: Serge Lutens Fleurs d'Oranger Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Serge Lutens Fleurs d'Oranger is a bright white floral with orange blossom, tuberose and cumin.

Christopher Sheldrake created it in 2003. Orange blossom, jasmine, Indian tuberose, citrus, white rose, neroli, hibiscus, cumin, musk and woods come together in a radiant, spicy floral scent.

Sunny and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Paris Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Paris is the classic powdery rose with violet and mimosa.

Sophia Grojsman created it in 1983. Rose, mimosa, hyacinth, geranium, nasturtium, orange blossom and bergamot open lush, rose, violet, lily, linden blossom, ylang-ylang and orris root form a romantic heart, and iris, musk, heliotrope, sandalwood and oakmoss give it a soft finish.

Romantic and timeless, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: The Woods Collection Timeless Sands Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Woods Collection Timeless Sands is a warm blend of orange blossom, cedar and tonka.

Launched in 2017, it opens with orange blossom, bergamot and coriander. Cedar forms a woody heart, and ambrette, tonka bean and vanilla give it a warm, ambery finish.

Smooth and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: The Woods Collection Azure Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Woods Collection Azure is a sweet white floral with tuberose, ylang-ylang and amber.

Launched in 2017, it opens with fruity notes. Tuberose, ylang-ylang and jasmine form a lush heart, and amber, musk, woods and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Radiant and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier So Scandal Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier So Scandal! is a creamy white floral with raspberry, tuberose and milk.

Fabrice Pellegrin and Daphné Bugey created it in 2020. Raspberry, tuberose, orange blossom, jasmine sambac and a milky accord come together in a sweet, lush and lactonic floral scent.

Playful and sensual, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pour Homme Eau & Cèdre Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau & Cèdre is a woody blend of cardamom, cedar and vetiver.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2022. Cardamom opens warm, cedar forms a dry woody heart, and vetiver and patchouli give it an earthy finish.

Calm and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Cartier Declaration Haute Fraicheur Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Cartier introduces a new Woody Spicy fragrance for both men and women, Déclaration Haute Fraîcheur, released in 2021. Mathilde Laurent is the nose behind this scent, which features Citrus Leaf as its top note, Cardamom as its middle note, and Cedar as its base note.

title: Thomas Kosmala Light of Grace Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala Light of Grace is a soft blend of ambrette, iris and white oud.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2018. Ambrette and iris open soft, white flowers, vanilla and ambery woods form a gentle heart, and white oud, ambergris and musk give it an airy, salty finish.

Calm and luminous, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Thomas Kosmala A Never Ending Love Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala A Never Ending Love is a soft, musky blend of lemon zest, orange blossom and amber.

Thomas Kosmala created it in 2018. Lemon zest and bitter orange blossom open bright, aromatic spices form a warm heart, and musk, amber and woods give it a powdery finish.

Intimate and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Thomas Kosmala Song In The Wind Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thomas Kosmala Song in the Wind is a warm blend of saffron, rose and oud.

Launched in 2021, it opens with saffron, bergamot and raspberry. Rose, vanilla and musk form a soft heart, and ambergris, oud, amber and patchouli give it a rich, slightly animalic finish.

Sensual and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Penhaligon's Zizonia Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Penhaligon's Zizonia is a spicy, aromatic blend of cardamom, ginger and vetiver.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2010. Cardamom, bergamot, coriander and orange open bright, ginger, lavender, nutmeg, pepper, geranium and cumin form a spicy heart, and vetiver, sandalwood, cedar, amber and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Distinctive and polished, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Penhaligon's Legacy of Petra Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Penhaligon's Legacy of Petra is a resinous blend of green tea, licorice and myrrh.

Natalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2022. Green tea, fennel and bergamot open fresh, licorice, myrrh, olibanum and rosemary form a warm heart, and benzoin, woods and vanilla give it a balsamic finish.

Warm and contemplative, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Penhaligon's The World According to Arthur Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Penhaligon's The World According to Arthur is a warm blend of vanilla, incense and grapefruit.

Launched in 2021, it opens with vanilla, incense and grapefruit. Ambrette and clary sage form an aromatic heart, and incense and tonka bean give it a smoky, sweet finish.

Cozy and distinctive, it is a great choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Juliette Has a Gun White Spirit Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun White Spirit is a creamy white floral with tuberose and jasmine.

Launched in 2015, it opens with tuberose and jasmine sambac. Tuberose and ambroxan form a radiant heart, and musk, sandalwood, cedar and amber give it a smooth, woody finish.

Elegant and luminous, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Juliette Has a Gun Oil Fiction Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Oil Fiction is a warm, ambery blend of tuberose, ylang-ylang and labdanum.

Launched in 2013, it blends tuberose, ylang-ylang, iris and saffron with amber, labdanum, ambroxan, patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla and papyrus for a sunny, oily and warm scent.

Sensual and smooth, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Juliette Has a Gun In The Mood For Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun In the Mood for Oud is a sweet blend of oud, raspberry and vanilla.

Launched in 2019, it opens with bergamot. Oud, saffron, papyrus and raspberry form a warm, fruity heart, and tonka bean and vanilla give it a smooth finish.

Cozy and modern, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Juliette Has a Gun Metal Chypre Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Metal Chypre is a musky blend of pink pepper, suede and iris.

Romano Ricci created it in 2017. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, suede, iris, patchouli and amber form a powdery heart, and ambroxan, white musk and tonka bean give it a smooth finish.

Modern and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun is a sunny floral with coconut, gardenia and ylang-ylang.

Launched in 2023, it opens with freesia, coconut and bergamot. Gardenia, ylang-ylang, jasmine and orange blossom form a warm floral heart, and white musk, ambroxan and vanilla give it a soft finish.

Radiant and cheerful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Juliette Has a Gun Lipstick Fever Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Lipstick Fever is a powdery blend of raspberry, violet and iris.

Launched in 2020, it opens with raspberry and violet. Iris and patchouli form a powdery, earthy heart, and cedar and vanilla give it a soft, woody finish.

Playful and chic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Juliette Has a Gun Into The Void Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Into the Void is a woody blend of licorice, orchid and ambroxan.

Launched in 2016, it opens with licorice. Orchid and tonka bean form a sweet heart, and ambroxan, guaiac wood, papyrus, patchouli and cedar give it a dry, woody finish.

Modern and smooth, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold is a warm, spicy blend of honey, saffron and leather.

Daphné Bugey, Fabrice Pellegrin and Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2021. Honey, saffron and cardamom open warm, cypriol, rose and jasmine sambac form an earthy heart, and sandalwood, leather and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Glamorous and bold, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal By Night Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal by Night Intense is a sweet blend of honey, cherry and tuberose.

Daphné Bugey created it in 2018. Honey, bitter orange and citrus open golden, cherry, tuberose, orange blossom, pear and spikenard form a rich heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, patchouli, sandalwood and white musk give it a warm finish.

Seductive and bold, it is a great choice for evenings.

title: Jo Malone Orris & Sandalwood Cologne Intense Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Orris & Sandalwood is a powdery blend of orris, violet and labdanum.

Pierre Negrin created it in 2016. Orris, violet, musk, labdanum, tiger nut, amber, galbanum and geranium come together in a soft, earthy and woody scent.

Elegant and calm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Haute Fragrance Company Dry Wood Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Haute Fragrance Company Dry Wood is an earthy blend of sage, incense and vetiver.

Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Sage, Calabrian bergamot and black pepper open fresh, labdanum, incense and musk form a resinous heart, and vetiver, amber and patchouli give it a dry, woody finish.

Refined and grounded, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune is a zesty, iconic grapefruit with cassia and patchouli.

Jean-Paul Guerlain and Mathilde Laurent created it in 1999. Grapefruit and bergamot open sharp and juicy, cassia, petitgrain and neroli form a green heart, and patchouli and vanilla give it a soft finish.

Bright and energizing, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Orange Soleia Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Orange Soleia is a juicy, sparkling blend of blood orange and mint.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2020. Blood orange, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, petitgrain and mint form a cool, green heart, and musk and tonka bean give it a soft finish.

Fresh and energizing, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Hind Al Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Hind Al Oud is a pure, spicy oud.

Launched in 2021, it centers on oud with a fresh, spicy edge, giving a rich, smoky and woody scent with real depth.

Bold and distinctive, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Nettare di Sole Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Nettare di Sole is a sunny floral with orange blossom, jasmine and honey.

Thierry Wasser and Delphine Jelk created it in 2021. Orange blossom, watery notes and Calabrian bergamot open bright, solar notes, magnolia, jasmine sambac and rose form a radiant heart, and honey gives it a sweet finish.

Warm and cheerful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia is a fruity, aromatic blend of pomegranate, sage and cypress.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2020. Black currant, lemon and bergamot open bright, pomegranate, sage, rose and cypress form an aromatic heart, and white musk, moss and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Fresh and lively, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia is a fresh, watery floral with violet and melon.

Thierry Wasser and Delphine Jelk created it in 2021. Watery notes, violet, melon and wildflowers open fresh, solar notes, jasmine and orange blossom form a sunny heart, and violet, iris and white musk give it a powdery finish.

Light and natural, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Epices Exquises Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Épices Exquises is a warm, spicy blend of cardamom, coffee and oud.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2022. Cardamom, angelica and pink pepper open aromatic, black pepper and coffee form a rich heart, and sandalwood, oud and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Refined and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Floraiku Cricket Song Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Floraiku Cricket Song is a fresh floral with bergamot, magnolia and vetiver.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2017. Bergamot opens bright, magnolia forms a soft floral heart, and vetiver gives it a clean, woody finish.

Light and calm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Floraiku Between Two Trees is a fresh, green blend of grapefruit, maté and vetiver.

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2017. Grapefruit opens bright, maté forms an earthy, green heart, and vetiver gives it a smooth, woody finish.

Calm and natural, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Ex Nihilo Brompton Immortals Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Brompton Immortals is a warm, spicy floral with saffron, rose and vanilla.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2018. Saffron and pink pepper open warm, Bulgarian rose, ylang-ylang, jasmine sambac and lily form a lush heart, and Madagascar vanilla, olibanum, patchouli and white musk give it a smooth finish.

Elegant and glowing, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Dunhill Signature Collection Egyptian Smoke Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Alfred Dunhill's Egyptian Smoke is a spicy amber fragrance for men, which was launched in 2020. The perfumer behind this captivating creation is Jérôme Epinette. The top notes blend together Black Tea, Pink Pepper and Ginger, while the heart consists of Tobacco, Grasse Rose, Cacao and Papyrus. The fragrance is rounded off with a base of Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Palo Santo and Patchouli.

title: Dunhill Signature Collection Arabian Desert Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Alfred Dunhill's Arabian Desert is a bold and masculine Amber Floral fragrance released in 2019. It opens with bright and spicy Saffron and Pink Pepper, layered with sweet and floral Rose and Night Blooming Jasmine in its heart. The scent is completed by a robust base of Amber, Agarwood (Oud) and Incense to make it truly unforgettable.

title: Diptyque Florabellio Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Released in 2015, the Florabellio Eau de Toilette from Diptyque exudes an intoxicatingly aromatic and spicy scent suitable for both men and women. Fabrice Pellegrin, the talented nose behind the fragrance, masterfully combined Sea Notes, Sea Salt, Fennel, Apple Blossom, Osmanthus, Roasted Coffee Beans, and Sesame to create an unforgettable experience.

title: Clive Christian X Twist Sichuan Pepper Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Clive Christian's X Twist Sichuan Pepper was released in 2018, and is a gender-neutral Chypre fragrance. Its tantalizing top notes of Sichuan Pepper and Ginger are complemented by sweet middle notes of Peach, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley, all resting atop a warm and comforting base of Vanilla and Musk.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar is a radiant grapefruit and woody amber fragrance.

Jacques Cavallier Belletrud created it in 2016 around sparkling grapefruit, ambroxan and woods. The result is bright and clean, with a glowing citrus-amber trail.

A luxurious everyday scent that feels fresh and confident.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Falkar Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Created by renowned perfumer Jacques Cavallier in 2019, Falkar by Bvlgari is a warm, woody fragrance designed just for men. Nutmeg and Cinnamon embrace the senses at top notes, while a heart of Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Olibanum provides a sensual complexity. The amber base of Saffron, Agarwood (Oud) and Black Musk creates a mesmerizing trail of scent.

title: Bentley Beyond The Collection Wild Vetiver Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Launched in 2019, Bentley's Wild Vetiver is a sophisticated Woody Aromatic fragrance for men and women crafted by perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur.

title: Bentley Beyond The Collection Vibrant Hibiscus Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bentley's Vibrant Hibiscus, released in 2020, is a Floral fragrance that can be worn by both women and men. The blend of top notes includes Cassis, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Violet Leaves; middle notes consist of Red Peony, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine, Damask Rose and Hibiscus; and base notes are Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk and Moss.

title: Bentley Beyond The Collection Mellow Heliotrope Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bentley's Mellow Heliotrope is a unisex Amber Floral scent released in 2020. The top notes of Gardenia, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Cassis open the aroma, with heart notes of Raspberry, Elemi and Pink Pepper, all grounded with a base of Heliotrope, Vanilla, Praline, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Violet Leaf.

title: Bentley Beyond The Collection Majestic Cashmere Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bentley's Majestic Cashmere is a woody scent for both men and women, released in 2019 and crafted by perfumer Julie Masse.
