title: Bentley Beyond The Collection Exotic Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bentley's Exotic Musk is a timeless aroma for both men and women released in 2019. Created by Mathilde Bijaoui, the amber scent is unmistakable and unforgettable.

title: ArteOlfatto Vanesya Extrait de Parfum for Women
description_html: The fragrance Vanesya, created by ArteOlfatto for women, was released in 2013. Featuring top notes of Narcissus, Mango, Peach and Mandarin Orange, as well as middle notes of Peony, Osmanthus, Rose and Pink Pepper, it ends with base notes of White Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Patchouli for a floral-fruity scent.

title: ArteOlfatto Paropamiso Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: ArteOlfato introduces Paropamiso, a unisex Woody scent that was released in 2015. Its heady aroma is composed of Bergamot, Apple, Lemon, Pink Pepper, Magnolia, Bergamot Blossom, Musk, Woody Notes, and Patchouli.

title: Giorgio Armani Pivoine Suzhou Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Pivoine Suzhou is a fresh, fruity floral with raspberry, peony and rose.

Cécile Matton and Julie Massé created it in 2014. Raspberry, pink pepper and mandarin open juicy, peony, May rose and rose form a pretty heart, and musk, patchouli and amber give it a soft finish.

Light and romantic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Join The Club Birdie Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Join the Club Birdie is an earthy blend of patchouli, grass and vetiver.

Chris Maurice created it in 2012. Indian patchouli, a soil accord, grass, vetiver, lavender, sand, sea notes, apple and pepper come together in a green, earthy and woody scent.

Natural and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Vilhelm Parfumerie London Funk Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Vilhelm Parfumerie London Funk is an aromatic blend of juniper, basil and maté.

Launched in 2021, it opens with bergamot, juniper, basil and cardamom. Cassis and driftwood form a fruity, woody heart, and vetiver, maté, cedar, ambergris and sandalwood give it a fresh finish.

Crisp and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Vilhelm Parfumerie Do Not Disturb Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Vilhelm Parfumerie Do Not Disturb is a fruity, woody floral with black currant and ylang-ylang.

Jérôme Épinette created it in 2016. Black currant, carnation, ylang-ylang, Haitian vetiver and papyrus come together in a rich, fruity and gently spicy floral wood.

Sensual and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Vilhelm Parfumerie Basilico & Fellini Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Vilhelm Parfumerie Basilico & Fellini is a green blend of basil, fig and hay.

Launched in 2017, it opens with basil and dragon fruit. Fig and violet form a soft green heart, and grass, hay and vetiver give it a fresh, earthy finish.

Natural and refreshing, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Talitha Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Talitha is an aromatic blend of citrus, spices and leather.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2022. Lemon leaf, Amalfi lemon, pink grapefruit and bergamot open bright, nutmeg, ambergris, leather, ylang-ylang, cinnamon, rose and cardamom form a spicy heart, and Haitian vetiver, guaiac wood, cedar and musk give it a woody finish.

Refined and lively, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Orionis Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Orionis is a warm, balsamic blend of incense, saffron and vanilla.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Incense and saffron open smoky, ambergris, amber and patchouli form a warm heart, and tolu balsam, benzoin, vanilla and musk give it a powdery finish.

Cozy and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Nero Oudh Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Nero Oudh is a dark, earthy blend of saffron, rose and Indian oud.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Saffron, cypriol, ylang-ylang, rose geranium and magnolia open spicy, Bulgarian rose, gurjan balsam, guaiac wood, violet and cedar form a woody heart, and Indian oud, patchouli, ambergris, vanilla and musk give it a rich finish.

Intense and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Lyncis Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Lyncis is an earthy, powdery blend of iris, rose and oakmoss.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Iris flower, white iris, bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper open soft, rose, orange blossom, amber and jasmine form a floral heart, and oakmoss, patchouli, tonka bean, sandalwood, cedar and vetiver give it a woody finish.

Refined and calm, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Chi Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Chi is an earthy gourmand of coffee, caramel and truffle.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2022. Coffee, milk, caramel and almond open sweet, Cambodian oud, patchouli, earthy notes, truffle and vanilla form a dark heart, and cypriol, tonka bean, Indian oud, vanilla flower and caramel give it a rich finish.

Unusual and indulgent, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Cas Attar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Cas Attar is a spicy rose with pepper, oud and birch.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2017. Rose, black pepper and pink pepper open spicy, oud, green pepper and birch form a smoky heart, and ambergris, musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Bold and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Bianco Puro Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Bianco Puro is a warm, sweet blend of citrus, mango, caramel and oud.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Green mandarin, bergamot and lemon open bright, saffron, lavender, clove, mango and caramel form a sweet, spicy heart, and Cambodian oud, myrrh, vanilla, sandalwood and vetiver give it a rich finish.

Opulent and smooth, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: The Woods Collection North Star Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
The Woods Collection North Star is a fresh, woody blend of pomelo, juniper and vetiver.

Launched in 2021, it opens with pomelo and raspberry. Violet, juniper and rose form an aromatic heart, and vetiver and leather give it an earthy finish.

Clean and grounded, it is a great everyday scent.

title: The Woods Collection Dancing Leaves Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Woods Collection Dancing Leaves is a woody rose with geranium and patchouli.

Launched in 2016, it opens with florals and green notes. Rose, African geranium and sandalwood form a warm heart, and patchouli and white flowers give it an earthy finish.

Elegant and natural, it is a great everyday scent.

title: The House of Oud Up To The Moon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The House of Oud Up to the Moon is a fruity floral with pear, iris and raspberry.

Cristian Calabrò and Carlo Ribero created it in 2020. Neroli, Tuscan iris, black currant, pear and grapefruit open bright, magnolia, Damask rose and jasmine sambac form a floral heart, and raspberry, vanilla, ambrette, amber and sandalwood give it a sweet finish.

Pretty and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: The House of Oud Hidden Shades Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The House of Oud Hidden Shades is a soft blend of mirabelle, cherry blossom and vanilla.

Maurizio Cerizza created it in 2023. Lemon, bergamot and mirabelle open bright, cherry blossom, jasmine and labdanum form a floral heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood, patchouli, benzoin and musk give it a warm finish.

Pretty and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black I Love NY Edition Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: This classic Aromatic Fougere scent for men, 212 VIP Black, was launched in 2017 by the esteemed Carolina Herrera. Its unique formulation was conceived by the noses Carlos Benaim and Anne Flipo, and features notes of Absinthe, Anise, Fennel, Lavender, Black Vanilla Husk, and Musk.

title: Francesca Bianchi The Lover's Tale Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Francesca Bianchi The Lover's Tale is a smoky, powdery blend of honey, orris and leather.

Francesca Bianchi created it in 2018. Honey, mimosa, aldehydes and bergamot open bright, orris, peach, heliotrope, jasmine and Bulgarian rose form a soft heart, and leather, castoreum, musk, labdanum, oakmoss and sandalwood give it a sensual finish.

Romantic and bold, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Francesca Bianchi Sex And The Sea Neroli Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Francesca Bianchi Sex and the Sea Neroli is a sensual blend of neroli, coconut and ambergris.

Francesca Bianchi created it in 2019. Neroli, coconut, ambergris, honey, mimosa and petitgrain meet immortelle, vanilla, iris, benzoin, sandalwood, labdanum and a touch of civet for a warm, salty and powdery skin scent.

Sensual and sun-kissed, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Francesca Bianchi Etruscan Water Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Francesca Bianchi Etruscan Water is an earthy, aromatic citrus with oakmoss and orris.

Francesca Bianchi created it in 2019. Oakmoss, orris, ambergris, bergamot, immortelle, vetiver, petitgrain, basil, musk, labdanum, caraway, jasmine, grapefruit and tangerine come together in a fresh, mossy and slightly salty scent.

Natural and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Francesca Bianchi Byzantine Amber Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Francesca Bianchi Byzantine Amber is a rich, resinous amber with leather and incense.

Francesca Bianchi created it in 2023. Cinnamon and bergamot open warm, geranium forms the heart, and leather, labdanum, benzoin, styrax, ambergris and incense give it a deep, balsamic finish.

Opulent and enveloping, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Ultra Violet Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Introducing Amber Oud Ultra Violet by Al Haramain Perfumes, a fresh Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women, launched in 2023. A captivating combination of top notes including Ginger, Rose and Bergamot, middle notes of Tuberose, Jasmine and White Flowers, and base notes of Oak, Patchouli and Musk, this scent is sure to be a favorite.

title: Emporio Armani Diamonds Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Emporio Armani Diamonds is a fruity floral with litchi, raspberry and rose.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2007. Litchi and raspberry open juicy, rose, patchouli, freesia, cedar and lily-of-the-valley form a floral heart, and vanilla, amber and vetiver give it a warm finish.

Pretty and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Rosso Pompei Extrait de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Rosso Pompei is a bright citrus floral with a warm, woody base.

Paolo and Tiziana Terenzi created it. Grapefruit, Amalfi lemon and grapes open juicy, ambergris, jasmine, magnolia, lily-of-the-valley and tuberose form a radiant heart, and cedar, patchouli, woods and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.

Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Moro Di Venezia Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Moro di Venezia is a powdery blend of grapefruit, violet and hinoki.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2018. Grapefruit, pineapple, bergamot and black currant open juicy, violet, jasmine, amber and lily-of-the-valley form a soft heart, and hinoki, vanilla, musk and oak give it a woody finish.

Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. is a clean, juicy pear wrapped in soft musk.

Romano Ricci created it in 2021. Fresh pear meets ambroxan for a bright, airy heart, and musk and ambrettolide give it a skin-like, comforting finish.

Light and easy to wear, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Libra Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Libra is a powdery, bright blend of citrus, orris and ambergris.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2022. Lemon, grapefruit, Bulgarian rose, bergamot and tuberose open bright, orris root, ambergris, jasmine sambac and Atlas cedar form a soft heart, and musk, vanilla flower, benzoin, vetiver, patchouli and oakmoss give it a smooth finish.

Elegant and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Leo Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Leo is a bright, ambery blend of citrus, myrrh and rose.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2022. Sicilian mandarin, Brazilian orange, kumquat and bergamot open sunny, ambergris, myrrh, violet leaves, magnolia, Bulgarian rose and jasmine sambac form a rich heart, and musk, tonka bean, cedar, oak, sandalwood and benzoin give it a warm finish.

Radiant and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: BYREDO M/Mink Eau de Parfum Unisex
BYREDO Mister Marvelous Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Introducing the captivating Mister Marvelous by Byredo, a woody-aromatic fragrance for men, which was released in 2011. You'll be tantalized by the top notes of petitgrain and neroli, with bamboo and lavender as the main middle notes, while Virginia Cedar and Amber complete this scent as the base notes.

title: Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme Eau Intense Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme Eau Intense is a green, aromatic citrus with florals and smooth woods.

Roja Dove created it in 2023. Rhubarb, grapefruit, thyme, artemisia, lavender and lime open crisp, tuberose, jasmine, black currant, orange blossom and apple form the heart, and juniper, vetiver, galbanum, vanilla, cedarwood, ambergris and leather give it depth.

Fresh and luxurious, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Parisienne Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Parisienne is a fruity rose with blackberry, violet and a vinyl accord.

Sophia Grojsman and Sophie Labbé created it in 2009. Blackberry, cranberry and a vinyl accord open bright, Damask rose, violet and peony form a powdery heart, and musk, sandalwood, vetiver and patchouli give it a soft finish.

Chic and modern, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Dior Miss Dior Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: The latest interpretation of the iconic Miss Dior Eau de Parfum (2021), released in 2021, is an Amber Floral scent for women crafted by the renowned perfumer, Francois Demachy. Composed of top notes of Iris, Peony and Lily-of-the-Valley, middle notes of Apricot, Rose and Peach, and base notes of Vanilla, Musk, Tonka Bean, Benzoin and Sandalwood, this fragrance is sure to make a statement.

title: Jo Malone Rose & White Musk Absolu Eau de Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Rose & White Musk Absolu is a soft rose with oud and white musk.

Anne Flipo created it in 2018. Damask rose and rose water form a rich floral heart, and oud, white musk and amber give it a warm, powdery finish.

Elegant and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Jo Malone Violet & Amber Absolu Eau de Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Violet & Amber Absolu is a powdery blend of violet, oud and amber.

Anne Flipo created it in 2019. Oud, violet, amber, white musk, violet leaf and florals come together in a soft, powdery and gently woody scent.

Elegant and warm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Tom Ford Ombre de Hyacinth Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Ombré de Hyacinth is a green, airy floral with hyacinth, galbanum and olibanum.

Calice Becker created it in 2012. Violet leaf, galbanum, magnolia petals and olibanum open green, hyacinth, pink pepper and jasmine form a cool heart, and galbanum, musk and benzoin give it a soft finish.

Fresh and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra 2021 Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum is a woody blend of lemon, cypress and labdanum.

Launched in 2022, it opens with Italian lemon. Cypress and oak form a dry, woody heart, and amber and labdanum give it a warm finish.

Refined and aromatic, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum for Men
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir is a rich, honeyed take on the Le Male signature.

Launched in 2023, it opens with lavender and mint, moves into a warm heart of vanilla and benzoin, and settles into honey, tobacco and tonka bean for a sweet, intense finish.

Le Male Elixir is sweet and dense, with a honeyed warmth that turns heads. It is a bold choice when you want to make an impression.

title: Le Labo The Noir 29 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Thé Noir 29 is a dark, mellow blend of fig, tea leaves and tobacco.

Frank Voelkl created it in 2015. Fig, bay leaf and bergamot open fresh and green, cedar, vetiver and musk form a dry, woody heart, and tobacco and hay give it a warm, slightly smoky finish.

Understated and sophisticated, it is easy to wear in any season.

title: By Kilian Blue Moon Ginger Dash Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: By Kilian's Blue Moon Ginger Dash is a unisex scent created in 2023 by perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur. Bright Lemon and Calone open the scent, while spicy Ginger and Vodka comprise the middle notes. Finally, Ambroxan and White Musk create a cozy, musky base.

title: Dior Dioriviera Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Dioriviera is a sunny blend of green fig and rose.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2023. Green notes, fig and rose blend into a fresh, fruity and gently woody scent that evokes the Riviera.

A perfect summer daytime scent.

title: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum for Men
description_html:
Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum is a deeper, spicier take on Grey Vetiver.

Launched in 2023, it opens with orange blossom, moves into a warm saffron heart and settles into Haitian vetiver for a refined, earthy finish.

A polished choice for the office and evenings.

title: Nishane Mana Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nishane Mana is a rich, spicy blend of saffron, oud and suede.

Christian Provenzano created it in 2022. Saffron, cardamom, ginger and black pepper open warm, oud, suede, Turkish rose and castoreum form a leathery heart, and guaiac wood, sandalwood, labdanum, benzoin, musk and olibanum give it a deep finish.

Opulent and bold, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Goldfield & Banks Purple Suede Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Goldfield & Banks Purple Suede is a bold leather with lavender, hyssop and oud.

Ilias Ermenidis created it in 2022. Leather, lavender and pink pepper open aromatic, leatherwood, hyssop and coriander form the heart, and oud, cashmeran, civet, patchouli, amber and oakmoss give it an animalic finish.

Daring and distinctive, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Goldfield & Banks Island Lush Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Goldfield & Banks Island Lush is a spicy, woody blend of nutmeg, iris and sandalwood.

Amélie Jacquin created it in 2023. Nutmeg, ginger, pink pepper and bergamot open warm, guaiac wood, iris, cedar and geranium form a powdery heart, and sandalwood, leather, vetiver, benzoin and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Refined and warm, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Dior Eau Sauvage Extreme Intense 2010 Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: In 2010, master perfumer Francois Demachy released Eau Sauvage Extreme 2010 for men. The fragrance is composed of sharp top notes of Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon and Grapefruit; followed by aromatic middle notes of Elemi, Lavender, Mint, Basil and Jasmine; and woody base notes of Virginia Cedar, Oakmoss, Patchouli and Vetiver.

title: By Kilian Love Don't Be Shy Eau Fraiche Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: By Kilian's Love Eau Fraîche, a Floral-scented fragrance for women released in 2019, was created by the nose Calice Becker. It opens with Neroli and Petitgrain followed by heart notes of Jasmine, Peony and Freesia. The base of Marshmallow and White Musk rounds out the perfume.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Summer Vibes Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dolce&Gabbana's Light Blue Summer Vibes is a fresh, Floral Woody Musk scent specifically designed for women and released in 2023. Master perfumer Olivier Cresp created the combination of Calabrian bergamot, Peach, and Cedar, making this fragrance a unique and memorable experience.

title: Tiziana Terenzi Lince Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tiziana Terenzi Lince is a powdery blend of absinthe, iris and vanilla.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2018. Absinthe, star anise, green tea, grapefruit, orange and bergamot open aromatic, iris, jasmine, orange blossom, fig and Bulgarian rose form a soft heart, and vanilla, heliotrope, ambergris, sandalwood and musk give it a warm finish.

Elegant and cozy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Mizensir Elixir de Musc Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mizensir Elixir de Musc is a powdery, warm blend of musk, iris and heliotrope.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Musk, iris, heliotrope, amberwood and amber come together in a soft, ambery and velvety scent.

Intimate and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Mancera Of The Wild Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Of the Wild is a sweet, fruity blend of strawberry, pear and toffee.

Launched in 2022, it opens with strawberry, pear and heliotrope. Patchouli, orange blossom and jasmine form a floral heart, and musk, vanilla pod, toffee and vetiver give it a warm finish.

Playful and cozy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Mancera Fabulous Yuzu Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Fabulous Yuzu is a bright, sweet blend of yuzu, jasmine and sandalwood.

Launched in 2022, it opens with yuzu, lemon, mandarin and cinnamon. Jasmine, mimosa and vetiver form the heart, and Mysore sandalwood, vanilla and tonka bean give it a creamy finish.

Fresh and cheerful, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Summer Vibes Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Dolce&Gabbana released a brand new Woody Aromatic fragrance for men in 2023, titled Light Blue Pour Homme Summer Vibes. Created by perfumer Alberto Morillas, this scent is made up of Sicilian Lemon as the top note, Cypress as the middle note, and Amberwood as the base note.

title: Clive Christian 1872 Crab Apple Blossom Parfum Unisex
description_html: In 2020, Clive Christian introduced a unisex fragrance, Crab Apple Blossom, composed by the perfumer Kamila Lelakova. At the top of the blend are aquatic notes, bergamot and apple blossom, while the middle notes feature mojito and rhubarb. Finally, the base is composed of driftwood and sandalwood.

title: Bentley Momentum Unlimited Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Created by Bentley in 2018, Momentum Unlimited is a woody aromatic fragrance for men composed by the esteemed Michel Almairac. Its refreshing top notes include green apple, grapefruit, and cardamom, and its heart notes are cedar, vetiver, and sandalwood. Finally, its base notes are leather, musk, and ambroxan.

title: Bentley For Men Absolute Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: The Bentley For Men Absolute by Bentley fragrance for men was created in 2014 by Michel Almairac. It features a captivating blend of top notes such as Pink Pepper and Ginger, middle notes like Olibanum, Papyrus and Sandalwood, and base notes of Atlas Cedar, Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Moss for a warm and earthy aroma.

title: Giorgio Armani Prive Rose Milano Soie de Nacre Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Rose Milano Soie de Nacre is a fresh rose with citrus and oakmoss.

Launched in 2023, it opens with lemon and bergamot. Damask rose and jasmine form a soft floral heart, and oakmoss and patchouli give it a mossy finish.

Graceful and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Royal Parfum for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Royal is a warm, spicy and aromatic take on 1 Million.

Quentin Bisch and Christophe Raynaud created it in 2023. Cardamom, tangerine and bergamot open bright, lavender, sage and violet leaf form an aromatic heart, and benzoin, cedar and patchouli give it a rich, ambery finish.

Confident and smooth, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: BYREDO Sunday Cologne Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Byredo's Sunday Cologne, released in 2011, is a Woody Aromatic scent for both men and women. It has top notes of Bergamot, Star Anise and Cardamom, middle notes are of Lavender, Geranium, and Incense, and base notes of Vetiver, Oak Moss and Patchouli.

title: Clive Christian Town & Country Parfum Unisex
description_html: Town and Country by Clive Christian is a new fragrance for women and men launched in 2023 under the Crown Collection. This fragrance falls under the spicy woody amber family, comprising of 207 ingredients and a concentration of 25%. It exudes a crispness with invigorating notes from the most sophisticated herbs, resting on a deeper base. The scent captures the innate beauty of the countryside and the sophistication of London town.

title: Mind Games Scholar's Mate Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mind Games Scholar's Mate is a spicy, woody blend of cardamom, orris and sandalwood.

Christelle Laprade created it in 2022. Cardamom, bergamot, grapefruit and cinnamon leaf open bright, orris, elemi and pimento form a spicy heart, and sandalwood, fig nectar, cypriol and vetiver give it an earthy finish.

Refined and warm, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Media Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Media Cologne Forte is a fresh blend of verbena and fennel.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2023. Verbena and bergamot open bright, hedione and fennel form a fresh heart, and musk and woods give it a clean finish.

Light and refreshing for warm days.

title: Diptyque L'Eau Papier Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Diptyque L'Eau Papier is a soft, airy musk that feels like a blank page.

Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2023. White musk, mimosa, toasted sesame and light woods blend into a gentle, powdery scent with a delicate floral warmth.

Quiet and comforting, it is perfect for anyone who wants a subtle, close-to-the-skin scent for everyday wear.

title: Cartier Pasha de Cartier Noir Absolu Parfum for Men
description_html: Released in 2013, Pasha de Cartier Edition Noire by Cartier is a woody-aromatic men's fragrance created by nose Nathalie Feisthauer.

title: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Azzaro's Wanted Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody aromatic scent for men, released in 2023. Its captivating composition features top notes of juniper berries, a middle note of sage, and a base note of vetiver.

title: ZARKOPERFUME PURPLE MOLéCULE 070.07 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Purple Molécule 070.07 is a creamy floral with magnolia, orchid and vanilla.

Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it in 2019. Magnolia, white orchid and wildflowers open soft and fruity, and Madagascar vanilla, musk and sandalwood give it a warm, ambery finish.

Gentle and sweet, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Tony Iommi Monkey Special Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Tony Iommi Monkey Special is a rich, boozy blend of rum, spice and caramel.

Chris Maurice created it in 2021. Rum, passionfruit, bergamot and geranium open bright, cinnamon, patchouli, leather and rose form a warm heart, and caramel, vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood and labdanum give it a sweet, lasting finish.

Perfect for cooler evenings and special nights out.

title: Tom Daxon VSOP Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Daxon VSOP is a spicy, woody blend of cognac, ginger and vetiver.

Launched in 2013, it opens with bergamot, cognac and geranium. Elemi, black pepper, ginger, pink pepper and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and vetiver, cashmeran, musk and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.

Refined and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Airlines Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Airlines is a collector's edition of Le Male with mint, lavender and vanilla.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2020. Cardamom, mint, lavender, bergamot and artemisia open fresh, cinnamon, orange blossom and caraway form a spicy heart, and vanilla, cedar, sandalwood, tonka bean and amber give it a warm finish.

Classic and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: D.S. & DURGA Pistachio Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Pistachio, a brand new Aromatic Green fragrance from the house of DS&Durga, was released in 2022. Crafted by perfumer, David Seth Moltz, this unisex scent opens with a Pistachio top note, followed by a heart note of the same, and rounding off with a base note of Pistachio.

title: D.S. & DURGA Bistro Waters Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: DS&Durga's Bistro Waters is an aromatic green scent for both men and women, debuting in 2022. It was created by the esteemed nose, David Seth Moltz, and features an inviting blend of Lime Blossom, Coriander, and Pear top notes; Green Pepper and Mandarin Orange middle notes; and a captivating base of Moss, Basil, and Nutmeg.

title: Bvlgari Pour Homme Extreme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: The woody aromatic men's fragrance Bvlgari Extreme was released in 1999, crafted by the talented nose Jacques Cavallier. At the top, the scent opens with tea, grapefruit, bergamot, neroli, petitgrain, lavender, coriander and galbanum, blending into balsam fir, guaiac wood, pepper, nutmeg, Brazilian rosewood and cardamom at the heart, and rounding out with musk, cedar, iris, oakmoss and sandalwood at its base.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Urban Man Elixir Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Armaf's Club De Nuit Urban Elixir for men was released in 2022 and is a brand new fragrance. It has top notes of Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Jasmine and Orange Blossom; middle notes of Lavender, Geranium, Elemi, Saffron, Tagetes and Vetiver, and base notes of Ambroxan, Patchouli, Cedar, Amber and Labdanum.

title: CandleX After Hours - Intense Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Dolce & Gabbana The One

AFTER HOURS is a magnetic & comforting scent, it is full of allure and personality. The aromatic elixir is a warm and woody arrangement that fits perfectly in a luxury candle. Exemplifying good taste, class, and charisma this smooth scent will infuse the environment around you with a little extra magic.

Beginning with a sparkling & bold spicy oriental combination of grapefruit, coriander and basil followed by a balancing ginger, cardamom, and orange blossom. With base notes of cedarwood, amber and tobacco to finish off and create the suave aura. It is modern take on a warm and spiced aroma.

AFTER HOURS is inspired by The One by Dolce & Gabbana, a contemporary, tasteful, and timeless fragrance. A classic scent with a sultry edge providing a deliciously decadent addition fit to enhance any room, especially after hours.

title: ZARKOPERFUME BUDDHA-WOOD Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Buddha-Wood is a smooth, woody blend of buddha wood and sandalwood.

Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it. Buddha wood and Australian sandalwood come together in a soft, creamy and calm woody scent.

Simple and serene, it is a great everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME PINK MOLeCULE 090.09 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Pink Molécule 090.09 is a sweet blend of champagne, apricot and whipped cream.

Launched in 2014, it opens with champagne, apricot, black elder and black orchid, and whipped cream, blackwood and mahogany give it a creamy, sweet and gently woody finish.

Playful and soft, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME OUD'ISH Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Oud'ish is a musky blend of ambergris, green tea and oud.

Launched in 2013, it blends ambergris, green tea, white musk and oud into a soft, salty and lightly animalic woody scent.

Modern and smooth, it is a great everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME MOLeCULE No.8 Wodden Chips Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Molecule No. 8 Wooden Chips is a woody blend of mandarin, patchouli and oud.

Launched in 2015, it blends woods, mandarin, patchouli, oud and rose into a dry, citrusy and smooth woody scent.

Clean and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME INCEPTION Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Inception is a fresh, marine blend of sea notes, citrus and woods.

Launched in 2013, it blends sea notes, citrus, green notes, woods, florals and spices into a crisp, aromatic and breezy scent.

Fresh and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME e'L Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume e'L is a fresh, green blend of pomegranate, sea notes and green tea.

Launched in 2013, it opens with white flowers and pomegranate. Sea notes, green notes and green tea form a fresh heart, and white musk and white woods give it a clean finish.

Calm and refreshing, it is a great everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME CLOUD COLLECTION No.3 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection No. 3 is a fruity, airy blend of berries, magnolia and oud.

Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it in 2019. Red berries, mandarin and pear open juicy, ozonic notes, magnolia, tulip and black rose form an airy heart, and sandalwood, white musk, white wood, oud and vanilla give it a soft finish.

Light and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME CLOUD COLLECTION No.2 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection No. 2 is a fresh blend of lemongrass, jasmine leaf and sea water.

Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it in 2018. Lemongrass opens bright, jasmine leaf forms a green heart, and sea water, white musk and woods give it a clean, marine finish.

Fresh and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: ZARKOPERFUME CLOUD COLLECTION No.1 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection No. 1 is a fruity, leathery blend of sea buckthorn and jasmine.

Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it in 2017. Sea buckthorn, fruity notes, woods, leather and jasmine come together in a sweet, juicy and slightly animalic scent.

Distinctive and warm, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Babycat Accord Diam-Vanille Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Babycat is a warm, leathery vanilla with pepper and saffron.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2022. Elemi, pink pepper and black pepper open spicy, olibanum and saffron form a smoky heart, and bourbon vanilla, suede and cedar give it a smooth, sensual finish.

Sleek and seductive, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Vilhelm Parfumerie The Oud Affair Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Vilhelm Parfumerie The Oud Affair is a sweet blend of honey, tobacco and oud.

Jérôme Épinette created it in 2015. Honey and ginger open warm, tobacco leaf forms a rich heart, and oud and vanilla give it a sweet, smoky finish.

Cozy and sensual, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Vilhelm Parfumerie Room Service Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Vilhelm Parfumerie Room Service is a fruity, powdery blend of blackberry, orchid and violet.

Jérôme Épinette created it in 2015. Blackberry and mandarin open juicy, orchid, violet and bamboo form a soft heart, and musk, black amber and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Playful and sweet, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Precious Oud Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Van Cleef & Arpels Precious Oud is a rich white floral with tuberose, incense and oud.

Amandine Clerc-Marie created it in 2011. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, tuberose, incense and jasmine form a lush heart, and oud, sandalwood, patchouli, ambergris and vetiver give it a deep finish.

Opulent and elegant, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Patchouli Blanc Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Van Cleef & Arpels Patchouli Blanc is a clean, aldehydic blend of patchouli, rose and musk.

Jérôme Épinette created it in 2022. Aldehydes and pink pepper open bright, patchouli and rose form a soft heart, and cashmere wood and white musk give it a clean finish.

Elegant and modern, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Orchid Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Van Cleef & Arpels Orchid Leather is a warm blend of vanilla, plum and incense.

Julien Rasquinet created it in 2021. Vanilla absolute, labdanum, plum, incense and cardamom come together in a rich, fruity and balsamic scent.

Cozy and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Moonlight Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Van Cleef & Arpels Moonlight Patchouli is a woody blend of patchouli, cacao and iris.

Sonia Constant created it in 2016. Patchouli leaf, cacao and woods open warm, Bulgarian rose and iris form a powdery heart, and suede, leather and fruity notes give it a smooth finish.

Elegant and sensual, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Bois d'Iris Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Van Cleef & Arpels Bois d'Iris is a powdery, woody iris with incense and amber.

Émilie Bevierre-Coppermann created it in 2009. Iris, driftwood, vanilla, incense, myrrh, sugar, amber, ambergris, vetiver and labdanum come together in a soft, warm and refined scent.

Elegant and calm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Ambre Imperial Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Van Cleef & Arpels Ambre Impérial is a warm, smooth amber with tonka and vanilla.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2015. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, amber, tonka bean, vanilla and benzoin form a sweet heart, and woods give it a soft finish.

Cozy and elegant, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Tom Daxon Midnight Saffron Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Tom Daxon Midnight Saffron is a powdery floral with pepper, rose and iris.

Launched in 2013, it opens with lily-of-the-valley, pink pepper, cardamom and black pepper. Rose, iris and jasmine form a soft heart, and oakmoss, vetiver and musk give it an earthy finish.

Refined and calm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Tom Daxon Crushing Bloom Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Tom Daxon Crushing Bloom is a bright white floral with citrus, orange blossom and oakmoss.

Launched in 2019, it opens with mandarin and bergamot. Orange blossom and jasmine form a lush heart, and amber, oakmoss, patchouli and woods give it a warm finish.

Elegant and radiant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Thameen London Royal Sapphire Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thameen Royal Sapphire is a bright blend of citrus, orange blossom and amber.

Launched in 2019, it opens with mandarin and bergamot. Orange blossom and jasmine form a white floral heart, and amber, oakmoss, patchouli and woods give it a warm, slightly animalic finish.

Elegant and radiant, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Thameen London Regent Leather Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thameen Regent Leather is a warm, spicy leather with saffron, jasmine and vanilla.

Launched in 2016, it opens with lemon. Saffron, cardamom, jasmine and rose form a spicy floral heart, and vanilla, gurjan balsam, animalic notes, cedar, labdanum, patchouli and musk give it a rich finish.

Bold and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Thameen London Cullinan Diamond Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thameen Cullinan Diamond is a powdery blend of black pepper, rose and vanilla.

Launched in 2021, it opens with black pepper. Rose, vanilla and orris form a soft, powdery heart, and cashmere musk, amber and cedar give it a smooth finish.

Elegant and smooth, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Thameen London Amber Room Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Thameen Amber Room is a warm blend of amber, Turkish rose and spices.

Launched in 2013, it blends amber, Turkish rose, spices, bergamot, cedar and coriander into a rich, glowing and gently woody scent.

Elegant and warm, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Remix X Ansel Elgort Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Ralph Lauren Polo Red Remix x Ansel Elgort is a spicy blend of cranberry, saffron and coffee.

Launched in 2019, it opens with mandarin, cranberry and cardamom. Clary sage, saffron and geranium form an aromatic heart, and coffee, amberwood, patchouli and tonka bean give it a warm finish.

Bold and modern, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Penhaligon's Sports Car Club Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Penhaligon's Sports Car Club is a fresh, woody blend of pine, cypress and eucalyptus.

Launched in 2022, it opens with pine and pink pepper. Cypress and eucalyptus form a cool, aromatic heart, and ambroxan, patchouli and musk give it a clean finish.

Crisp and invigorating, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Orto Parisi Megamare Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Orto Parisi Megamare is a powerful marine blend of citrus, seaweed and ambroxan.

Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2019. Bergamot and lemon open bright, calone, hedione and seaweed form a salty, oceanic heart, and ambroxan, cedar and musk give it a radiant finish.

Bold and fresh, it works day or night.

title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis Cologne Forte is a clean blend of bergamot, sweet pea and musk.

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2021. Bergamot opens bright, sweet pea and mock orange form a soft floral heart, and white musk gives it a powdery, clean finish.

Light and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Le Labo Lys 41 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Le Labo Lys 41 is a creamy white floral with tuberose, lily and jasmine.

Daphné Bugey created it in 2013. Tuberose, lily, jasmine, vanilla, musk and woods come together in a lush, sunny and slightly animalic floral scent.

Radiant and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Tears From The Moon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Tears from the Moon is a fresh, delicate floral with peony and lily-of-the-valley.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2022. Peony opens soft and rosy, lily-of-the-valley forms a dewy heart, and stephanotis gives it a gentle, green finish.

Light and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Gucci Love At Your Darkest Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Gucci Love at Your Darkest is a dry, spicy blend of black pepper, olibanum and cedar.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2022. Black pepper opens sharp, olibanum forms a smoky, resinous heart, and cedar gives it a dry, ambery finish.

Moody and minimal, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Ex Nihilo Vetiver Moloko Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Vetiver Moloko is a creamy, earthy blend of vetiver, milk and vanilla.

Launched in 2014, it opens with bergamot and Bulgarian rose. Milk and cypress form a soft, aromatic heart, and vetiver, amyris and Madagascar vanilla give it a smooth, woody finish.

Calm and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Ex Nihilo Citizen X Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Citizen X is a dry, ambery blend of mastic, white pepper and iris.

Yann Vasnier created it in 2017. Mastic and white pepper open fresh, iris forms a powdery heart, and amberwood, olibanum and musk give it a warm, woody finish.

Modern and polished, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Ex Nihilo Bois d'Hiver Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Ex Nihilo Bois d'Hiver is a powdery, spicy blend of cardamom, cedar and heliotrope.

Michel Girard created it in 2014. Cardamom and pink pepper open warm, white cedar, heliotrope and cyclamen form a powdery heart, and patchouli, sandalwood, musk and cypriol give it a woody finish.

Cozy and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 Women Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: 212 by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. 212 was launched in 1997. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Cactus Flower, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lily, Freesia, Gardenia, Jasmine, White Camelia, Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose and Peony; base notes are Musk and Sandalwood.

title: Carner Barcelona Rose & Dragon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Rose & Dragon by Carner Barcelona is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Rose & Dragon was launched in 2016. Top notes are Wild Strawberry, Saffron, Cumin and Cinnamon; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose, Honey and Incense; base notes are Leather, Labdanum, Castoreum and Amber.

title: Carner Barcelona Megalium Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Megalium by Carner Barcelona is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Megalium was launched in 2018. Top notes are Cinnamon, Cinnamon Leaf, Calamus and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Nutmeg, Pimento, White Pepper and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Myrrh, Olibanum, Opoponax and Styrax.

title: Carner Barcelona Felino Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Carner Barcelona's Felino is a unisex Amber Floral fragrance released in 2020. Its opening notes of Absinthe, Hazelnut and Bergamot give way to a heart of Leather, Clove, Jasmine and Ylang-Ylang, before its woody, sweet base of Myrrh, Opoponax, Civet, Styrax and Vanilla complete the scent.

title: Carner Barcelona Bestium Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Bestium by Carner Barcelona is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Bestium was launched in 2020. Top notes are Turkish Rose, Bulgarian Rose, Saffron and Bergamot; middle notes are Chinese Osmanthus, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Incense; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Spanish Labdanum and Incense.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Rubinia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Rubinia by Bvlgari is a Amber Woody fragrance for women. Rubinia was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top note is Sicilian Mandarin; middle notes are Copaiba balm, Sandalwood, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Saffron, Violet and Agarwood (Oud).

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Orom Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Le Gemme Orom by Bvlgari is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Le Gemme Orom was launched in 2022. Top note is Bourbon Vanilla; middle note is Siam Benzoin; base note is Agarwood (Oud).

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Empyr Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Le Gemme Empyr by Bvlgari is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Le Gemme Empyr was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top note is Ginger; middle note is Ginger; base notes are Sandalwood and Labdanum.

title: BDK Parfums Villa Néroli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Villa Néroli by BDK Parfums is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. The nose behind this fragrance is Alexandra Carlin. Top notes are Tunisian Neroli, Petitgrain and Lemon; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Ambroxan, Cashmeran, Madagascar Vetiver, Spanish Labdanum, Moss and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf.

title: CandleX White Tie & Tails - Classic Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Parfums de Marly Layton

WHITE TIE & TAILS is an enticing and debonair oriental floral aroma that is truly impossible to resist. It is a cluster of seduction and well-mannered self-assurance. A proud, noble, and velvety scent that writes its own narrative.

WHITE TIE & TAILS is a formal gala appropriate fragrance that references the superiority and distinction of aristocratic society, inspired by Layton by Parfums de Marly. Expressing itself through its zesty bergamot, apple and lavender top notes into a refreshing garden of jasmine, violet and geranium to create a chic and courtly combination. The opulence of this scent is further heightened by the addictive nature of spiced vanilla, caramelized coffee, and exquisite woods.

If you are searching for an intoxicating, luxurious and heady candle to envelop your senses; WHITE TIE & TALES is the epitome of finery and decorum.

title: CandleX Vert Classique - Classic Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Creed Green Irish Tweed

VERT CLASSIQUE is an elite and elevated barbershop blend, true to its name, a classic. Evoking confidence, poise and a distinguished nature, this gorgeous green fragrance is sure to upgrade your environment.

Opening with overflowing lively notes of atmospheric greens, refreshing peppermint, verbena and lemon accords. This sea breeze scent carries you a floral violet leaf, which leads into a tasteful base of ambergris, iris and sandalwood that creates a the most refined for of sophistication. In all its fresh and woody glory, VERT CLASSIQUE is inspired by the famous and everlasting Green Irish Tweed by Creed.

With such an invigorating, commanding & dignified aroma; VERT CLASSIQUE is an ideal choice for that daily indulgence you’ve been seeking.

title: CandleX Paradise Lost - Classic Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme

PARADISE LOST is a delightfully compelling fragrance with irresistible charm and enthralling easy-going energy. Embodying effortlessly bright intrigue, strength of character, and sex appeal to create an aromatic invitation into an enticing atmosphere that delights senses.

The cool combination of fresh & citrusy opening notes brings forth a clean, stimulating scent that illuminates perfectly in any area. Lime, grapefruit, thyme & lavender blend seamlessly with the heart of the fragrance, which includes lily of the valley, rose de mai and blackcurrant.

While the scent develops it reveals a luxuriously rich and sensual base of ambergris, vanilla, leather, and musk offering a deeply seductive and masculine finish that is long-lasting and exceptional. PARADISE LOST personifies the spirit of Elysium by Roja Parfums and maintains the grandeur and integrity of this masterful scent composition.

Journey through your senses, reach for valor and bring paradise into your everyday environment with PARADISE LOST.

description_html:
Inspired by Parfums de Marly Delina

DAYDREAM is a captivatingly romantic fragrance that personifies femininity, elegance, and privilege, and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere for those fortunate enough to experience the wonder.

DAYDREAM features a delicate and complex blend of fruity and floral notes, fashioning an enchanting aroma that is both dreamy and well-polished. The candle opens with top notes of rhubarb, bergamot, and litchi, which pair just like a dream with the heart of the fragrance, that includes lush and floral notes of Turkish rose, peony, and warm vanilla.

This candle burns to reveal a gentle and sensual base of vetiver, musk, and cashmeran, providing a chic and feminine finish that is both calming and unforgettable. DAYDREAM beautifully embodies the essence of Delina by Parfums de Marly making this aroma the perfect option for those who appreciate the splendor and brilliance of fine fragrances.

Create a pleasureful, intimate, and dreamy ambiance with the lavish and indulgent aromatic bouquet provided by DAYDREAM.

title: CandleX Alpha Q - Intense Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Creed Aventus

ALPHA Q is a powerful fragrance that embodies leadership, strength, and success. This sophisticated blend has been expertly translated into a candle that can bring a touch of luxury and refinement to your space. This fragrance is the epitome of style, combining rich, woody notes with fruity undertones to create an intoxicating aroma that is sure to captivate your senses.

At the heart of ALPHA Q lies an intermingling mixture of blackcurrant, bergamot, and apple, which together create a crisp, invigoratingly fresh opening that can add that extra energy to any room. As the candle burns, the fragrance develops into an opulent and complex fusion of birch, patchouli, and jasmine, providing a warm and sensuous base that is masculine and inviting.

ALPHA Q captures the character of the iconic fragrance Aventus by Creed, providing an indulgent experience that fills your area with an air of elegance and vibrancy. The scent is attractive and intricate, making it perfect for everyday indulgence. Whether you're looking to enhance your home with a touch of richness, or seeking the perfect gift for a fragrance enthusiast, ALPHA Q is an exceptional choice that will not disappoint.

title: CandleX After Hours - Classic Scented Candle - 8 oz
description_html:
Inspired by Dolce & Gabbana The One

AFTER HOURS is a magnetic & comforting scent, that is full of allure and personality. The aromatic elixir is a warm woody arrangement that fits perfectly in a luxury candle. Exemplifying good taste, class, and charisma this smooth scent will infuse the environment around you with a little extra magic.

Beginning with a bold, spicy, sparkling oriental combination of grapefruit, coriander and basil followed by a balancing ginger, cardamom, and orange blossom. The base notes consist of cedarwood, amber and hints of tobacco which altogether create the suave blend. It is modern take on a warm and spiced aroma.

AFTER HOURS is inspired by The One by Dolce & Gabbana, a contemporary, tasteful, timeless fragrance. A classic scent with a sultry edge providing a deliciously decadent addition fit to enhance any room, especially after hours.

Top notes are Violet, Lemon, Violet Leaf and Green Apple; middle notes are Moroccan Jasmine, Italian Jasmine, Geranium and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Musk, Narcissus and Sandalwood.

title: Xerjoff JTC 400 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff JTC 400 is a bright, honeyed blend of citrus, orange blossom and white tobacco.

Launched in 2018, it opens with honey, bitter orange, mandarin and bergamot. Orange blossom, white tobacco, ylang-ylang and rose form a radiant heart, and vanilla, cedar, patchouli and vetiver give it a warm finish.

Elegant and sunny, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Walk On The Wild Side Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris Walk on the Wild Side is a spicy leather with ginger, saffron and caramel.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2020. Ginger, pink pepper, saffron, bergamot and cypress open spicy, jasmine, white amber and iris form a soft heart, and leather, musk, caramel and Haitian vetiver give it a sensual finish.

Bold and seductive, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Orlov Paris The Best of Me Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris The Best of Me is an earthy rose with barley, sesame and vetiver.

Amélie Jacquin created it in 2020. Yellow mandarin and bergamot open bright, Pomarose and rose form a floral heart, and tonka bean, vetiver, barley, sesame, bran and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Distinctive and cozy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Sun Drop Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris Sun Drop is a spicy blend of saffron, rose and oud.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2020. Nutmeg, saffron, cardamom and cinnamon open warm, oud, rose and clove form a rich heart, and sandalwood, musk and patchouli give it a woody finish.

Opulent and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Orlov Paris Star of the Season Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Orlov Paris Star of the Season is a powdery blend of orange blossom, iris and vanilla.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2015. Orange blossom opens bright, iris and rose form a powdery heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, woody finish.

Elegant and smooth, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Sea of Light Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Orlov Paris Sea of Light is a fresh, salty blend of citrus, peach and sea notes.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2015. Lemon, citrus, mandarin and petitgrain open bright, black currant and peach form a fruity heart, and sea notes, salt and white musk give it a breezy finish.

Light and refreshing, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Out of the Box Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris Out of the Box is a sweet rose with peony, caramel and vanilla.

Jordi Fernández created it in 2020. Peony, pink pepper and jasmine open bright, caramel, Bulgarian rose and amber form a sweet heart, and vanilla, white musk and incense give it a warm finish.

Cozy and romantic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Hope Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris Hope is a soft, fruity floral with osmanthus, peach and rose.

Amélie Jacquin created it in 2020. Pink pepper, bergamot and violet leaf open fresh, osmanthus, peach and rose form a fruity floral heart, and musk, cedar and patchouli give it a soft finish.

Gentle and pretty, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Golden Prince Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Orlov Paris Golden Prince is an aromatic blend of grapefruit, incense and vetiver.

Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2017. Grapefruit, spices and red berries open bright, incense, juniper berries, cedar and nutmeg form a woody heart, and vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood give it an earthy finish.

Refined and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Flame of Gold Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Orlov Paris Flame of Gold is a warm, woody blend of amber, patchouli and leather.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2015. Amber and musk open warm, patchouli and Virginia cedar form a woody heart, and leather and vanilla give it a smooth finish.

Rich and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Orlov Paris Empower You Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris Empower You is a bright blend of citrus, orange blossom and incense.

Olivier Pescheux created it in 2020. Yellow mandarin, blood orange, grapefruit, bergamot, lemon, cassis and ginger open sparkling, orange blossom, Bulgarian rose, jasmine sambac and geranium form a floral heart, and cedar, musk, patchouli, oud and incense give it a warm finish.

Radiant and confident, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Orlov Paris Cross of Asia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris Cross of Asia is a lush white floral with ylang-ylang, jasmine and tuberose.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2015. Geranium opens fresh, ylang-ylang, jasmine and tuberose form a rich floral heart, and musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Radiant and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Shooting Stars Uden Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Uden is a bright citrus fragrance with rum, coffee and vanilla.

Launched in 2009, it opens with citrus, lemon and grapefruit. Rum, guaiac wood, sandalwood and rose form the heart, and vanilla, coffee, musk and ambergris give it a warm finish.

An elegant choice for days and evenings.

title: Orlov Paris Burning Desire Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Orlov Paris Burning Desire is a fresh, spicy rose with grapefruit and raspberry.

Shyamala Maisondieu created it in 2020. Grapefruit, bergamot, cardamom and black pepper open bright, rose and raspberry form a fruity floral heart, and musk gives it a clean finish.

Lively and romantic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Roja Parfums Oceania Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Roja Parfums Oceania is a bright, sparkling citrus with herbs, florals and soft woods.

Roja Dove created it in 2019. Lavender, grapefruit, mandarin, lemon, bergamot, lime, rosemary and thyme open fresh, violet, geranium, ylang-ylang and jasmine form the heart, and musk, cedar, moss, iris, vetiver, sandalwood and vanilla give it a smooth finish.

Fresh and luxurious, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 is a sweet, creamy gourmand of pistachio, ice cream and marshmallow.

Olivier and Sébastien Cresp created it in 2023. Pistachio, bergamot, ice cream, rum, hazelnut and cardamom open rich, pear, peony, jasmine and raspberry form a fruity heart, and whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, sandalwood and tonka bean give it a dessert-like finish.

Fun and indulgent, it is a great everyday scent for anyone who loves sweet fragrances.

title: Cartier La Panthere Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: La Panthere by Cartier is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. La Panthere was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Mathilde Laurent. Top notes are Dried Fruits, Rhubarb, Big Strawberry, Anise and Bergamot; middle notes are Gardenia, Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Pear and Orange Blossom; base notes are Oakmoss, Musk, Leather and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Quercia Eau de Parfum Concentree Unisex
description_html: Quercia Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Quercia Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are Lemon, Pink Pepper, Calabrian bergamot and Petitgrain; middle notes are Cardamom, Cedar and Geranium; base notes are Moss, Tonka Bean and Patchouli.

title: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Parfum for Men
description_html:
Ralph Lauren Polo Red Parfum is a bright, powdery blend of blood orange, absinthe and orris.

Launched in 2023, it opens with bergamot, blood orange and pink pepper. Absinthe, lavender and orris form an aromatic heart, and opoponax, musk and cedar give it a smooth, ambery finish.

Polished and modern, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Toilette is a fresh, aquatic blend of cucumber, melon and basil.

Carlos Benaim and Christophe Laudamiel created it in 2003. Cucumber, melon and mandarin open cool, basil, sage and geranium form an aromatic heart, and suede, woods and musk give it a clean finish.

Crisp and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum Intense for Men
description_html:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir is a rich, warm blend of olibanum, vanilla and amber.

Launched in 2023, it wraps olibanum, vanilla, amber and tonka bean into a dense, sweet and resinous scent with real presence.

A bold choice for cooler days and nights out.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Pacific Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Pacific is a salty, sunny blend of coconut, cypress and woods.

Sophie Labbé created it in 2023. Salt, coconut and lemon meet cypress, patchouli, cashmeran and sandalwood for a relaxed, beachy and woody scent.

Easygoing and warm-weather ready, it is a great casual everyday scent.

title: By Kilian Love Don't Be Shy Extreme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Love Don't Be Shy Extreme by By Kilian is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Love Don't Be Shy Extreme was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker. Top notes are Neroli and Bergamot; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Marshmallow, Vanilla, Musk and Pomegranate.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense for Women
description_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Le Parfum is a rich, sweet blend of pear, jasmine and vanilla.

Quentin Bisch and Sonia Constant created it in 2021. Juicy pear opens the way to tonka bean and jasmine, settling into a deep, creamy vanilla.

A warm, seductive choice for evenings and cooler days.

title: Emporio Armani She Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Emporio Armani She is a soft, powdery blend of pear, heliotrope and almond.

Daniela Andrier created it in 2020. Citrus and pear open bright, heliotrope, cardamom, angelica and jasmine form a powdery heart, and white musk, almond, vanilla, cedar and amber give it a warm finish.

Cozy and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Emporio Armani Diamonds Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:

Jacques Cavallier created it in 2008. Bergamot and guaiac wood open fresh, Sichuan pepper, cedar and vetiver form a spicy, woody heart, and cacao and amber give it a warm finish.

Smooth and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Dolce & Gabbana L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: D&G Anthology L'Imperatrice 3 by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women. D&G Anthology L'Imperatrice 3 was launched in 2009. Top notes are Kiwi, Rhuburb and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Watermelon, Cyclamen and Jasmine; base notes are Lemon Tree, Musk and Sandalwood.

title: Creed Jasmin Imperatrice Eugenie Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Jasmin Imperatrice Eugenie by Creed is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Jasmin Imperatrice Eugenie was launched in 1989. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Italian Jasmine, Ambergris and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Sandalwood and Vanille.

title: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Eclat Eau de Parfum For Women

Pretty and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

Refined and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

An elegant choice for cooler days and evenings.

Elegant and refined, it is a lovely everyday scent.

Refined and bold, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

Elegant and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

Cozy and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

Refined and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

Refined and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Memo Paris Flam Eau de Parfum Unisex

Elegant and warm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

Fresh and lively, it is a great everyday scent.

Opulent and elegant, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Mancera Musky Garden Eau de Parfum for Women

Pretty and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: The House of Oud Breath Of The Infinite Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:

Light and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Amouage Opus XII Rose Incense Eau de Parfum Unisex

Bold and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Purple Eau de Parfum for Women

title: Giorgio Armani My Way Parfum for Women

title: Xerjoff Oud Stars Luxor Eau de Parfum Unisex

Radiant and cheerful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

Elegant and warm, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

Confident and modern, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler days.

title: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Intense Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:

Antoine Maisondieu and Guillaume Flavigny created it in 2023. Rich vanilla leads from the first spray, lavender adds a soft aromatic lift, and vetiver gives the base a dry, earthy balance.

Born in Roma Intense is smooth, cozy and easy to love, the kind of vanilla scent people notice and remember. It is a warm signature you will reach for often.

title: Givenchy Gentlemen Society Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:

Karine Dubreuil-Sereni and Maïa Lernout created it in 2023. Cardamom and sage open fresh, French narcissus and Haitian and Madagascar vetiver form the heart, and vanilla, cedar and palo santo give it a warm finish.

Refined and versatile, it suits the office and evenings alike.
