title: Roja Parfums Enigma Special Edition Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Roja Enigma Special Edition Pour Femme is a powdery floral with peach, rose and vanilla.

Launched in 2013, it opens with peach, neroli and bergamot. Rose, heliotrope, ylang-ylang, jasmine and geranium form a soft heart, and orris root, vanilla, musk, ambergris, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Elegant and refined, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Rose Rouge Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Van Cleef & Arpels Rose Rouge is a fruity, sweet rose with raspberry and cacao.

Julien Rasquinet created it in 2018. Black currant, pink pepper and bergamot open juicy, rose, raspberry and vetiver form a rich heart, and vanilla, cacao pod, patchouli, benzoin and musk give it a warm finish.

Romantic and cozy, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Jo Malone Silk Blossom Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Silk Blossom (2022) is a soft, spicy floral with white pepper and silk tree blossom.

Céline Roux created it in 2022. White pepper opens fresh, silk tree blossom forms a delicate heart, and moss gives it an earthy finish.

Light and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Jo Malone Sakura Cherry Blossom Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Sakura Cherry Blossom is a soft floral with cherry blossom, rose and mimosa.

Christine Nagel created it in 2011. Bergamot and mandarin open fresh, cherry blossom, rose and mimosa form a delicate heart, and musk and woods give it a soft finish.

Light and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Jo Malone Rose & Magnolia Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Rose & Magnolia is a fresh rose with magnolia and patchouli.

Launched in 2022, it opens with magnolia. May rose and Damask rose form a rich heart, and patchouli and amber give it a warm, woody finish.

Romantic and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Jo Malone Nashi Blossom Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Nashi Blossom (2016) is a fresh blend of lemon, pear blossom and white musk.

Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2016. Lemon opens bright, pear blossom and rose form a delicate heart, and white musk gives it a clean, powdery finish.

Light and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Jo Malone Mimosa & Cardamom Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Mimosa & Cardamom is a soft, powdery blend of mimosa, cardamom and tonka.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2015. Cardamom opens warm and spicy, mimosa forms a golden floral heart, and tonka bean gives it a sweet, smooth finish.

Gentle and comforting, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Jo Malone Frangipani Flower Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Jo Malone Frangipani Flower is a sunny, tropical floral with frangipani and ylang-ylang.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2019. Lemon and solar notes open bright, frangipani, jasmine and ylang-ylang form a creamy heart, and sandalwood and benzoin give it a warm finish.

Warm and cheerful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Frederic Malle Rose & Cuir Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Frédéric Malle Rose & Cuir is a spicy, green blend of rose and leather.

Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2019. Geranium, black currant and Sichuan pepper open bright, leather and rose form a smooth heart, and vetiver and cedar give it a dry, woody finish.

Refined and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Armaf Odyssey Homme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Odyssey Homme by Armaf is a Amber fragrance for men. Top notes are Vanilla and Amber; middle notes are Oriental notes, Spices and Iris; base notes are Vanilla, Leather and Jasmine.

title: Ariana Grande Cloud 2.0 Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Cloud Intense by Ariana Grande is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Cloud Intense was launched in 2021. Top notes are Lavender, Bergamot and Pear; middle notes are Whipped cream, Coconut, Praline and Vanilla orchid; base notes are Cashmeran, Ambroxan, Musk and Woodsy Notes.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum is a rich, vanilla-forward take on Black Opium.

Nathalie Lorson, Olivier Cresp, Marie Salamagne and Honorine Blanc created it in 2022. Pear, cinnamon and green mandarin open bright, orange blossom and jasmine sambac form the heart, and several vanillas, coffee and patchouli give it a deep finish.

A rich choice for evenings.

title: Rasasi Qasamat Mohraf Oud Moattar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Rasasi Qasamat Mohraf Oud Moattar is a richer, oud-forward rose with raspberry and vanilla.

Launched in 2020, it opens with juicy raspberry, lemon and bergamot. Rose, geranium, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley form a lush heart, and oud, vanilla, amber, guaiac wood, patchouli, musk and sandalwood give it a deep finish.

Opulent and smooth, it is a strong choice for evenings.

title: V Canto Lucrethia Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Lucrethia is a sweet blend of pear, coffee and vanilla.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2016. Pear, linden blossom, pink pepper, petitgrain and laurel open bright, jasmine, coffee, cacao, amber and clove form a warm heart, and vanilla, honeysuckle, benzoin, patchouli and cedar give it a sweet finish.

Cozy and distinctive, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Montale Sweet Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale Sweet Vanilla is a soft, creamy vanilla with a touch of apricot.

Pierre Montale created it in 2015. Smooth vanilla meets juicy apricot for a sweet, powdery and gently fruity scent.

Comforting and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: M. Micallef Secrets of Love Glamour Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
M. Micallef Secrets of Love Glamour is a fruity, spicy floral with peach, saffron and jasmine.

Jean-Claude Astier created it in 2016. Apple, nutmeg, peach, cinnamon and saffron open warm, jasmine, plum and rose form a floral heart, and cashmere wood, vanilla, white musk and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

Elegant and warm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Mancera Aoud Black Candy Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Mancera Aoud Black Candy is a sweet blend of licorice, mint and rose.

Pierre Montale created it in 2012. Licorice and mint open cool and sweet, amber and rose form a soft heart, and sweet notes and white musk give it a smooth finish.

Playful and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Houbigant Duc de Vervins L'Extreme Eau de Parfum for Man
description_html:
Houbigant Duc de Vervins L'Extrême is a classic aromatic blend of citrus, lavender and oakmoss.

Launched in 1991, it opens with bergamot, orange blossom and lemon. Lavender and spices form an aromatic heart, and oakmoss, lavender and amber give it a mossy finish.

Polished and timeless, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Houbigant Quelques Fleurs L'Original Eau de Parfum for Woman
description_html:
Houbigant Quelques Fleurs L'Original is a classic, lush bouquet of over a dozen flowers.

Robert Bienaimé created it in 1913. Green notes, orange blossom, tarragon and citrus open fresh, lilac, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, rose, tuberose, ylang-ylang, violet, iris and orchid form a rich heart, and oakmoss, honey, musk, sandalwood, amber and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Elegant and timeless, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Coffee Break Golden Moka Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Coffee Break Golden Moka is a bright citrus with coffee, oud and incense.

Launched in 2018, it opens with blood orange, lemon and mandarin. Coffee, Cambodian oud, amber, rose and incense form a rich heart, and green notes, incense and labdanum give it a resinous finish.

Distinctive and warm, it is a great choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Costume National Scent Intense Red Edition Parfum for Man
description_html: Scent Intense Parfum Red Edition by CoSTUME NATIONAL is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Scent Intense Parfum Red Edition was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Laurent Bruyere.

title: Xerjoff Coffee Break Golden Green Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Coffee Break Golden Green is a woody blend of juniper, leather and coffee.

Launched in 2020, it opens with cardamom, juniper berries, pink pepper and nutmeg. Vetiver, cedar, leather, labdanum and incense form a smoky heart, and coffee, cypriol, musk and ambergris give it a warm finish.

Refined and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Coffee Break Golden Dallah Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Coffee Break Golden Dallah is a warm, spicy blend of coffee, oud and hazelnut.

Launched in 2018, it opens with exotic spices. Incense, coffee, Cambodian oud, amber and rose form a rich heart, and hazelnut, cacao and tonka bean give it a gourmand finish.

Deep and cozy, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Boucheron Oud de Carthage Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Oud de Carthage by Boucheron is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Oud de Carthage was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Honey and Incense; middle notes are Tonka Bean and Labdanum; base notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Leather.

title: Boucheron Ambre D'Alexandrie Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Ambre D'Alexandrie by Boucheron is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Ambre D'Alexandrie was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Christophe Hérault. Top notes are Vanilla, Tobacco and Benzoin; middle notes are Amber and Labdanum; base notes are Ambergris and Musk.

title: Ajmal Amber Musc Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Amber Musc by Ajmal is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Amber Musc was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Abdulla Ajmal.

title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Black Edition Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Amber Oud by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Amber Oud was launched in 2018. Top notes are Rosemary, Bergamot, Cedar and Lemon; middle notes are Spices, Cedar and Guaiac Wood; base notes are resins, Amber and Musk.

title: Memo Paris Iberian Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Memo Paris Iberian Leather is a spicy leather with saffron, iris and oud.

Launched in 2022, it opens with geranium, coriander, rosemary and bergamot. Clove, saffron, cinnamon, iris, osmanthus, jasmine and rose form a spicy heart, and leather, oud, patchouli, vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood give it a rich finish.

Bold and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Nasamat Scotland Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat Scotland Leather is a warm blend of pepper, iris and oud.

Launched in 2014, it opens with orange, pepper, gurjan balsam and cypress. Jasmine, rose and iris form a floral heart, and musk, oud, vanilla and benzoin give it a rich finish.

Bold and elegant, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat Oud Bouquet Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat Oud Bouquet is a bright blend of citrus, fruits and vanilla.

Launched in 2014, it opens with orange, lemon and bergamot. Fruity notes form a juicy heart, and amber, white musk and Bourbon vanilla give it a soft, warm finish.

Easy and cheerful, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat Moroccan Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat Moroccan Leather is a spicy leather with saffron, iris and suede.

Launched in 2014, it opens with pink pepper, saffron and leather. Iris, violet and suede form a powdery heart, and vanilla, cedar, patchouli and incense give it a warm finish.

Refined and bold, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat Italian Bergamot Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat Italian Bergamot is a sunny blend of citrus, coconut and tuberose.

Launched in 2014, it opens with lemon, mandarin, coconut and peach. Ylang-ylang, tuberose and jasmine form a creamy heart, and sandalwood, vanilla, musk and amber give it a warm finish.

Bright and cheerful, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat Haiti Vetiver Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat Haiti Vetiver is a fruity floral with peach, plum and peony.

Peach and plum open juicy, violet, peony and rose form a soft floral heart, and patchouli, cedar, vanilla, amber and musk give it a warm finish.

Pretty and smooth, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat French Jasmine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat French Jasmine is a lush floral with orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose.

Orange blossom opens bright, jasmine, carnation, rose and tuberose form a rich floral heart, and amber, woods and musk give it a warm finish.

Romantic and radiant, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat England Cashmere Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat England Cashmere is a smooth blend of frankincense, oud and amber musk.

Launched in 2014, it opens with frankincense. Oud forms a deep, woody heart, and amber musk gives it a soft, warm finish.

Simple and refined, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat Cambodian Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat Cambodian Oud is a smoky blend of cardamom, frankincense and leather.

Cardamom, nagarmotha and frankincense open spicy, cedarwood, leather and patchouli form a woody heart, and woods and amber musk give it a warm finish.

Bold and refined, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Nasamat African Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Nasamat African Musk is a warm blend of iris, honey, leather and tobacco.

Launched in 2014, it opens with bergamot, violet, iris and carnation. Honey, leather, tobacco leaf and amber form a rich heart, and cedar, vetiver and musk give it a woody finish.

Warm and distinctive, it is a great scent from spring through fall.

title: Carolina Herrera Carolina Herrera Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera is a Floral fragrance for women. Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera was launched in 1988. Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera was created by Carlos Benaim, Clement Gavarry and Rosendo Mateu. Top notes are Apricot, Orange Blossom, Green Notes, Brazilian Rosewood and Bergamot; middle notes are Indian Tuberose, Jasmine, Spanish Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Honeysuckle, Narcissus, Hiacynth and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Civet, Musk, Oakmoss, Amber, Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedar.

title: Montale So Amber Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Montale So Amber is a warm rose with ambergris, saffron and raspberry.

Pierre Montale created it in 2016. Moroccan rose opens rich, ambergris, saffron and sandalwood form a warm heart, and raspberry, white musk and vanilla give it a sweet finish.

Cozy and elegant, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Masque Milano Times Square Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Masque Milano Times Square is a powdery floral with violet, hazelnut and osmanthus.

Bruno Jovanovic created it in 2017. Violet, hazelnut and rose open soft, osmanthus and tuberose form a floral heart, and styrax, guaiac wood and sandalwood give it a warm, woody finish.

Elegant and unusual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Masque Milano Petra Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Masque Milano Petra is a warm, ambery blend of rose, myrrh and incense.

Cécile Zarokian created it in 2020. Pink pepper, yellow mandarin and bergamot open bright, sweet and fruity notes, jasmine sambac and Moroccan rose form a soft heart, and ambergris, patchouli, myrrh, incense, benzoin and leather give it a rich finish.

Rich and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Masque Milano Mandala Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Masque Milano Mandala is a resinous blend of olibanum, incense and myrrh.

Christian Carbonnel created it in 2017. Olibanum, angelica and nutmeg open aromatic, incense, cardamom, labdanum, cedar, cinnamon and clove form a spicy heart, and myrrh, ambergris, sandalwood and oakmoss give it a warm finish.

Contemplative and warm, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Masque Milano Madeleine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Masque Milano Madeleine is a creamy gourmand of chestnut, whipped cream and milk.

Fanny Bal created it in 2020. Chestnut, whipped cream and cumin open warm, tuberose, geranium and cypress form an unusual heart, and milk, vanilla pod, musk and tonka bean give it a soft finish.

Cozy and nostalgic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Masque Milano L'Attesa Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Masque Milano L'Attesa is a powdery, elegant blend of champagne, iris and leather.

Luca Maffei created it in 2016. Champagne, bergamot and neroli open sparkling, iris, orris root, ylang-ylang and tuberose form a soft heart, and leather, oakmoss and sandalwood give it an earthy finish.

Refined and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Masque Milano Kintsugi Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Masque Milano Kintsugi is a soft, fruity floral with magnolia, rose and suede.

Vanina Muracciole created it in 2019. Magnolia, bergamot and amber open bright, suede, rose and violet leaf form a velvety heart, and raspberry leaf, patchouli, benzoin and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Elegant and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Masque Milano Dolceacqua Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Masque Milano Dolceacqua is a soft floral with lily-of-the-valley, mimosa and almond blossom.

Delphine Thierry created it in 2020. Lily-of-the-valley, sea notes, ivy and marjoram open green, mimosa, almond blossom, white rose and ylang-ylang form a powdery heart, and musk, oakmoss, cedar, benzoin and saffron give it a warm finish.

Graceful and calm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Zadig & Voltaire This is Him! Pour Lui Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Zadig & Voltaire This is Him! is a warm, spicy blend of black pepper, incense and vanilla.

Nathalie Lorson and Aurélien Guichard created it in 2016. Black pepper and grapefruit open bright, incense and vanilla form a warm heart, and sandalwood gives it a creamy finish.

Smooth and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Elle Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Elle is a fresh, woody floral with litchi, rose and patchouli.

Jacques Cavallier and Olivier Cresp created it in 2007. Litchi, peony and Amalfi lemon open bright, pink pepper, rose, jasmine and freesia form a floral heart, and patchouli, vetiver, cedar and ambrette give it a woody finish.

Confident and modern, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Torino21 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Torino21 is a cool, herbal burst of mint, citrus and green leaves.

Launched in 2021, it opens with mint, lemon, basil and thyme. Black currant, lavender, rosemary and jasmine give the heart a fresh, aromatic lift, and lemon verbena and musk keep it clean and bright to the end.

Crisp and energizing, it is made for warm days and anyone who loves a truly green, fresh scent.

title: Xerjoff Purple Accento Crystal Edition Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Purple Accento Crystal Edition is a sweet blend of pineapple, loganberry and vanilla.

Chris Maurice created it in 2021. Pineapple, hyacinth and mandarin open juicy, pink pepper, loganberry and jasmine form a fruity heart, and amber, vanilla, musk, sandalwood and oud give it a powdery finish.

Playful and smooth, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Oud Stars P.33 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Oud Stars P.33 is a fresh, woody blend of apple, cypress and iris.

Launched in 2022, it opens with apple, bergamot, grapefruit and pink pepper. Cypress, cinnamon and iris form an aromatic heart, and cedar, musk and amber give it a smooth finish.

Refined and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Xerjoff Oud Stars Ceylon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Ceylon is a honeyed blend of jasmine sambac, black tea and oud.

Chris Maurice created it in 2017. Honey, jasmine sambac and bergamot open sweet, oud, black tea and sandalwood form a warm heart, and amber, musk and Madagascar vanilla give it a powdery finish.

Cozy and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

title: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Valaya is a luminous white floral with a soft, musky glow.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Mandarin, white peach, bergamot and aldehydes open bright and airy, orange blossom and lily of the valley bloom at the heart, and musk, ambroxan, akigalawood and vanilla leave a clean, skin-like finish.

Elegant and feminine, it feels like freshly laundered silk and suits everyday wear and special moments alike.

title: Guerlain Encens Mythique Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Encens Mythique is a warm, smoky blend of rose, saffron and incense.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Aldehydes, rose and saffron open bright, pink pepper, vetiver and patchouli form the heart, and ambergris, olibanum and woods give it a resinous finish.

Refined and mysterious, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

title: Guerlain Eau de Bain Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Eau de Bain is a soft, clean blend of orange blossom, almond and vanilla.

Launched in 2019, it opens with orange blossom, bergamot, lemon and green notes. Almond and white musk form a creamy heart, and vanilla and precious woods give it a warm finish.

Comforting and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Guerlain Cuir Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Guerlain Cuir Intense is a rich leather with osmanthus, tobacco and sandalwood.

Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Osmanthus and ylang-ylang open soft, leather and musk form a sensual heart, and tobacco, sandalwood and cedar give it a warm, woody finish.

Bold and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

title: Mercedes-Benz Sign Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Mercedes-Benz Sign is a warm, aromatic blend of cardamom, orange blossom and tonka.

Olivier Cresp created it in 2021. Guatemalan cardamom, violet leaf and pink pepper open fresh, orange blossom, lavender and geranium form a floral heart, and tonka bean, cashmere wood and patchouli give it a sweet finish.

Smooth and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Mercedes Benz Man Bright Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Mercedes-Benz Man Bright is a fresh blend of mint, lavender and incense.

Olivier Cresp created it in 2021. Bergamot, mint and pink pepper open fresh, lavender and incense form an aromatic heart, and tonka bean, cedar and patchouli give it a warm finish.

Crisp and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

title: Jo Malone London White Moss & Snowdrop Cologne
description_html:
Jo Malone White Moss & Snowdrop is a fresh, mossy blend of clementine, snowdrop and amber.

Launched in 2018, it opens with petitgrain and clementine. Neroli and snowdrops form a delicate heart, and moss, tonka bean and amber give it an earthy, warm finish.

Calm and refined, it is a lovely everyday scent.

title: Hermes H24 Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Hermès H24 Eau de Parfum is a mossy, aromatic take on H24.

Christine Nagel created it in 2022 around oakmoss, clary sage, sclarene, narcissus and Brazilian rosewood, giving it a green, earthy and softly floral character.

A refined, modern scent for everyday wear.

title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition Extreme Pure Perfume Unisex
description_html: Amber Oud Gold Edition Extreme Pure Perfume by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Amber Oud Gold Edition Extreme Pure Perfume was launched in 2022. Top notes are Bergamot and Green Notes; middle notes are Melon, Sweet Notes, Cedar, Pineapple and Amber; base notes are Myrrh, Woodsy Notes, Musk and Vanilla.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Peony Eau de Parfum for Women

title: Tom Ford Lost Cherry Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy

Scent Type:
Warm & Sweet Gourmands

Key Notes:
Black Cherry Accord, Rose Absolute Orpur, Roasted Tonka Orpur

About:
Tom Ford Lost Cherry is a full-bodied journey into the once-forbidden, a contrasting scent that reveals a tempting dichotomy of playful, candy-like gleam on the outside and luscious flesh on the inside.

Innocence intersects indulgence with an opening that captures the classic perfection of the exotic cherry fruit—black cherry’s ripe flesh dripping in cherry liqueur glistens with a teasing touch of bitter almond. The heart bursts forth in cherry waves of sweet and tart. Griotte syrup expresses the textured maceration of voluptuous fruits while breathtaking florals Turkish rose and jasmine sambac penetrate the senses and soul. Peru balsam and roasted tonka at the drydown suggest a new portrait of an iconic symbol. When blended with an unexpected mélange of sandalwood, vetiver, and cedar, the finish reaches fantasy-inspiring levels of insatiability.

title: Men's Scent Box
DIY 5ml Premium Atomizers - Create your own Premium Decant
description_html:
DIY 5ml Premium Atomizers - Create your own Premium Decant

 

Decantx offers a “do it yourself” option with all the tools needed to create your own sample sized formats. Select the color option of your choice from the 5ml Decantx premium atomizers and begin decanting on your own with the efficient and cost-effective kit created just for you!

This kit includes:

  • 5 x 5ml premium atomizers in the color selected. All Atomizers will be the same color unless the assorted color option is chosen.
  • 5 Silver Funnels for pour transfer
  • 5 Spray Nozzle Extensions spray transfer

Funnel – Pour Method. Best for opened perfume bottles or other samples. Place Funnel into place on the Atomizer and carefully pour contents into Atomizer.

Spray Nozzle – Spray Method. Best for sealed perfume bottles. Remove current spray top from perfume bottle and replace with our Spray Nozzle. Position Spray Nozzle into open Atomizer and spray to fill.

Pro Tips:

  • Be sure to securely tighten your atomizer once it has been filled.
  • Pour slowly & carefully to avoid spills.
  • Don’t overfill. Always leave enough room for the atomizer to be tightly fastened and leave a small air pocket for expansion.
  • Store atomizers in a dry and dark space for maximized lifespan.

Approx Sprays Per 5ml Atomizer: 75 Sprays

A very interesting edition announced for September 2012 and aimed at younger audience arrives from the Balenciaga Company. Balenciaga, in collaboration with Coty, Prestige and IFF created the new fragrance FLORABOTANICA which attracts attention with its modern, attractive flacon and unusual ingredients.
The composition was developed by perfumers of the house of IFF, Olivier Polge and Jean-Christophe Herault, who composed it of such accords as mint, carnation, hybrid rose, caladium leaves, amber and vetiver. It was envisaged that the composition would offer floral character, which is also very seductive and its flowers will not be just beautiful, but also very dangerous.
The advertising campaign is decorated with three metal sculptures resembling the Ghesquière floral print created a few years ago. Photos for the campaign were taken by Steven Meisel, and the advertising face is young actress Kristen Stewart. She is wearing a dress from the floral collection and holding her hands in her pockets.

title: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum For Women
description_html:
Very Good Girl by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Very Good Girl was launched in 2021. Very Good Girl was created by Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner. Top notes are Litchi and Red Currant; middle note is Rose; base notes are Vanilla and Vetiver.
At the beginning of February 2021, Carolina Herrera presents a new flanker in an attractive bright red stiletto bottle. Red is definitely a trend in 2021 because many houses have decided to offer new creations in red bottles.
Very Good Girl is a new olfactory adventure that takes a surprising turn: Where previous fragrances in the family explored the subversive power of jasmine or the tonka bean, this new Eau de Parfum ups the ante, drawing its strength from the potency of the rose, a distinctive scent, which here treads on entirely new ground.
VERY GOOD GIRL arrives after last year's creation, Good Girl Suprême, and Good Girl Légère from 2018. They stand out as different compositions from the other editions of the collection, which were limited edition bottles of the original Good Girl creation from 2016.
As the brand explains: "Rose and vetiver: an idyllic contrast. Very Good Girl is a Floral Fruity fragrance. Its aromatic journey starts with the currant, a playfully mischievous wild berry that’s joined by the exotic lychee in a unity of confidence. It’s at this point that the singular yet mysterious qualities of the rose come into play. As one of the most important raw ingredients in the history of perfumery, it has previously seen countless interpretations. All-encompassing and seductive, its unique scent is an ace up any sleeve, which is exactly what perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner capitalized on for this new chapter in the Good Girl universe."
"Here, it’s the creamy and powdery nuances of the rose that come to the fore, with an indulgent romanticism that’s as warm and silky as the world’s most seductive red lipstick.
There’s no need to justify a declaration of love for this most luxurious of ingredients, and even if this were reason enough to create a fragrance, Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner are anything but a conformist. Hence why the final burst in Very Good Girl is a veiled background of vetiver, the raw form of which evokes the smell of wood, and is often used in men’s perfumery. It’s a key ingredient of Bad Boy, for example, but also of Good Girl Suprême, providing a surprising and contemporary counterpoint that in this new fragrance creates an alliance with the warmth of vanilla.
The result is a floral fragrance that enhances the natural beauty of its raw ingredients, but without forgoing creativity."
As Carolina Herrera famously said, “Fashion is evolution, not revolution,” a maxim that fully applies to this new fragrance. Just as when Wes Gordon modernizes timeless materials such as silk or leather when designing fashion for the brand, the rose is used with a completely contemporary aesthetic. This is why Very Good Girl is not only a tour de force for the senses, it’s also a fragrance that’s ready to wear and enjoy in the modern world.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 Heroes Forever Young Eau De Toilette For Men
description_html:
212 Heroes by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. 212 Heroes was launched in 2021. 212 Heroes was created by Domitille Michalon Bertier, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Pear, cannabis and Ginger; middle notes are Geranium and Sage; base notes are Musk and Leather.
"Feel forever young with 212 Heroes, a fresh new masculine scent that celebrates youth, freedom and authenticity. Contained inside a striking skateboard-shaped bottle and represented by a diverse cast of talented creatives, this innovative, vegan fragrance is proof that nothing is more heroic than being authentic.
212 Heroes reinvents Fougères with a new olfactive genre: Fougère Fruity Woody. Youthful top notes of Pear Elixir and Ginger are heightened by Lemon Haze Cannabis. The heart features an innovative, fresh accord of Geranium Oil Madagascar, leading to a leathery and woody base.
A revolutionary fragrance calls for a revolutionary bottle. 212 Heroes opens a new chapter in industrial design with an innovative glass and chrome bottle that evokes the silhouette of a skateboard and captures the spirit of a new generation." - a note from the brand.

title: Xerjoff Oud Stars Alexandria III Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Xerjoff Alexandria III is a woody blend of rosewood, rose and oud.

Chris Maurice created it in 2019. Rosewood, lavender and cinnamon open aromatic, Bulgarian rose, cedar and lily-of-the-valley form the heart, and Laotian and Thai oud, sandalwood, vanilla, musk and amber give it a rich finish.

Opulent and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum for Men
description_html:

Launched in 2022, it opens with cardamom, neroli, ginger and mandarin. Kulfi, Bulgarian rose, jasmine and orange blossom form a creamy heart, and suede, vanilla, leather, amber, guaiac wood and tonka bean give it depth.

title: Ralph Lauren Ralphs Club Parfum for Men
description_html:

Dominique Ropion created it in 2022. Lavender, apple and grapefruit open fresh, geranium, clary sage and orange blossom form an aromatic heart, and vetiver, patchouli, Virginia cedar and cashmeran give it a warm finish.

Confident and polished, it works year-round, day or night.

Aurélien Guichard created it in 2022. Pine needles and olibanum open fresh and resinous, benzoin and incense form a warm heart, and Atlas, Himalayan and Virginia cedar give it a dry, smoky finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2022. Bergamot leaf and bergamot open bright, iris, orris, clary sage and aldehydes form a smooth, powdery heart, and tonka bean and cedar give it a warm finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works in every season, day or night.

A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

Elegant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

title: The Niche Must Haves Box for Dad - Decantx Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
The Niche Must Haves Box for Dad - Decantx Fragrance Collection Box

 

1) Amouage Interlude Man Eau de Parfum for Men

Interlude Man is a spicy – woody fragrance that opens with zesty bergamot, oregano and pimento berry oil, perpetuating intervals of conflict which are countered by aromatic notes of amber, frankincense, opoponax, cistus and myrrh. Eternal notes of leather, agarwood smoke, patchouli and sandalwood in the base add lasting layers of depth and texture.

 

 

2) Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum for Men

The exceptional Aventus was inspired by the dramatic life of a historic emperor, celebrating strength, power and success. Introduced in 2010 and crafted by the deft hand of Sixth Generation Master Perfumer Olivier Creed in collaboration with his son Erwin, this scent has grown to become the best-selling fragrance in the history of the brand. Olivier created its iconic name derived from A ("from") ventus ("the wind"), illustrating the Aventus man as destined to live a driven life, ever galloping with the wind at his back toward success. Aventus is a sophisticated blend for individuals who savor a life well-lived.

 

3) Parfums de Marly Layton Eau de Parfum for Men

Layton opens with a dazzling splash of juicy, tangy bergamot and apple, tilted towards the alluringly masculine with fresh lavender, geranium and violet. Warm amber tones lend richness to the spicy heart, while a drydown of precious woods and vanilla up the opulence even further- perfect for a fragrance meant to evoke a name still synonymous with gloriously high-end excess. Life at Versailles must surely have been a dazzling mix of business, statecraft, leisure and celebration- it should come as no surprise that Layton presents itself as a perfect fragrance for any and all of those pursuits.

title: The Mothers Day Niche Collection Giftbox - Decantx Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
Mothers are the gifts that keep on giving! It's time to show the special women in your life how much you love, appreciate and adore them. What better way than with a curated giftbox of fragrances just for her. Scent is the silent expression that holds memories and emotions close to us, which is why we've selected some of our favorite and most timeless fragrances for any and all moms this Mothers Day! .

 

1) Juliette Has a Gun Not A Perfume Eau de Parfum for Women

 This minimalist, fresh, and clean fragrance is hypoallergenic and ideal for those who don’t normally wear perfume. It is composed of a single note, called cetalox, which is usually used in perfumery as a base note. Here it plays the lead role for a fragrance that will easily satisfy the most difficult tastes, and particularly those preferring discretion over complexity.

 

 

2)  Parfums de Marly Delina La Rosee Eau de Parfum for Women

Delina La Rosée by Parfums de Marly is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Delina La Rosée was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top notes are Pear, Litchi and Bergamot; middle notes are Peony, Turkish Rose, Watery Notes and Floral Notes; base notes are White Musk, Haitian Vetiver and Woody Notes.

 

 

3) BYREDO La Tulipe Eau de Parfum for Women

BYREDO La Tulipe is a Feminine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2010, The nose behind this fragrance is Ben Gorham, Jerome Epinette,  Top Note: Freesia, Cyclamen, Rhuburb Heart Note: pink tulip Base Note: Green Notes, vetyver, Woodsy Notes

 

 

4) Bond No. 9 The Scent Of Peace Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

The most beautifully civic-minded unisex fragrance ever devised. Notes of sparkling, energizing grapefruit and blackcurrant are balanced by the sheer loveliness of lily of the valley, and mellow base notes of cedar wood and musk. Eau de Parfum.

 

 

5) Creed Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum for Women

Nearly three years in the making, this olfactory celebration of strong women was highly anticipated before its triumphant unveiling by The House of Creed. Aventus for Her is inspired by some of history's most powerful women—empresses, queens and heads of state, who were Creed's clients—as well as modern women everywhere who confidently shatter glass ceilings. The Aventus for Her spirit lives in every woman. She is poised with inner strength and radiance, and leaves an indelible mark on all she touches. To be near her is to feel the presence of greatness.

Stéphanie de Bruijn L'Île aux Cygnes is a lush white floral with gardenia, jasmine and honeysuckle.

Stéphanie de Bruijn created it in 2020. Gardenia, jasmine, orange blossom, honeysuckle, ylang-ylang, iris and rose come together in a creamy, radiant floral scent.

Romantic and graceful, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

title: Stephanie de Bruijn Le Sully Eau de Parfum For Women
description_html:
Stéphanie de Bruijn Le Sully is a powdery blend of vanilla, iris and tonka.

Stéphanie de Bruijn created it in 2020. Vanilla, musk, amber, iris, bergamot, tonka bean and cedar come together in a warm, sweet and velvety scent.

Cozy and elegant, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Stephanie de Bruijn Antigone Eau de Parfum For Women
description_html:
Stéphanie de Bruijn Antigone is a powdery, fruity floral with peach, raspberry and musk.

Stéphanie de Bruijn created it in 2020. Musk, peach, jasmine, Italian lemon, raspberry, lily-of-the-valley, rose, sandalwood, cedar and vanilla come together in a soft, sweet and powdery scent.

Gentle and pretty, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

title: Jovoy Paris Psychedelique Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Jovoy Psychédélique is a warm, rich blend of patchouli, amber and vanilla.

Jacques Flori created it in 2011. Citrus opens bright, patchouli, amber, labdanum, geranium and rose form a deep heart, and vanilla and musk give it a smooth, sweet finish.

Bold and enveloping, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Jovoy Paris Private Label Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Jovoy Private Label is an earthy blend of vetiver, leather and papyrus.

Cécile Zarokian created it in 2011. Vetiver, leather and papyrus open dry and smoky, patchouli and sandalwood form a woody heart, and labdanum gives it a warm, resinous finish.

Refined and moody, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Jovoy Paris Pavillon Rouge Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Jovoy Pavillon Rouge is a rich, boozy blend of whiskey, rum, tobacco and leather.

Marie Schnirer created it in 2018. Whiskey, rum, sesame and spices open warm, tobacco, leather, coffee and tea form a deep heart, and vanilla, ebony and benzoin give it a smooth finish.

Bold and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Jovoy Paris Les Jeux Sont Faits Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Jovoy Les Jeux Sont Faits is a boozy blend of rum, tobacco leaf and vanilla.

Amélie Bourgeois created it in 2012. Angelica, dried fruits and petitgrain open bright, tobacco leaf, rum, cumin and gin form a rich heart, and labdanum, patchouli, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Bold and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Jovoy Paris L'art de La Guerre Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Jovoy L'Art de la Guerre is a green, leathery blend of rhubarb, immortelle and oakmoss.

Vanina Muracciole created it in 2014. Rhubarb, green apple and bergamot open crisp, immortelle, lavender, nutmeg and violet leaf form an herbal heart, and leather, oakmoss, patchouli, labdanum and sandalwood give it a rich finish.

Bold and distinctive, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Jovoy Paris Incident Diplomatique Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Jovoy Incident Diplomatique is an earthy blend of mandarin, vetiver and patchouli.

Launched in 2017, it opens with mandarin. Haitian and Java vetiver and nutmeg form a dry, spicy heart, and patchouli and sandalwood give it a woody finish.

Refined and grounded, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Jovoy Paris Ambre Premier Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Jovoy Ambre Premier is a warm, spicy amber with rose and vanilla.

Michelle Saramitot created it in 2011. Spices and citrus open bright, rose forms a soft heart, and amber, vanilla and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Electimuss Trajan Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Trajan is a bright, sparkling citrus with saffron and ambergris.

Launched in 2020, it opens with blood orange, mandarin, lemon and bergamot. Saffron, sage and lavender form a warm, aromatic heart, and ambergris, oakmoss and cedar give it a smooth, salty finish.

Easy to wear year-round, day or night.

title: Jovoy Paris 21 Conduit St Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Jovoy 21 Conduit St is an aromatic blend of rhubarb, fir and amaretto.

Oli Marlow and Marie Schnirer created it in 2020. Grapefruit, rhubarb, bergamot and lavender open bright, balsam fir and amaretto form a warm heart, and ambroxan, woods and tonka bean give it a smooth finish.

Refined and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Electimuss Summanus Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Summanus is a spicy, woody rose with black pepper and sandalwood.

Launched in 2020, it opens with black pepper and cardamom. Rose and amber form a warm heart, and sandalwood, guaiac wood and cypriol give it a powdery, woody finish.

Elegant and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Bortnikoff Tabac Dore Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Tabac Doré by Bortnikoff is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Tabac Doré was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Vanilla Absolute and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Tobacco, Benzoin, Cinnamon and Fig; base notes are Peru Balsam, Agarwood (Oud), Tolu Balsam, Labdanum, Cedar and Sandalwood.

title: Electimuss Silvanus Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Silvanus is a woody floral with saffron, oud and lily-of-the-valley.

Launched in 2020, it opens with saffron, oud and clove. Lily-of-the-valley, rosewood, cedar and sandalwood form a fresh woody heart, and ambergris and white musk give it a clean finish.

Refined and versatile, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

title: Bortnikoff Sayat Nova Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Sayat Nova by Bortnikoff is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sayat Nova was launched in 2020. Sayat Nova was created by Dmitry Bortnikov and Rajesh Balkrishnan.

title: Electimuss Rhodanthe Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Rhodanthe is a fruity, spicy rose with raspberry, black tea and oud.

Sofia Bardelli created it in 2019. Clove, pear, lemon and bergamot open bright, Bulgarian rose, raspberry, saffron, violet and black tea form the heart, and oud, patchouli, amber, cedar, musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Rich and romantic, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Bortnikoff Santa Sangre Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Santa Sangre by Bortnikoff is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Santa Sangre was launched in 2021. Santa Sangre was created by Dmitry Bortnikov and Rajesh Balkrishnan. Top notes are Jasmine Sambac, Pink Grapefruit and Vanilla Flower; middle notes are Pink Lotus and White Lotus; base notes are Dragon Blood Resin, Sandalwood and Siam Benzoin.

title: Bortnikoff Oud Sinharaja Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Oud Sinharaja by Bortnikoff is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Oud Sinharaja was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Bergamot, Grapefruit and Cardamom; middle notes are Frangipani, Jasmine Sambac and Magnolia; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Atlas Cedar and Labdanum.

title: Electimuss Octavian Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Electimuss Octavian is a rich, spicy rose with saffron, incense and oud.

Launched in 2020, it opens with saffron and pink pepper. Rose and olibanum form a warm, resinous heart, and oud and amber give it a deep finish.

Bold and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Bortnikoff Musk Khabib Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Musk Khabib by Bortnikoff is a fragrance for women and men. Musk Khabib was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Bergamot, Nutmeg and Cardamom; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Tolu Balsam and Cedar; base notes are Natural Musk, Ambergris, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss and Vetiver.

title: Electimuss Jupiter Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Jupiter by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Jupiter was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Sofia Bardelli. Top notes are Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Saffron, Davana and Labdanum; middle notes are Sandalwood, Vetiver, Patchouli and Cedar; base notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Ambergris, Musk, Tonka Bean and Vanilla.

title: Bortnikoff Lao Oud Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Lao Oud by Bortnikoff is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Lao Oud was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Magnolia and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Cacao, Chamomile, Peru Balsam, Beeswax and Cinnamon; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Indian Oud, Coffee, Vanilla Absolute, Tonka Bean, Birch Tar, Guaiac Wood and Woody Notes.

title: Electimuss Fortuna Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Fortuna by Electimuss is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Fortuna was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Sofia Bardelli. Top notes are Saffron and Grapefruit; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose and Geranium; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Musk, Patchouli and Vetiver.

title: Bortnikoff Coup de Foudre Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Coup de Foudre by Bortnikoff is a Citrus Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Coup de Foudre was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Sweet Orange, Green Tea, Lemon, Bergamot, White Grapefruit and Black Pepper; middle notes are Champaca, Jasmine, Rose de Mai, Lily-of-the-Valley, Ylang-Ylang and Tuberose; base notes are Cinnamon, Benzoin, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood, Pink Lotus, Turmeric, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud), Tolu Balsam, Tonka Bean and Pine.

title: Electimuss Capua Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Capua by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Capua was launched in 2020. Top note is elemi; middle note is Cedar; base notes are Vetiver, Cedar, Cashmere Wood and Amber.

title: Bortnikoff Classica Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Classica by Bortnikoff is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Classica was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Neroli, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Heliotrope, Rose de Mai, Orange Blossom, iris, Sandalwood and Olibanum; base notes are Musk, Vanilla, Labdanum, Tonka Bean, Castoreum, Palisander Rosewood, Ambergris, Patchouli, Birch Tar and Vetiver.

title: Electimuss Black Caviar Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Black Caviar by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. Black Caviar was launched in 2019. Top notes are Caviar, Agarwood (Oud) and Cedar; middle notes are Rosemary, Sage and Lavender; base notes are Vetiver, Patchouli and Oakmoss.

title: Electimuss Auster Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Auster by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Auster was launched in 2020. Top notes are Star Anise and Lemon; middle notes are Cloves and Geranium; base notes are Patchouli, Ambergris and Cedar.

title: Electimuss Aurora Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Aurora by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Aurora was launched in 2020. Top notes are Agarwood (Oud), Saffron, Cardamom and Cloves; middle notes are Rose, Patchouli and Sandalwood; base notes are Ambergris and White Musk.

title: Electimuss Amber Aquilaria Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Amber Aquilaria by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. Amber Aquilaria was launched in 2019. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Cognac and Rose; base notes are Ambergris, Agarwood (Oud), Bourbon Vanilla and Sandalwood.

title: Electimuss Alkout Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Alkout by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Alkout was launched in 2020.

title: V Canto Arsenico Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Arsenico is a fruity, woody blend of pineapple, birch and patchouli.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2017. Pineapple, apple, red currant and bergamot open juicy, cedar, birch, patchouli, cypriol, benzoin, tonka bean and jasmine form a smoky heart, and oakmoss, musk and amber give it an earthy finish.

Bold and versatile, it works day or night in spring and fall.

title: V Canto Amans Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Amans is a fresh, aromatic blend of citrus, rosemary and rosewood.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Bergamot, lemon, cardamom and pink grapefruit open bright, rosemary, geranium and nutmeg form an herbal heart, and rosewood, tonka bean, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.

Crisp and refined, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: V Canto Temptatio Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Temptatio is a sweet, fruity blend of peach, passionfruit and vanilla.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2020. Peach, passionfruit, black currant and citrus meet rose, jasmine, ylang-ylang, iris and violet, with vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood, patchouli, amber and musk for a powdery, sweet finish.

Seductive and warm, it works day or night in spring and winter.

title: V Canto Sigismondo Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Sigismondo is a spicy blend of saffron, rose and Cambodian oud.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2020. Saffron and cinnamon open warm, Cambodian oud, Bulgarian rose, cypriol and patchouli form a deep heart, and musk, oud, amber and vanilla give it an animalic finish.

Opulent and bold, it is made for winter nights.

title: V Canto Posi Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Posi is a woody blend of rose, saffron and sandalwood.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Rose, lemon, saffron and bergamot open bright, geranium, cypriol, amber and ylang-ylang form a warm heart, and woods, patchouli, sandalwood, oakmoss and musk give it an earthy finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in summer, fall and winter.

title: V Canto Mastin Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Mastin is a rich blend of oud, saffron and rose.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Oud, saffron, rose and cardamom open spicy, white wood, orris, cedar, orange blossom and jasmine form a floral heart, and ambergris, blackwood, oud, musk and a sand accord give it an animalic finish.

Intense and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: V Canto Magnificat Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Magnificat is a warm, ambery blend of rose, cotton candy and incense.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Amber, rose and ylang-ylang open rich, amber, cotton candy, sandalwood and geranium form a sweet heart, and incense, benzoin, vanilla, patchouli and musk give it a balsamic finish.

Opulent and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: V Canto Kashimire Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Kashimire is a warm, balsamic blend of cashmere wood, vanilla and labdanum.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Cashmere wood, copahu balm and amber open warm, vanilla, sandalwood, ylang-ylang and geranium form a creamy heart, and patchouli, labdanum, musk and vetiver give it a powdery finish.

Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: V Canto Isotta Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Isotta is an aromatic blend of eucalyptus, rose and leather.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2020. Eucalyptus, citrus and green tea open fresh, geranium, Bulgarian rose and jasmine form a floral heart, and leather, cedar, vanilla and tonka bean give it a warm finish.

Distinctive and polished, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: V Canto Irae Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Irae is a spicy, woody blend of cacao, Sichuan pepper and wormwood.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Cacao pod, tonka bean and bergamot open warm, Sichuan pepper, wormwood, coriander and a hot iron accord form a sharp heart, and oak, rosewood and amber give it a woody finish.

Bold and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: V Canto Ensis Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Ensis is a green, fruity floral with cassis, lilac and cacao.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Cassis, green leaves, pansy and bergamot open fresh, black currant, lilac, lily-of-the-valley and Bulgarian rose form a floral heart, and metallic notes, cacao, musk, patchouli and amber give it a soft finish.

Fresh and distinctive, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: V Canto Cicuta Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Cicuta is a sweet, citrusy rose with coriander and vanilla.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2016. Clementine, orange and bergamot open bright, rose, Bulgarian rose and coriander form a floral heart, and vanilla, vanilla flower, birch, musk, borage and amber give it a warm finish.

Elegant and sweet, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: V Canto Cianuro Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
V Canto Cianuro is a tropical blend of papaya, mango and water lily.

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2018. Papaya, passionfruit, mango, pineapple and neroli open juicy, water lily, narcissus, lily-of-the-valley and Turkish rose form a fresh heart, and cashmere wood, oakmoss, patchouli, leather and sandalwood give it a woody finish.

Sunny and lively, it is a lovely scent for spring.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy amber with myrrh and opoponax.

Launched in 2009, it opens with mandarin, bergamot and lily-of-the-valley. Myrrh and jasmine form a resinous heart, and opoponax, amber, patchouli and vanilla give it a rich, balsamic finish.

Seductive and opulent, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Parfums de Marly Layton Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Parfums de Marly Layton pairs crisp apple and lavender with a warm, spiced vanilla heart.

Hamid Merati-Kashani composed it in 2016. Apple, lavender, mandarin and bergamot open bright and fresh, geranium, violet and jasmine add a floral lift, and the base settles into vanilla, cardamom, pepper, sandalwood, patchouli and guaiac wood.

Layton is sweet, fresh and spicy all at once, so it rarely misses. Reach for it on date nights and evenings out, and enjoy it most when the air turns cooler in spring, fall and winter.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Live Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Live is a fresh, bright blend of orange blossom, ginger and sage.

Dominique Ropion created it in 2019. Orange blossom opens light and floral, bergamot and ginger form a zesty heart, and juniper and sage give it a clean, aromatic finish.

Easy and energetic, it suits everyday wear and date nights from spring through fall.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau Fraîche is a light, crisp citrus with mint and lavender.

Launched in 2020, it opens with lemon, ginger and pepper. Geranium, lavender, mint and juniper berries form a cool, aromatic heart, and cedar and olibanum give it a clean, woody finish.

Refreshing and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Vinyle Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Vinyle is a warm, sweet blend of immortelle, myrrh and vanilla.

Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2016. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, immortelle and myrrh form a resinous heart, and vanilla, resins and anise give it a sweet finish.

Cozy and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo is a refined, spicy fragrance with a vanilla and patchouli base.

Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2015. Bergamot, coriander and violet leaf open fresh, black pepper, lily of the valley and rose form the heart, and ambergris, patchouli and vanilla give it a smooth finish.

Elegant in every season, from the office to date night.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Trench Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Trench is a powdery blend of tangerine, fig and iris.

Amandine Clerc-Marie created it in 2015. Tangerine, bergamot and fig open bright, iris and neroli form a powdery heart, and musk, cedar and ambrette give it a soft finish.

Elegant and calm, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Saharienne Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Saharienne is a fresh, green blend of citrus, orange flower and ginger.

Launched in 2011, it opens with Amalfi lemon, bergamot and mandarin. White flowers, orange flower, cassis, galbanum and petitgrain form a green heart, and ginger and pink pepper give it a spicy finish.

Crisp and elegant, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Rouge Velours Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Rouge Velours is a woody rose with pink pepper, white tea and patchouli.

Launched in 2021, it opens with pink pepper and white tea. Rose, jasmine and iris form a velvety heart, and patchouli, vetiver and musk give it an earthy finish.

Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Toilette is a fruity floral with raspberry, peony and musk.

Dora Baghriche, Harry Frémont and Olivier Cresp created it in 2017. Raspberry, blackberry, bergamot and pink pepper open juicy, peony, datura, jasmine sambac and orange blossom form a lush heart, and patchouli, white musk, cashmeran and ambroxan give it a clean finish.

Light and romantic, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris is a sweet, fruity floral with strawberry, peony and patchouli.

Dora Baghriche, Harry Fremont and Olivier Cresp created it in 2016. Strawberry, raspberry, pear and citrus open juicy, peony, jasmine and datura form a lush heart, and patchouli, white musk, vanilla and ambroxan give it a warm finish.

Romantic and versatile, it suits everyday wear and the office in spring and fall.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Intense for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense is a warm, sensual lavender and orange blossom fragrance.

Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm created it in 2020. Lavender, mandarin and bergamot open fresh, lavender, orange blossom, jasmine sambac and orchid form the heart, and Madagascar vanilla, tonka bean, ambergris and vetiver give it a rich finish.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum is a bold blend of lavender, orange blossom and vanilla.

Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm created it in 2019. Lavender, mandarin, black currant and petitgrain open fresh, lavender, orange blossom and jasmine form the heart, and Madagascar vanilla, ambergris, musk and cedar give it a warm finish.

Versatile from spring through winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

title: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Sport Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Sport is a crisp, sporty blend of verbena, bergamot and cedar.

Anne Flipo and Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2014. Verbena, bergamot and aldehydes open sparkling, coriander and woods form the heart, and cedar and amber give it a clean finish.

Fresh and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Le Parfum is a fresh, airy blend of cardamom, violet leaf and woods.

Launched in 2020, it opens with ozonic notes, cardamom and lemon. Geranium, violet leaf and basil form an aromatic heart, and amberwood, cedar and vetiver give it a warm, woody finish.

Elegant and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette is a fresh, spicy ginger and citrus classic.

Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Pierre Wargnye created it in 2006. Ginger, bergamot and lemon open bright, spices, violet leaf, white pepper and basil form the heart, and tonka bean, cedar and vetiver give it a smooth finish.

Easy to wear for spring and summer days, the office and the gym.

title: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Cologne Bleue Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Cologne Bleue is a fresh blend of sea notes, citrus and lavender.

Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2018. Sea notes, grapefruit, blood orange, mandarin, cardamom and black pepper open bright, lavender, apple, geranium and thyme form an aromatic heart, and patchouli, cedar and sandalwood give it a woody finish.

Fresh and sporty, it is great for the office, the gym and casual days in spring and summer.

title: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'Homme is a smooth, seductive blend of cardamom, lavender and cedar.

Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Pierre Wargnye created it in 2009. Cardamom opens warm and spicy, lavender, cedar and bergamot form an elegant heart, and vetiver and caraway leave a soft, intimate finish.

La Nuit de L'Homme is soft, refined and seductive rather than loud. It is made for fall and winter nights and date nights, when you want to smell close and inviting.

title: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'homme Bleu Electrique Eau de Toilette For Men

title: By Kilian Pure Oud Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Dark, enigmatic, charismatic and moody. No, we're not talking exes— we're talking oud. The rare and precious oil found in agarwood has been inspiring perfumers of late, leading to a bounty of scents based on this compelling note. One of our favorites is this luxurious potion by Calice Becker. She has mastered the critical element of balance – showcasing all of the wonderful strangeness of oud, while taming it just enough to keep it from becoming overwhelming. Pure Oud opens with the dark glitter of obsidian, as saffron swirls over a deep animalic growl, then takes us on a long and twisty journey to secret places: a deliciously murky lair filled with mysterious smoke; a hidden chamber redolent with ink, leather and ancient wood. Make no mistake, this is powerful stuff: the ink is extremely inky, the leather is enveloping and rich, the animalic elements are so vivid that you can feel the lion's breath on your neck— and yet Becker has taken all of these prickly components and spun them into velvet. The end result is so astonishingly smooth and well-blended that you could wear it every day. Oud lovers will adore this, naturally, but this also gets our vote for the oud fragrance most likely to win new converts-- not because it is a simplified version, but because it gets all the complications perfectly right. Magical.

Pure Oud  Notes

Saffron, Oud Oil, Cypriol, Gaiac Wood, Copahu Balm, Ciste, Myrrh.

title: By Kilian I Don't Need A Prince By My Side To Be A Princess Eau de Parfum for Women

description_html: "White Collection" In The Garden of Good & Evil by the house of By Kilian presents the fourth edition this year, called Playing With The Devil, inspired by forbidden fruit interpreted in modern, imaginative way. The concept of god and evil is recognized in this composition in which on the one side the creator offers sweet, fruity tamed accord sprinkled with insolence and lecherous heat of resin and hot spices.

title: By Kilian Pearl Oud Eau de Parfum for Men

title: By Kilian Musk Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Kilian Musk Oud Perfume by Kilian, Citric and woody, Kilian Musk Oud is a flowery and musky fragrance suited for both men and women . Its high notes are characterized by crisp lemon and coriander alongside rich cardamom, while its heart notes include softer florals like rose, artemisia and geranium. Both sillage and endurance are on the heavier side with this fragrance, imprinting the air around the wearer with a warm, complex atmosphere well after the initial application. When the bottom notes emerge, patchouli, incense and rum are among the most striking aromas. While the complexity and richness of the scent lends exceptionally well to autumn use, this fragrance can be enjoyed in any season.

title: By Kilian Moonlight in Heaven Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance Family: Fresh

Scent Type: Fresh Citrus & Fruits

Key Notes: Mango, Coconut Milk, Rice

Fragrance Description: The fresh perfume of tasty mango and the fresh scent of powdered sambac jasmine are mixed with coconut milk and rice all wrapped in tonka bean and the delicacy of vetiver. Both unique and familiar, this fresh perfume with an exotic fragrance pushes you to open the doors of paradise.

About the Bottle: The bottles of Kilian's Fresh Citrus family are adorned with a distinctive Klein-blue lacquer and meticulously engraved on each side with the representation of the Achilles shield. Like Kilian Hennessy says, "In perfumery, it is as much about seduction as it is about protection."

About the Fragrance: Moonlight In Heaven is part of Kilian’s Fresh Citrus family. Fresh aromas reminiscent of a sip of sparkling citrus fruits, aquatic notes, or refreshing aldehydes bring freshness, lightness, and a serene feeling to these compositions. The Perfumer is Calice Becker.

title: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad extreme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
KILIAN pushes two of its heritage fragrances to their olfactive extremes.

Good girl gone Bad - EXTREME, is dipped in a delicious elixir of pure milky toffee goodness. Take the uninhibited whirlwind of flowers in Good girl gone Bad and envelope it in a luscious, milky facet. It opens with a pink and white bouquet of roses of May, and the most beautiful orange blossoms carried by the song of three sirens, calling from its core: tuberose, Egyptian jasmine sambac, and narcissus. These exquisite flowers are wrapped in a milky toffee elixir, making them half-innocent, half-voluptuous, and now—a delicious temptress altogether.

PERFUMER
Alberto Morillas

The jet-black perfume flacon can be tucked and carried away in a dedicated, black lacquer clutch adorned with the seductress’s ultimate partner-in-crime: a snake, as if emerging from the depths of desire.

title: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum for Women

Half-innocent, half-voluptuous, the apricot-tinged osmanthus absolute, orange blossom, and rose of may absolute that opens the fragrance are beholden by the ultimate temptress, an explosion of the three-sirens of flowers: tuberose absolute, jasmine and narcissus.

The perfect fragrance for good girls who dare to turn bad and sexy, to be worn wherever they want to be kissed. The Good girl gone Bad Eau de Parfum will last until the end of the night.

Floral

Scent Type:
Classic Florals

Key Notes:
Rose ,Tuberose, Jasmine

title: By Kilian Flower of Immortality Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
With Flower of Immortality, Kilian pays homage to the Chinese tale “A Tale of the Fountain of the Peach Blossom Spring”. It is recounted that a fisherman from Wu Ling loses his way along a stream and, unexpectedly, finds himself rowing alongside a lush peach tree forest. He decides to explore further and, at the end of the forest, lands at the fountainhead of the stream. There, he disembarks and just steps beyond, discovers a haven of peace, a utopian paradise where people live apart from the exterior world.

For Kilian, Flower of Immortality is, above all, an olfactory homage to the peach blossom and its very strong symbolism in China. This blossom, whose pink petals are unveiled only in the middle of the winter, is believed to have the power to bewitch the human soul and to make it immortal. It is the set of symbols and myths that surround the flower that Kilian wanted to recreate in this new fragrance.

Flower of Immortality was composed as the memory of the utopian paradise, where the fragrance of peach blossoms brings a promise of hospitality and immortality. The smooth and juicy scent of White Peach, interweaved by the sweet and powdery notes of Carrot and Iris. A dazzling breeze of Blackcurrant Bud absolute refreshes while the exquisite Rose Crystal is softened by the Tonka Bean and the scent of Vanilla beans drying in the sun.

- Top: peach blossom, blackcurrant buds, peach.

- Middle: iris, rose, carrot.

- Base: tonka bean, vanilla.

title: By Kilian Bad Boys Are No Good But Good Boys Are No Fun Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Kilian launches My Kind Of Love in 2018, five new fragrances inspired by seduction games, bold declarations of love and a way to love freely. 

The lower-priced line comes out at Sephora in August 2018 named My Kind of Love. The concept is to choose a flavor of love which corresponds with the different scents: fun, sparkling, hot and sweet.

"I wanted to invite you to take a walk on the wild side with a scent made for misbehaving. Boys is a very sexy and very fresh scent thanks to the instantly recognizable cola accord made of nutmeg, cinnamon, and lime."— Kilian Hennessy.

title: By Kilian Black Phantom Eau de Parfum Unisex

title: By Kilian Bamboo Harmony Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Bamboo Harmony is inspired by The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, a Japanese folk tale. The bamboo stands as the symbol of human perfection and is in Chinese culture the means to practice calligraphy with, it being the main material out of which calligraphy brushes are made of. It symbolizes therefore art, beauty and the "men of letters".

The fragrance Bamboo Harmony by Kilian focuses on the olfactory impression of a sip of white tea drunk off bamboo, with fresh top notes of notes of bergamot, neroli and Bigarade. The white tea leaves being renowned for their sumptuous taste and delicate refinement are here accented with a hint of spice. Coupled with white tea there are Maté notes in Bamboo Harmony , interwoven with fig leaves and oakmoss, making us savour a serene moment of spirituality in a drop of fragrance.

Gucci Guilty Love Edition Pour Homme is a fresh, floral take on Guilty with lilac and violet.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2021. Mandora, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, lilac, violet and geranium form a soft floral heart, and patchouli and amber give it a warm finish.

Light and modern, it is a lovely spring scent.

title: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Gucci Guilty Pour Femme is a fruity, spicy floral with lilac, peach and patchouli.

Aurélien Guichard created it in 2010. Pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot open bright, lilac, peach, geranium, jasmine and black currant form the heart, and patchouli, amber, white musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Confident and versatile, it suits the office and everyday wear in spring, fall and winter.

title: Gucci Guilty Eau Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

Launched in 2015, it opens with lemon and bergamot. Snowberry, orris and orange blossom form a soft heart, and patchouli and musk give it a clean finish.

Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Gucci Guilty Cologne Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

Gucci Guilty Cologne Pour Homme is a fresh, aromatic blend of juniper, cypress and violet.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Juniper berries, rosemary and Calabrian bergamot open crisp, cypress, heliotrope and violet form a soft heart, and white musk, patchouli leaf and cedar give it a clean finish.

Light and polished, it is great for the office and everyday wear in spring and summer.

title: Gucci Guilty Absolute Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Leather opens bold, cypress and patchouli form the heart, and woods and vetiver give it an earthy finish.

Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Refined and moody, it suits date nights and everyday wear in fall and winter.

title: Gucci Bloom Profumo di Fiori Eau de Parfum for Women

Gucci Bloom Profumo di Fiori is a lush white floral with jasmine sambac, tuberose and ylang-ylang.

Radiant and elegant, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Fresh and feminine, it is a great everyday scent for the office and spring days.

description_html:
Fragrance du Bois New York 5th Avenue is a soft, woody rose with caramel and violet.

Shadi Samra created it in 2020. Rose and bergamot open bright, caramel, violet and cypriol form a sweet heart, and cashmere wood, musk, vanilla and guaiac wood give it a powdery finish.

Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Minuit Et Demi Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance Du Bois Minuit et Demi is a warm, boozy gourmand of caramel, coffee and vanilla.

Stéphane Bengana created it in 2020. Cardamom, pimento and bergamot open spicy, caramel and coffee form a rich heart, and Madagascar vanilla, cinnamon, tobacco, musk, liquor, cedar, cashmeran and vetiver give it a deep finish.

Indulgent and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Milano Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance Du Bois Milano is a fruity, smooth leather with saffron and vanilla.

Shadi Samra created it in 2020. Orange, saffron, thyme and bergamot open bright, fruity notes, olibanum and jasmine form the heart, and leather, musk, amber, woods and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Refined and inviting, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Cavort Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance Du Bois Cavort is a warm, spicy floral with saffron, rose and incense.

Launched in 2021, it opens with saffron, cinnamon, geranium and davana. Jasmine, orange blossom, rose and ylang-ylang form a lush heart, and incense, labdanum, sandalwood and patchouli give it a rich, balsamic finish.

Opulent and warm, it works day or night.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Cannabis Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance du Bois Cannabis Intense is a spicy, woody blend of cannabis, saffron and oud.

Shadi Samra created it in 2020. Cardamom, pink pepper and orange open bright, cannabis, nutmeg and saffron form an aromatic heart, and woods, cedar, oud and musk give it a warm finish.

Bold and distinctive, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Fragrance Du Bois Brume Du Matin Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Fragrance du Bois Brume du Matin is a soft, fruity floral with peony, peach and rose.

Launched in 2016, it opens with mandarin and bergamot. Peony, rose, peach, violet, jasmine and plum form a pretty heart, and white musk, woods and amber give it a powdery finish.

Fresh and gentle, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Ferragamo F by Ferragamo Black Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Ferragamo F by Ferragamo Black is a smooth blend of lavender, apple and tonka bean.

Olivier Polge created it in 2009. Lavender and apple open fresh, black pepper and coriander form a spicy heart, and tonka bean and labdanum give it a warm, sweet finish.

Easy and charming, it is great for date nights in spring, fall and winter.

title: Etat Libre d'Orange Vierges Et Toreros Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Etat Libre d'Orange Vierges et Toreros is a bold blend of leather, tuberose and spice.

Antoine Lie and Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2007. Leather, tuberose, nutmeg, cardamom, pepper, ylang-ylang, patchouli, vetiver, musk, labdanum and bergamot come together in a spicy, animalic and unusual scent.

Daring and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Etat Libre d'Orange Tilda Swinton Like This Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Etat Libre d'Orange Tilda Swinton Like This is a warm, cozy blend of immortelle, pumpkin and ginger.

Mathilde Bijaoui created it in 2010. Immortelle, pumpkin, ginger and tangerine meet heliotrope, vetiver, musk, neroli and rose for a sweet, herbal and comforting scent.

Gentle and autumnal, it is perfect for fall days.

title: Etat Libre d'Orange Je Suis Un Homme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Etat Libre d'Orange Je Suis un Homme is a bold blend of leather, citrus and cognac.

Antoine Lie created it in 2006. Leather, bergamot, lemon, clove, bitter orange and cognac meet birch, cinnamon, myrtle, patchouli and musk for a spicy, boozy and rugged scent.

Confident and distinctive, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.
