title: Etat Libre d'Orange Hermann A Mes Cotes Me Paraissait Une Ombre Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Etat Libre d'Orange Hermann à Mes Côtés Me Paraissait une Ombre is a musky rose with an earthy edge.

Quentin Bisch created it in 2015. Geosmin, pepperwood, ambroxan, rose, patchouli and musk come together in a soft, airy and slightly earthy floral wood.

Unusual and calm, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Escentric Molecules Molecule 03 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Molecule 03 is a clean, earthy vetiver.

Geza Schoen created it in 2010. Vetiver and vetiveryl acetate come together in a green, aromatic and smooth woody scent with a quietly earthy feel.

Fresh and minimal, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

title: Escentric Molecules Escentric 04 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 04 is a bright, aromatic blend of grapefruit, juniper and sandalwood.

Geza Schoen created it in 2017. Grapefruit, juniper, osmanthus, mastic, galbanum and rose open fresh, orris and rose form a soft heart, and Javanol, balsam, sandalwood and woods give it a creamy finish.

Crisp and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

title: Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 is a fresh, spicy blend of lime, ginger and vetiver.

Geza Schoen created it in 2010. Lime, ginger and pepper open bright, tea, iris and jasmine form a soft heart, and vetiver, Virginia cedar, leather, sandalwood and musk give it a woody finish.

Clean and modern, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

title: Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 is a clean, woody scent built around Iso E Super.

Geza Schoen created it in 2006. Iso E Super meets pink pepper, Amalfi lemon and iris, with hedione, orris, balsam and musk adding a soft, airy warmth that feels like your own skin, only better.

Subtle and versatile, it works for the office, the gym and everyday wear in spring and summer.

title: EIGHT & BOB Eight & Bob Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: EIGHT & BOB by EIGHT & BOB is a Aromatic fragrance for men. EIGHT & BOB was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Albert Fouquet. Top notes are Cardamom, Ginger, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Cedar, Guaiac Wood, Hazelnut and Labdanum; base notes are Ambergris, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Patchouli.

title: Dunhill Signature Collection Indian Sandalwood Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Indian Sandalwood by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Indian Sandalwood was launched in 2019. Top notes are Carrot and Bergamot; middle notes are Orris and Moss; base notes are Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha.

title: Dunhill Icon Absolute Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Dunhill Icon Absolute by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Dunhill Icon Absolute was launched in 2015. Top notes are bergamot and black pepper; middle notes are saffron, black rose and jasmine; base notes are agarwood (oud), tobacco leaf and leather.

title: Dunhill Century Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Experience freshness like no other with the Dunhill London Century Eau de Parfum Spray, an aromatic-woody fragrance for moments of clarity.

Dunhill Century is for the future you. Inspired by reflection, the elegant composition is perfect for men that want to be their best. An opportunity for change or to reinvent yourself, Century exudes the style and confidence all men will wish to possess.

The Century Eau de Parfum makes an entrance with a citrus opening, merging bright notes of bergamot, grapefruit and mandarin. This luminosity continues in the heart with a neroli facet, before taking an aromatic and spicy turn with the addition of cardamom and oilbanum. In the base, sandalwood and musk smooth out the composition, while a nod of exotic cypriol gives the scent a seductive edge.

title: D.S. & DURGA White Peacock Lily Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: White Peacock Lily by D.S. & Durga is a Floral fragrance for women and men. White Peacock Lily was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Nerium Oleander, Cabreuva and Grapefruit; middle notes are White Lily, Egyptian Jasmine, Whipped cream and Violet; base notes are Watery Notes, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Vanilla.

title: D.S. & DURGA Vio Volta Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Vio Volta by D.S. & Durga is a Woody fragrance for women and men. Vio Volta was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

title: D.S. & DURGA St. Vetyver Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: St. Vetyver by D.S. & Durga is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. St. Vetyver was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Bitter Orange, Pink Pepper and Seagrass; middle notes are Hat straw, Reed and Clove Leaf; base notes are Vetiver, Breadnut and Rhum agricole.

title: D.S. & DURGA Rose Atlantic Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Rose Atlantic by D.S. & Durga is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women and men. Rose Atlantic was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Rose Petals, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Rose, Lime (Linden) Blossom, Salt and Grass; base notes are Sea water, Oakmoss and Musk.

title: D.S. & DURGA Radio Bombay Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Transistor radio hewn of sandalwood radiates ragas in the Bandra heat. Hot copper tubes warm the soft wood releasing blooms of musk, cream, peach, ambrette, coco, cedar distillates.

Radio Bombay by D.S. & Durga is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Radio Bombay was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are woody notes and cedar; middle notes are sandalwood, iris, boronia and peach; base notes are ambrette (musk mallow), sandalwood, ambergris, balsam fir, musk and coconut.

title: D.S. & DURGA Notorious Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Notorious Oud by D.S. & Durga is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Notorious Oud was launched in 2019. Top notes are Saffron, Camphor and Galbanum; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Bulgarian Rose and Lavender; base notes are Papyrus, Cetalox and Civet.

title: D.S. & DURGA Mississippi Medicine Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Mississippi Medicine by D.S. & Durga is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Mississippi Medicine was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

title: D.S. & DURGA Italian Citrus Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Italian Citrus by D.S. & Durga is a Citrus fragrance for men. Italian Citrus was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

title: D.S. & DURGA I Don't Know What Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
D.S. & Durga I Don't Know What is a subtle enhancer that makes other scents glow.

David Seth Moltz created it in 2018. Bergamot opens bright, Iso E Super and vetiver form an airy heart, and amber, a soft civet accord and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

Wear it alone or layered, in any season.

title: D.S. & DURGA Freetrapper Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Before cowboys, there were free trappers. Renegade mountaineers of the Jacksonian era who cut trails through the wild in search of beaver pelts. This fragrance is dedicated to them. It consists of dark notes of cedar, pine, wild bergamot and snakeroot. Freetrapper was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

 Notes

Distilled incense, bergamot, bitter orange, dark cedar, snakeroot, osmanthus, amberwood, santal, and castoreum.

title: D.S. & DURGA El Cosmico Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: El Cosmico by D.S. & Durga is a Woody fragrance for women and men. El Cosmico was launched in 2015. El Cosmico was created by David Seth Moltz and Kavi Moltz. Top notes are Pine and Pepper; middle notes are Oak, Khella and Creosote Bush; base notes are Khella and Sand.

title: D.S. & DURGA Debaser Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
D.S. & Durga Debaser is a creamy, sunny blend of fig, coconut milk and woods.

David Seth Moltz created it in 2015. Fig, coconut milk, white woods, iris and tonka bean blend into a soft, milky and slightly sweet scent.

Perfect for spring and summer days.

title: D.S. & DURGA Crystal Pistil Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Crystal Pistil by D.S. & Durga is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Crystal Pistil was launched in 2020. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Water Notes and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Jasmine, Floral Notes and Paradisone; base notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), White Musk and Synthetic Civet.

title: D.S. & DURGA Cowboy Grass Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Cowboy Grass by DS&Durga is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

title: D.S. & DURGA Coriander Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Coriander is a fresh and uplifting fragrance of green leaf notes and cracked coriander seed. It is a part of the Feminine Collection II Solos. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

Notes

Russian coriander, pepper, juniper needle, geranium, clove stem, clary sage, musk, magnolia, and mace.

title: D.S. & DURGA Burning Barbershop Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Burning Barbershop by D.S. & Durga is a Aromatic fragrance for men. Burning Barbershop was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

title: D.S. & DURGA Bowmakers Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
D.S. & Durga Bowmakers captures a violin maker's workshop of varnish and wood.

David Seth Moltz created it in 2013. Violin varnish, mahogany and an outdoors accord open warm, amber pine rosin, maple wood and cypress form the heart, and spiced tree resin, cedar and moss give it a woody finish.

Made for fall and winter days.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Velvet Patchouli by Dolce&Gabbana is a Chypre fragrance for women and men. Velvet Patchouli was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Rodrigo Flores-Roux. The fragrance features patchouli and kephalis.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Exotic Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Velvet Exotic Leather is inspired by male skin, his sensuality and elegance. The essence of a man, his scent and masculinity, enriched with the sophisticated touch of leather. Velvet Exotic leather is a sensual and elegant scent, with a complex heart of Black Leather accord. Rich and warm Cistus Labdanum, intense Styrax and deep woody Cade oil create its unique and masculine leather character. Fresh notes of Clary Sage and Lavender and refined and fruity Rum absolute recall a vintage liquor. While Olibanum and Incense extend a warm and enveloping touch

Velvet Exotic Leather fragrance notes
Black leather, Labdanum, Styrax, Cade, Clary sage, Lavender, Rum, Incense, Olibanum

title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Sport Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: The One Sport’s opens with a clever and unexpected pairing of rosemary with an aquatic accord, followed by the dry, cool, green feel of sequoia tree bark and aromatic cardamom. The sequoia’s cool demeanor relaxes the energy in this cologne into a laid-back, contemplative, and calm profile.

title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Grey Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Fragrance Family:
Earthy & Woody

Scent Type:
Citrus & Woods

Key Notes:
Grapefruit, Cardamom, Vetiver

About:
Joining the Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men line, The One Grey is a celebration of modern elegance and charisma. It is a fusion of opposites, grounding aromatic cardamom with earthy vetiver. The cardamom opens the fragrance, combined with bitter citrus notes of grapefruit. Lavandin and vetiver power the heart of the scent, while the base reveals The One for Men’s signature sensuality with warm tobacco and elegant grey woods accord.

title: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy tobacco and amber classic.

Olivier Polge created it in 2015. Grapefruit, coriander and basil open fresh, ginger, cardamom and orange blossom form a spicy heart, and amber, tobacco and cedar give it a smooth, seductive base.

Made for fall and winter, ideal for date nights and evenings out.

title: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One 2 Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
The Only One fragrance that came out in late August 2018 as a new flanker of the original The One from 2006, gets its sequel in the form of the new edition The Only One 2. The first fragrance brought the composition of a gourmand iris in combination with coffee, while chapter 2 introduces a scent of powdery rose and violet with a sweet coffee note.

The composition symbolizes the scent of love, seduction and lust, presented with a bottle in ruby red colour. 

Top notes: pear, red berries, blackberry, freesia
Heart: red rose, violet, coffee
Base: tonka, patchouli, ambergris, amber woods

title: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense by Dolce&Gabbana is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Violaine Collas. Top notes are Neroli, Italian Mandarin and Green Apple; middle notes are Jasmine, Coconut and Orange Blossom; base notes are Vanilla, Cashmere Wood and Cedar.

title: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: The Only One by Dolce&Gabbana is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. The Only One was launched in 2018. Top notes are Violet, Bergamot and Orange; middle notes are Coffee, Pear, iris, Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Caramel, Vanilla and Patchouli.

title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense for Men
description_html:
"The quintessence of masculine charisma and refined elegance, The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense brings a striking new intensity to the Dolce&Gabbana Beauty The One for Men line. Drawing on the olfactory inheritance of The One for Men Eau de Toilette and Eau de Parfum, and The One Grey Eau de Toilette Intense, it introduces a new expression of timeless sophistication that heightens the irresistible magnetism of the man who wears it.

The One For Men Eau de Parfum Intense finds its magnetic appeal in a daring fusion of opposites. Intensely masculine, fascinating yet authentic, it is a scent of extremes – warm neroli golden facets with deep black leather in an enigmatic expression of olfactory chiaroscuro.

Sharing the same clean geometric lines as the original The One for Men fragrance, the bottle is now reimagined in black, the iconic colour of Dolce&Gabbana. Symbolic of elegance, sensuality and tradition, the sleek black form is accented with radiant gold details, mirroring the distinctive facets of the fragrance within."

title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold For Men Eau de Parfum Intense
description_html: The One Gold For Men by Dolce&Gabbana is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. The One Gold For Men was launched in 2021. The One Gold For Men was created by Rodrigo Flores-Roux, Michel Girard and Olivier Pescheux. Top notes are Blood Orange, Sicilian Bergamot and Ginger; middle notes are Clary Sage, Cardamom and Geranium; base notes are Patchouli, Amberwood and Haitian Vetiver.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme (2012) by Dolce&Gabbana is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme (2012) was launched in 2012. Top notes are Citruses, Bergamot, Neroli and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lavender, Sage and Pepper; base notes are Tobacco, Tonka Bean and Cedar.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense pour Femme is a juicy, crisp citrus with green apple.

Olivier Cresp created it in 2017. Lemon and Granny Smith apple open bright, marigold and jasmine form a fresh heart, and musk and amberwood give it a lasting finish.

A summer favorite for everyday wear and active days.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
A stunning perfume, overwhelming and irresistible like the joy of living. The scent is surprisingly colored with the liveliness of Sicilian citron, the happiness of Granny Smith apple, and the spontaneity of bluebells. Feminine and resolute notes are expressed with the intensity of jasmine, the freshness of bamboo, and the charm of white rose. The deep and true base embodies the character of cedarwood, the fullness of amber, and the embrace of musk.

Notes:
Sicilian Citron, Bluebell, Granny Smith Apple, Jasmine Sambac, Bamboo, White Rose, Cedarwood, Amber, Musk.
Style:
Deep and true.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Discover Vulcano Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Dolce & Gabbana is launching a new fragrant pair for spring 2014 and it is inspired by the islands of Vulcano and Panarea. The perfumes arrive in characteristic bottles as limited editions with light compositions aimed at the summer period of the year.

Edition for men is inspired by the island of Vulcano, the volcanos were named after later on. This island is known for mud bath and the crater with smoke. The name Volcano was given by the ancient Romans and during the years it entered many modern languages. Romans used this island to obtain high quality raw materials and timber. The fragrance Vulcano depicts the atmosphere with a luminous blend of Italian lemon and ginger, followed by an aromatic-woody blend of cypress and lavender. The base closes with an elegant woody layer of vetiver and cedar. Men's version Light Blue Discover Volcano can be purchased as 125ml Eau de Toilette.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Sun Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
This summer Dolce & Gabbana Beauty adds a solar twist to its cult scent Light Blue with a Limited Edition: Light Blue Sun Pour Homme. A cocktail of Italian bergamot and frozen grapefruit infused by coconut water boosts Light Blue Pour Homme's signature contrast of coolness and sensuality. Light Blue Sun invites you to live the passion of a young summer crush on the island of Capri. Scent: Solar fresh woody. Made in France.

 

TOP NOTES

  • Bergamot
  • Ginger
  • Frozen grapefruit
  • Ozonic accord

HEART NOTES

  • Rosemary
  • Cypress
  • Coconut water
  • Cedarwood

BASE NOTES

  • Vanilla
  • Vetiver
  • White musks
  • Oakmoss

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense pour Homme is a deeper, saltier take on Light Blue.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Grapefruit and mandarin open bright, sea water and juniper form a fresh, salty heart, and amberwood and musk give it a lasting finish.

A summer favorite for the office, the gym and everyday wear.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Love is Love Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Light Blue Love Is Love Pour Homme was presented in March 2020, as a irresistible summery edition. "The classic woody and musky scent is boosted by vibrant citrus and crisp Granny Smith apple. A surprising twist of apple gelato is contrasted by aromatic rosemary and pink pepper notes, enhancing this fragrance’s passion and sensuality."

Top Notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Mandarin, Granny Smith apple
Heart Notes: Pink Pepper, Rosemary, Apple gelato accord
Base Notes: Creamy Musks, Amber Wood, Vanilla

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Forever Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Light Blue Forever by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Light Blue Forever was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Cresp. Top notes are Lemon, Blood Orange and Green Apple; middle notes are Orange Blossom and White Flowers; base notes are White Musk, Cedar and Cashmeran.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Drawing upon their native home of Italy, Dolce & Gabbana's innovative design team has captured the sensuality of the Mediterranean. A refreshing blend of citrus notes combines perfectly with masculine woods and subtle spice to create a distinctive fragrance that epitomizes relaxed sophistication.

Notes:
Sicilian Mandarin, Frozen Grapefruit Peel, Bergamot, Juniper, Rosemary, Szechuan Pepper, Rosewood, Musk Wood, Incense, Oak Moss.
Style:
Mysterious. Confident. Sensual.

title: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
"K by Dolce&Gabbana is a fragrance that captures the essence of a man in his element. He is the king of his everyday life. He follows his own path, cherishing his family and loved ones above all else. Effortlessly charming, and not afraid to show his vitality, he remains true to his roots, respecting tradition while embracing modernity."

The opening notes of the composition include sparkling blood orange, pressed Sicilian lemon and juniper berries. The heart reveals the pimento essence combined with clary sage, geranium and lavandin, while the base is woody and masculine combining the cedarwood, vetiver and patchouli accords.

title: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum by Dolce&Gabbana is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum was launched in 2020. Top notes are lemon, sicilian lemon, blood orange, cardamom, juniper berries and pimento; middle notes are geranium, clary sage, lavender and fig nectar; base notes are cedar, patchouli, vetiver and cypriol oil or nagarmotha.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Pure instinct; the power of an emotion that is freely expressed. It is the force of a determined man, with a heart that is rooted in tradition, yet revels in the modern world. This product is a woody aromatic fragrance, whose profound appeal is defined by a brand new discovery in the olfactory world: the Moepel accord which has been re-created from the flowers and leaves of the milkwood tree using headspace technology.

  • Top notes: Opens with luminous aquatic notes and green accents of basil. This fresh feeling is completed with notes of marigold and geranium
  • Heart: First come the notes of lavender and then the tobacco masculinity is further defined with soft dry notes from absolutes of hay and bran?
  • Base notes: Luxurious floral, balsamic, and honey accents. Intensity and strength come from the profound combination labdanum, sandalwood and cypress. A contrast of fresh, warm and rich, that completes the composition of the fragrance and emphasizes its woody charm

title: Diptyque Vetyverio Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Vetyverio Eau De Parfum by Diptyque is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Vetyverio Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Pescheux. Top notes are Grapefruit and Mandarin Orange; middle note is Turkish Rose; base notes are Haitian Vetiver, Vetiver and Patchouli.

title: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Tam Dao Eau de Toilette is a lighter, airier take on Diptyque's sandalwood.

Launched in 2003, it opens with Italian cypress, myrtle and rose. Sandalwood and cedar form a creamy heart, and rosewood, spices, amber and white musk give it a soft finish.

A calm daytime scent for spring, fall and winter.

title: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Tam Dao is a creamy, meditative sandalwood.

Daniel Molière created this eau de parfum in 2013. Sandalwood and cedar are warmed by amberwood, vanilla and musk, with a light touch of coriander, lime and ginger.

Calm and comforting, it is an easy everyday scent from spring through winter.

title: Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Parfum is a green, milky fig that smells like a summer orchard.

Olivia Giacobetti created this eau de parfum in 2012. Fig leaf and ripe fig open fresh and green, the scent of the fig tree forms the heart, and woods and black pepper give it a dry, creamy finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

title: Diptyque Oud Palao Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Oud Palao Eau de Parfum by Diptyque is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Oud Palao Eau de Parfum was launched in 2015.

title: Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Orphéon is a soft, powdery woody fragrance with a quiet floral heart.

Launched in 2021, it opens with crisp juniper berries, moves into a soft jasmine heart and settles into powdery notes, cedar and tonka bean for a warm, polished finish.

Orphéon is understated and elegant, a scent that rewards people who stand close. It is a lovely daytime choice for spring and fall.

title: Diptyque L'Ombre dans L'Eau Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: L'Ombre Dans L'Eau ("Shadow in the water") is a female fragrance from 1983, based on the unusual and beautiful harmony of black currant leaf and Bulgarian rose, which blend perfectly together. This perfume was created by Serge Kalouguine, a famous French perfumer who dedicated 30 years of his life to the house of Fragonard. Read more about this fragrance in the article L'Ombre dans L'Eau ("Shadow in the water") from Diptyque.

title: Diptyque L'Ombre Dans L'Eau Limited Edition Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: L'Ombre Dans L'Eau Limited Edition by Diptyque is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. L'Ombre Dans L'Eau Limited Edition was launched in 2019. Top notes are Cassis, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Black currant leaf, Rose and Black Currant; base notes are Musk and Ambergris.

title: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Fleur de Peau is a soft, powdery musk that feels like warm skin.

Olivier Pescheux created it in 2018. Aldehydes, pink pepper, angelica and bergamot open bright, iris and Turkish rose form a velvety heart, and musk, ambrette, carrot, ambergris, leather and sandalwood give it a sensual finish.

Elegant and intimate, it is a daytime favorite for spring and fall.

title: Diptyque Eau Duelle Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Eau Duelle by Diptyque is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Eau Duelle was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin. The fragrance features cardamom, elemi resin, olibanum, bergamot, pink pepper, juniper, saffron, black tea, musk, ambergris and bourbon vanilla.

title: Diptyque Do Son Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Do Son by Diptyque is a Floral fragrance for women. Do Son was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin. Top notes are African Orange flower, iris and Rose; middle notes are Tuberose and Pink Pepper; base notes are Benzoin and Musk.

title: Diptyque Do Son Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Diptyque Do Son is a soft, breezy tuberose with a fresh, airy feel.

Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2005. Orange flower, iris and rose open fresh, tuberose and pink pepper form a lush heart, and benzoin and musk give it a soft finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Christian Dior Vanilla Diorama Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Vanilla Diorama is a rich, boozy vanilla with rum and cacao.

François Demachy created it in 2021. Orange, pink pepper and lemon open bright, rum, cacao and cardamom form a gourmand heart, and Bourbon vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, smooth finish.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Christian Dior Tobacolor Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Tobacolor is a sweet, honeyed tobacco with soft fruits and smoke.

François Demachy created it in 2021. Tobacco leaf, honey, plum, peach and citrus blend with a light smoke and warm amber for a rich, cozy scent.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Christian Dior Spice Blend Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Spice Blend is a warm, boozy blend of rum, ginger and spices.

François Demachy created it in 2019. Rum and ginger open warm, pink pepper, cinnamon, black pepper, clove, nutmeg and coriander form a spicy heart, and bay leaf and woods give it a dry finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Dior Sauvage Elixir for Men
description_html:
Dior Sauvage Elixir is the richest, spiciest take on Sauvage.

François Demachy created it in 2021, trading the original's bright freshness for warmth. Cinnamon, nutmeg and cardamom open over a flash of grapefruit, lavender sits at the heart, and licorice, sandalwood, amber, patchouli and Haitian vetiver settle into a smooth, long-lasting base.

Sauvage Elixir is dense and powerful, built for cool evenings and nights out from fall into spring. One or two sprays go a long way, and it lasts for hours.

title: Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette is the fresh, peppery original that started the Sauvage line.

François Demachy created it in 2015. Calabrian bergamot and pepper open bright and spicy, Sichuan pepper, lavender, vetiver and geranium form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, cedar and labdanum give it a clean, lasting finish.

Easy to wear from spring through fall, for the office, the gym and everyday.

title: Dior Sauvage Parfum for Men
description_html:
Dior Sauvage Parfum is the smooth, refined Parfum version of Sauvage.

François Demachy created it in 2019. Bergamot, mandarin and elemi open bright, sandalwood forms a creamy heart, and olibanum, tonka bean and vanilla give it a warm finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

title: Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum is the warmer, smoother version of the modern classic.

François Demachy created it in 2018. Bergamot opens bright and fresh, Sichuan pepper, lavender, star anise and nutmeg add a spicy heart, and ambroxan and vanilla leave a smooth, lasting trail.

Versatile and easy to wear, it works in every season, day or night, from the office to date night.

title: Christian Dior Santal Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Santal Noir by Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Santal Noir was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

title: Christian Dior Sakura Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Sakura by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Sakura was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Green Notes; middle notes are Japanese Cherry Blossom, Rose, Jasmine and Hedione; base notes are Mimosa, Violet and White Musk.

title: Christian Dior Rouge Trafalgar Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Dior Rouge Trafalgar is a bright, juicy red-fruit fragrance.

Launched in 2020, it opens with raspberry, strawberry, cherry and mandarin. Black currant and grapefruit form a fresh heart, and musk and patchouli give it a soft finish.

Playful and fresh, it is perfect for spring and summer days.

title: Dior Miss Dior Rose N'Roses Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Dior Rose N'Roses is a new addition to the Miss Dior line, announced as a fresh and radiant Eau de Toilette.

Top notes: Italian mandarin, bergamot, geranium essence

Heart: Grasse rose, Damask rose

Base: white musk

Miss Dior Rose N'Roses was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

title: Christian Dior Purple Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Purple Oud by Dior is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Purple Oud was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

title: Dior Poison Girl Unexpected Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Poison Girl Unexpected by Christian Dior is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Poison Girl Unexpected was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Ginger, Blood Orange and Lemon; middle note is Damask Rose; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Hazelnut and Cashmeran.

title: Dior Poison Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Some perfumes are born a myth. Heady, mysterious, and revolutionary since its creation, Poison is Dior’s ultimate weapon of seduction. Its exceptional, exotic alchemy is composed of a rich blend of spicy, fruity, and amber notes warmed by honey and musk—an unforgettable fragrance.

Notes:
Coriander, Tuberose, Opoponax.

Style:
Unexpected. Charismatic. Unforgettable.

title: Christian Dior Oud Ispahan Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Oud Ispahan by Dior is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Oud Ispahan was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Labdanum; middle notes are Rose, Patchouli and Saffron; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Sandalwood and Cedar.

title: Christian Dior New Look 1947 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: New Look 1947 by Dior is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. New Look 1947 was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Pink Pepper; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Rose, Tuberose and Gardenia; base notes are Benzoin and Vanilla.

title: Dior Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Fragrance Family:
Floral

Scent Type:
Fruity Florals

Key Notes:
Grapefruit, Musk

About:
Experience the caress of a fresh rose dressed in peony flowers. This vivacious eau de toilette unfurls with radiant Calabrian bergamot, revealing a tender heart of peony and Damascus rose. Its lingering finish is edged with white musk. A floral springtime signature, perfect for a flirty and irresistibly charming Miss Dior.

Blooming Bouquet is a composition designed like a dress embroidered with a thousand blossoms. It pays tribute to Christian Dior's legendary love of flowers.

title: Dior Miss Dior Cherie Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: The new Miss Dior Eau de Parfum reveals the femininity of a sensual floral. Its heart is a floral declaration that combines the beauty of Grasse rose with the boldness of Damascus rose, both wrapped in a ribbon of fresh notes of Calabrian bergamot. This handcrafted creation is woven with rosewood from French Guiana and pink pepper from Réunion Island for heightened character. A Miss Dior that will leave you lovestruck.

title: Christian Dior Leather Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Leather Oud by Dior is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Leather Oud was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Cardamom, Cloves, Jasmine and Geranium; base notes are Leather, Agarwood (Oud), Smoke, Birch, Patchouli, Amberwood, Sandalwood and Sand.

title: Christian Dior La Colle Noire Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: La Colle Noire by Dior is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. La Colle Noire was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Lemon; middle notes are May Rose, Spices, Peony, Lily-of-the-Valley, Black Currant, Raspberry and Peach; base notes are White Musk, Sandalwood, Amber, Heliotrope and Agarwood (Oud).

title: Dior Joy Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Discover the new fragrance JOY by Dior. The feeling of joy is finally captured in a perfume with enveloping softness and energy. Shining with the vibrant smile of flowers and citrus fruits, the smooth caress of wood, and the serenity of musks, the fragrance is faceted with a thousand enveloping nuances that lead to a clean, simple expression.

Fragrance Family:
Floral

Scent Type:
Warm Florals

Key Notes:
Mandarin, Sandalwood, White Musk

title: Christian Dior Jasmin Des Anges Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Jasmin des Anges is a sunny blend of jasmine, apricot and peach.

François Demachy created it in 2018. Bergamot opens bright, jasmine, apricot, osmanthus and peach form a lush heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a soft finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: Dior J'adore Absolu Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: J'Adore Absolu by Christian Dior is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. J'Adore Absolu was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Jasmine Sambac and Magnolia; middle notes are Jasmine, Indian Tuberose and May Rose; base note is Orange Blossom.

title: Dior J'adore Infinissime Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: J'Adore Infinissime by Christian Dior is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. J'Adore Infinissime was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Blood Orange, Bergamot and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, Ylang-Ylang, Lily-of-the-Valley and Rose; base note is Sandalwood.

title: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html:
Dior Hypnotic Poison is a seductive blend of almond, vanilla and coconut.

Annick Menardo created it in 1998. Coconut, plum and apricot open sweet, rosewood, jasmine, caraway and tuberose form the heart, and vanilla, almond, sandalwood and musk give it a rich finish.

Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

title: Dior Dior Homme Sport Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
A sexy woody fragrance with a juicy, spicy freshness, Dior Homme Sport is reinvented to more fully embody a life lived with sport as philosophy, not a race for performance.

The composition plays on facets of fruity, spicy freshness while retaining the sexy, woody notes of Dior Homme's identity.

"Dior Homme Sport is a story that starts off strong and fast, and never lets up. A meteor that bursts with a lasting, intense pleasure."—François Demachy, Dior Perfumer

Notes:
Citron, Cedarwood Accord, Ginger Accord.
Style:
Adventurous. Exhilarating. Free.

title: Dior Homme Cologne Cologne for Men
description_html:
Dior Homme Cologne is a light, clean burst of bergamot and grapefruit blossom.

François Demachy created it in 2013. Calabrian bergamot opens sparkling, grapefruit blossom forms a fresh floral heart, and musk gives it a soft, clean finish.

A summer favorite for the office and everyday wear.

title: Dior Homme 2020 Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Dior Homme 2020 is a clean, modern woody musk with a crisp, airy feel.

François Demachy created it in 2020. Bergamot, pink pepper and elemi open fresh, cashmere wood, Atlas cedar and patchouli form a smooth heart, and Iso E Super, Haitian vetiver and white musk leave a clean, radiant trail.

Polished and easy to wear, it is a daytime favorite from spring through fall.

title: Christian Dior Holy Peony Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Dior Holy Peony is a fresh, delicate peony and rose fragrance.

François Demachy created it in 2019. Peony, rose, red fruits, apricot, green leaves, musk and woods blend into a soft, airy floral.

A daytime favorite for spring.

title: Dior Higher Energy Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Higher Energy by Christian Dior is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Higher Energy was launched in 2003. Higher Energy was created by Nathalie Gracia-Cetto and Carlos Vinals. Top notes are Pineapple, Juniper Berries, Grapefruit, Melon and Mint; middle notes are Nutmeg, Pepper and Incense; base notes are Cedar, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Musk and Labdanum.

title: Christian Dior Happy Hour Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Happy Hour by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Happy Hour was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

title: Christian Dior Gris Dior Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Gris Dior is an elegant chypre of rose, oakmoss and patchouli.

François Demachy created it in 2017. Rose and bergamot meet earthy oakmoss and patchouli, with cedar, sandalwood and amber adding a soft, refined warmth.

Chic and timeless, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Christian Dior Granville for Eau de Parfum Women
description_html: La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Granville by Dior is a Aromatic fragrance for women. La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Granville was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Lemon, Rosemary and Thyme; middle notes are Pine Tree and Dyer’s Greenweed; base notes are Pepper, Sandalwood and Woody Notes.

title: Christian Dior Grand Bal for Eau de Parfum Women
description_html: Dior Grand Bal by Dior is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Dior Grand Bal was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

title: Dior Forever and Ever Dior Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Forever and Ever Dior by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women. Forever and Ever Dior was launched in 2006. Top notes are Freesia, Jasmine and Ivy; middle notes are Rose Hip, Almond Blossom and Geranium; base notes are Vanilla, Musk and Amber.

title: Christian Dior Feve Delicieuse Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: F?ve D?licieuse (2018) by Dior is a Amber fragrance for women and men. F?ve D?licieuse (2018) was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Lavender, Mint and Calabrian bergamot; middle notes are Cherry, Freesia and Jasmine; base notes are Tonka Bean, Madagascar Vanilla, Caramel, Dark Chocolate, Benzoin, Leather, Coconut, Sandalwood and Cedar.

title: Dior Fahrenheit Parfum for Men
description_html:
Dior Fahrenheit Parfum is a rich, dark take on Fahrenheit with licorice and rum.

François Demachy created it in 2014. Suede, licorice and Sicilian mandarin open warm, violet leaf, rum, coriander and cumin form the heart, and Bourbon vanilla gives it a smooth finish.

Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

title: Dior Fahrenheit Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Dior Fahrenheit is the bold, leathery classic with its famous gasoline-like violet leaf.

Jean-Louis Sieuzac and Michel Almairac created it in 1988. Nutmeg flower, lavender, cedar, mandarin and bergamot open warm, violet leaf, nutmeg, sandalwood and jasmine form the heart, and leather, vetiver, musk, amber and tonka bean give it depth.

Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

title: Dior Escale A Portofino Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Cruise Collection - Escale a Portofino by Dior is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women. Cruise Collection - Escale a Portofino was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Bergamot, Lemon and Petitgrain; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Juniper Berries and Almond; base notes are Cypress, Cedar, Galbanum, Musk and Caraway.

title: Christian Dior Eden-Roc Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Eden-Roc by Dior is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Eden-Roc was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Sea Salt, Citruses and Mineral notes; middle notes are Jasmine, Mastic or Lentisque and Coconut; base notes are Pine Tree and Labdanum.

title: Dior Dune Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Dune Pour Homme by Christian Dior is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. Dune Pour Homme was launched in 1997. Dune Pour Homme was created by Olivier Cresp and Jean-Pierre Bethouart. Top notes are cassis, fig leaf, basil and sage; middle notes are fig wood bark, mignonette and rose; base notes are sandalwood, tonka bean, vanilla and cedar.

title: Dior Diorella Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Diorella by Christian Dior is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. Diorella was launched in 1972. The nose behind this fragrance is Edmond Roudnitska. Top notes are Green Notes, Sicilian Lemon, Bergamot, Melon and Basil; middle notes are Honeysuckle, Peach, Moroccan Jasmine, Carnation, Cyclamen and Rose; base notes are Oakmoss, Vetiver, Patchouli and Musk.

title: Christian Dior Cuir Cannage Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Cuir Cannage by Dior is a Leather fragrance for women and men. Cuir Cannage was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom and Bergamot; middle notes are Leather, iris, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Leather, Birch, Juniper, Tobacco, Violet and Cade oil.

title: Christian Dior Cologne Royale Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Cologne Royale by Dior is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Cologne Royale was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

title: Christian Dior Bois D'Argent Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Bois d'Argent is a soft, elegant blend of iris, myrrh and honey.

Annick Menardo created it in 2004. Iris, cypress and juniper open fresh, myrrh and patchouli form a resinous heart, and woods, honey, vanilla, amber, musk and leather give it a smooth finish.

A refined daytime scent for spring and fall.

title: Christian Dior Balade Sauvage Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Balade Sauvage by Christian Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Balade Sauvage was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Ozonic notes, Petitgrain and Bergamot; middle notes are Fig Tree, Fig, Solar notes, Sea Notes, Peach, Hedione, Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Pebbles, Labdanum, Amberwood and Vanilla.

title: Christian Dior Ambre Nuit Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Dior Ambre Nuit is a warm, sensual amber with a rich Turkish rose.

François Demachy created it in 2018. Amber and Turkish rose blend into a warm, glowing and slightly spicy scent that feels elegant and intimate.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Dior Addict Shine Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dior Addict Shine by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Dior Addict Shine was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

title: Dior Addict Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dior Addict Eau Fraiche 2012 by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Dior Addict Eau Fraiche 2012 was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Grapefruit and Bergamot; middle notes are Lotus, Pomegranate and Freesia; base notes are Musk and Woodsy Notes.

title: Dior Addict Eau de Toilette for Women
description_html: Dior Addict Eau de Toilette by Christian Dior is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Dior Addict Eau de Toilette was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Sicilian Mandarin; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac and Tunisian Neroli; base notes are Vanilla and Sandalwood.

title: Davidoff Cool Water Parfum for Men
description_html: Cool Water Parfum by Davidoff is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Cool Water Parfum was launched in 2021. Cool Water Parfum was created by Jean-Christophe Herault and IFF. Top notes are Lemon and Pink Pepper; middle note is Haitian Vetiver; base note is Sandalwood.

title: Creed Zeste Mandarine Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Zeste Mandarine by Creed is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Zeste Mandarine was launched in 2020. Top notes are Italian Orange and Lemon Leaf; middle notes are Yellow Mandarin and Italian Lemon; base notes are Indian Patchouli, Petitgrain Paraguay and Orangewood.

title: Creed White Flowers Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Crafted from hand-picked ingredients by sixth-generation master perfumer Olivier Creed, this crisp floral blend became the third bottle in Creed's Les Royals Exclusives collection. Serene and composed, White Flowers embraces its wearer like a jasmine vine with delicate divinity—a work of art in both form and fragrance.

Style: Floral, rich.

Notes:

- Top: violet leaves, green apple, lemon.

- Middle: jasmine, geranium, rose.

- Base: musk, sandalwood, narcissus.

title: Creed White Amber Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: White Amber by Creed is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. White Amber was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top note is fruits; middle notes are jasmine and benzoin; base notes are amber and sandalwood.

title: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Virgin Island Water is a tropical escape of coconut, lime and white rum.

Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2007. Coconut, lime, bergamot and mandarin open bright, ginger, ylang-ylang, jasmine and hibiscus form a sunny heart, and white rum, sugar cane and musk give it a sweet, breezy finish.

A summer favorite for daytime, the office and everyday wear.

title: Creed Viking Cologne Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Viking Cologne is a fresh, aromatic take on Viking.

Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2021. Mandarin, pink pepper, lemon and bergamot open bright, geranium, lavender, nutmeg, rosemary and sage form the heart, and olibanum, vetiver, sandalwood and cedar give it a clean finish.

Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

title: Creed Vetiver Geranium Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Vetiver Geranium by Creed is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. Vetiver Geranium was launched in 2014. Top notes are Granny Smith apple, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Geranium, Rose and Cinnamon; base notes are Cedar, Patchouli, Musk, Vetiver and Amber.

title: Creed Vanisia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Vanisia by Creed is a Amber fragrance for women. Vanisia was launched in 1987. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Amber, Sandalwood, Ambergris and Vanille.


From the Creed website: CREED created Vanisia for the queen of Spain who happened to be the great niece of Marie Antoinette of France. After assuming the throne, the Spanish queen wished to make a style statement like her French relative. She commissioned from CREED a fragrance that was rich, sensual and mysterious, with undertones of Spanish woods and rich vanilla: the unforgettable Vanisia.

The top note of Vanisia is Bergamot. Middle notes include jasmine and Bulgarian rose. Base notes encompass sandalwood, vanilla, amber and ambergris.

title: Creed Tabarome Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Tabarome is a warm, classic blend of tobacco, ginger and leather.

Olivier Creed created it in 2000. Bergamot and tangerine open bright, ginger forms a spicy heart, and tobacco, sandalwood, ambergris, leather and patchouli give it a rich finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, for the office and everyday.

title: Creed Sublime Vanille Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Those who encounter Sublime Vanille are powerless to resist its hypnotic spell, willfully surrendering to its heady decadence. A provocative blend of vanilla and Tonka bean, Sublime Vanille is rendered mysterious with sparkling notes of lemon. The result is a universal soft oriental, nearly gourmand scent for both him and her, from newcomers and devotees of vanilla to fragrance connoisseurs who wish to add a true asset to their curated collection.

Style: Soft oriental.

Notes:

- Top: vanilla from Comoros, Tonka bean.

- Middle: white bergamot, lemon.

- Base: Tonkin musk.

title: Creed Spring Flower Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
CREED made Spring Flower as the signature scent of a film legend, fashion icon and renowned humanitarian. This pink and pretty scent was released to the public many years later.

Spring Flower is a fresh and feminine fragrance that includes notes of peach, melon and apple in the top. The heart includes jasmine and rose. Musk and ambergris form the base.

title: Creed Spice and Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Spice and Wood celebrates The House of CREED's long history of weaving scents into a fragrant story as part of the Les Royales Exclusives Collection. The blend's tenacious opening of sun-drenched lemon, warm clove and aromatic apple settles into rich notes of cedarwood, calling to mind the ancient banks of the timber-lined Nile. Spice and Wood mingles powerful depth with alluring refinement.

 

Style: Woody, fresh.

Notes:

- Top: apple, bergamot, lemon.

- Middle: angelic root, pinkberries, vetiver, patchouli, cloves, pimento (Jamaican pepper), birch.

- Base: iris, cedarwood, oakmoss, Tonkin musk.

title: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Silver Mountain Water is a crisp, sparkling scent inspired by fresh mountain air.

Olivier Creed created it in 1995. Bergamot and mandarin open bright, green tea and black currant form a cool, fruity heart, and musk, petitgrain, sandalwood and galbanum give it a clean, airy finish.

A daytime classic for spring and summer, easy to wear to the office, on weekends and after the gym.

title: Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Royal Princess Oud by Creed is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Royal Princess Oud was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed . Top notes are bergamot, rose and violet; middle notes are jasmine, vanilla absolute, patchouli and tuscan iris; base notes are siam benzoin, sandalwood, styrax and agarwood (oud).

title: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Royal Mayfair Cologne by Creed, Introduced in 2015, Royal Mayfair is a fruity, floral fragrance that was created for men and women . Named after the posh, London neighborhood of Mayfair, this gourmand scent is a fresh and imaginative experience. This original scent was a bespoke creation for the Duke of Windsor; however, 80 years after the original was made, it is now available to you. The top notes are composed of gin, lime and pine tree. The heart centers around the perfect floral experience of a rose. The base notes finish with orange, cedar and eucalyptus.

Before becoming a niche fragrance house, Creed was a tailoring company that was started in London, but eventually moved its headquarters to Paris. Beginning in the 1980s, the business developed a positive reputation around its colognes and perfumes. One of the reasons the business can sometimes go years between releasing a new fragrance is that it doesn’t follow a strict release schedule and only sells a product when it’s ready.

title: Creed Pure White Cologne Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Pure White Cologne calls to mind the impeccable style of men during the Victorian Age, well-groomed and sharply tailored, like a crisp white shirt perfectly made to measure. This citrus-fresh blend gives way to an understated sweetness and powdery elegance reminiscent of the fine mist of a foggy London afternoon.

 

FRAGRANCE CATEGORY: Citrus/Fresh

 

TOP NOTES

  • Lemon
  • Bergamot
  • Grapefruit

HEART NOTES

  • Galbanum
  • Pear
  • Petite grain

BASE NOTES

  • Ambergris
  • White Musk
  • Rice powder

title: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Original Vetiver is a clean, crisp vetiver with fresh citrus and spice.

Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2004. Bergamot, ginger and mandarin open fresh, Haitian vetiver, sandalwood and iris form an elegant heart, and musk and ambergris give it a soft, clean finish.

A refined daytime scent for spring and summer and a natural fit for the office.

title: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Millésime Impérial is a sunny, salty citrus fragrance.

Olivier Creed created it in 1995. Fruity notes and sea salt open bright, Sicilian lemon, iris, bergamot and mandarin form the heart, and sea notes, musk and woods give it a clean, breezy finish.

A spring and summer favorite for the office, the gym, weekends and date nights.

title: Creed Love in Black Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Love in Black is a perfume for women introduced in 2008. Inspired by former first lady Jacqueline Kennedy, the fragrance is composed of ingredients from the places this intriguing public figure visited and loved.

Top notes encompass Italian violet, night-blooming jasmine and cedar from Virginia. The heart adds Florentine iris, cloves and Tonkin musk, while the base introduces Bourgogne black currant and Bulgarian rose. The flacon is created from black sand like that of the Greek isles. This edition celebrates magic of each woman and evening elegance, which is completed by a ribbon bow on the neck of the bottle. Love in Black was created by Olivier Creed Sixth Generation and Erwin Creed Seventh Generation.

title: Creed Jardin D'Amalfi Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed expands the Royal Exclusives line with three limited edition fragrances launched in 2011: Jardin d'Amalfi, Original Cologne and White Flowers. These fragrances celebrate the 250th anniversary of the house.

Jardin d'Amalfi celebrates the lush summer gardens of Italy's Amalfi coast.

A CREED Royal Exclusive, Jardin D’Amalfi is packaged in a hand-blown Pochet glass bottle etched with CREED’s crest. The cut-glass cap reveals an open-neck pour.

Top notes: mandarin, bergamot, lemon, pink pepper and petit grain. Heart: cedar, rose and apple. Base: vetiver, white musk and cinnamon.

title: Creed Acqua Originale Green Neroli Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Green Neroli by Creed is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Green Neroli was launched in 2020. Top notes are Mint, Blood Mandarin and Petitgrain Paraguay; middle notes are Neroli, Tarragon and Orange; base notes are Mint, Italian Lemon, Caraway and Rosemary.

title: Creed Floralie Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Creed Floralie is a unique new fragrance in partnership with Neiman Marcus department store. Floralie has notes of rose, tubeorse, and other florals and oriental basenotes such as amber and woods.

title: Creed Fleurs de Gardenia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Fleurs de Gardenia by Creed is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Fleurs de Gardenia was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top notes are Galbanum, Pink Pepper and Black Currant; middle notes are Gardenia, Peony, Lily-of-the-Valley, Pink Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Virginia Cedar and Patchouli.

title: Creed Fleurs de Bulgarie Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Fleurs de Bulgarie by Creed is a Floral fragrance for women. Fleurs de Bulgarie was launched in 1845. The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Third Generation. Top note is Bergamot; middle note is Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Musk and Ambergris.

title: Creed Fleurissimo Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
A sophisticated blend of high-fashion glamour and elegant aristocracy, the scent marries tuberose, violet, iris and Bulgarian rose. Fleurissimo will evoke the beautiful essence of a bride in any woman for her most special occasions, ensuring all eyes in the room are on her.

 

Style: Floral, fresh.

Notes:

- Top: bergamot, violet leaves.

- Middle: Bulgarian rose, tuberose, ylang-ylang.

- Base: Florentine iris, ambergris.

title: Creed Erolfa Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Erolfa is a fresh, aquatic citrus inspired by the sea.

Olivier Creed created it in 1992. Bergamot, lime, melon, lemon and green notes open bright, herbal notes, pine, ginger, jasmine and pepper form the heart, and ambergris, musk, sandalwood, oakmoss and cedar give it a clean finish.

A spring and summer favorite for the office, the gym and everyday wear.

title: Creed Citrus Bigarade Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Citrus Bigarrade by Creed is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. Citrus Bigarrade was launched in 1901. The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Fourth Generation. Top notes are Citruses and Bergamot; middle note is Neroli; base note is Ambergris.

title: Creed Acqua Originale Cedre Blanc Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Cedre Blanc is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2014

Top Note: Bergamot, Bay Leaf, Galbanum, Cardamom
Heart Note: Geranium, Lily, Jasmine
Base Note: Cedar, Vetiver, Sandalwood

title: Creed Bois Du Portugal Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Bois du Portugal is a refined, classic blend of lavender and woods.

Olivier Creed created it in 1987. Bergamot opens bright, lavender forms an elegant aromatic heart, and sandalwood, cedar, vetiver and ambergris give it a smooth, woody finish.

Timeless and versatile, it suits the office, weekends and evenings from spring through winter.

title: Creed Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Creed Aventus for Her is a bright, fruity floral with a green apple sparkle.

Olivier Creed created it in 2016. Green apple, bergamot, lemon, pink pepper and violet open fresh, musk, rose, sandalwood and styrax form the heart, and black currant, peach, amber, ylang-ylang and lilac give it a soft finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

title: Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Creed Aventus is the smoky, fruity signature that became a modern legend.

Created by Olivier Creed and his son Erwin in 2010, it opens with juicy pineapple, black currant, bergamot and apple. Birch and patchouli bring the famous smoky edge, softened by Moroccan jasmine and rose, before a dry-down of musk, oakmoss, ambergris and a touch of vanilla.

Aventus is confident without trying too hard, which is why it works almost anywhere: the office, a weekend lunch or a night out. It shines from spring through fall, and a sample is the easiest way to see why so many people call it their signature.

title: Creed Aventus Cologne Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Creed Aventus Cologne is a lighter, fresher take on the Aventus spirit.

Olivier Creed created it in 2018. Mandarin, ginger and pink pepper open bright and zesty, vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood form the heart, and musk, birch, tonka bean and styrax give it a clean, smoky finish.

A great daytime choice for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

title: Creed Acqua Originale Iris Tubereuse Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Iris Tubereuse by Creed is a Floral fragrance for women. Iris Tubereuse was launched in 2014. Top notes are Violet Leaf, Galbanum and Orange; middle notes are Tuberose, Lily and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Orange Blossom, Musk and Vanilla.

title: Creed Acqua Fiorentina Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
The setting for this scent is 15th century Florence, Italy. An artful portrait of the countryside, its orchards brimming lightly with sweet plums, bergamot, and lemony blooms. A lively touch of apple marks sixty vibrant years of Queen Elizabeth's reign, along with beautiful Renaissance roses, greengage plums, Virginia cedar, and white carnation. This long-awaited fruity-floral encore offers a fresh, youthful scent that will delight for any occasion. Made in France.

TOP NOTES
  • Greengage plum
  • Apple

HEART NOTES
  • Rose
  • White carnations
  • Bergamot
  • Lemon

BASE NOTES
  • Virginia cedar
  • Sandalwood
  • White grapefruit

title: Creed Acqua Originale Asian Green Tea Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Asian Green Tea by Creed is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Asian Green Tea was launched in 2014. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Lemon and Neroli; middle notes are Green Tea, Black Currant, Violet, Heliotrope and Rose; base notes are Musk, Amber and Sandalwood.

title: Creed Acqua Originale Aberdeen Lavender Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Aberdeen Lavander by Creed is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for women and men. Aberdeen Lavander was launched in 2014. Top notes are Rosemary, Artemisia, Bergamot and Lemon; middle notes are Lavender, Lily, Tuberose and Rose; base notes are Patchouli, Leather and Vetiver.

title: Coach Platinum Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
oach Platinum takes you on a road trip across America that ends in New York City. It's a distinctive woody & sensual fragrance that speaks to a bold, daring and magnetic man.



It opens with an impulsive cocktail of black pepper, pineapple, and juniper berries. The luminous start is rapidly contrasted by the bold texture of refined woody notes: patchouli & cashmere. A leathery haze of vanilla warms it all, creating a sensual & elegant signature.



The mirrored bottle is a stunning & luxurious object of design - bright silver lacquer, smooth metallic touch & sleek glass. It references many of Coach's iconic codes: a turn lock spray cap, faux-leather hangtag, and Horse & Carriage logo engraving. The two-colored outer packaging combines brushed silver and black-blue leather-grained sides for a contrasting effect.

title: Coach Men Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
COACH FOR MEN Eau de Toilette takes you on a journey of endless possibilities, evoking a sense of freedom that comes from the energy and spontaneity of New York City. A modern fragrance which combines fresh, energetic top notes and a skin-like warm sensuality in the amber, woody base notes.

Masculine yet refined, the fragrance starts with cool, fresh green Nashi pear, contrasted with spicy cardamom, and finishes with a textured vetiver base note, creating an aromatic, woody scent. The bottle design is emblematic of the Coach brand and features several iconic codes: turnlock, hangtag, carriage logo engraving.

Fragrance Notes:
  • Top - Green nashi pear
  • Middle - Spicy cardamom
  • Base - Textured vetiver

title: Coach Blue Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Coach Blue by Coach is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Coach Blue was launched in 2020. Top notes are lime and absinthe; middle notes are ozonic notes and black pepper; base notes are amber and cedar.

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection XX Art Nouveau Water Lily Parfum for Women
description_html:
The Scoop

Clive Christian’s Noble XX Water Lily Eau De Parfum is the type of big, luxurious floral chypre that French perfume companies just don’t make anymore. If you mourn the fall-from-fashion of powerful, statement-making scents like Eau de Soir (Sisley), Odalisque or Number One (both Parfums de Nicolai), then say hello to Water Lily. This is Perfume with a capital P; the kind worn both by rich ladies to church and women dressed to kill on a night out, all glossy red lips and high heels.

A burst of hairspray aldehydes ushers in a huge floral credenza of creamy tuberose flushed with the salty, aquatic freshness of water lily, all stretched over a surprisingly animalic base of cashmere woods, musk, and patchouli. The name ‘Water Lily’ makes it sound as if it might be a light, watery scent, but no - it has the density of velvet folded many times over. Green leaves add a soapy freshness but fail to make much of a dent in the thick, salty creaminess of the golden florals. If you loved the potent civety floral chypres of the past – Eau de Soir, Giorgio, Odalisque – and mourn what the restrictions on oakmoss has done to this genre, then we highly recommend you get acquainted with Clive Christian’s Noble XX Water Lily. To us, Water Lily is less a perfume than the bugle call of a woman confident in her own worth, allure, and place in the world.

Noble XX Water Lily  Notes

aldehydes, green leaves, iris, tuberose, heliotrope, water lily, cashmeran, vetiver, patchouli

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection XX Art Nouveau Papyrus Parfum for Men
description_html: XX Art Nouveau Papyrus by Clive Christian is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. XX Art Nouveau Papyrus was launched in 2018. Top note is Bergamot; middle note is Lavender; base note is Papyrus.

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection XXI Art Deco Vanilla Orchid Parfum for Women
description_html: XXI Art Deco Vanilla Orchid by Clive Christian is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. XXI Art Deco Vanilla Orchid was launched in 2018. Top notes are Galbanum and Hiacynth; middle notes are Vanilla orchid and Lily-of-the-Valley; base note is Vanilla.

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection XXI Art Deco Cypress Parfum for Men
description_html:
The Scoop

Clive Christian Cypress is a beautifully-made masculine that manages to capture the magic of a French Riviera night, where the spicy greenness of the breeze sweeping through tall cypress trees mingles with the effervescence of freshly-poured champagne. Think F. Scott Fitzgerald and Zelda boozing it up in a citrus grove in Nice, the tinkle of laughter and light jazz floating on the warm night air, and that’s the mood board right there for the scent.

The opening to Cypress is surprisingly spicy, thick with cloves, cinnamon, ginger root, and the anisic mintiness of fresh basil. But it’s also immensely fresh and sour, a lively undercurrent of tart bergamot playing off the green bitterness of cypress. Fans of the balsamic soapiness of Jaipur Homme will recognize echoes in Cypress, but where the Boucheron burrows deep into an opoponax base, Cypress swerves into an elegant essay on the dry richness of woods. In the base, a handsome pairing of oakwood and cedarwood knits together a rich weave of smoke, toasted wood, and spice until you can’t tell where one ends and the other begins. In the far reaches of the scent, rich amber swells up to thicken the woods, adding weight but not sweetness. If anyone is feeling short-changed by the dearth in good masculines these days, then point them in the direction of Clive Christian Cypress – they won’t be disappointed.

Noble XXI Cypress  Notes

petitgrain, bergamot, basil, cypress, clove, ginger, nutmeg, amber, oakwood, cedar

title: Clive Christian X Feminine Edition Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Clive Christian X Feminine Edition is a Feminine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2001, The nose behind this fragrance is Patricia Choux,

Top Note: Peach, Pineapple, Rhuburb, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Ivy
Heart Note: Jasmine, Orris Root, Rose, Mignonette, Lily-of-the-Valley
Base Note: Patchouli, Vanilla, Musk, French labdanum, Vetiver, Virginia Cedar

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection XVII Baroque Siberian Pine Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: XVII Baroque Siberian Pine by Clive Christian is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. XVII Baroque Siberian Pine was launched in 2017. Top notes are bergamot, lemon, mandarin orange, neroli and pink pepper; middle notes are jasmine, lavender, bourbon geranium, pine needles, coriander, cardamom and orange blossom; base notes are oakmoss, patchouli, cedar, musk and ambergris.

title: Clive Christian X Twist Saffron Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Clive Christian X Twist Saffron is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2016, The nose behind this fragrance is Angela Stavrevska,

Top Note: Pink Pepper, Ginger
Heart Note: Saffron, Cinnamon, Orris
Base Note: Sandalwood, Musk

title: Clive Christian X Twist Narcissus Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Clive Christian X Twist Narcissus is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2016, The nose behind this fragrance is Angela Stavrevska,

Top Note: Apricot
Heart Note: Egyptian Jasmine, Narcissus, Lily-of-the-Valley
Base Note: Woodsy Notes, Cashmere Wood

title: Clive Christian X Neroli Parfum Unisex
description_html: To celebrate the love story that founded our brand Clive Christian has created two limited edition perfumes inspired by orange blossom 1872 refreshed with the fragrant blossom from a flowering mandarin tree and X with the verdant fruit intertwined around neroli flowers an ode to Queen Victoria whose crown proudly adorns every bottle of Clive Christian perfume.

title: Clive Christian X Masculine Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Clive Christian X Masculine is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2001, The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen,

Top Note: Rhuburb, Pineapple, Bergamot
Heart Note: iris, Paprika, Jasmine
Base Note: Virginia Cedar, Cinnamon, Amber, Oakmoss, Vetiver, Styrax, Vanilla, French labdanum

title: Clive Christian V for Women Parfum for Women
description_html:
Having shared her father's passion for perfume from an early age and served as Ambassador for the Clive Christian Perfume House since its renaissance in 1999, Clive asked his eldest daughter Victoria to select two perfumes from his Private Collection that he ultimately named as a tribute to her choice and to her namesake?Queen Victoria?who uniquely crowned the perfumery in 1872.

"V" for Women?White Floral Chypre?Orange blossom, traditionally associated with joy and betrothal, is embraced by rose and jasmine and entwined with soothing chamomile and bright lavender to impart a romantic and spirited perfume.

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection VII Rock Rose Parfum for Men
description_html:
A thoroughly modern interpretation of a classically styled fougère, Noble VII Rock Rose is a dynamic, arrestingly sensual scent designed for a man, but perfect for anyone with a vibrant and sophisticated sense of style. Rock Rose opens with an invigorating top of citrus oils anchored by the rich warmth of bergamot, given a masculine edge with black pepper and the classic cologne touch of neroli. The heart revolves around a fusion of clean lavender, herbs, violet and the rich, resinous character of rock rose. The base is a powerful combination of dark cocoa and patchouli with an abundance of amber and a touch of sparkling vetiver to compliment the top citrus notes. The results overall are striking, both direct and powerful, but also complex and deeply resinous, ideal for a man of sophisticated style and royal bearing. The world's tastemakers have always flocked to Clive Christian for their dynamic, luxurious fragrances. With Noble VII Rock Rose, a bold new chapter in their prodigious history is written.

 

Noble VII Rock Rose  Notes

Bergamot, black pepper, neroli, lavender, violet, rock rose, clary sage, cocoa, patchouli, amber, vetiver

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection VIII Rococo Magnolia Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: VIII Rococo Magnolia by Clive Christian is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. VIII Rococo Magnolia was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Angela Stavrevska. Top notes are bergamot, cassis and mandarin orange; middle notes are rose, magnolia, cinnamon and cloves; base notes are sandalwood and oakmoss.

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection VIII Rococo Immortelle Parfum for Men
description_html: VIII Rococo Immortelle by Clive Christian is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for men. VIII Rococo Immortelle was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Celia Orozco Cirimbilli. Top notes are Bergamot and Lemon; middle note is Immortelle; base notes are Papyrus, Amber and Vetiver.

title: Clive Christian Noble Collection VII Cosmos Flower Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Beautifully feminine, universally complex, Noble VII Cosmos Flower is a bold new offering from Clive Christian, the venerable house's very first gourmand fragrance. Inspired by the nobility of England's Queen Anne period and the wondrous gardens that graced the homes of royals and elites, Cosmos Flower is built around the titular flowers' sumptuously rich and mouthwatering chocolatey scent. A delicious blend of sweet benzoin and caramel in the base is given a chypre-like twise with bitter cocoa, dry amber and a hidden touch of leather that unfurls as the fragrance warms. The bouquet at the heart wraps around a deep and fruity rich plum accord that fuses with the intensity of ylang-ylang, the sensuality of jasmine, the fruitiness of osmanthus and the cosmos flower itself. True, natural cocoa delivers both creamy gourmand notes but also a dark bitter edge, enhancing the fruity character detectable in the opening, while a touch of fiery rum brings warmth and delight. Extraordinarily sophisticated, unapologetically British, this gorgeous gourmand represents both a bold new step and also the continuation of the grand tradition of Clive Christian.

Noble VII Cosmos Flower  Notes

Rum, mandarin, pink pepper, apple, jasmine, osmanthus, ylang-ylang, violet, plum, cocoa, benzoin, leather, amber, caramel

title: Clive Christian V for Women Fruity Floral With Dark Plum Parfum for Women
description_html:
Based on more feminine notes, V Fruity Floral has a clean jasmine heart, complemented by top notes of cassis and palmarosa. Tantalizing with bergamot, black pepper, frankincense and brimming with aromatic allure, the perfume is enriched by richer notes of dark plum and ylang-ylang. V Fruity Floral is designed in a pair to be worn with V Amber Fougere.

 

Key notes: Jasmine, cassis, palmarosa

title: Clive Christian No.1 Feminine Parfum for Women
description_html:
The Scoop

Undeniably feminine, with an olfactory arc that moves from transporting and fresh-aromatic to otherworldly, exotic and decadent, No. 1 for Women is a first-class perfume ticket to a floral wonderland. The best Indian jasmine, Tahitian vanilla, Rose Centifolia, carnation and ylang-ylang, make up No. 1's heart, helping to explain the perfume's designation as the world's most expensive, made without reference to cost. But this cost helps produce an intoxicating scent experience that is recognizably special at first spray.

No. 1 starts with a floral high that sustains itself operatically, with subtle pineapple, plum and lemon revolving around intense jasmine and ylang-ylang notes. It then evolves into an ambery vanilla base touched with cedar, musk and the smoothest sandalwood. By the time the perfume dries down, the marriage of these precious ingredients is seamless, and the floral drama subsides into a comforting, ambery-vanillic warmth that lasts. The Empress does have clothes.

No. 1 for Women  Notes

Pineapple, plum, mirabelle, bergamot, lemon, and cardamom, rose, jasmine, ylang ylang, orris, orchid, vanilla, tonka seeds, cedarwood, sandalwood, musk, amber

title: Clive Christian No. 1 for Men Parfum for Men
description_html:
Wanting to push the parameters of what is acceptable, Clive Christian turned his creative design to having a fragrance for the night. No. 1 was created with passion. It has great personality; it is refined and without question highly distinctive and original. It is a perfume which stands out from the crowd; it is the fragrance of ultimate luxury.

 

No. 1 for Men  Notes

Bergamot, lime, Sicilian mandarin, cardamom, nutmeg, thyme, lily of the valley, rose, jasmine, ylang ylang, heliotrope, cedarwood, sandalwood, vetiver, ambery woods, and vanilla.

title: Clive Christian L for Men Woody Oriental With Deep Amber Parfum for Men
description_html:
Clive Christian’s L for Men Woody Oriental with Deep Amber diverges quite a bit from the original L for Men - a bright explosion of citrus against spice - by placing most of the focus on woods.
