And what a beautiful specimen of wood it is: oily, buttery, with the underbite of a greenish spice that the notes list tells us is pepper (but our noses defiantly peg as cardamom). Strangely enough, there’s no wood listed either, so we credit perfumer Mike Parrot for being able to root out the woodiest elements of tobacco, pepper, lavender, maple, and cade, and unite them all for the cleanest, smoothest woods extravaganza that we’ve smelled in a while.

 

L- Woody Oriental  Notes

lemon, mandarin, pepper, lavender, geranium, magnolia, jasmine, orris, amber, tobacco, musk, maple, cade

title: Clive Christian L for Men Parfum for Men
description_html:
Spicy Woods perfume with a heart of fir balsam and rose combined with the warm and spicy notes of nutmeg and cardamom. In the base the smoky and earthy facet of vetiver is blended with musk for sensuality, and mixed with cedar Atlas, oud and spices to bring all base notes to life. At the top, grapefruit enhances the natural citrus facet of vetiver, while petitgrain mandarinier lends the perfume a modernand distinctive edge.

Top Notes: grapefruit, petitgrain mandarinier.
Middle Notes: fir balsam, rose, nutmeg, cardamom.
Base Notes: vetiver, oud, Atlas cedarwood, musk.

title: Clive Christian L for Women Floral Chypre With Rich Patchouli Parfum for Women
description_html:
Drawing on the inspirations that have permeated Clive Christian's world in the budding metropolis, L Floral Chypre is a bold fragrance, built around jasmine sambac and rose shrouded in a patchouli base with a twist of dry orris and frankincense, wrapped up in sensual vanilla and musks. With more feminine notes, it is designed to be worn as a pair with the more masculine L Woody Oriental.

Key notes: Jasmine sambac, rose, patchouli

title: Clive Christian Addictive Arts Jump up and Kiss Me Hedonistic Parfum for Men
description_html: Jump up and Kiss Me Hedonistic by Clive Christian is a Oriental fragrance for men. Jump up and Kiss Me Hedonistic was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Julie Pluchet.

title: Clive Christian Addictive Arts Jump up and Kiss Me Ecstatic Parfum for Women
description_html: Jump up and Kiss Me Ecstatic by Clive Christian is a Floral fragrance for women. Jump up and Kiss Me Ecstatic was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Julie Pluchet.

title: Clive Christian I Woody Floral Parfum for Women
description_html:
The Scoop

Clive Christian’s I For Women Woody Floral With Vintage Rose is a scent as tender as rose petals dried between the pages of a Jane Austen novel. Inspired by Clive Christian’s experience as a master furniture designer, the scent represents the delicate harmony between light and dark in an exquisite mahogany marquetry inlaid with mother of pearl.

The light side of the equation is the rose, buried in soft, opalescent layers of white ambers, musks, and vanilla, which give the fragrance a tulle-like delicacy. Soft red fruits and a sprinkling of boozy pink pepper nudge the vanilla-rose combination towards sparkling, while orris introduces a light dusting of powder. The truffled edge to the rose – not quite jammy but tilted towards rose lokhoum – gives the scent a candied lipstick nuance, which in turn makes it feel romantic. Now, if you’ve taken a peek at the notes list and suspect that oud and cedarwood arrive to spoil the prettiness of this picture, then let us set your mind at rest. Although the scent does turn woodier, the darkness of the mahogany part of the equation never quite materializes. Instead, a warmly earthy pairing of vetiver and patchouli tethers the feathery rose, making sure it doesn’t just float off into space. There’s indeed a hint of smoky wood but the outcome is clean rather than dirty. The wood does its job unobtrusively, simply giving the fluffy florals and musks something sturdy to drape themselves over. Deeply feminine and even, dare we say it, ladylike, I For Women Woody Floral With Vintage Rose would be perfect for those who love powdery, retro-styled roses such as Lipstick Rose (Malle) or Paris (YSL).

I- Woody Floral  Notes

bergamot, mandarin, red fruits, cardamom, pink pepper, black pepper, jasmine, lily of the valley, orris, rose, cedarwood, amber, patchouli, oud, vetiver, vanilla, musk

title: Clive Christian I for Men Amber Oriental With Rich Musk Parfum for Men
description_html:
Clive Christian’s I For Men Amber Oriental With Rich Musk is a spiced, mossy musk with an old school masculine vibe. Its authentic 1970’s growl comes from that classic combination of sweet and dirty. First, we have a gloriously powdery musk that walks the tightrope between clean and filthy so perfectly that memories of vintage Original Musk (Kiehl’s) and Musc Ravageur (Malle) jump effortlessly to mind. This accord is thickened further with dried fruit and davana, giving it a sweet booziness that will get you tipsy if you lean in too closely. This is in turn balanced out by the bitterness of fir balsam and the rubbery honk of cowboy leather.

 

I- Amber Oriental  Notes

Musk, amber, davana, dried fruit, fir balsam, moss, Atlas cedarwood, leather, vanilla, tonka, frankincense, patchouli, sandalwood, oakwood, juniper, apple, whiskey, bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin, tagetes, pineapple

title: Clive Christian E for Women Green Fougere With Aromatic Lavender Parfum for Women
description_html:
Drawing on regal encounters that have permeated Clive Christian's world, E Green Fougere references the elegenace of royal gardens with fresh notes of rose, lavender and narcissus. E Green Fougere is based on more feminine notes, designed to be worn in a pair with the more masculine E Gourmande Oriental.

Clive Christian’s E for Women Green Fougere with Aromatic Lavender is an interesting scent built around an interesting idea – a fougere that women will want to wear. And want to wear it they shall. Because somehow, perfumer Tom Gage has figured out how to remove all the parts of a fougere that make it too masculine for women, like geranium, cedar, and coumarin, replacing them with softer herbal, floral, and earthy notes that retain the essential character of the fougere while rendering it more universally appealing.

E- Green Fougere  Notes

rose, narcissus, pineapple, fir balsam, acacia, orris, hyssop, immortelle, cypress, lavender, moss, clover, vetiver

title: Clive Christian E for Men Gourmand Oriental With Sweet Clove Parfum for Men
description_html:
Clive Christian’s E for Men Gourmande Oriental with Sweet Clove is the gourmand to end all gourmands. Are you a coffee lover? Well, this smells like the best cup of coffee you’ve had in your life. Imagine walking through miles of frozen tundra to a small, cozy log cabin, whereupon you’re handed a cup of dark, rich coffee stirred with a maple leaf and sweetened slightly with rough brown sugar. In a nutshell, that’s just how warm, intense, and inviting this fragrance is.

 

E- Gourmande Oriental  Notes

rum, osmanthus, labdanum, cade, clove, cinnamon, oak, patchouli, oakmoss, vanilla, caramel, maple

title: Clive Christian C for Men Woody Leather With Oudh Intense Parfum for Men
description_html:
C Woody Leather With Oudh Intense (formerly C For Men, though this is a wholly reimagined release) is a painstakingly constructed, perfectly balanced masculine scent that reminds us of the multi-dimensionality of fine niche fragrance. For although C Woody Leather, in the end, is a wonderfully intense, sensually smoky melange of tobacco and exotic woods, it guides us to that richness along a carefully constructed trail of juicy citrus and ravishing spice, displaying the sort of sophistication and wit that has always separated Clive Christian from the competition.

 

C- Woody Leather  Notes

Mandarin, saffron, tobacco, oudh, leather

title: Clive Christian C for Women Parfum for Women
description_html:
C for Women embraces the Clive Christian Perfume House accord of rose and jasmine absolute, yet here it is pushed to crescendo in union with violet and tuberose to reveal a perfume brimming with voluptuousness and dangerous pleasure.

Top notes: bergamot, coriander seed, lie de vin (cognac oil, wine sediment), narcisse (daffodil), geranium, mandarin, petitgrain, tagete (marigold).

Heart notes: tuberose, jasmine, rose, violet, osmanthus (apricot aroma), ylang-ylang (placed on the beds of newlyweds in Indonesia), orange flower, cistus (rock rose labdanum resin/gum with a smoky, marshy scent).

Base notes: amber, vetiver (thin aromatic roots), vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood, musk.

title: Clive Christian Chasing The Dragon Hypnotic Perfume for Men
description_html: Chasing the Dragon Hypnotic by Clive Christian is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men.  Chasing the Dragon Hypnotic was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Angela Stavrevska.

title: Clive Christian Addictive Arts Chasing the Dragon Euphoric Parfum for Women
description_html: Chasing the Dragon Euphoric by Clive Christian is a Floral fragrance for women. Chasing the Dragon Euphoric was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Angela Stavrevska.

title: Clive Christian C for Women Green Floral With Scottish Heather Parfum for Women
description_html:
Clive Christian C Green Floral With Scottish Heather is a Feminine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2017, The nose behind this fragrance is Beverley Bayne,

Top Note: Chamomile, Apple, Bergamot, Pear
Heart Note: Rose
Base Note: Green Grass, Dew Drop

title: Clive Christian 20th Anniversary Collection Iconic Masculine Parfum for Men
description_html:
Capturing the history, creativity and craftsmanship of the perfume house the limited edition Anniversary Collection is a celebration of past, present and future in perfumed form. Bottling nearly 200 years of haute perfumery and paying tribute to Clive Christian's inspirational heritage from the Crown Perfumery Company.

20 Iconic Masculine is a riot of petitgrain twisted with sweet mandarin is lifted to fresh heights with brilliant pink pepper. A juicy squeeze of yuzu with aromatic rosemary delves into smooth cedar to create the masculine perfume of an iconic pair.

Adorned with a platinum colored cage and crowned with a platinum colored cap, the precious metal of a 20th anniversary. The cage is a unique abstract design, a modern interpretation of the decorative cages found on the Crown Perfumery Company perfume bottles in 1872.

Top Notes: Yuzu, pink pepper, cassis
Heart Notes: Elemi, mandarin petitgrain, juniper berry
Base Notes: Vetiver, rum, cedarwood

title: Clive Christian 1872 for Women Parfum for Women
description_html:
A floral, fruity Citrus that combines fresh, clean top notes with the intense bouquet of Rose de Mai, one of the rarest ingredients in nature. The resulting aroma offers a deeply emotive experience for the wearer.

1872 for Women  Notes

Bergamot, tangerine, lemon, pineapple, blueberry, rosemary, rose de Mai, lily of the valley, jasmine, purple violet, freesia, cedarwood, sandalwood, patchouli, erogen musk, and moss.

title: Clive Christian 1872 Men Parfum for Men
description_html: A fragrance with a classical DNA and a century-old tradition. This is precisely because it is created according to formulae and methods originally used by Crown Perfumery. All ingredients are strictly vegetable in order to perpetuate a lasting formula of fragrance.

title: Clive Christian 1872 Mandarin Parfum Unisex
description_html: 1872 Mandarin by Clive Christian is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. 1872 Mandarin was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Beverley Bayne. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Nectarine, Lime, Basil, Ginger, Lemon and Coriander; middle notes are Lavender, Rose, Freesia, Orchid, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Violet; base notes are Moss, Vetiver, Cedar, Amber, Patchouli, Saffron and Musk.

title: Clive Christian 1872 Twist Bergamot Parfum Unisex
description_html:
A sparkling fusion of bergamot and mandarin and rosemary and lavender, which provides a clean herbal edge, this aromatic delight softens slowly to reveal a heart of earthy clary sage.
  • Top Note: Bergamot
  • Heart Note: Neroli
  • Base Note: Patchouli

title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Exotic floral-fruity fragrance Euphoria was launched in 2005. The fragrance is luminous and luscious like fruits notes of which are captured in it. Euphoria is mysterious and appealing like dark exotic flowers. It invites you to enjoy in joys of life. The main notes are rose hip, Japanese apple, green leaves, Lotus, black orchid, red woods, black violet and amber

title: Calvin Klein Eternity Cologne for Him Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Eternity Cologne For Men by Calvin Klein is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Eternity Cologne For Men was launched in 2020. Eternity Cologne For Men was created by Julie Masse, Ralf Schwieger and Veronique Nyberg. Top notes are ginger, aldehydes and juniper berries; middle notes are mastic or lentisque, bourbon geranium and cardamom; base notes are moss, ambroxan and lorenox.

title: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Sophisticated and profoundly masculine, Eternity Eau de Parfum for men maintains a signature fougere essence while introducing a new modern woody note to the composition. The iconic fougere signature is re-interpreted with an alluring sage providing a crisp freshness while the majestic cypress creates a masculine and sensual middle and the suede accord unleashes an elegant and powerful woody trail.

title: Calvin Klein Eternity Flame for Him Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Eternity Flame For Men by Calvin Klein is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Eternity Flame For Men was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Laurent Le Guernec.

Top note is Pineapple;

Middle note is Rosemary;

Base notes are Amber, Leather and Labdanum.

title: Calvin Klein Contradiction Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Calvin Klein Contradiction is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 1999, The nose behind this fragrance is Carlos Benaim, Pierre Wargnye,

Top Note: Lime, Lavender, Lemon, Clary Sage, Mandarin Orange
Heart Note: Cardamom, Pepper, Coriander, Nutmeg
Base Note: Vetiver, Musk, Sandalwood, Ebony Wood

title: Calvin Klein CK One Shock For Him Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
One of the most successful fragrances from Calvin Klein is CK One, the citrus unisex fragrance from 1994. CK One Shock is a surprise for all the fans of CK One line. It is not an unisex edition, but two separate oriental compositions: CK One Shock For Her and CK One Shock For Him.

CK One Shock For Him is built around aromatic, spicy and deep oriental nuances. It opens with citrusy clementine, fresh cucumber and energy drink accord. The heart of black pepper, black basil and cardamom is placed on the base of masculine tobacco, musk, patchouli and ambrene wood.

title: Chloe Love Story Eau Sensuelle Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Love Story Eau Sensuelle by Chloé is a Floral fragrance for women. Love Story Eau Sensuelle was launched in 2017. Love Story Eau Sensuelle was created by Anne Flipo and Domitille Michalon Bertier. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Yuzu, Lemon and Pear; middle notes are Heliotrope and Passion Flower; base notes are Musk, Sandalowood, Amber and Cedar.

title: Chloe Love Story Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Love Story by Chloé is a Floral fragrance for women. Love Story was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Anne Flipo. Top notes are Neroli, Pear, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Lemon; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Stephanotis, Rose, Peach and Black Currant; base notes are Musk, Cedar, Cashmirwood and Patchouli.

title: Chloe Chloe Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Chloé Eau de Parfum captures the creative, confident individuality of the Chloé woman. It is a fresh and feminine fragrance suited to a free spirit with an utterly innate sense of chic.

The scent takes the classic rose and ingeniously translates it into a vibrant perfume, intimate and sensual. Chloé Eau de Parfum begins with a combination of floral powdery notes: hints of peony, lychee, and springtime freesia. The airy, flirtatious head notes drift away to reveal the richer and more sensual side of the rose. The distinctive character of this unique rose is accompanied by magnolia and lily of the valley, as well as subtle intimations of warm amber and elegant cedarwood.

 

 

Fragrance Family:
Floral


Scent Type:
Powdery Florals


Key Notes:
Peony, Rose, Honey, Cedarwood

title: Cartier Pasha de Cartier Noire Sport Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Pasha de Cartier Edition Noire Sport by Cartier is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Pasha de Cartier Edition Noire Sport was launched in 2015. Top notes are Citruses and Watery Notes; middle note is Sea Notes; base notes are Cedar, Sandalwood and Amber.

title: Cartier Pasha de Cartier Edition Noire Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Masculine and very modern Pasha de Cartier Edition Noire was created as irresistible reinterpretation of the legendary Pasha de Cartier edition from 1992. The house of Cartier in its collection also offers several versions of the first perfume: Pasha de Cartier Edition Prestige Acier from 1992 and Pasha de Cartier Fraicheur Menthe from 2010. The latest edition is a combination of fresh green citruses and powerful deep resins contributing to intenseness and creating a masculine blend of the urban and the charismatic.

Top notes of the new fragrance Pasha de Cartier Edition Noire provide freshness in green and fresh citruses, balanced perfectly with warm and cuddly aromas of woody amber and cedar accords.

title: Cartier Eau de Cartier Essence D'Orange Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Cartier is presenting Eau de Cartier Essence d`Orange, a lively and sunny fragrance with agrums, which leaves a sophisticated floral trail in a heart stretching to woody notes in a base of this composition. .

Top notes of Eau de Cartier Essence d`Orange bring us a sparkling, luminous cocktail of oranges and bergamot. A heart encompasses sophisticated violets, while a base is enriched with patchouli along with warm and sensual cedar.

title: Cartier Carat Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
A bouquet of fire—a thousand points of light both luminous and floral. Created by Mathilde Laurent, perfumer at the Maison Cartier. Faceted like a diamond, the bottle captures and fractures the light in a myriad of colors.

 

Style: Floral.

 

Notes: Hyacinth, iris, violet, ylang-ylang, honeysuckle, daffodil, tulip.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Supreme Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Good Girl Suprême by Carolina Herrera is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Good Girl Suprême was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Louise Turner. Top notes are Forest Fruits and Egyptian Jasmine; middle notes are Tonka Bean and Tuberose; base note is Vetiver.

title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Dot Drama Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Good Girl Dot Drama by Carolina Herrera Perfume. Step into something truly breathtaking when you lavish your skin in Good Girl Dot Drama, a mesmerizing women's fragrance. This complex perfume blends spicy, floral, citrus and woody accords for a spellbinding combination that will leave you feeling chic and confident with every step you take

 

Notes:

- Top: sambac jasmine, tuberose crystal.

- Middle: velvet almond.

- Base: tonka bean, cocoa, coffee.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Men Sport Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Ch Sport Cologne by Carolina Herrera, Show your appreciation for the great outdoors with CH Sport, an invigorating men’s cologne . This captivating fragrance combines citrus, herbal and marine accords for a refreshing and exuberant scent that’s still entirely masculine and seductive. Top notes of sparkling bergamot, grapefruit and potent sage introduce the fragrance for a revitalizing and zesty atmosphere that’s sure to fire you up for the next great adventure. Meanwhile, heart notes of Sichuan pepper, clean juniper berries and sea notes expand the elixir with their exotic, botanical nature. Finally, base notes of vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood dry down the intensity with a soothing touch for an all-around spirited and charming cologne that’s perfect for any sports enthusiast with a young heart of gold

title: Carolina Herrera CH Kings Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: CH Kings by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. CH Kings was launched in 2019. Top notes are pink pepper, black pepper, cardamom and violet; middle notes are pineapple, lavender, clary sage, cacao and coffee; base notes are tonka bean, amber and musk.

title: Carolina Herrera CH Men Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: CH Carolina Herrera (New) was introduced in 2009 as a men's cologne that simultaneously emphasizes rich elegance with a dash of eccentricity. Offering a perfect solution for evening wear needs, this enticing cologne from Carolina Herrera features distinctive top notes of bergamot and grapefruit and familiar base notes such as vanilla and amber. Heart notes of jasmine and violet make this cologne a must-have pick for men who aim to cultivate their personal style.

title: Carolina Herrera Chic Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Chic is light, but elegant, coloured in red, of course, because this colour is very feminine; it is not virgin-like, but passionate. The real chic lies in constrasts: when the simple becomes complicated, because it encourages thinking and has a magical, influential power. For this purpose the simple and magical red colour was chosen, the shape of the bottle is simple, and the fragrance itself is a perfect balance between freshness and graceful sensuality. The top notes include Bulgarian rose and red freesia, the middle ones mandarin blossom and orange; the base voluptuous vanilla and white musk. Chic was created by Alberto Morillas and Jacques Cavallier.

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Superstar Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Bad Boy Superstar Collector's Edition by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bad Boy Superstar Collector's Edition was launched in 2021.

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum for Men
description_html: Bad Boy Le Parfum by Carolina Herrera is a Leather fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bad Boy Le Parfum was launched in 2021. Bad Boy Le Parfum was created by Fanny Bal, Bruno Jovanovic and Nicolas Beaulieu. Top notes are cannabis and Grapefruit; middle notes are Black Pepper and Geranium; base notes are Vetiver and Leather.

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Bad Boy is a fragrant expression of duality, representing the bold nature of the modern man. At once strong and sensitive, confident and relaxed, the bad boy embraces his contrasting characteristics with assured ease. Bad Boy Eau de Toilette is a fragrance of layered notes inspired by the bad boy's complexity and harmoniously combined for a distinctive blend of modern sophistication. Bad Boy represents the rebellious men who chart their own path and design their own principles. A complex journey for the senses, Bad Boy opens with alluring notes of black and white pepper, blended with the citric vibrancy of Italian green bergamot. Characteristics of duality continue at the fragrance heart, where cedarwood and sage bring a magnetic elegance. The true secret lies in the base of the scent, with a sensual blend of tonka bean and absolut of cocoa, resulting in a fragrance of refined masculinity with a hint of edge.

Top Notes: Black Pepper, White Pepper, Italian Green Bergamot
Middle Notes: Cedarwood, Sage
Bottom Notes: Tonka Bean, Absolut of Cocoa
Mood: Bold & Sophisticated

title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Wins Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: 212 VIP Men Wins by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. 212 VIP Men Wins was launched in 2021. 212 VIP Men Wins was created by Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Yuzu, Basil and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lavender and Madagascar Pepper; base notes are Skin and Tonka Bean.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Signature scent that you will recognize on the dance floor and won't forget once you leave the party. 212 VIP Men is an explosive cocktail of vodka, caviar lime, frozen mint, black pepper, hot ginger, apple, king wood, salty amber and tonka beans.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 Men Surf Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Inspired by vacation and fun on the water, Carolina Herrera in collaboration with the house of Puig is launching fragrant pair 212 Surf: CAROLINA HERRERA 212 SURF FOR HER and CAROLINA HERRERA 212 SURF FOR HIM. The limited fragrant duo will provide two new compositions inspired by sea aromas, excitement and summer companionship, dedicated to younger population. The line is described as 'fresh, youthful and carefree, a collection that retells a fun, characteristic story inspired by summer memories'.

The edition for men provides aromatic marine aromas mixing with sparkling grapefruit and patchouli. The editions are announced as very optimistic, lively and addictive.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 Sexy Men Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
212 Sexy Men is a sensual fragrance for the modern man. Its lingering scent exudes the mystery and sophistication of mythical New York City nights. Weaving notes of fresh citrus, spicy sensuality, and woody orientals, the scent emits a sensation of solidity, strength, and quality that can be worn for any occasion.
Notes:
Bergamot, Mandarin, Green Leaf, Cardamom, Flower Petals, Pepper, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk, Amber
 
Style:
Sensual. Oriental. Fresh.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 Heroes Forever Young Eau de Toilette For Men
description_html:
212 Heroes by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. 212 Heroes was launched in 2021. 212 Heroes was created by Domitille Michalon Bertier, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Pear and Ginger; middle notes are Geranium and Sage; base notes are Musk and Leather.

"Feel forever young with 212 Heroes, a fresh new masculine scent that celebrates youth, freedom and authenticity. Contained inside a striking skateboard-shaped bottle and represented by a diverse cast of talented creatives, this innovative, vegan fragrance is proof that nothing is more heroic than being authentic.

212 Heroes reinvents Fougères with a new olfactive genre: Fougère Fruity Woody. Youthful top notes as Pear Elixir and Ginger. The heart features an innovative, fresh accord of Geranium Oil Madagascar, leading to a leathery and woody base.

A revolutionary fragrance calls for a revolutionary bottle. 212 Heroes opens a new chapter in industrial design with an innovative glass and chrome bottle that evokes the silhouette of a skateboard and captures the spirit of a new generation." - a note from the brand.

title: Carolina Herrera 212 Men Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Carolina Herrera presents a whole new 212 just for men. In a boldly masculine silver container, this innovative woodsy scent compliments and intertwines with 212 for women. With the personality of sandalwood, the spirit of incense and the sensuality of gaiac, its character of cool gardenia is balanced by warm spices. It's subtle and unique.

title: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum For Women
description_html:
Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl is a fruity rose with lychee and red currant.

Louise Turner and Quentin Bisch created it in 2021. Lychee and red currant open juicy, rose forms the heart, and vanilla and vetiver give it a soft finish.

A fun choice for spring and summer, day or night.

title: BYREDO Young Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BYREDO Young Rose is a soft, airy rose with a peppery twist.

Launched in 2021, it opens with ambrette and Sichuan pepper. Damask rose and iris form the heart, and ambroxan and musk give it a clean finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

title: BYREDO Velvet Haze Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Velvet Haze by Byredo is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Velvet Haze was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Jerome Epinette. Top notes are Coconut, Hibiscus and Bergamot; middle notes are Patchouli, Tuberose and Osmanthus; base notes are Patchouli, Musk, Cacao Pod, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Cashmeran.

title: BYREDO Super Cedar Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BYREDO Super Cedar is a soft, powdery cedar with a touch of rose.

Launched in 2016, it opens with rose, moves into a clean heart of Virginian cedar and settles into Haitian vetiver and musk for a calm, woody finish.

Easy to wear from spring through fall, every day.

title: BYREDO Sundazed Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Say hello to endless summer. Sundazed, the newest scent from Byredo, is an infectiously joyful blend of bright citrus, sugared florals, and a sparkling skin musk that fans of Blanche already know and love. It's a love letter to spontaneous daytrips and wholesome indulgences- the citrus is zesty, mouthwatering, and energetic, the neroli heart rich, romantic, and made deliciously sweet with a sugared note of fresh-spun cotton candy. And it all dries down to a clean, soft musk that glows for hours with the gentle warmth of sun-kissed skin after a long day of outdoor adventures. And when we say "endless summer, " that's exactly what we mean- since Sundazed is now part of Byredo's permanent collection, you can experience this little slice of beachside bliss whenever you want. So whenever you need to change your mood- or keep the good times rolling- this is the one to reach for.

Sundazed Notes
Mandarin, lemon, neroli, jasmine sambac, cotton candy, skin musk

title: BYREDO Slow Dance Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
A top note of opoponax, or sweet myrrh, provides an immediate, honeyed and smoky sensuality in a rich, intoxicating amber signature. A heart of labdanum reinforces and encourages the scent to stay true with a creamy softness, while geranium provides a sparkling freshness. Swathing all is a veil of violet, a magical note that provides a universal balance. A base of vanilla and patchouli anchors the scent, utilizing the universal sweet appeal of vanilla against the mysterious compulsion of patchouli, the known and unknown, the light and dark together.

 

Style: Oriental.

 

Notes:

- Top: opoponax.

- Middle: geranium, labdanum, violet.

- Base: vanilla, patchouli.

title: BYREDO Seven Veils Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The story behind the scent is based on the biblical tale about Salome's dance, that is known as "the dance of the Seven Veils".

The composition includes: carrot seed, pimento berries, Tahitian vanilla flower, laurier rose, glycine, tiger orchid, sandalwood and vanilla. Seven Veils was launched in 2011.

title: BYREDO Sellier Extrait de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Woody and aromatic, Night Veils Sellier opens with notes of black tea and cashmeran followed by a heart of leather accord and tobacco and a base of oakmoss and birch tree.

 

Style: Woody, aromatic.

 

Notes:

- Top: black tea, cashmeran.

- Middle: leather accord, tobacco leaves.

- Base: oakmoss, birch tree.

title: BYREDO Rose Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
An updated take on the classic symbol of love and devotion, this fragrance darkens the character of the traditional olfactory rose, the Damascene, making it potent and contemporary once again. Rose Noir becomes a decadent, dirty rose with intense and animalic quality.

  • Top notes: Grapefruit, freesia
  • Middle notes: Rose damascene
  • Base notes: Cistus, moss, musk
  • Eau de Parfum

title: BYREDO Reine de Nuit Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Night Veils perfume extract- When the last rays of sun have gone, the most intense fragrance is diffused. Jasmine, lily and rose: many flowers in a powerful sillage unveil their mysteries once night falls. Inspired by those hours impregnated with floral particles, the Night Veils collection by BYREDO offers a new perfume ritual.

TOP NOTES
Blackcurrant
Saffron

HEART NOTES
Incense
Rose

BASE NOTES
Ambrette see

title: BYREDO Pulp Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Pulp is the epitome of ripe fruit, bottled. Imagine that you have just bitten into the juiciest, ripest plum, felt the snap of a crisp apple in your teeth, indulged in a handful of berries ready to explode, all fresh from the fields and orchards, the kiss of the sun still on them. Now put it all in your mouth at the same time and you have the cacophony of fruit that is Pulp. This is grown-up fruit: no sugar-coating, no syrup, just a tiny hint of sweetness to bring out the nuances.

With a whiff of blossom and a touch of bark, you can sense an olfactory arc of how the fruit begins, grows, and ripens. Pulp will make you smile and feel a bit giddy, because there is nothing else quite like it.

 

Pulp  Notes

Bergamot, cardamom, black currant, fig, red apple, tiara, cedar wood, praline, peach flower

title: BYREDO Palermo Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
In the ancient Mediterranean city of Palermo, the regional capital of Sicily, the orange trees that Berber and Moorish emirs planted long ago still grow. Their bergamot and bigarade fruits light up Byredo's Palermo, a scent as close to olfactory happiness as you can get, a perfume played in the highest, brightest keys.

Palermo's citrus grove sits alongside a rose garden, its rose bushes greened up in spring with the smell of crushed orange tree leaves and sliced fruits: lemon, lime, grapefruit, and maybe even aromatic pomelo. In its opening, an effervescent freshness of citrus juice is layered with cut citrus rinds, their zest oils conveying a more intense richness, bitterness, and spice.

During your walk in the garden, as the sun warms your skin, a warm musk rises up, slightly powdery, softening the bracing freshness of the hesperidic top notes of Palermo and helping the freshness to linger with the warmth. This is a unisex fragrance perfect for warmer months.

Palermo  Notes

Sicilian bergamot, bigarade, fresh rose absolute, skin musk, ambrette flower

title: BYREDO Oud Immortel Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Oud Immortel by Byredo is a Woody Chypre fragrance for women and men. Oud Immortel was launched in 2010. Top notes are Limoncello, Incense and Cardamom; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Papyrus and Brazilian Rosewood; base notes are oak moss and Tobacco.

title: BYREDO Open Sky Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Open Sky by Byredo is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Open Sky was launched in 2021. Top notes are Pomelo and Black Pepper; middle note is cannabis; base notes are Vetiver and Palo Santo.

title: BYREDO Mumbai Noise Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Mumbai Noise  by Byredo is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Mumbai Noise  was launched in 2021. Top note is Davana; middle notes are Coffee and Tonka Bean; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Labdanum and Sandalwood.

title: BYREDO Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Byredo Mojave Ghost is a soft, airy floral inspired by the quiet beauty of the desert.

Launched in 2014, it opens with juicy sapodilla and ambrette. Magnolia, violet and sandalwood form a gentle, powdery heart, and ambergris and cedar leave a clean, woody trail.

Light and understated, it is a daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

title: BYREDO Mixed Emotions Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Mixed Emotions by Byredo is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Mixed Emotions was launched in 2021. Top notes are Black Currant and Mate; middle notes are Tea and Violet Leaf; base notes are Birch and Papyrus.

title: BYREDO Tobacco Mandarin Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Tobacco Mandarin by Byredo is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Tobacco Mandarin was launched in 2020. Top notes are Cumin, Mandarin Orange and Coriander; middle notes are Tobacco, Labdanum and Leather; base notes are Olibanum, Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud).

title: BYREDO Lil Fleur Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Byredo Lil Fleur launches in June 2020. The inspiration for the new Byredo creation lies in the youthful emotions, ups and downs of the teenage years; their intensity, boldness and openness.

Lil Fleur explores the floral components and the note of Damasc rose as dominant and presents it in a new, modern and complex light. 

Top notes: cassis, tangerine, saffron
Heart: Damask rose (oil), leather
Base: light woods, ambergris, vanilla

title: BYREDO La Tulipe Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
BYREDO La Tulipe is a fresh, green floral built around tulips.

Ben Gorham and Jérôme Epinette created it in 2010. Freesia, cyclamen and rhubarb open fresh, tulip forms the heart, and green notes, vetiver and woods give it a clean finish.

A daytime favorite for spring.

title: BYREDO Inflorescence Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
To celebrate the beginning spring, nature's perennial and powerful rebirth, perfumer Ben Gorham designed a floral scent that would capture the strength and beauty of wild garden blossoms just as they reach their dramatic peak. The result, the wonderfully entitled Inflorescence, is an arcadian stroll through untamed bowers of full-blown, rambling roses, interspersed by the intoxicating, honeyed notes of pink freesias in their prime. Two of spring's very first flowers lie at the heart. The creamy-soft allure of the magnolia blossom, its petals fully open about to drop onto beds of quivering lily of the valley, or may bells in the language of flowers, symbolic of a return to happiness and the joy associated with the onset of spring. Finally and most unusually, Ben Gorham has used jasmine at the base. Again luxuriant and overgrown, a veritable riot of fresh sweetness that supports the structure and furnishes a heady close.

 

Style: Floral.

 

Notes:

- Top: rose petals, pink freesia.

- Middle: magnolia, lily of the valley.

- Base: fresh jasmine.

title: BYREDO Gypsy Water Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BYREDO Gypsy Water is a fresh, woody fragrance of pine, juniper and incense.

Launched in 2008, it opens with juniper, lemon, bergamot and pepper. Pine needles, incense and orris root form a soft heart, and sandalwood, vanilla and amber give it a warm finish.

Easy to wear for the office and everyday, from spring through fall.

title: BYREDO Flowerhead Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Flowerhead is inspired by the traditional Indian wedding where flower heads are strung together on giant leis. Couples are often showered with petals by the groom’s brother for a spiritual protection and flowers are abundant. From the mandap wedding canopy, which is entirely covered in exotic blooms, to the spiritual pooja rooms and verandahs, the explosion of colour is wildly celebratory and the scent is overwhelming.

  • Top notes: Angelica seeds, Sicilian lemon, lingonberry
  • Middle notes: Jasmine sambac, tuberose, rose petals
  • Base notes: fresh amber and suede
  • Eau de Parfum

title: BYREDO Encens Chembur Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Chembur by Byredo is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Chembur was launched in 2008. The fragrance features bergamot, amalfi lemon, ginger, incense, nutmeg, french labdanum, amber, musk and elemi resin.

title: BYREDO Eleventh Hour Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Eleventh Hour by Byredo is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Eleventh Hour was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Jerome Epinette. Top notes are Sichuan Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes are Plum, Rum, Fig and Carrot Seeds; base notes are Cashmere Wood, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Iso E Super, Olibanum and Labdanum.

title: BYREDO Elevator Music Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Off-White fashion brand, fronted by Virgil Abloh, co-operates with Swedish Byredo, with Ben Gorham as the perfumer to create the new fragrance Elevator Music.

Elevator Music was launched in 2018.

title: BYREDO Casablanca Lily Extrait de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Casablanca Lily (2019) by Byredo is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Casablanca Lily (2019) was launched in 2019. Top notes are Gardenia and Plum; middle notes are Indian Tuberose and Carnation; base notes are Honey and Palisander Rosewood.

title: BYREDO Blanche Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BYREDO Blanche is a crisp, clean floral that smells like fresh white linen.

Launched in 2009, it opens with aldehydes, rose and pink pepper. Peony, violet and orange flower form a soft heart, and musk, woods and sandalwood give it a pure, airy finish.

Effortless for spring and summer days, the office and everyday wear.

title: BYREDO Black Saffron Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BYREDO Black Saffron is a warm, fruity leather with saffron.

Launched in 2012, it opens with saffron, juniper berries and grapefruit. Leather and black violet form the heart, and raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver give it a smooth finish.

Versatile in spring, fall and winter, for the office and everyday.

title: BYREDO Bibliotheque Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BYREDO Bibliothèque is a soft, fruity leather that evokes an old library.

Launched in 2017, it opens with plum and peach. Violet and peony form a powdery heart, and leather, vanilla, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.

Cozy for fall and winter days, the office and everyday wear.

title: BYREDO Baudelaire Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
The Scoop

“…A lazy isle to which nature has given singular trees, savory fruits, men with bodies vigorous and slender, and women in whose eyes shines a startling candor.”

The poet Charles Baudelaire, famously a lover of perfume and the exoticism of faraway lands, was by turns cerebral, sensual, perverse, and sentimental. Byredo's homage to the French dandy reflects this mercurial nature with its multiple olfactory dimensions.

A gentle sweetness lies at the heart of Baudelaire, with hyacinth warmed by amber and a touch of fruit. This sentimental center gives way to the aromatics of caraway, patchouli, and juniper berries, with their green whiff of the brisk outdoors. Baudelaire's base truly provides a counterpoint to its initial warmth, the way that his poetry often launches into philosophy: sensuality gives way to aridity, with a dry, incense-y base of leather, patchouli and papyrus.

Earthy yet worldly, warm yet sophisticated, Baudelaire is as elegant as a dandy's walking stick.

Baudelaire  Notes

Juniper berry, Black pepper, Caraway, Incense, Hyacinth, Leather, Papyrus, Patchouli, Black amber

title: BYREDO Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
BYREDO Bal d'Afrique is a sunny, joyful floral built on citrus, violet and cedar.

Jérôme Epinette created it in 2009. Amalfi lemon, bergamot, black currant and African orange flower open bright and sparkling, violet, cyclamen and jasmine form a soft floral heart, and vetiver, amber, musk and cedar give it a gentle, woody finish.

Bal d'Afrique feels light-hearted and sunny, a little like a warm afternoon outdoors. It is a daytime favorite for spring and summer, easy to wear to the office or on weekends.

title: BYREDO Accord Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Byredo's Accord Oud presents a striking set of olfactory opposites. The warm sweetness of blackberry and boozy rum pair with a camphorous glow from patchouli. And saffron's rounded softness is set against the sharp and smoky birch of a leather accord. Powdery musks resolve and fill in some of these opposites, and notes like clary sage complement the birch and patchouli.

A resinous, aromatic, fruity leather, Byredo's Accord Oud suggests that oud is as much a mysterious set of olfactory characteristics — sweet, medicinal, soft, and dark — as it is an actual perfume note.

Accord Oud  Notes

Blackberry, Saffron, Rum, Leather Accord, Clary Sage, Patchouli, Powdery Musks

title: BYREDO 1996 Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
1996 transports the wearer to another plane and, like the image it is inspired by, combines polar opposites, as the Northern hemisphere gives way to creamy orris and soft, slightly flirtatious violets. The soul of this fragrance is a warm, almost viscous black amber, its deep cognac rapture envelops the wearer and time stands still for just a moment until the journey concludes in the softly sensual leather and patchouli of the Orient.

 

Style: Woody, aromatic.

Notes:

- Top: juniper berries, black pepper.

- Middle: violet, leather accord, orris.

- Base: patchouli, black amber, vanilla.

title: Bvlgari Goldea The Roman Night Absolute Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Goldea The Roman Night Absolute by Bvlgari is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Goldea The Roman Night Absolute was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Plum and Orange Blossom; middle notes are Madagascar Vanilla and Jasmine Sambac; base notes are Black Musk, Patchouli and Moss.

title: Bvlgari Man Wood Neroli Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Bvlgari Man Wood Neroli by Bvlgari is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bvlgari Man Wood Neroli was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are bergamot and neroli; middle notes are orange blossom, virginia cedar and cypriol oil or nagarmotha; base notes are leather, white musk, amber, ambergris and woody notes. >

title: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
The house of Bvlgari launches their new fragrance Bvlgari Man Wood Essence in July 2018, as a part of the Bvlgari Man collection. The philosophy of the new fragrance is based on the balance between the urban life of a modern man and the call of nature.

Bvlgari Man Wood Essence combines an accord of woods – wood barks, resins and essences – mixed with spicy notes. Italian citrus zest along with coriander leaf gives a fresh, green character in the opening, leading to an intense woody cypress, vetiver and cedar accord based on benzoin resins.

title: Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence Eau de Parfum takes on a new olfactory territory along with the raw strength and mesmerizing power of the vital element of Air. The fragrance is inspired by and crafted to emulate this element that represents the connection of body and mind, to give man the confidence to take that deep breath and the strength to achieve greatness while living life to the fullest.

  • Top - juniper berry, ginger extract, geranium essence
  • Middle - Australian sandalwood, rare orris, Artemisia essence
  • Base - Alaskan cedarwood essence, clearwood accord, musks

title: Bvlgari Bvlgari Man Black Orient Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
After the success of Bvlgari Man In Black fragrance from 2014, presented as a flanker of the original Bvlgari Man from 2010, Bvlgari launches its two new editions in 2016. First came Bvlgari Man Black Cologne, an unusual summer, oriental-fresh Eau de Toilette, and that is now followed by Bvlgari Man Black Orient, a lush oriental Eau de Parfum for the fall season. The fragrances are developed by Alberto Morillas.

Sophisticated and mysterious, Bvlgari Man Black Orient has a spicy aromatic opening thanks to the rich notes of rum (a standard for the collection) and peppery cardamom. The opulent floral heart includes lavish tuberose and oriental Taif rose, laid on the intensive masculine basis of oud and leather.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Yasep Eau de Parfum for men
description_html: Yasep by Bvlgari is a Amber fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Yasep was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Sicilian Mandarin and Sichuan Pepper; middle notes are Sandalwood and Cedar; base notes are Musk, Amyris and Vetiver.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Splendida Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Splendia by Bvlgari is a Floral fragrance for women. Splendia was launched in 2016.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Opalon Eau de Parfum For Men
description_html: Opalon by Bvlgari is a Amber Floral fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Opalon was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Neroli and Ginger; middle notes are Lemongrass and Geranium; base notes are Ambergris and White Musk.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Garanat Men Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Garanat by Bvlgari is a Oriental Floral fragrance for men. Garanat was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. The fragrance features damask rose, rose and incense.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Desiria Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Desiria by Bvlgari is a Floral fragrance for women. Desiria was launched in 2016.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Azaran Eau de Parfum for men
description_html: Azaran by Bvlgari is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Azaran was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Saffron and Bergamot; middle notes are Cedar and Green Tea; base notes are Leather, Woody Notes and Beeswax.

title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Ambero Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Ambero by Bvlgari is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Ambero was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier.

title: Bvlgari GOLDEA The Roman Night Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
BVLGARI is writing a new chapter in its olfactory narrative with a floral musky chypre, the first for the brand. The fragrance features a more contemporary signature for women who find its bold character both appealing and intriguing. The fragrance evokes the Eternal City and its ebullient energy emanating from the frenzy etched into its nights. The scent embodies the new goddess of the night, a spontaneous and instinctive woman who stands by her choices.

 

 

Fragrance Family:
Floral

Scent Type:
Warm Florals

Key Notes:
Black Musk, Lucious Mulberry, Blooming Jasmine

title: Bvlgari Eau Parfumee Au The Bleu Eau de Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Eau Parfumée au Thé Bleu is a new fragrance of tea collection by Bvlgari arriving after the following editions: Eau Parfumee au The Vert, Eau Parfumee au The Blanc, Eau Parfumee au The Rouge which will, as announced by the brand Bvlgari .

The latest edition Eau Parfumée au Thé Bleu is based on notes of Oolong tea (Chinese Fujian tea), combined with blue tea, iris blossom and aromatic lavender, and is created by perfumer Daniela Andrier.

title: Bvlgari Aqva Marine Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Aqva Pour Homme Marine by Bvlgari is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Aqva Pour Homme Marine was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Grapefruit, Neroli, Mandarin Orange and Petitgrain; middle notes are Water Notes, Seaweed and Rosemary; base notes are Virginia Cedar and Amber.

title: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Aqva Pour Homme by Bvlgari is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Aqva Pour Homme was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Orange and Petitgrain; middle notes are Seaweed, Lavender and Cotton Flower; base notes are Virginia Cedar, Woodsy Notes, Patchouli, Clary Sage and Amber.

title: Burberry Mr. Burberry Indigo Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Mr. Burberry Indigo by Burberry is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Mr. Burberry Indigo was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Rosemary, Lemon, Bergamot and Grapefruit; middle notes are Mint, Violet, Water Notes, Sage, Tea and Hedione; base notes are Oakmoss, Iso E Super and Amber.

title: Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Mr. Burberry by Burberry is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Mr. Burberry was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Grapefruit, Cardamom, Tarragon and Mint; middle notes are Cedar, Birch Leaf, Nutmeg and Lavender; base notes are Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, Amberwood, Benzoin and Oakmoss.

title: Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Introducing Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum. An intense interpretation of the original Mr. Burberry, the fragrance captures the essence and anticipation of London at nighttime.

A warm, sensual, and woody scent with fresh and aromatic top notes of tarragon and comforting, spicy cinnamon, layered delicately on rich patchouli with a base of amber and smoky vetiver.
 
 
Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy

Scent Type:
Cool Spices

Key Notes:
Cinnamon, Lavender, Vetiver

title: Brioni Brioni for Men Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Brioni Cologne by Brioni, Launched in 2009 as a limited-edition, self-titled cologne, Brioni is a refined and masculine fragrance that evokes timeless elegance and polish. Created with confident men in mind, this scent combines classic notes that render it ideal for daytime wear at events such as client meetings and after-dinner appointments. It opens with refreshing, citrusy top notes of Sicilian lemon and Calabrian bergamot followed by a woody, aromatic heart comprised of galbanum, lavender, patchouli, vetiver, verbena and nutmeg. An elegant base of tonka bean and oakmoss rounds out this intensely sophisticated cologne.

Italian-based fashion house Brioni was established by Gaetano Savini and Nazareno Fonticoli in 1945. This fragrance was designed in collaboration with renowned perfumer Raymond Matts and is the first released by the company since the 1950s. Packaged within a simple yet charming glass bottle, it contains a distinct olfactory blend that enables wearers to exude poise and quiet confidence throughout the day and into the evening.

title: Bottega Veneta Eau Sensuelle Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Bottega Veneta Eau Sensuelle Eau de Parfum is a floral fruity chypre fragrance with a delicate mix of jasmine and gardenia, blended to a joyful and elegant peach note. It leaves behind a distinctive and lasting leathery trail of patchouli and vanilla. Floral.

 

Notes:

- Top: gardenia, jasmine.

- Middle: peach.

- Base: leather, vanilla, patchouli.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Oud Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Oud is a warm, spicy blend of apple, saffron and oud.

Launched in 2015, it opens with apple and citrus. Cinnamon, saffron, clove and labdanum form a rich heart, and oud, sandalwood and cypriol give it a deep, woody finish.

Bold and warm, it is great for date nights and evenings in fall and winter.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Hugo Boss Bottled is a warm, fruity and woody classic with a touch of cinnamon.

Annick Menardo created it in 1998. Apple, plum, bergamot, lemon, oakmoss and geranium open fresh, cinnamon, mahogany and carnation form a spicy heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, cedar, vetiver and olive tree give it a smooth finish.

Dependable and easy to wear, it is great for the office in spring and fall.

title: Hugo Boss Hugo Iced Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Hugo Iced is a cool, fresh blend of mint, tea and juniper.

Launched in 2017, it opens with mint and tea. Bitter orange and juniper form a crisp heart, and vetiver gives it a clean, woody finish.

Refreshing and easy, it is great for the office, the gym and casual days in spring and summer.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Unlimited Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Unlimited is a fresh, fruity blend of mint, grapefruit and pineapple.

Launched in 2014, it opens with mint, grapefruit and violet leaf. Pineapple, cinnamon and rose form a sweet heart, and labdanum, white musk and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.

Light and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Tonic Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Tonic is a bright, zesty citrus with ginger and spice.

Launched in 2017, it opens with apple, bitter orange, grapefruit and lemon. Ginger, cinnamon, clove and geranium form a spicy heart, and vetiver and woods give it a clean finish.

Fresh and energetic, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Night is a soft, woody blend of lavender, birch and violet.

Launched in 2010, it opens with lavender and birch. Violet forms a smooth, powdery heart, and woods and musk give it a quiet, sensual finish.

Relaxed and easy, it is a great evening scent in spring and fall.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Intense Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Intense is a warm, spicy take on Bottled with vanilla and sandalwood.

Launched in 2015, it opens with apple, orange blossom and bergamot. Cinnamon, clove, cardamom, geranium and lavender form a spicy heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, coumarin, cedar and vetiver give it a rich finish.

Warm and dependable, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Infinite Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Infinite is a fresh, aromatic blend of apple, lavender and sandalwood.

Launched in 2019, it opens with apple, cinnamon, sage and mandarin. Lavender, rosemary and patchouli form an aromatic heart, and sandalwood and olive tree give it a smooth, woody finish.

Easy and versatile, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy take on Bottled with apple and cinnamon.

Honorine Blanc created it in 2020. Apple, black pepper and bergamot open bright, cinnamon, chestnut and cardamom form a cozy heart, and musk and vetiver give it a clean finish.

Dependable and smooth, it works day or night in spring and fall.

title: Bond No. 9 west side Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Music to your Nose. You've heard the West Side... Now Smell it. (Bond No. 9's West Side, that is.) A melodious full-bodied coloratura perfume, with dark-light, high-low, sweet-sharp floral and woody notes.

Notes: Rose, ylang ylang, peony, sandalwood, amber, vanilla, musk 

Bond sure knows how to do Rose fragrances! West Side is quite a boozy Rose, like a sweet red wine. The Rose petals are floating on top of a vanilla infused beverage, which makes the fragrance unique and irresistible. It's soft, radiant and stunningly beautiful. Men and women alike love this one, for it is a charming scent with just enough bite to get the attention you deserve.

title: Bond No. 9 Sutton Place Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Bond No. 9 Sutton Place is a fruity, leathery blend of cassis and pineapple.

Launched in 2016, it opens with cassis, bergamot, tangerine, pink pepper and pineapple. Patchouli, jasmine and lily form the heart, and leather, musk, vanilla and amber give it a smooth finish.

Easy to wear from spring through fall, for the office and everyday.

title: Bond No. 9 Success Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Success has been introduced in 2013 as a new fragrance by the house of Bond No9 which is as sweet and alluring as dollar sign. Success breaks all the rules of romantic fragrances and just like money, the fragrance is universal (for both sexes).

The fragrance is constructed as spicy-gourmand; it allures and intoxicates the one who smells it. Top notes introduce spices and citruses: mandarin, lemon, coriander and cardamom, leading to a heart composed of honey scents of tuberose and rose spiced with gourmand accords of plum and pimento. The base provides an oriental tone with a combination of vanilla, patchouli and amber.

title: Bond No. 9 Spring Fling Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Spring Fling by Bond No 9 is a Floral fragrance for women. Spring Fling was launched in 2018. Top notes are Fruity Notes, Lily-of-the-Valley and Passion Flower; middle notes are Honeysuckle, Jasmine and Freesia; base notes are Musk, Amber and Teak Wood.

title: Bond No. 9 Soho Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Soho by Bond No 9 is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Soho was launched in 2016. Top notes are petitgrain, sweet orange and cassis; middle notes are jasmine, orris root and orange blossom; base notes are amber, moss, cedar and vetiver.

title: Bond No. 9 The Scent Of Peace for Him Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Bond No. 9 The Scent of Peace for Him is a fresh, fruity aromatic with pineapple and juniper.

Michel Almairac created it in 2013. Pineapple, juniper berries and bergamot open bright, currant buds form a green heart, and cedar and vetiver give it a clean, woody finish.

Easy to wear for spring and summer days, from the office to date night.

title: Bond No. 9 Sag Harbor Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Sag Harbor by Bond No 9 is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Sag Harbor was launched in 2012. Top notes are Ivy, Bay Leaf and Bergamot; middle notes are Peony, Magnolia, Grapes and Honeysuckle; base notes are Amber, Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud).

title: Bond No. 9 Queens Eau de Parfum Unisex

Launched in 2017, it opens with tangerine and freesia. Lily, jasmine sambac and rose form the heart, and amber, musk and sandalwood give it a soft finish.

A daytime favorite for spring.

description_html:

Belle Epoque fashionistas. And now comes Bond No. 9's updated, 21st 
century New York Patchouli, all set to spice up the art of urban

description_html:

Notes: red plum, saffron, orange zest, oud, red rose, orris, patchouli, musk, honey, vetiver.

Launched in 2017, it opens with gardenia, jasmine and carnation. Patchouli, sea notes and sandalwood form the heart, and caramel and coffee give it a sweet, warm finish.

Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Musk, patchouli, sandalwood, and vetiver support the fruits, spices and flowers above.

description_html:
Bond No. 9's Chinatown is a seductively dynamic eau de parfum. Its topnote is a burst of peach blossom, blended with creamy-sweet gardenia and sultry tuberose and a hint of patchouli adds a spiky note to the other florals. On one side of the bottle, the flowers are the color of irridescent pearl on a deep fuschia background. Turn it over, and in yin-yang style its the same design with the colors reversed. A feminine scent perfect for her.

Superpower meets Supercity: The emerging superpower energy with the avant-garde cachet of downtown New York. A sultry, mouth-watering equal-opportunity East-West bouquet.


Notes: Peach blossoms, gardenia, tuberose, patchouli, cardamom

title: Balenciaga Florabotanica Eau de Parfum For Women
description_html:
Florabotanica by Balenciaga is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Florabotanica was launched in 2012. Florabotanica was created by Olivier Polge and Jean-Christophe Herault. Top note is Mint; middle notes are Rose, Carnation and cannabis; base notes are Vetiver and Amber.
A very interesting edition announced for September 2012 and aimed at younger audience arrives from the Balenciaga Company. Balenciaga, in collaboration with Coty, Prestige and IFF created the new fragrance FLORABOTANICA which attracts attention with its modern, attractive flacon and unusual ingredients.
The composition was developed by perfumers of the house of IFF, Olivier Polge and Jean-Christophe Herault, who composed it of such accords as mint, carnation, hybrid rose, caladium leaves, amber and vetiver. It was envisaged that the composition would offer floral character, which is also very seductive and its flowers will not be just beautiful, but also very dangerous.
The advertising campaign is decorated with three metal sculptures resembling the Ghesquière floral print created a few years ago. Photos for the campaign were taken by Steven Meisel, and the advertising face is young actress Kristen Stewart. She is wearing a dress from the floral collection and holding her hands in her pockets.

title: Azzaro Wanted Tonic Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Wanted Tonic by Azzaro is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Wanted Tonic was released in 2020. Top note is Lime. Middle Notes is Ginger. Base Note is Patchouli.

title: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Azzaro Wanted by Night is a warm, spicy blend of cinnamon, tobacco and red cedar.

Michel Girard and Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Cinnamon, mandarin, lavender and lemon open warm, fruity notes, incense, red cedar and cumin form the heart, and tobacco, vanilla, leather and benzoin give it a rich finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Wanted by Azzaro is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men's. Wanted was released in 2016. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin. Top notes are Lemon, Ginger, Lavender and Mint. Middle Notess are Apple, Juniper, Guatemalan Cardamom and Geranium. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Amberwood and Haitian Vetiver.

title: Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense for Men
description_html:
Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense is a warm, sweet toffee and spice fragrance.

Launched in 2021, it opens with cardamom, moves into a rich toffee heart and settles into amberwood for a warm, addictive finish.

Made for fall and winter nights.

title: Atelier Cologne Vanille Insensee Pure Perfume Unisex
description_html: Vanille Insensee by Atelier Cologne is a Woody fragrance for women's and men. Vanille Insensee was released in 2011. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Ralf Schwieger. Top notes are Lime, Citron and Coriander. Middle Notess are Vetiver, oak moss and Jasmine. Base Notes are Vanille, Oak and Amber.

title: Atelier Cologne Silver Iris Pure Cologne Absolue Unisex
description_html: Silver Iris by Atelier Cologne is a Amber Floral fragrance for women's and men. Silver Iris was released in 2013. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Jérôme Epinette. Top notes are Black Currant, Tangerine and Pink Pepper. Middle Notess are iris, Violet Leaf and Mimosa. Base Notes are Musk, Patchouli and White Amber.

title: Atelier Cologne Santal Carmin Cologne Absolue Unisex

Top notes are Saffron, Lime and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood and White Musk. Base Notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Texas Cedar and Papyrus.

title: Atelier Cologne Rose Anonyme Cologne Absolue Unisex
description_html: Rose Anonyme by Atelier Cologne is a Amber Floral fragrance for women's and men. Rose Anonyme was released in 2012.

title: Atelier Cologne Pomelo Paradis Cologne Absolue Unisex

Top notes are Pink Grapefruit, Calabrian Mandarin and Black Currant. Middle Notess are Orange Blossom, Mint and Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes are Vetiver, Amber and iris.

Top notes are Blood Orange and Bitter Orange. Middle Notess are Geranium and Jasmine. Base Notes are Sandalwood, Amber and Tonka Bean.

title: Atelier Cologne Grand Neroli Cologne Absolue Unisex

title: Atelier Cologne Cedrat Enivrant Cologne Absolue Unisex
