The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Ralf Schwieger. Top notes are Citron, Lime and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Mint, Juniper Berries and Basil. Base Notes are Vetiver, elemi and Tonka Bean.

title: Atelier Cologne Bois Blonds Cologne Absolue Unisex
description_html: Bois Blonds by Atelier Cologne is a Amber Woody fragrance for women's and men. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Jérôme Epinette. Top notes are Tunisian Neroli and Pink Pepper. Middle Notess are Orange Blossom and Incense. Base Notes are Woody Notes, Haitian Vetiver and Musk.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Leather Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Leather is a warm blend of vanilla, leather and chestnut.

Cécile Matton created it in 2020. Vanilla, leather, guaiac wood and oud open rich, sage and lavender form an aromatic heart, and chestnut, elemi and spices give it a cozy, balsamic finish.

Smooth and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze is a cool, spicy citrus with a touch of chestnut.

Launched in 2020, it opens with ginger, lime, mandarin and apple. Lavender, cardamom, geranium and sage form an aromatic heart, and bourbon vanilla, amberwood, guaiac wood and candied chestnut give it a warm finish.

Fresh but cozy, it is an easy daytime scent for spring and fall.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You is a warm, sweet blend of spices, chestnut and vanilla.

Cécile Matton created it in 2017. Cardamom, pink pepper, mint and violet leaf open fresh, pineapple, sage, melon, cinnamon and lavender form the heart, and vanilla, chestnut, cedar, amberwood and guaiac wood give it a cozy finish.

Smooth and inviting, it is made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger with You Absolutely Parfum for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely is a boozy, warm blend of rum, chestnut and vanilla.

Launched in 2021, it opens with rum, elemi and bergamot. Lavender and davana form an aromatic heart, and chestnut, Madagascar vanilla, cedar and patchouli give it a sweet, smooth finish.

Stronger With You Absolutely is cozy, sweet and smooth, with a boozy warmth that is easy to love. It is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Giorgio Armani Si Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Sì Intense is a richer take on Sì with cassis, rose and vanilla.

Julie Massé created it in 2014. Black currant, cassis, freesia, mandarin and bergamot open fruity, May rose, osmanthus, neroli and artemisia form the heart, and vanilla, patchouli, woods and ambroxan give it a warm finish.

Confident and elegant, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Giorgio Armani Si Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Sì is an elegant blend of cassis, rose and vanilla.

Christine Nagel created it in 2013. Cassis opens juicy, May rose and freesia form a soft floral heart, and vanilla, patchouli, ambroxan and woods give it a warm, polished finish.

Graceful and confident, it works day or night in fall and winter.

title: Emporio Armani Remix for Him Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani Remix for Him is a spicy, aromatic blend of star anise, cardamom and licorice.

Launched in 2006, it opens with star anise, bergamot and basil. Cardamom, nutmeg and lily-of-the-valley form a spicy heart, and vetiver, licorice, clove and white musk give it a warm finish.

Distinctive and smooth, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Prive Oud Royal Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html:
Armani Privé Oud Royal is a deep, smoky blend of oud, incense and saffron.

Evelyne Boulanger created it in 2010. Oud, incense, sandalwood, saffron, amber and rose come together in a rich, resinous and regal scent.

Luxurious and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani My Way is a bright, luminous white floral with tuberose and jasmine.

Carlos Benaim and Bruno Jovanovic created it in 2020. Orange blossom and bergamot open fresh, tuberose and Indian jasmine form a radiant heart, and white musk, Madagascar vanilla and Virginian cedar give it a soft finish.

Uplifting and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Armani Mania Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Mania by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women's. Mania was released in 1999. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Labdanum, Vanilla, Orange Blossom and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Nutmeg, Saffron, Cloves and Amber. Base Notes are White Musk, Guaiac Wood, Vanilla and iris.

title: Emporio Armani In Love With You Freeze Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Emporio Armani In Love With You Freeze is a fresh, fruity floral with cherry, pear and peony.

Launched in 2020, it opens with cherry, mandarin, bergamot and pear. Peony, jasmine sambac and lily-of-the-valley form a light floral heart, and patchouli, white musk, woods and vetiver give it a clean finish.

Bright and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Emporio Armani He Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Emporio Armani He is a fresh, aromatic blend of sage, yuzu and orris.

Alain Astori and Carlos Benaim created this version in 2020. Sage, yuzu and cardamom open bright, nutmeg, orris root and rose form a soft heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, white musk and tonka bean give it a smooth finish.

Easy and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profumo Special Blend Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profumo Special Blend is an aromatic blend of sea notes, rosemary and incense.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Sea notes and bergamot open fresh, rosemary, sage and geranium form an herbal heart, and patchouli and incense give it a smoky finish.

Deep and polished, it is perfect for date nights from spring through fall.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Lights Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Lights is a light, aromatic marine with a fresh, woody base.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2021. Cardamom, green mandarin and sea notes open cool and bright, cypress, fir balsam, rosemary, lavender and mastic form an aromatic heart, and patchouli, vetiver and cedar give it a clean finish.

Breezy and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Eau de Parfum is a deep, aromatic marine fragrance.

Alberto Morillas created it in 2020. Sea notes, Aquozone, bergamot and green mandarin open fresh and salty, rosemary, cypress, lavender and mastic add an aromatic heart, and mineral notes, musk, patchouli and amber give it depth.

Cool and confident, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Armani Acqua di Giò Eau de Toilette is the fresh, watery floral that defined a whole style of men's scent.

Edouard Fléchier created it in 1995. Peony, pineapple, lemon, peach and violet open bright, lily-of-the-valley, hyacinth, jasmine, freesia and calone bring a cool, aquatic heart, and musk, cedar, sandalwood, styrax and amber give it a clean finish.

Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioa Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioia is a fresh, green blend of lemon, mint and jasmine.

Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Loc Dong created it in 2010. Amalfi lemon and mint open bright, jasmine, peony and pink pepper form the heart, and cedar, labdanum and brown sugar give it a warm finish.

A summer favorite for daytime.

title: Giorgio Armani Eau de Nuit Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Eau de Nuit is a powdery blend of iris, cardamom and tonka.

Marie Salamagne created it in 2013. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, iris, cardamom, nutmeg and heliotrope form a soft heart, and tonka bean, amber and cedar give it a warm finish.

Smooth and elegant, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Giorgio Armani Eau d'Aromes Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Giorgio Armani Eau d'Arômes is a fresh, aromatic blend of citrus, ginger and vetiver.

Launched in 2014, it opens with mandarin and bergamot. Ginger and patchouli form a warm heart, and vetiver, sage and cardamom give it an earthy, aromatic finish.

Clean and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

title: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Absolu Gold Parfum for Men
description_html:
Armani Code Absolu Gold is a warm, ambery take on Code with iris and saffron.

Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2020. Mandarin and green apple open bright, iris and saffron form a refined heart, and tonka bean, benzoin, guaiac wood and cedar give it a rich finish.

Smooth and luxurious, it is made for fall and winter nights.

title: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Armani Code Eau de Parfum is a smooth blend of lavender, tonka bean and vanilla.

Launched in 2021, it opens with lavender, lemon and bergamot. Tonka bean forms a sweet, creamy heart, and vanilla, cedar, musk and suede give it a soft, powdery finish.

Elegant and warm, it is made for evenings in spring, fall and winter.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Sillage Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Club De Nuit Sillage by Armaf is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Club De Nuit Sillage was launched in 2020. Top notes are Bergamot, Violet Leaf, Black Currant, Lemon, Lime and Ginger; middle notes are iris, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambroxan, Cedar and Sandalwood.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Milestone Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Club De Nuit Milestone Cologne by Armaf, Go big with a fragrance that exudes sophistication and a down-to-earth vibe. Club De Nuit Milestone isn’t just for men seeking a quick thrill at a bar. Rather, they can flaunt its distinct aura at work, pleasure and day-to-day living. An opening of fruit notes and sea salt instantly captures your attention. It transitions to a woodsy heart of iris, mandarin orange, bergamot and Sicilian lemon. Musk combined with sea tones creates the base. It’s a pleasant yet non-offensive scent that complements humid weather and blazing sun rays.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html: Armaf Perfumes Club de Nuit Intense for Men is a bold scent that starts with fresh, fruity tones of lemon, apple and blackcurrant. Underneath are the middle notes of birch, jasmine and rose. This intense scent follows up with sensual base notes of ambergris, musk, patchouli and vanilla. The cologne spray for men starts out quite strong, but mellows within 10 to 15 minutes of application

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Parfum LIMITED EDITION for Men
description_html: Limited edition Club De Nuit Intense Perfum for men by Armaf is a exasperating spicy woody fragrance that opens with lemon, black currant and apple blending to its splendid floral heart of rose and jasmine spiced up with birch for smoky leather expression. Base note settles with vanilla, ambergis, musk and patchouli giving a sophisticated blend for individials who relish a life well-lived.

title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Parfum by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Club de Nuit Intense Man was launched in 2019. Top notes are Lemon, Pineapple, Black Currant, Bergamot and Apple; middle notes are Birch, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambergris, Patchouli and Vanilla.

title: Ariana Grande Thank U, Next Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Thank U, Next by Ariana Grande is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Thank U, Next was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Jerome Epinette. Top notes are Raspberry and Pear; middle notes are Coconut and Pink Rose; base notes are Macarons and Musk.

title: Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau de Parfum For Women
description_html: Sweet Like Candy by Ariana Grande is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Sweet Like Candy was launched in 2016. Top notes are Blackberry, Pear and Bergamot; middle notes are Whipped cream, Marshmallow, Black Currant, Frangipani, Honeysuckle and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla and Cashmere Wood.

title: Ariana Grande Moonlight Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Moonlight by Ariana Grande is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Moonlight was launched in 2017. Top notes are Plum and Black Currant; middle notes are Marshmallow and Peony; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood and Amber.

title: Ariana Grande Cloud Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Cloud by Ariana Grande is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Cloud was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Clement Gavarry. Top notes are bergamot, pear and lavender; middle notes are coconut, whipped cream, praline and vanilla orchid; base notes are woody notes and musk.

title: Ariana Grande Ari Eau de Parfum For Woman
description_html: Ari by Ariana Grande is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Ari was launched in 2015. Top notes are Raspberry, Pear and Grapefruit; middle notes are Vanilla orchid, Lily-of-the-Valley and Rose; base notes are Marshmallow, Musk and Woody Notes.

title: Amouage Sunshine Eau de Parfum for women
description_html: Sunshine by Amouage is a Amber Floral fragrance for women. Sunshine was launched in 2014. Top notes are Almond, Black Currant and Artemisia; middle notes are Osmanthus, Vanilla, Magnolia and Jasmine; base notes are White tobacco, Papyrus, Juniper and Patchouli.

title: Amouage Sunshine Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
The Scoop

Fresh and also warm, bright and also dark, Sunshine Man is a striking new scent from the house of Amouage as gorgeously contradictory as the solar eclipse from which it draws inspiration. Built around a boozy, syrupy note of orange brandy, an herbaceous kick of clary sage and juniper, and a rich yet fresh base of cedar, tonka and vanilla, Sunshine Man is dramatically different in composition from the frankincensed opulence of past releases, and yet, in its sensuality and sophistication, it is clearly every bit an Amouage, with originality and longevity to spare. With each contrasting element playing off its counterpart, Sunshine Man achieves ideal balance- the kind of spectacular scent that can cool off a hot summer day or warm up a cold winter night. Another triumph for creative director Christopher Chong and Amouage, Sunshine Man is a versatile new addition to your wardrobe.

Sunshine Man  Notes

Lavender, orange brandy, everlasting flower, bergamot, juniper berry, clary sage, cedarwood, tonka bean, vanilla

title: Amouage Silver Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html: Silver Cologne by Amouage is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. Silver Cologne was launched in 2002. Top notes are orange blossom, plum, mandarin orange and bergamot; middle notes are orchid, jasmine, heliotrope, ylang-ylang and rose; base notes are sandalwood, amber, patchouli, musk, vetiver and incense.

title: Amouage Reflection Woman Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Reflection Woman by Amouage is a Floral fragrance for women. Reflection Woman was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Maurice Roucel. Top notes are Green Leaves, Freesia and Water Violet; middle notes are Magnolia and Jasmine; base notes are Cedar, Sandalwood and Amber.

title: Amouage Reflection Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Amouage Reflection Man is a refined floral-woody fragrance with a fresh, spicy opening.

Created in 2007, it opens with rosemary, pink pepper and petitgrain. Jasmine, neroli, orris root and ylang-ylang give it a soft, powdery floral heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, cedar and patchouli finish it with quiet depth.

Reflection Man is clean and elegant rather than loud, with a soft floral warmth that feels quietly luxurious. Wear it in the daytime from spring through fall, or save it for a special occasion.

title: Amouage Reflection 45 Extrait de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Amouage Reflection 45 is the richer, deeper extrait take on the Reflection signature.

Lucas Sieuzac created it in 2021. Lavender, juniper, clary sage, cardamom and pink pepper open aromatic and fresh, iris, jasmine, neroli, tonka and vanilla form a smooth heart, and olibanum, myrrh, patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver give it depth.

Elegant and versatile, it works in every season, day or night.

title: Amouage Portrayal Woman Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Portrayal Woman by Amouage is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Portrayal Woman was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Annick Menardo. Top note is Jasmine; middle notes are Vanilla and Tobacco; base note is elemi.

title: Amouage Portrayal Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
The fifth chapter of the second cycle of the Amouage narrative by Creative Director Christopher Chong, Portrayal is a manifestation of a person’s orientation to him or herself. A reflection of his or her unique authenticity, it is about breaking free from the cages of solitude society sets around people because their truths are often seen as shockingly unconventional.

Portrayal embodies an artist’s ability to reconnect fragments from different times and places. When society is barren, they are able to transport themselves and immerse in the freedom of rebellion that can be compared to London’s Roaring 1920’s and New York’s grooving 1980’s. With the flamboyant, glamorous and often disaffected companionship of Bright Young People, the artists lose themselves. Desperately seeking something to fill the void, they synergies with art, culture and themselves in order to recreate something infinitely indefinable.

Portrayal Man is an olfactive depiction of 1920s bohemian culture. Its woody and leather aroma exudes an air of exquisite audacity. It is about the arrogance and social tension in the world’s cultural discourse. With Vetiver at its heart and top notes of Violet Leaves, Portrayal Man emits a dandy yet masculine impression. Its light spicy facet enriches its woody base of Cade, allowing the fragrance to illustrate an enlightening energy that is unforgettable.

Amouage’s signature glass crystal bottles are introduced in an iridescent pearl finish adorned with a blue Swarovski crystal for Portrayal. The boxes are a delicate dusty blue with an elegant art deco inspired jacquard.

The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Negrin.

title: Amouage Opus VII Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Allow the alluring unisex fragrance of Amouage Library Opus VII to surround you in a luxurious scent to lift your mood and brighten your day. Introduced in 2013, the design house of Amouage blended together top notes of galbanum and pink pepper while adding middle notes of cardamom and fenugreek that flow into the bottom notes of nutmeg. This composition gives you <g>the feeling</g> of success and confidence whether you are at your office on a special date.

title: Amouage The Library Collection Opus III Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Opus III is the third fragrance of the luxurious Amouage Library Collection, created by the perfumer Karine Vinchon Spehner. Floral notes of mimosa and broom introduce us into the world of this composition, together with cloves, nutmeg and thyme. Violet, jasmine, ylang-ylang and orange blossom essences are t the heart. The base is created with rich oriental notes of ambrette, papyrus, musk, notes of cedar wood, sandalwood and Guaiac, with the warm embrace of balsamic benzoin and soft vanilla. The Library Collection Opus III was launched in 2010.

title: Amouage The Library Collection Opus II Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: The composition of Opus II fragrance is a fougere one. This fragrance is created by the perfumer Michele Saramito. The olfactory journey begins with essential oils of lavender, wormwood, pink pepper and bay leaves. In the heart are the floral aromas of jasmine and rose spiced with cinnamon and cardamom, while the base features cedar, amber, musk, incense and patchouli.

title: Amouage Myths Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Myths Man is a surreal mirage of oriental elements intoxicated with enigmatic tones of smoke and wood, creating a fusion of dream and ambivalence.

Myths Man, represented by the celestial Chinese dragon, a symbol of enlightenment and honour, opens with the classical beauty of Chrysanthemum and Orris. The fragrance paves the way to an intoxicating heart defined by an interpretation of a thorny rose accord. The culmination is a base projecting both peace and calamity with Labdanum, Ashes, and Leather.

 

Myths Man  Notes

Chrysanthemum, orris, rum, rose, vetiver, elemi, labdanum, ashes and leather.

title: Amouage Memoir Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Amouage Memoir Man is a smoky, aromatic blend of wormwood, incense and leather.

Karine Vinchon Spehner created it in 2010. Wormwood, mint and basil open green, incense, lavender and rose form the heart, and tobacco, leather, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and oakmoss give it depth.

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

title: Amouage Meander Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Meander by Amouage is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Meander was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Mackenzie Reilly. Top notes are Olibanum, Carrot Seeds, Pink Pepper and Black Pepper; middle notes are Orris, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Rose and Narcissus; base notes are Sandalwood, Olibanum and Vetiver.

title: Amouage Lyric Woman Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
With Lyric Woman, Amouage is redefining the use of rose in perfume by rendering the traditional note in a completely unique manner. Spicy and resinous, Lyric Woman is an oriental rose, rich, complex and intricate. The piquant character of the composition is apparent immediately: the top notes blend bracing bergamot with tangy ginger and contrast this cool accord with warm, velvety spiciness of cardamom and cinnamon. The regal, crimson rose, surrounded by a creamy, opulent posse of ylang ylang, jasmine and orris, retains that spicy character in the heart of the fragrance, due to the presence of fiery geranium. The base of the scent, which includes the luxurious signature note of Amouage, frankincense, finishes the beautiful melody on a deep, sensual note. The drydown of woods, resins, vanilla and patchouli, paired with rose, is decadently rich, the epitome of Oriental luxury.

 

Lyric for Women  Notes

Bergamot, spicy cardamom, cinnamon, ginger, rose, angelica, jasmine, ylang-ylang, geranium, orris, oakmoss, musk, wood, patchouli, vetiver, sandalwood, vanilla, tonka bean, frankincense

title: Amouage Journey Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
The Scoop

Like a Chinese dragon, Journey Man opens with a fiery roar filled with Sichuan peppers and bold spices in a golden, boozy flame. The peppers tingle and gently bite, while a richly fruited sweetness intoxicates you with a cognac note. It's a visual of gold and red, but darkness lurks all around, thanks to swirls of incense, an oud-like cypriol woodiness, and a streak of leathery resins in the base. Tobacco, a sprinkling of cardamom, and the juiciness of neroli orange are the final touches to a complex fragrance that grabs your attention from the start.

Journey is slowly transformed by a beautiful creaminess which tames the dragon's fiery bite. A smooth layer of tonka vanilla coats the peppers, dry woodiness, incense, and spices. The cognac booziness turns into ambered warmth, and the perfume lingers more softly on the skin. Over time, Journey turns into a creamy, tonka sweetness with woods, spices, and just a hint of fruit mingle together. It's a bold fragrance whose initial intensity gives way to softness in a rich mix that feels very much like an Amouage.

Journey Man  Notes

Sichuan pepper, Bergamot, Cardamom, Neroli Bigarade, Juniper Berries, Incense, Geraniol, Tobacco Leaves, Ambrox, Cyriol, Tonka Bean Abstract

An opulent base of sumptuous vanilla, benzoin, amber, sandalwood, oakmoss, leather, tonka and musk inject warmth to the fragrance's contradicting accords.

Bergamot, Grapefruit, Ginger, Tagete, Frankincense, Rose Absolute, Orange Blossom, Nut, Kiwi, Coffee, Honey, Opoponax, Vanilla, Benzoin, Amber, Sandalwood, Agarwood, Oakmoss, Leather, Tonka Beans, Musk

title: Amouage Imitation Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
One moment, one sensory experience, can completely alter a child's perception of the world. For Amouage Creative Director Christopher Chong, that moment happened the first time he experienced New York City as a child in the 1970's- the vibrant street culture, the breathtaking diversity, and the very sights, sounds and smells of the greatest city in the world during a tumultuous and consequential era threw open a door to life's infinite possibilities. Imitation is his attempt to capture that vibrancy.

Imitation Man represents '70s NYC in bold, sensual, refined leather tones, opening with electric citrus and tingling spices that evoke blinding sunshine on bustling asphalt streets. The leather at the center of the fragrance is rich, soft suede, refined with lush rose, buttery orris and bright violet. An atmospheric base of spicy, smoky, animalic notes gives the thrilling authenticity of a smoke filled discotheque. Imitation Man will take you away to a time and place of chaos and beauty- and the endless adventures that follow.

Imitation Man  Notes

Citron, nutmeg, black pepper, rose, orris, violet, myrrh, leather, vetiver, patchouli, castoreum

title: Amouage Honour Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Honour Man, the regal, dramatic masculine fragrance with a spicy, woody character, is heir to Amouage's ongoing (soap) operatic narrative that began with Jubilation, and continued on with Lyric, Epic, and Memoir.

With an intensely peppery, dark opening, Honour Man creates olfactory storm clouds of disquiet, confusion, and drama befitting its back story, which was written by the perfume house's creative director Christopher Chong and inspired by Puccini's tragic opera Madame Butterfly.

In Chong's melodramatic creative brief, Honour is the son of Madame Butterfly, Puccini's tragic heroine who commits suicide when the American soldier who abandoned her years before returns to take their son. Honour has come back, so the narrative goes, to confront his mother's tragedy and to come to terms with his identity.

After the blast of pepper, Honour Man allows a fresh, rosy-floral note from geranium to peek through the dark clouds, followed by a succession of warm, woody, and spicy notes, including an intense patchouli that reminds us that Honour is still a fiery young man. Chong suggests that these comforting, beautifully blended base notes represent the reconciliation of our hero's troubled quest with his “filial elegy to honour his mother.” Its dry down does indeed feel like the denouement to a stormy, existential drama.

Honour Man is housed in a white crystal bottle with a gold-plated cap affixed with a white opal Svarovski crystal.

Honour Man  Notes

Pink pepper, black pepper, geranium, elemi, nutmeg, patchouli, frankincense, cedarwood, vetiver, tonka bean, musk

title: Amouage Gold Woman Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Every woman needs a Grand Perfume in her arsenal, a fragrance that will make her feel like Jean Harlow in a satin gown descending a marble staircase. Gold Woman is just that fragrance. Legendary perfumer Guy Robert created Gold using the highest quality ingredients that money could buy. He artfully melded more than 120 essences into an opulent perfume he calls the "crowning glory" of his career. Gold opens with a champagne-like burst of greens and lily of the valley, giving way to a floral symphony rich with rose and jasmine but so lushly orchestrated that it's difficult to isolate any one note. As Gold settles, it begins to purr with the warmth of sandalwood and frankincense. Gold lasts for hours and hours, and a little goes a long way. Gold Woman is a marriage of French tradition and Omani luxury that no 1930s movie, no matter how glamorous, could top. So, go ahead. Dab a few drops of Gold behind your ears and make an entrance they'll never forget.

Gold Woman is housed in majestic gold glass bottle and the cap is crystallized by a single white opal Swarovski jewel.

 

Gold Woman  Notes

Frankincense, Rock Rose, Lily of the Valley, Orris, Jasmine, Myrrh, Musk, Cedarwood, and Sandalwood.

title: Amouage Gold Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
With Gold Man, Amouage shows it understands that sometimes the softer touch is the sexier. Instead of bombarding us with the typical hallmarks of a macho fragrance, Gold Man gently seduces with its blend of deep, dark jasmine, iris, and rose, grounded by civet, ambergris, musk, and Omani's celebrated silver frankincense. A hint of patchouli and oakmoss brings to mind the classic chypres of the 1930s. The overall feel of Gold Man is of luxury and mystery, like seeing an Aston Martin speeding through a warm night on a road above the ocean. The man who wears Gold is confident and sophisticated and doesn't need to flaunt his masculinity. We wouldn't rule out Gold for a certain type of femme fatale, either. A deeply luxurious and elegant Chypre.

Gold Man Notes

Frankincense, Rock Rose, Lily of the Valley, Orris, Myrrh, Musk, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Ambergris and Civet.

title: Amouage Fate Man Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
In the final creation that expresses the end of the first cycle of the Amouage narrative, “Fate” for man and woman explores the uncertainty of the future and the universal principal by which the order of things is inescapably prescribed. The immutable fragrances are presented in Amouage's iconic clear glass-crystal bottles with a rainbow undertone with gold plated caps accented with an aurora borealis inspired Swarovski crystal.

Fate Man is one of those rare perfumes where you just have to try it to understand it. It begins with an opening salvo of absinthe and herbs through a heart of immortelle swathed in the most luxurious frankincense. The wheel of fortune that is Fate Man ends up on cedar and licorice to bring this stunning perfume to a close. Despite being labeled as masculine, Fate Man is a true shared fragrance and if you are a fan of Amouage-- this is a must try. Fate Man is as ever-changing as the swirling colors on the rainbow coated flacon; the experience is slightly altered every time you wear it.

As the subtly sophisticated floral heart notes kick in, a rich chord of saffron gives savory depth. A stout, gently earthy base featuring leather and guaiac exudes effortless masculinity. All in all, Beloved Man feels exactly as it was intended: like the comfort and contentment that comes from a relationship that is strong, supportive and permanent. We're thrilled to finally have the opportunity to share this exclusive gem with you.

title: Afnan Violet Bouquet Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html:
Afnan Violet Bouquet for Women is opened by tones of jasmine swaying in the waves of seduction, from the initial sweetness of fully-flowing white-blooming, intoxicating tufts of flowers, through still-flushed flower buds whose fragrance encircles earth and green with a blend of flowers and twig petals. tenderness with falling twilight, when jasmine lightly sleeps together with the intertwining bittersweet saffron, with undertones hidden in flashes of skin. The velvety powdery chord melts into the honey bed of noble ambergris, in which floral nuances will once again sound, this time in the main tones of graceful violets. Rare woody plants, turning their tones into majestic cedars and a spicy green aroma of firs with their balsamic-resinous notes, which also contain some forest moisture, which is chased by dry mosses.

title: Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
Supremacy Incense - is a burning heat, embracing passion and alluring sensuality.

The warm spice at the beginning shows a spicy oregano combined with a slightly bitter bergamot, into which the majestic, velvety ambergris melts the honey heat. Crispy green apple and seductive blackcurrant stalked with delicious pineapple are added.

The softness of the trees embraces and attracts, but at the same time deepens the aroma especially with the touches of oud oil, whose chords are smooth in this composition. The echoes of flowers, headed by roses and Moroccan jasmine, float to the trees.

Smoke from smoldering rare trees, skin with undertones of apricots and a sensual musk charge, accompanied by a few nuances of vanilla pods, enters the scene.

The final parade shows earthy shades of oak moss, herbal spice patchouli with bitterly leathery labdan, whose interconnected smell will make a special touch of mystery.

 

Top Notes: Bergamot, Oregano, Fresh Spicy

Middle Notes: Amber, Labdanum, Opoponax

Base Notes: Leather, Smoky, Patchouli, Oud
