title: Afnan Her Highness Red Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Her Highness Red Perfume by Afnan, As we walked along the plaza outside the opulent Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world, a cool breeze wafted in from the ocean. Evening fell, and we found ourselves dazzled by the Dubai Fountain, perhaps the most extravagant and beautiful man-made water and light show in existence. I’ll never forget that magical evening! Afnan Her Highness Red Perfume captures the enchantment and scents of the best the United Arab Emirates has to offer. Sea salt and a breath of ocean opens the fragrance in a crisp and breathlessly fresh top. Sweet and powdery heliotrope carries the heart, along with undertones of juicy fruits and a bouquet of white florals. Elegant and soft musk creates a memorable base. Unusual and intriguing, this perfume is for women who enjoy romance and a hint of mystery.

title: Afnan Her Highness Black Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Her Highness Black by Afnan Perfume. Every woman can feel like a royalty thanks to Her Highness Black. This tantalizing perfume embodies the confidence bestowed upon a royal with the bold power of self-sufficiency and independence that can turn any woman into the queen of her world. Seductive, bold and sophisticated, this fragrance is a complementary blend of delectable plums immersed in an intoxicating bouquet of tuberose, jasmine and ylang-ylang. A dash of pink pepper kicks the scent up a notch, adding an invigorating spiciness to the long-lasting aroma.

title: Acqua di Parma Yuzu Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Yuzu Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Yuzu Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are calabrian bergamot, sichuan pepper and yuzu; middle notes are mimosa, lotus, violet leaf and jasmine; base notes are musk, licorice and sandalwood.

title: Acqua di Parma Sandalo Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Sandalo Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sandalo Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are lemon, calabrian bergamot, orange and petitgrain; middle notes are lavender and cardamom; base notes are sandalwood, amber and tonka bean.

title: Acqua di Parma Rosa Nobile Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Rosa Nobile by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Rosa Nobile was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Pepper; middle notes are Rose, Peony, Violet and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Musk, Cedar and Ambergris.

title: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus Eau de Parfum Unisex
description_html: Osmanthus Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Osmanthus Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are Neroli and Green Mandarin; middle notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Peony and Pink Pepper; base notes are Osmanthus and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto Di Panarea Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Panarea near Sicily is an an island suspended in time. The smallest and oldest of the Eolie islands, its essence is brought to life in this revitalizing fragrance.

A scent characterized by the aromatic notes of myrtle and basil, it opens with lemon and bergamot. At the heart, a sea breeze accord melts with jasmine and rose. Its intense base includes lentisc and juniper with cedarwood and amber.
 
Notes:
Myrtle, Basil, Lemon, Bergamot, Sea Breeze Accord, Jasmine, Rose, Lentisc, Juniper, Cedarwood, and Amber.
 
Style:
Revitalizing. Intense. Aromatic.

title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo di Sicilia Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Sicily is a crossroads of art and culture, with the almond as part of the local tastes and traditions.

Known in Italian as Mandorlo di Sicilia, the soothing appeal of Sicilian almond opens this delicious fragrance. Its sweet caress joins notes of star anise, bergamot, and orange. The fragrance’s heart blends green Mediterranean almond and ylang-ylang before base notes of cedarwood, vanilla, and white musk emerge.

Notes:
Sicilian Almond, Star Anise, Bergamot, Orange, Green Mediterranean Almond, Ylang-Ylang, Cedarwood, Vanilla, and White Musk.
Style:
Delicious. Sweet. Soothing.

title: Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Citron, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Magnolia, Jasmine, Rose and Tuberose; base notes are Vetiver, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vanilla.

title: Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile Eau de Parfum for Women
description_html: Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile was launched in 2006. Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile was created by Francoise Caron and Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are iris, Star Anise, Bergamot, Orange and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Tuberose, Orange Blossom, Mimosa, Ylang-Ylang, Hibiscus and Cedar; base notes are Vanilla and Amber.

title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
Acqua di Parma Fico di Amalfi is a sunny blend of citrus and fig.

Launched in 2006, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot, citron and lemon. Fig nectar, jasmine and pink pepper form a juicy heart, and fig tree, cedar and benzoin give it a soft, woody finish.

A summer favorite for everyday wear and the gym.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne Unisex
description_html:
Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2017, The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy,

Top Note: Ozonic notes, Bergamot, Orange, Petitgrain
Heart Note: Narcissus, Jasmine Sambac, Coriander
Base Note: White Musk, Cedar, Patchouli

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Mirra Eau de Cologne For Men
description_html: Colonia Mirra by Acqua di Parma is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Colonia Mirra was launched in 2017. Top notes are Orange Blossom and Citruses; middle notes are Myrhh and Nutmeg; base notes are Amber and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Leather Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html:
Acqua Di Parma presents an original creation born from the unconventional pairing of fresh citrus notes from the iconic Colonia fragrance and the rich and sensual caress of aromatic leather. Colonia Leather Eau de Cologne Concentrée recalls the artistic luxury and traditions of handcrafted leather and accessories.

Notes:
Sicilian Lemon, Italian Orange, Raspberry, Honeysuckle, Petit Grain, Rose, Leather, Cedarwood, Birchwood, Gaiac Wood, Labdaum.
Style:
Stylish. Elegant. Masculine.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Intensa Cologne for Men
description_html:
Colonia Intensa by Acqua di Parma is a Woody fragrance for men. Colonia Intensa was launched in 2007. Colonia Intensa was created by Alberto Morillas and Francois Demachy.

Top notes are Citruses, Bergamot, Cardamom, Ginger and Sicilian Lemon;

Middle notes are Neroli, Cedar, Myrhh, Guaiac Wood and Artemisia;

Base notes are Leather, Benzoin, Musk and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html:
Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza is a richer, more refined take on the classic Italian cologne.

Launched in 2015, it opens with mandarin, orange, petitgrain, bergamot and grapefruit. Neroli, sage, jasmine, rose and rosemary form an elegant heart, and clove, moss, patchouli, vetiver and amber give it depth.

A polished daytime scent for spring and summer and a natural fit for the office.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Ebano Eau de Cologne Concentree for Men
description_html: Colonia Ebano by Acqua di Parma is a Woody fragrance for men. Colonia Ebano was launched in 2017. Top notes are resins, Red Pepper, Petitgrain and Bergamot; middle notes are Ebony and Honey; base notes are Vetiver and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta Eau de Cologne Unisex
description_html: Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta by Acqua di Parma is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta was launched in 2003. Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta was created by Bertrand Duchaufour and Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Bitter Orange, Bergamot, Lemon Verbena and Sweet Orange; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Vetiver, Jasmine, Cedar, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Paprika; base notes are Oakmoss, resins, White Musk and Patchouli.

title: Acqua di Parma Colonia Ambra Eau de Cologne For Men
description_html: Colonia Ambra by Acqua di Parma is a Amber fragrance for men. Colonia Ambra was launched in 2015.

title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Chinotto Di Liguria Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: Chinotto di Liguria by Acqua di Parma is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. Chinotto di Liguria was launched in 2018. Top notes are mandarin orange and chinotto; middle notes are jasmine, geranium, cardamom and rosemary; base notes are patchouli and musk.

title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Cedro Di Taormina Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
The latest fragrance in the Blu Mediterraneo collection is inspired by Taormina—a spectacular landscape where the unique and lush nature of the Mediterranean vegetation blends with the impressive strength of volcanic rock formations.

Fresh citrus essences and aromatic basil capture the landscape’s vibrant fragrance and sunlit radiance. In the heart of the fragrance, black pepper and lavender create a sparkling, spicy experience and blend perfectly with the elegant, intense base notes of cistus labdanum, vetiver, and Virginia cedarwood.
 

Notes:
Italian Citron, Black Pepper, Virginia Cedarwood, Elemi Resin, Vetiver, Guaiac.
Style:
Vibrant. Fresh. Sparkling.

title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html:
The land of Calabria is strong and intense. Only here does authentic bergamot find its natural habitat. Its sparkling notes appear at the onset of this joyful and uplifting fragrance and are enhanced by the freshness of citron, red ginger, and cedarwood. At the base, an unprecedented combination of vetiver, benzoin, and musk emerges.

Notes:
Bergamot, Citron, Red Ginger, Cedarwood. Vetiver, Benzoin, and Musk.
Style:
Joyful. Uplifting. Unique.

title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau de Toilette Unisex
description_html: This unisex perfume introduced in 1999 is full of fresh, aromatic and encouraging notes. Top notes bring us juicy freshness of orange, Sicilian mandarin, bergamot and luminous, bitter grapefruit. A heart is composed of petit grain and cardamom, while a base carries notes of caramel and musk.

title: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men
description_html:
An intriguing and charismatic, intensely masculine fragrance.

The opening notes create an instant rush of invigorating pepper, followed by an unforgettable development of warm cardamom. The base notes leave an irresistible trail of sensual leather. It is Abercrombie’s fragrant take on the charismatic personality of a man who is naturally attractive. It's a genuinely intriguing and addictive woody spicy oriental, blended for the man who is driven by his First Instinct.

  • Head Notes: Invigorating Pepper, Mandarin Leaf, Star Fruit Heart Note: Violet Leaves, Saffron Powder Warm Cardamom, Spicy Pepper
  • Base Notes: Sensual Leather, Cashmere Wood, Extreme Amber, Coconut Water

title: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
'First Instinct' is the first fragrance to be sold outside of the Abercrombie & Fitch boutiques. This addictive and irresistible fragrance is a fougere aromatic amber. Blended for the man who lives by his first instinct. This modern fragrance opens with electronic gin and Tonic combined with kiwano melon. In the heart, szechuan pepper ignites the spark to attraction while violet leaves bring depth and a citrus twist. The base is made up of suede musk and sleek warm amber, creating the perfect blend of fresh elements of fougere and oriental warmth.
  • Top notes: Gin, Tonic, Kiwano Melon
  • Heart notes: Violet Leaves, Szechuan Pepper
  • Base notes: Cashmere Woods, Sleek Amber, Sueded Musk
  • Woody/Earthy scent
  • Spray fragrance

title: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Blue Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
The scent balances an energetic opening, a spicy development and an addictive trail. Frozen apple, combined with juicy bergamot and aromatic cardamom, gives an exciting first impression. A mix of pepper, rosemary and crisp lavender brightens up the heart while giving it an effortless flair. At the base, addictive amber, supported by rich Sandalwood and Tonka Beans, leaves a deeper trail of unexpected tones. It is Abercrombie’s fragrant interpretation of the moment of exhilaration when you feel the sky’s the limit. A fresh, one-of-a-kind Fougere scent for the adventurous man whose lives by his First Instinct.

 

  • Head Notes: Frozen Apple, Cardamom, Bergamot
  • Heart Notes: Crisp Lavender, Rosemary, Pepper
  • Base Notes: Addictive Amber, Tonka Beans, Sandalwood

title: Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau de Cologne for Men
description_html:
Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce is a fresh, woody aromatic that became a modern classic.

Bruno Jovanovic and Christophe Laudamiel created it in 2002. Fir, lemon, orange, cardamom, petitgrain and sea notes open fresh, rosemary, jasmine, rose and sage form the heart, and musk, vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood give it a clean finish.

A daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and weekends.

title: Man Niche
Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette for Men
description_html:
Armaf Perfumes Club de Nuit Intense for Men is a bold scent that starts 
with fresh, fruity tones of lemon, apple and blackcurrant. Underneath 
are the middle notes of birch, jasmine and rose. This intense scent 
follows up with sensual base notes of ambergris, musk, patchouli and 
vanilla. The cologne spray for men starts out quite strong, but mellows 
within 10 to 15 minutes of application

title: countdown item
Titi’s Top 5 Scents for Women – A Titi Oguntade Fragrance Box
description_html:
1) Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum for Women

Royal Princess Oud by Creed is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Royal Princess Oud was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed . Top notes are bergamot, rose and violet; middle notes are jasmine, vanilla absolute, patchouli and tuscan iris; base notes are siam benzoin, sandalwood, styrax and agarwood (oud).

 

 

2 Parfums de Marly Safanad Eau de Parfum for Women

The grace of a thoroughbred lies not only in its sheer power but also the stunning economy of that power- the perfection of each movement, the efficiency of every step. Safanad, with its delicate, subtly complex floral warmth, is a reflection of this grace, taking advantage of a quieter, more restrained composition to truly showcase each note and impress on us a form of beauty all the more ravishing for its dignity. Opening with bright orange and a lusciously three-dimensional pear note, Safanad then stuns us with a floral heart led by sweet ylang and lightly earthy iris. A warm, rich base of vanilla, woods and amber cradles these florals, keeping a fresh femininity to the composition throughout its life. Lush and gorgeous, Safanad is proof that gentle and stunning are not mutually exclusive terms.

 

 

3) Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Femme Extrait de Parfum for Women

Amyris is a luminous fragrance steeped in natural, urban elegance, reflecting a vibrant parisian lifestyle. In this new Extrait de parfum composition, Francis Kurkdjian infused new energy to the duo featuring amyris from Jamaica and iris from Florence: a floral-sunny accent for her, heightened by jasmine absolute, a playful whirlwind of the senses. Made in France.

 

 

4) By Kilian Love Don't Be Shy Eau de Parfum for Women

Love by Kilian by By Kilian is a Oriental fragrance for women. Love by Kilian was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker. Top notes are Neroli, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Coriander; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Honeysuckle, Rose and iris; base notes are Caramel, Vanilla, Sugar, Musk, Civet and Labdanum.

 

 

5) Initio Parfums Addictive Vibration Eau de Parfum for Women

Addictive Vibration by Initio Parfums Prives is a Floral fragrance for women. Addictive Vibration was launched in 2016. Addictive Vibration was created by Pierre-Constantin Guéros and Maurice Roucel. The fragrance features apple blossom, orange blossom, vanilla orchid, musk and honey.

title: Top 5 Niche Fragrance Picks for Everyone (Unisex) - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Creed Pure White Cologne Eau de Parfum Unisex

Pure White Cologne calls to mind the impeccable style of men during the Victorian Age, well-groomed and sharply tailored, like a crisp white shirt perfectly made to measure. This citrus-fresh blend gives way to an understated sweetness and powdery elegance reminiscent of the fine mist of a foggy London afternoon.

 

 

2 Mancera Instant Crush Eau de Parfum Unisex

Instant Crush by Mancera is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Instant Crush was launched in 2019. Top notes are saffron, ginger, sicilian bergamot and sicilian mandarin; middle notes are moroccan rose, egyptian jasmine, amberwood and indonesian patchouli leaf; base notes are sandalwood, oakmoss, white musk and madagascar vanilla.

 

 

3) BYREDO Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum Unisex

A mix of Parisian avantgardism and African culture shaped a unique and vibrant expression. The intense life, the excess and euphoria is illustrated by Bal d'Afrique's neroli, African marigold and Moroccan cedarwood.

 

 

4) Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Gold Edition Eau de Parfum Unisex

Working the ingredient to express its full potential and meeting the challenge of composing two different eaux de parfum with the same notes: juniper berries, nutmeg, coriander, musks, ambery woods and vanilla. The Gentle Fluidity duo was born of the perfumer’s imagination to offer two distinct olfactory silhouettes, for her or for him.

 

 

5) Nishane Hundred Silent Way Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Hundred Silent Ways by Nishane is a fragrance for women and men. Hundred Silent Ways was launched in 2016. Top notes are mandarin orange, tuberose and peach; middle notes are jasmine, gardenia and orris; base notes are vanilla, sandalwood and vetiver.

title: Top 5 Niche Perfume Picks for Women - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) By Kilian Love Don't Be Shy Eau de Parfum for Women

Love by Kilian by By Kilian is a Oriental fragrance for women. Love by Kilian was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker. Top notes are Neroli, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Coriander; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Honeysuckle, Rose and iris; base notes are Caramel, Vanilla, Sugar, Musk, Civet and Labdanum.

 

 

2 Parfums de Marly Cassili Eau de Parfum for Women

At the intersection of desire and delicacy, Cassili is a fruity-floral beauty that reminds us that Parfums de Marly does feminine scents with every bit as much modern-meets-classic complexity as their much-heralded masculines. Exploding with triumphant fruitiness, yet anchored by a sophisticated woodsy gourmand base, Cassili is both fashion-forward and refined, with a true Parfums de Marly signature.

 

 

3) Roja Parfums Elixir Pour Femme Essence De Parfum for Women

“Fragrance is like a magical elixir: Invisible, a single drop can transform you into a goddess. It has the power to make you feel irresistible, confident, and seductive - where anything is possible. This magical elixir exudes effortless sensuality - giving you the power to light up a room, to leave an impression, and to get what you want.” - a note from the brand.

 

 

4) Juliette Has a Gun Mmmm... Eau de Parfum for Women

For a sheer bliss, mix 10 grams of distilled neroli, an ounce of jasmine sambac, and a knob of iris butter. Melt a little caramel, add some fresh raspberries, and slowly bring to the boil. Gently stir in a pinch of ground Sandalwood and a dash of patchouli, sprinkle a few grams of icing sugar, and whisk until a delicious sigh is achieved.

 

 

5) Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 Lira Eau de Parfum for Women

Lira by Xerjoff is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Lira was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Chris Maurice. Top notes are Blood Orange, Bergamot and Lavender; middle notes are Cinnamon, Licorice and Jasmine; base notes are Caramel, Vanille and Musk.

title: Top 5 Designer Fragrance Picks for Everyone (Unisex) - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Acqua Eau de Toilette Unisex

This? woody aromatic fragrance with fresh fougère and citrus facets is cool, salty, and refreshing. Merging cool air and refreshing waters as one, the salty waves of wind and sea collide with the warmth of the sun on the body, tempering its pulsating, red-blooded heat. An instant hit of exhilarating sea air mixes saltiness with the woody macchia of the beach, a wild tangle of cypress, juniper and myrtle. Like shafts of sunlight on wet skin, lemon’s citrus breath brightens the crisp earth of pine cones and needles at the scent’s core. The liquid amber facets of cistus absolute drip with lentisque resinoid, capturing the denouement of the Costa Azzurra Acqua experience, when the water that remains pools on the body’s languid muscles.

 

 

2 Dior Balade Sauvage Eau de Parfum Unisex

Balade Sauvage by Christian Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Balade Sauvage was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Ozonic notes, Petitgrain and Bergamot; middle notes are Fig Tree, Fig, Solar notes, Sea Notes, Peach, Hedione, Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Pebbles, Labdanum, Amberwood and Vanilla.

 

 

3) Yves Saint Laurent Capeline Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex

Capeline by Yves Saint Laurent is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Capeline was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Juliette Karagueuzoglou. Top notes are Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Sea water and Neroli; base notes are Vanilla Absolute, White Musk and Vetiver.

 

 

4) Hermes Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette Unisex

Hermès presents news coming from the Jardin Collection - Un Jardin sur la Lagune - launching in March 2019. The illustration for the packaging of the new perfume is signed by the famous Bosnian artist Safet Zec. The fragrance is conceived as vibrant, caressing, distinctive and a bit nostalgic.

 

 

5) Gucci Memoire d'Une Odeur Eau de Parfum Unisex

A universal perfume unassigned with a gender or a time, Gucci Mémoire d’une Odeur is an elixir that transcends gender by its individuality. Roman chamomile is structured with Indian coral jasmine petals for tenderness, precious musks for depth, and noble woods—including warm, luminous sandalwood and airy, subtle cedarwood.

title: Top 5 Designer Cologne Picks for Men - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Dior Homme Cologne Cologne for Men

Dior returns to the elegance of simplicity. Pure and radical, Dior Homme Cologne brings the sparkling freshness of bergamot to the citrus sweetness of grapefruit blossoms. Its enveloping trail reflects the casual charm of a timeless white dress shirt—not ostentatious, but stylish.

 

 

2 Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Toilette for Men

Mr. Burberry by Burberry is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Mr. Burberry was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Grapefruit, Cardamom, Tarragon and Mint; middle notes are Cedar, Birch Leaf, Nutmeg and Lavender; base notes are Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, Amberwood, Benzoin and Oakmoss.

 

 

3) Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum for Men

Explorers know it well: adventure has no limits. Once you have climbed a new summit, you start thinking of the next challenge. Like an irresistible call. The splendor of unexplored landscapes and the true nature of man. Introducing Explorer, the new fragrance from Montblanc. This unconventional woody aromatic leather Eau de Parfum reveals a fresh green Italian bergamot, contrasted with a powerful vetiver from Haiti and combined with rich and exclusive patchouli from Indonesia. The Explorer bottle pays tribute to European craftsmanship through the expertise and heritage of the Maison Montblanc. Resolutely masculine, its solid shape evokes timeless strength and the true spirit of exploration.

 

 

4) Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

The new edition of the reinvented Gucci Gucci Guilty perfume line is an intense version of the masculine fragrance Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum. The celebration of freedom that the brand pursues through the #ForeverGuilty story continues, and the Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum offers a reinterpretation of the original scent with accords of hot chili peppers and soothing fresh roses.

 

 

5) Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Eau de Toilette for Men

Valentino Uomo Born in Roma by Valentino is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Valentino Uomo Born in Roma was launched in 2019. Valentino Uomo Born in Roma was created by Antoine Maisondieu and Guillaume Flavigny. Top notes are mineral notes, salt and violet leaf; middle notes are sage and ginger; base notes are vetiver and woody notes.

title: Top 5 Designer Perfume Picks for Women - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette for Women

Inspired by a mixture of Donatella Versace's favorite floral fragrances, Bright Crystal is a fresh, sensual blend of refreshing chilled yuzu and pomegranate mingled with soothing blossoms of peony, magnolia, and lotus flower, warmed with notes of musk and amber.

 

 

2 Gucci Flora Lavender Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Toilette for Women

Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Limited Edition 2020 by Gucci is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Limited Edition 2020 was launched in 2020. Top notes are Pear and Red Berries; middle notes are Gardenia and Frangipani; base notes are Patchouli and Brown sugar.

 

 

3) Jimmy Choo Jimmy Choo L'eau Eau de Toilette for Women

Jimmy Choo L’Eau is signed by perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou who explains: “Jimmy Choo L'Eau captures the scent of a delicious thirst-quenching hibiscus flower blended with barks, fruits and vibrant woods, to create a radiant feminine sensuality.” The scent is floral with a hint of fruit and musk. It opens with notes of bergamot and hibiscus that lead to the heart of nectarine and peony, based on cedarwood and musk.

 

 

4) Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum for Women

Honey by Marc Jacobs is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Honey was launched in 2013. Honey was created by Annie Buzantian and Ann Gottlieb. Top notes are Punch, Pear and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Honeysuckle, Orange Blossom and Peach; base notes are Honey, Vanilla and Woodsy Notes.

 

 

5) Dior Miss Dior Rose N'Roses Eau de Toilette for Women

Dior Rose N'Roses is a new addition to the Miss Dior line, announced as a fresh and radiant Eau de Toilette.

title: Top 5 Classic Perfume Picks for Women - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Dior Diorissimo Eau de Toilette for Women

Diorissimo by Christian Dior is a Floral fragrance for women. Diorissimo was launched in 1956. The nose behind this fragrance is Edmond Roudnitska. Top notes are Green Leaves and Bergamot; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Lilac, Jasmine, Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Amaryllis, Rosemary and Boronia; base notes are Civet and Sandalwood.

 

 

2 Thierry Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum for Women

Alien is a radiant fragrance, and its deep purple-hued glass bottle is designed to mimic an amethyst, a precious gem that symbolizes femininity and refinement. This sacred talisman can be layered with any Alien Body product.

 

 

3) Dior Poison Eau de Toilette for Women

Some perfumes are born a myth. Heady, mysterious, and revolutionary since its creation, Poison is Dior’s ultimate weapon of seduction. Its exceptional, exotic alchemy is composed of a rich blend of spicy, fruity, and amber notes warmed by honey and musk—an unforgettable fragrance.

 

 

4) Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

Created for a contemporary libertine, Gucci Guilty for Her is defined by a signature Fougère accord of Geranium usually found in men’s scents. Intimate and magical lilac flower is laced with amber to radiate warmth and grace at the fragrance’s heart.

 

 

5) Chloe Chloé Eau de Parfum for Women

The scent takes the classic rose and ingeniously translates it into a vibrant perfume, intimate and sensual. Chloé Eau de Parfum begins with a combination of floral powdery notes: hints of peony, lychee, and springtime freesia. The airy, flirtatious head notes drift away to reveal the richer and more sensual side of the rose. The distinctive character of this unique rose is accompanied by magnolia and lily of the valley, as well as subtle intimations of warm amber and elegant cedarwood.

title: Top 5 Classic Cologne Picks for Men - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Dior Eau Sauvage Eau de Toilette for Men

This is a fresh perfume which can be easily recognized among other fresh fragrances. Clear and fresh scent of lemon and bitter-fresh rosemary are combined perfectly with masculine, woody nuances of a base.

 

 

2 Giorgio Armani Eau Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

Fashion house Armani presented its first masculine fragrance Eau Pour Homme in 1984. Sharp, strong, citrusy and aromatic, this one has become a classic among men's fragrances. Almost 30 years later, in February the 2013, Armani launches a new version of Eau Pour Homme and a brand new nocturnal edition Eau de Nuit.

 

 

3) Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme (2012) by Dolce&Gabbana is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme (2012) was launched in 2012. Top notes are Citruses, Bergamot, Neroli and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lavender, Sage and Pepper; base notes are Tobacco, Tonka Bean and Cedar.

 

 

4) Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne Unisex

Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne Natural Spray is a fresh, refined and timeless fragrance for the pragmatic and successful man who loves tradition. It is a composition born from sunny Sicilian fruits and a harmonious blend of floral essences such as lavender and damask rose that merge with woody notes of vetiver, sandalwood and patchouli.

 

 

5) Givenchy Gentleman (1974) Eau de Toilette for Men

Gentleman (1974) by Givenchy is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Gentleman (1974) was launched in 1974. The nose behind this fragrance is Paul Leger. Top notes are honey, cinnamon, bergamot, rose, lemon and tarragon; middle notes are patchouli, orris root, jasmine and cedar; base notes are leather, amber, patchouli, musk, oakmoss, vanilla, vetiver and civet.

title: "Blind Buy" Cologne Picks for Men - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

Yves Saint Laurent reigns as one of the most influential and inspired designers in the world. From his early days in the studio of Christian Dior to his acclaimed haute couture collections of today, YSL's touch remains unmistakable. The YSL style is reflected in the realm of fashion, including accessories, jewelry, ready-to-wear, fragrance, and cosmetics.

 

 

2 Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum for Men

Dolce & Gabbana launched The One for Men in 2008 as the fragrance intended to become a masculine classics. In 2015, The One for Men Eau de Parfum appears as an enhanced, denser version of the scent.

 

 

3) Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profumo Parfum for Men

Woody, aromatic, and aquatic, Acqua Di Giò Profumo is an intensely masculine fragrance. The elixir opens in a single wave of spices and citrus notes of elemi and bergamot. The heart erupts with geranium, sage, and rosemary, pulsing as it warms the skin to release a recognizable cloud of patchouli and incense.

 

 

4) PRADA L'Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

The house of Prada launches La Femme Prada and L'Homme Prada mid-2016. The new fragrant “pair of equals" represents man and woman that are “reunited in an identical vision. She could be him, he could be her. She is an absolute woman, he is an absolute man. There is not an obvious definition of relationship between them. They could be lovers, friends, or even strangers. Both have multiple identities.“

 

 

5) BYREDO Elevator Music Eau de Parfum Unisex

The Off-White fashion brand, fronted by Virgil Abloh, co-operates with Swedish Byredo, with Ben Gorham as the perfumer to create the new fragrance Elevator Music.

title: "Blind Buy" Unisex Fragrance Picks - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Navitus Parfums Carte Blanche Unisex

Carte Blanche is a unique all year fragrance opening with a unique freshness of Italian mandarin, Sicilian Bergamot, Guatemalan cardamom and an agrest accord combined with the warmth of grilled almonds, driftwood, benzoin, vanilla and other ingredients.

 

 

2 Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat rouge 540 Eau de Parfum Unisex

Baccarat Rouge 540 by Maison Francis Kurkdjian is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. Baccarat Rouge 540 was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Saffron and Jasmine; middle notes are Amberwood and Ambergris; base notes are Fir Resin and Cedar.

 

 

3) Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum Unisex

Capturing a rarefied air this fragrance evokes the private exchanges and insider moments where fantasies come true. The scent can only be described in one way: with a name that says it all. The vibrant opening makes an instant statement as clary sage and fresh lavender command attention with aromatic foreplay. Delectable bitter almond and vanilla inflections infuse textural richness to the leather heart. Drenched in orris root from the iris flower, the full luscious body of the supple Italian plunge reveals its exquisite beauty. Addictive tonka bean and lavish leather drive the scent as amber undertones reverberate with a warm glow. Ultra-fine blonde woods create a confident expression of pure luxury with a creamy finish.

 

 

4) BYREDO Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum Unisex

In the xeric wilderness of the Mojave desert, trees and vegetation more ancient than many civilizations defy conditions that prey on human vulnerability. The ghost flower is a rare species that dares to blossom above this baked, hard ground. Despite its arid surroundings and inability to produce nectar, the ghost flower, or mohavea confertiflora, maintains its perfect, majestic beauty and thrives year after year. In an astonishing feat of ingenuity, the flower uses mimicry to attract the pollinators of a neighboring plant species by developing markings that resemble those of a female bee genus attracted to its subject and duping the male bee into following suit. This moving human-like behavior and captivating tale of survival lies in the foundation that inspired Mojave Ghost, an homage to this most bewitching flower.

 

 

5) Jo Malone Yuja Cologne Unisex

Yuja Cologne by Jo Malone London is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Yuja Cologne was launched in 2020. Top note is Yuzu; middle note is Clary Sage; base notes are Balsam Fir and Cedar.

title: "Blind Buy" Perfume Picks for Women - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum for Women

Black Opium by Yves Saint Laurent is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women. Black Opium was launched in 2014. Black Opium was created by Nathalie Lorson, Marie Salamagne, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc. Top notes are Pear, Pink Pepper and Orange Blossom; middle notes are Coffee, Jasmine, Bitter Almond and Licorice; base notes are Vanilla, Patchouli, Cedar and Cashmere Wood.

 

 

2 Giorgio Armani Si Eau de Parfum for Women

Si by Giorgio Armani is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women. Si was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Christine Nagel.

 

 

3) Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum for Women

An explosion of flowers, Flowerbomb opens with subtle traces of bergamot and mandarin, leading to a heart of an exquisite floral explosion, comprised of sambac jasmine, freesia, centifolia rose, and osmanthus. Deep amber, woody, and patchouli notes combine with warm vanilla and praline notes to complete a truly addictive fragrance. Wear it for a night out on the town with the girls, a romantic dinner, a spontaneous adventure with no definite destination. Flowerbomb ensures you’ll leave a trail of allure wherever you go.

 

 

4) Bond No. 9 The Scent Of Peace Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

The Scent Of Peace Perfume by Bond No. 9, Bright, soft, and balanced, The Scent of Peace is a woody floral perfume that’s suitable for daytime or evening wear. It introduces itself with piquant notes of grapefruit and blueberry, followed by a green heart of clean and silky lily of the valley. Cedar and musk add a masculine nuance that rounds out the base of this distinctive blend.

 

 

5) Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue Eau de Parfum for Women

An alchemy of irresistible notes that dance, arouse, come together, and embrace, this fragrance is a refreshing blackcurrant sorbet with Granny Smith apple and a contemporary floral bouquet. Woody base notes playfully mix together to create a unique, captivating, sensuous, and vibrant movement.

title: Editors Pick Groom Colognes for Men - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Parfums de Marly Layton Exclusif Eau de Parfum for Men

In Layton Exclusif, a heavy dose of civet hums through the rich floral heart, delivering a new layer of sensuality. And the already opulent vanilla and woods base is further enhanced, with resinous amber and an alluringly powerful coffee note to invigorate the senses and heighten the passion. Does Layton Exclusif take the place of our beloved Layton? It's not meant to. Instead, we think of the two as the ultimate pair- Layton, a gentleman's perfect match for a day of royal festivities, and Layton Exclusif, a dangerously seductive secret weapon when day turns to evening.

 

 

2 Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

Royal Oud Cologne by Creed, Released in 2011, Royal Oud is a synthesis of Parisian and Persian style and grace . It incorporates elements of a Persian palace with marble, wood, leather and gold along with the historical components of its personal design house. The rarity of oud makes it a treasured scent note, and to own a fragrance that features it so strongly is a fortunate occurrence. The top notes are a citrusy mixture of lemon, Sicilian bergamot and pink pepper. The heart notes reach out with galbanum, cedar and angelica root. The base is a luxurious finish of oud, sandalwood and musk.

 

 

3) Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex

A bold masculine look transformed into a feminine staple by Yves Saint Laurent, the tuxedo is an expression of impertinent seduction. TUXEDO blends the matte texture of smoked patchouli with ambergris accord to express a magnetic and dark sex appeal. The sharp black pepper enhanced with the freshness of cardamom mirrors the satin stripe that runs along the seam of the trousers and the lapels of the jacket. With a refined sense of detail, the gleaming effect of the spices electrifies and highlights the sophistication of the garment.

 

 

4) PRADA L'Homme Intense Eau de Parfum for Men

Prada L'Homme Intense is a multi-layered Eau de Parfum. At the heart of the fragrance, amber, patchouli, iris and tonka beans create combinations of notes that accentuate the endless facets of the Prada man.

 

 

5) LE LABO Santal 33 Eau de Parfum Unisex

The man, firelight in his face, leaning on the worn leather saddle, alone with the desert wind—an icon so powerful that every man wanted to be him and every woman wanted to have him. From this memory is born Santal 33, the ambition to create an olfactive form inspired by the great American myth that is still a source of fantasy for the rest of the world. A perfume that touches the sensual universality of this icon, that would intoxicate a man as much as a woman. It introduces the brand's use of cardamom, iris, violet and ambrox, which crackle in the formula and bring to this smoking wood alloy—Australian sandalwood, papyrus, cedarwood—some spicy, leathery, musky notes and gives this parfum its unisex signature and addictive comfort. Here is, in a few words, what Santal 33 is. An open fire. The soft drift of smoke. Where sensuality rises after the light has gone.

title: Top Creed Perfume Picks for Women - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Creed Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum for Women

Nearly three years in the making, this olfactory celebration of strong women was highly anticipated before its triumphant unveiling by The House of Creed. Aventus for Her is inspired by some of history's most powerful women—empresses, queens and heads of state, who were Creed's clients—as well as modern women everywhere who confidently shatter glass ceilings. The Aventus for Her spirit lives in every woman. She is poised with inner strength and radiance, and leaves an indelible mark on all she touches. To be near her is to feel the presence of greatness.

 

 

2 Creed Love In White Eau de Parfum for Women

The scent is pure freedom—a floral-fresh blend grounded by Florentine iris, French daffodils, and subdued, powdery Tonkin rice. Love In White was honored on its launch day by a tribute—New York City’s Empire State Building illuminated by pure white lights.

 

 

3) Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum for Women

Royal Princess Oud by Creed is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Royal Princess Oud was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed . Top notes are bergamot, rose and violet; middle notes are jasmine, vanilla absolute, patchouli and tuscan iris; base notes are siam benzoin, sandalwood, styrax and agarwood (oud).

 

 

4) Creed Spring Flower Eau de Parfum for Women

CREED made Spring Flower as the signature scent of a film legend, fashion icon and renowned humanitarian. This pink and pretty scent was released to the public many years later. Spring Flower is a fresh and feminine fragrance that includes notes of peach, melon and apple in the top. The heart includes jasmine and rose. Musk and ambergris form the base.

 

 

5) Creed Floralie Eau de Parfum for Women

Creed Floralie is a unique new fragrance in partnership with Neiman Marcus department store. Floralie has notes of rose, tubeorse, and other florals and oriental basenotes such as amber and woods.

title: Top 5 Aventus Clones – Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
Every now and then a fragrance comes around that quite simply changes the game, becoming an instant classic.

What makes a scent stand apart from the rest? Well, that largely depends on each person and their individual taste; however, an exceptional aroma that is suitable for any season, fits any occasion and works in any place is often a good indicator!

Creating a scent that can achieve such high expectations is no easy feat; although, if anyone could do it, it would be The House of Creed. Producing the absolute reigning champion since 2010, Creed’s legendary “Aventus” is still the ultimate titleholder. Delightfully unique, easygoing, and impossible not to enjoy, Aventus has become a favorite amongst just about anyone who comes across it.

It is no wonder this gem has many admirers, after all this rich-fruity fragrance is curated with the finest ingredients by one of our oldest, most celebrated perfume houses. Fresh, masculine, and incredibly sexy, Aventus smells like success and it has the price tag to match.

 

1) Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Parfum for Men

Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Parfum by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Club de Nuit Intense Man was launched in 2019. Top notes are Lemon, Pineapple, Black Currant, Bergamot and Apple; middle notes are Birch, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambergris, Patchouli and Vanilla.

 

 

2) Afnan Supremacy Silver Eau de Parfum for Men

Supremacy Silver by Afnan Perfumes is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. Supremacy Silver was launched in 2013. Top notes are apple, bergamot, black currant and pineapple; middle notes are rose, birch, moroccan jasmine and patchouli; base notes are oakmoss, musk, ambergris and vanilla.

 

 

3) Al Haramain L'Aventure Eau de Parfum for Men

L'Aventure by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for men. L'Aventure was launched in 2016. Top notes are elemi, lemon and bergamot; middle notes are jasmine, lily-of-the-valley and woody notes; base notes are patchouli, amber and musk.

 

 

4) Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum for Men

Explorers know it well: adventure has no limits. Once you have climbed a new summit, you start thinking of the next challenge. Like an irresistible call. The splendor of unexplored landscapes and the true nature of man. Introducing Explorer, the new fragrance from Montblanc. This unconventional woody aromatic leather Eau de Parfum reveals a fresh green Italian bergamot, contrasted with a powerful vetiver from Haiti and combined with rich and exclusive patchouli from Indonesia. The Explorer bottle pays tribute to European craftsmanship through the expertise and heritage of the Maison Montblanc. Resolutely masculine, its solid shape evokes timeless strength and the true spirit of exploration.

 

 

5) Nishane Hacivat Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Don’t be afraid of that pineapple note. Rich and natural-smelling rather than sporty or cheap, the pineapple note is so well done here that it redeems the reputation of the much-maligned fruit. Hacivat wears on the skin as lightly as a white linen shirt in summer. It is discreet, professional, and sparklingly clean, but possessed of just enough bitter moss and woods for gravitas. A rare, classically-built woody chypre with a contemporary edge, Hacivat just smells really wonderful and will make other people think you smell great too. Bookmark this scent if you love a modern classic.

title: Top Creed Cologne Picks for Men - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum for Men

The exceptional Aventus was inspired by the dramatic life of a historic emperor, celebrating strength, power and success. Introduced in 2010 and crafted by the deft hand of Sixth Generation Master Perfumer Olivier Creed in collaboration with his son Erwin, this scent has grown to become the best-selling fragrance in the history of the brand. Olivier created its iconic name derived from A ("from") ventus ("the wind"), illustrating the Aventus man as destined to live a driven life, ever galloping with the wind at his back toward success. Aventus is a sophisticated blend for individuals who savor a life well-lived.

 

 

2 Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum for Men

Green Irish Tweed Cologne by Creed, This sporty mix is sure to make any man feel like a famous movie star . With hints of violet leaves, Mysore sandalwood, Florentine iris, ambergris, and French verbena, Green Irish Tweed is known for its longevity and reasonable sillage. Though certainly not overpowering, its refreshing and luxurious aroma lingers on the mind long after its wearer has departed the room. Furthermore, it's widely considered to be one of the defining scents of the brand’s catalogue. Green Irish Tweed was first released in 1985 and originally made for Hollywood icon Cary Grant. Creed has a long and storied history in the fragrance world with over 250 years in business. Founded by James Henry Creed after designing a fragrance for King George III, the company’s products present a modernized scent of past triumphs. Many iconic figures throughout history have enjoyed the company's products, including Queen Maria Cristina of Spain, Emperor Franz-Josef of Austria-Hungary, and Empress Eugenie of France.

 

 

3) Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum for Men

Millesime Imperial Cologne by Creed, Warmth and romance exude throughout the composition for Millesime Imperial cologne . It is a unisex fragrance, making it appropriate for men and women alike. It opens with a luxurious citrusy, marine aroma and includes top notes of sea salt and fruits. The heart consists of mandarin orange, bergamot, lemon and iris. It rounds out nicely in the base comprised of marine notes, woody scents and musk. This fragrance came out in 1995, and it is meant to evoke imagery of spending time by the Sicilian oceanside.

 

 

4) Creed Viking Eau de Parfum for Men

Viking Cologne by Creed, Viking by Creed is a powerful blend of aromatic and green accords . Introduced in 2016, it is an ultra-masculine fragrance, full of strong and robust scents. The cologne opens with pink pepper, black currant and bergamot, starting the fragrance with spiciness and tartness. Next, the heart opens up, with rose, mint and more pepper. The fragrance finishes with lavender, patchouli, vetiver and sandalwood. The floral scents are tempered by the fresh green scents and warm woody notes, creating a balanced ,manly cologne.

 

 

5) Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum for Men

Creed Silver Mountain Water is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 1995, The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed,

title: Best Gym / Workout Perfume Picks for Her - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
Keeping an active, healthy lifestyle is always a great idea! Whether you play a group sport, run, do yoga, dance, or work out at the gym- chances are you’re going to sweat it out! Sometimes being in the gym with others while you’re sweaty and overheated can be a bit daunting. Smelling good while you split the space and feel the burn can help alleviate that insecurity (if there is any that is).

Having a fragrance for the gym, a yoga session or any form of exercise isn’t necessarily essential, but it is a nice alternative for when in need of a cool, soft, refreshing and inoffensive fragrance (which could also act as an additional summer scent as well).

 

 

1) Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette for Women

A stunning perfume, overwhelming and irresistible like the joy of living. The scent is surprisingly colored with the liveliness of Sicilian citron, the happiness of Granny Smith apple, and the spontaneity of bluebells. Feminine and resolute notes are expressed with the intensity of jasmine, the freshness of bamboo, and the charm of white rose. The deep and true base embodies the character of cedarwood, the fullness of amber, and the embrace of musk.

 

 

2) Juliette Has a Gun Not A Perfume Eau de Parfum for Women

This minimalist, fresh, and clean fragrance is hypoallergenic and ideal for those who don’t normally wear perfume. It is composed of a single note, called cetalox, which is usually used in perfumery as a base note. Here it plays the lead role for a fragrance that will easily satisfy the most difficult tastes, and particularly those preferring discretion over complexity.

 

 

3) Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Toilette for Women

Eros Pour Femme Eau de Toilette offers a new sensual and addictive freshness based on the association of precious citrus notes—Sicilian lemon and mandarin—with crisp, fruity notes of raspberry and blackberry. A touch of calone creates the icy effect of a temping sorbet. Velvety floral petals of magnolia and jasmine confer femininity, while a touch of orange blossom adds intensity and character. The dry down offers notes of white woods, musk, and ambrox to convey elegance and add a sensual dimension.

 

 

4) By Kilian Flower of Immortality Eau de Parfum Unisex

With Flower of Immortality, Kilian pays homage to the Chinese tale “A Tale of the Fountain of the Peach Blossom Spring”. It is recounted that a fisherman from Wu Ling loses his way along a stream and, unexpectedly, finds himself rowing alongside a lush peach tree forest. He decides to explore further and, at the end of the forest, lands at the fountainhead of the stream. There, he disembarks and just steps beyond, discovers a haven of peace, a utopian paradise where people live apart from the exterior world.

 

 

5) Gucci Bloom Acqua di Fiori Eau de Toilette for Women

Acqua Di Fiori introduces a new chapter to the world of Gucci Bloom. The addition of green galbanum and dainty cassis buds bring the soft dewy freshness of the early petal and a light, aquatic composition to the signature scent, designed to celebrate the authenticity, vitality and joyful energy of women. Blended by master perfumer Alberto Morillas under the direction of the house’s Creative Director, Gucci Bloom is created to unfold like its name, capturing the rich scent of a thriving garden filled with an abundance of flowers. Tuberose and jasmine combine with Rangoon creeper—a unique flower discovered in South India to create a rich fragrance that transports the wearer to an imaginary garden.

4) Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

5) Carolina Herrera CH Men Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

Ch Sport Cologne by Carolina Herrera, Show your appreciation for the great outdoors with CH Sport, an invigorating men’s cologne . This captivating fragrance combines citrus, herbal and marine accords for a refreshing and exuberant scent that’s still entirely masculine and seductive. Top notes of sparkling bergamot, grapefruit and potent sage introduce the fragrance for a revitalizing and zesty atmosphere that’s sure to fire you up for the next great adventure. Finally, base notes of vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood dry down the intensity with a soothing touch for an all-around spirited and charming cologne that’s perfect for any sports enthusiast with a young heart of gold

title: Editors Pick Bridal Perfumes for Women - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
Finding that perfect scent for your big day can be a challenge. There are so many factors to consider, like; Do you wear your signature scent? Do you try something completely different? Do you style it accordingly to your bride vibe or your personal flair? Should the scent be appropriate for the time of year, season, or the type of wedding you have? It’s a lot to think about, we know! Don’t’ panic, were here to help!

First and foremost, your wedding fragrance should be something you absolutely love, after all you will relate it to the biggest & best day of your life, for life, no big deal.

The fragrance should also be weather appropriate for it to best compliment your skin and maximize your bridal energy. Think light, fresh florals and zesty fruits for spring and summer while sticking to smooth, warm sensual scents for the fall and winter.

Your bride fragrance style should always represent your unique self, while making you feel special and totally irresistible of course!

To help you narrow down your bridal style aroma we’ve put together a special list of wedding worthy scents to help inspire your wedding perfume!

Don’t forget to sample before you buy the bigger bottle, that way you can really feel the fragrance out to see if it’s the right choice for your wedding day.


 

 

1) Creed Fleurs de Gardenia Eau de Parfum for Women

Fleurs de Gardenia by Creed is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Fleurs de Gardenia was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top notes are Galbanum, Pink Pepper and Black Currant; middle notes are Gardenia, Peony, Lily-of-the-Valley, Pink Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Virginia Cedar and Patchouli.

 

 

2 Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum for Women

A floral explosion of Turkish rose, lily of the valley and peony creates a girlish, feminine fragrance accented with bright and tangy notes of lychee, rhubarb and bergamot. Vanilla, musk and cashmeran will wrap you in a feeling of warmth and sensuality.

 

 

3) MEMO Paris Granada Eau de Parfum for Women

A feminine white floral with hidden complexities, Granada is an ultra romantic, surprisingly sensual late night dance through the gardens of the Alhambra. Inspired by late evenings beneath the walls of the famed red castle, the nighttime air redolent with Andalusian jasmine, Granada seduces us with a lightly resinous mix of clean and dirty florals that balance purity and carnality with expert precision.

 

 

4) BYREDO Blanche Eau de Parfum Unisex

With this fragrance, Gorham wanted to capture the innocence and untainted side of a specific person he had in mind with a scent that is almost transparent. According to Gorham, this pure, simple eau de parfum is structurally simple, yet its character is extreme.

 

 

5) Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 Lira Eau de Parfum for Women

Lira by Xerjoff is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Lira was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Chris Maurice. Top notes are Blood Orange, Bergamot and Lavender; middle notes are Cinnamon, Licorice and Jasmine; base notes are Caramel, Vanille and Musk.

title: Best Gym / Workout Fragrance Picks for Everyone (Unisex) - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
When it comes to selecting a scent for the gym, we always want to remain conscious of those around us while still smelling our best. The gym is all about power, and yet nobody wants to be overpowered by the odors that surround them. Of course, sweating at the gym is a natural occurrence but we certainly don’t have to smell like it!

Although there are so many wonderful colognes and perfumes, not all of them are made for the constructs of the gym life. Wearing a scent that is too strong, too dominating or that doesn’t quite work with the vibe of the gym changes the whole dynamic. Those who are sharing the workout space with you will appreciate a fresh smell that can help mask the sweaty odors caused by intense training. However, wearing an aroma that does not fit well with this type of intense activity, or that does not perform well mixed with heat and sweat can cause an unpleasant, less appealing air around you.

 

 

1) Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette Unisex

Molecule 01 by Escentric Molecules is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Molecule 01 was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen. The fragrance features iso e super.

 

 

2 By Kilian Moonlight in Heaven Eau de Parfum Unisex

The fresh perfume of tasty mango and the fresh scent of powdered sambac jasmine are mixed with coconut milk and rice all wrapped in tonka bean and the delicacy of vetiver. Both unique and familiar, this fresh perfume with an exotic fragrance pushes you to open the doors of paradise.

 

 

3) Bond No. 9 BondNo9.com Eau de Parfum Unisex

BondNo9.com by Bond No 9 is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. BondNo9.com was launched in 2013. Top notes are bergamot, pineapple and juniper berries; middle notes are apple, black currant and cedar; base notes are patchouli, moss, amber and musk

 

 

4) BYREDO Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum Unisex

A mix of Parisian avantgardism and African culture shaped a unique and vibrant expression. The intense life, the excess and euphoria is illustrated by Bal d'Afrique's neroli, African marigold and Moroccan cedarwood.

 

 

5) Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum Unisex

Creed Original Vetiver is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2004, The nose behind this fragrance is Erwin Creed, Olivier Creed,

title: Editors Top 5 Fragrances Picks for Everyone (Unisex) - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Tom Ford Noir de Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex

Encompassing and celebrating the yin and the yang, this rich oriental scent reveals TOM FORD’s feminine side. Rich feminine florals and the masculine earthiness of black truffle, vanilla, patchouli, oud wood, and tree moss add a warm sensuality to this dark chypre oriental.

 

 

2 Bond No. 9 Lafayette Street Eau de Parfum Unisex

Lafayette Street by Bond No 9 is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Lafayette Street was launched in 2018. Top notes are bergamot, coriander and flowers; middle notes are ambroxan, apple and vanilla; base notes are woodsy notes, tonka bean and ambergris.

 

 

3) Mancera Instant Crush Eau de Parfum Unisex

Instant Crush by Mancera is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Instant Crush was launched in 2019. Top notes are saffron, ginger, sicilian bergamot and sicilian mandarin; middle notes are moroccan rose, egyptian jasmine, amberwood and indonesian patchouli leaf; base notes are sandalwood, oakmoss, white musk and madagascar vanilla.

 

 

4) Nishane Ani Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Ani by Nishane is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Ani was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Cecile Zarokian. Top notes are bergamot, green notes, ginger and pink pepper; middle notes are black currant, turkish rose and cardamom; base notes are patchouli, cedar, vanilla, benzoin, ambergris, musk and sandalwood.

 

 

5) Initio Parfums Oud for Greatness Eau de Parfum Unisex

Oud for Greatness by Initio Parfums Privés is the new fragrance from the Black Gold collection. Based on the purest natural Oud oil in high concentrations, "Oud for Greatness" is a very prestigious Oud with a strong character. Drawing its perfection and energy from the sources of sacred geometry, Oud for Greatness emanates the power of nature, the reawakening of greatness. Rarely the natural essence of oud wood has been so sublimated as in this formula, enhanced by the presence of patchouli and musk, almost wanting to repel any distraction from the senses. Superbly interwoven, surprisingly natural, the oud wood has been managed by the creator in a fresh register (lavender) and spicy (nutmeg, saffron). Oud for Greatness, is a fragrance that enchants and excites, making any dream possible.

title: Editors Top 5 Perfume Picks for Women - Fragrance Collection Box
description_html:
1) Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum for Women

Black and White? Good Girl, Bad Girl. Good Girl is a sensual, evocative fragrance born of the beautiful contradictions and the ever-present duality of modern women and modern life. Both freshly light and moodily dark, this innovative fragrance captures a woman's wondrous complexity with surprising and exceptional ingredients. The sweet, alluring qualities of jasmine give Good Girl its brightness and femininity. The darker side of Good Girl is created with richly fragrant cocoa and intoxicating tonka. Almond and coffee bring Good Girl its immediate vibrancy. Tuberose, extracted in a new way that creates a rich delicacy, is the fragrance's wild card, bringing fluidity and femininity.

 

 

2 Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

Sixteen years after the launch of Light Blue, master perfumer Olivier Cresp writes a new chapter of the Light Blue saga with Light Blue Eau Intense pour Femme. The fragrance opens with a sharp, addictive duo of scents: luminous lemon and crisp Granny Smith apple. With its fruity and floral facets, elegant marigold blends this accord into the heart notes—a wave of glowing, heady jasmine petals. The signature trail of lustrous amber woods and precious musk melts into sunkissed skin and unfurls into a vibrant, sensuously scented wake.

 

 

3) Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum for Women

A floral explosion of Turkish rose, lily of the valley and peony creates a girlish, feminine fragrance accented with bright and tangy notes of lychee, rhubarb and bergamot. Vanilla, musk and cashmeran will wrap you in a feeling of warmth and sensuality.

 

 

4) Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum for Women

The new fragrance of freedom by Yves Saint Laurent combines lavender essence from France with the sensuality of Moroccan orange blossom, for a unique floral fusion complemented by a daring note of musk accord.

 

 

5) Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau de Parfum for Women

Brilliant. Lavish. Refined. Velvet Orchid is a fragrance that lives in the black orchid world of glamorous mystique, sharing its aura yet standing apart with its own compelling identity. It pushes the D.N.A. of the original Black Orchid into new territory, evolving hidden facets of the original's olfactive structure with extravagant ingredients to reveal even more brilliance, femininity, and attractive force.

title: Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
Supremacy Incense - is a burning heat, embracing passion and alluring sensuality.

The softness of the trees embraces and attracts, but at the same time deepens the aroma especially with the touches of oud oil, whose chords are smooth in this composition. The echoes of flowers, headed by roses and Moroccan jasmine, float to the trees.

Smoke from smoldering rare trees, skin with undertones of apricots and a sensual musk charge, accompanied by a few nuances of vanilla pods, enters the scene.

The final parade shows earthy shades of oak moss, herbal spice patchouli with bitterly leathery labdan, whose interconnected smell will make a special touch of mystery.

Middle Notes: Amber, Labdanum, Opoponax

description_html:

Beach Hut Man, the newest from the Midnight Flower collection, is no mere salty aquatic- instead, as told by Creative Director Christopher Chong, it's "the story of an iridescent aromatic idyll that unfolds in the fragrant wild garden of a beach hut." What does that mean in plain language? It means that Beach Hut Man is equal parts oceanic and intensely green, for an utterly unique and exciting new masculine that invigorates and relaxes in equal measure.

As the subtly sophisticated floral heart notes kick in, a rich chord of saffron gives savory depth. A stout, gently earthy base featuring leather and guaiac exudes effortless masculinity. All in all, Beloved Man feels exactly as it was intended: like the comfort and contentment that comes from a relationship that is strong, supportive and permanent. We're thrilled to finally have the opportunity to share this exclusive gem with you.

Amouage Gold Woman Eau de Parfum for Women - Box Item
description_html:
Every woman needs a Grand Perfume in her arsenal, a fragrance that will make her feel like Jean Harlow in a satin gown descending a marble staircase. Gold Woman is just that fragrance. Legendary perfumer Guy Robert created Gold using the highest quality ingredients that money could buy. He artfully melded more than 120 essences into an opulent perfume he calls the "crowning glory" of his career. Gold opens with a champagne-like burst of greens and lily of the valley, giving way to a floral symphony rich with rose and jasmine but so lushly orchestrated that it's difficult to isolate any one note. As Gold settles, it begins to purr with the warmth of sandalwood and frankincense. Gold lasts for hours and hours, and a little goes a long way. Gold Woman is a marriage of French tradition and Omani luxury that no 1930s movie, no matter how glamorous, could top. So, go ahead. Dab a few drops of Gold behind your ears and make an entrance they'll never forget.

Gold Woman is housed in majestic gold glass bottle and the cap is crystallized by a single white opal Swarovski jewel.

 

Gold Woman  Notes

Frankincense, Rock Rose, Lily of the Valley, Orris, Jasmine, Myrrh, Musk, Cedarwood, and Sandalwood.

title: Amouage Gold Man Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
With Gold Man, Amouage shows it understands that sometimes the softer touch is the sexier. Instead of bombarding us with the typical hallmarks of a macho fragrance, Gold Man gently seduces with its blend of deep, dark jasmine, iris, and rose, grounded by civet, ambergris, musk, and Omani's celebrated silver frankincense. A hint of patchouli and oakmoss brings to mind the classic chypres of the 1930s. The overall feel of Gold Man is of luxury and mystery, like seeing an Aston Martin speeding through a warm night on a road above the ocean. The man who wears Gold is confident and sophisticated and doesn't need to flaunt his masculinity. We wouldn't rule out Gold for a certain type of femme fatale, either. A deeply luxurious and elegant Chypre.

Gold Man Notes

Frankincense, Rock Rose, Lily of the Valley, Orris, Myrrh, Musk, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Ambergris and Civet.

title: Amouage Imitation Man Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
One moment, one sensory experience, can completely alter a child's perception of the world. For Amouage Creative Director Christopher Chong, that moment happened the first time he experienced New York City as a child in the 1970's- the vibrant street culture, the breathtaking diversity, and the very sights, sounds and smells of the greatest city in the world during a tumultuous and consequential era threw open a door to life's infinite possibilities. Imitation is his attempt to capture that vibrancy.

Imitation Man represents '70s NYC in bold, sensual, refined leather tones, opening with electric citrus and tingling spices that evoke blinding sunshine on bustling asphalt streets. The leather at the center of the fragrance is rich, soft suede, refined with lush rose, buttery orris and bright violet. An atmospheric base of spicy, smoky, animalic notes gives the thrilling authenticity of a smoke filled discotheque. Imitation Man will take you away to a time and place of chaos and beauty- and the endless adventures that follow.

Imitation Man  Notes

Citron, nutmeg, black pepper, rose, orris, violet, myrrh, leather, vetiver, patchouli, castoreum

title: Amouage Honour Man Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
Honour Man, the regal, dramatic masculine fragrance with a spicy, woody character, is heir to Amouage's ongoing (soap) operatic narrative that began with Jubilation, and continued on with Lyric, Epic, and Memoir.

With an intensely peppery, dark opening, Honour Man creates olfactory storm clouds of disquiet, confusion, and drama befitting its back story, which was written by the perfume house's creative director Christopher Chong and inspired by Puccini's tragic opera Madame Butterfly.

In Chong's melodramatic creative brief, Honour is the son of Madame Butterfly, Puccini's tragic heroine who commits suicide when the American soldier who abandoned her years before returns to take their son. Honour has come back, so the narrative goes, to confront his mother's tragedy and to come to terms with his identity.

After the blast of pepper, Honour Man allows a fresh, rosy-floral note from geranium to peek through the dark clouds, followed by a succession of warm, woody, and spicy notes, including an intense patchouli that reminds us that Honour is still a fiery young man. Chong suggests that these comforting, beautifully blended base notes represent the reconciliation of our hero's troubled quest with his “filial elegy to honour his mother.” Its dry down does indeed feel like the denouement to a stormy, existential drama.

Honour Man is housed in a white crystal bottle with a gold-plated cap affixed with a white opal Svarovski crystal.

Honour Man  Notes

Pink pepper, black pepper, geranium, elemi, nutmeg, patchouli, frankincense, cedarwood, vetiver, tonka bean, musk

title: Amouage Interlude Man Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
The Scoop

Interlude Man is a spicy – woody fragrance that opens with zesty bergamot, oregano and pimento berry oil, perpetuating intervals of conflict which are countered by aromatic notes of amber, frankincense, opoponax, cistus and myrrh. Eternal notes of leather, agarwood smoke, patchouli and sandalwood in the base add lasting layers of depth and texture.

“I interpret what I see and feel into scents. All the social and natural chaos and disorder surrounding us today can be translated to a much more intimate level. The interlude moment is a reflection of all the trials and tribulations one overcomes to attain personal satisfaction and achievement.” He also explained the use of ingredients: “Amouage has established an enviable reputation for re-inventing accustomed scents. Frankincense and Myrrh traditionally smell spiritual and religious but in Interlude, they have been reconstructed to feel contemporary yet sophisticated.” –Christopher Chong

Interlude Man  Notes

Bergamot, Oregano, Pimento Berry Oil, Amber, Frankincense, Cistus, Opoponax, Leather, Agarwood Smoke, Patchouli, Sandalwood.

title: Amouage Journey Man Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
The Scoop

Like a Chinese dragon, Journey Man opens with a fiery roar filled with Sichuan peppers and bold spices in a golden, boozy flame. The peppers tingle and gently bite, while a richly fruited sweetness intoxicates you with a cognac note. It's a visual of gold and red, but darkness lurks all around, thanks to swirls of incense, an oud-like cypriol woodiness, and a streak of leathery resins in the base. Tobacco, a sprinkling of cardamom, and the juiciness of neroli orange are the final touches to a complex fragrance that grabs your attention from the start.

Journey is slowly transformed by a beautiful creaminess which tames the dragon's fiery bite. A smooth layer of tonka vanilla coats the peppers, dry woodiness, incense, and spices. The cognac booziness turns into ambered warmth, and the perfume lingers more softly on the skin. Over time, Journey turns into a creamy, tonka sweetness with woods, spices, and just a hint of fruit mingle together. It's a bold fragrance whose initial intensity gives way to softness in a rich mix that feels very much like an Amouage.

Journey Man  Notes

Sichuan pepper, Bergamot, Cardamom, Neroli Bigarade, Juniper Berries, Incense, Geraniol, Tobacco Leaves, Ambrox, Cyriol, Tonka Bean Abstract

Bergamot, Grapefruit, Ginger, Tagete, Frankincense, Rose Absolute, Orange Blossom, Nut, Kiwi, Coffee, Honey, Opoponax, Vanilla, Benzoin, Amber, Sandalwood, Agarwood, Oakmoss, Leather, Tonka Beans, Musk

title: Amouage Lyric Man Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
Lyric Man is the rarest of species- a masculine rose. Deep, daring and dangerous, this is a spicy, oriental rendition of the flower. Infused with angelica, pine and galbanum, the perfume has a striking green, earthy quality that makes it appear very classic, European and urbane. By contrast, the spices, nutmeg and saffron, and frankincense place the scent much further East, infusing it with the brooding sultriness that we find irresistible. The velvety accord of vanilla, sandalwood and musk, in the base of the scent, gives the fragrance unexpected softness. Audacious and harmonious, this is a rose like no other. Although undeniably masculine, the scent will be enjoyed by women who like dry, spicy, resinous florals.

Lyric for Men  Notes

Bergamot, lime, rose, angelica, orange blossom, green galbanum, spicy ginger, nutmeg, saffron, pine, sandalwood, vanilla, musk, frankincense

title: Amouage Memoir Man Eau de Parfum for Men - Box Item
description_html:
The Scoop

The releases from the house of Amouage over the past three years have had a uniting thread: uncomporomised richness and beauty. Their new series Memoir presents a new chapter in this narrative as conceived by Creative Director, Christopher Chong. Turning the industry norm of a dominant woman's fragrance on its head, Chong instead conceived the two Memoir fragrances from an inherently male point of view. Together, the Memoir fragrances offer a new interpretation of the ‘space' between man and woman, one that is almost impossible to resist.

Memoir Man is a Fougère, one that fractures the standard mix of Lavender and Oakmoss into bright shards by the addition of Basil and Mint and the further aspect of Absinth. Like a tray of unset gems the topnotes sparkle on the skin, leading into heart notes of Woods and a rich, smooth base of Vanilla, Amber and the traditional Oakmoss. Inspired by Baudelaire's flâneur who walked the city in order to experience it, the scent brings to mind the richness that is Paris. As the "Gentleman stroller" he is a living duality: both observer and observed, spectator and participant. Won't you take his hand?

Memoir Man  Notes

Basil, mint, frankincense, lavender, rose, oakmoss, leather, tobacco, absinth, wormwood, sandalwood, guaiac wood, vanilla, amber

title: Amouage Lyric Woman Eau de Parfum for Women - Box Item
description_html:
With Lyric Woman, Amouage is redefining the use of rose in perfume by rendering the traditional note in a completely unique manner. Spicy and resinous, Lyric Woman is an oriental rose, rich, complex and intricate. The piquant character of the composition is apparent immediately: the top notes blend bracing bergamot with tangy ginger and contrast this cool accord with warm, velvety spiciness of cardamom and cinnamon. The regal, crimson rose, surrounded by a creamy, opulent posse of ylang ylang, jasmine and orris, retains that spicy character in the heart of the fragrance, due to the presence of fiery geranium. The base of the scent, which includes the luxurious signature note of Amouage, frankincense, finishes the beautiful melody on a deep, sensual note. The drydown of woods, resins, vanilla and patchouli, paired with rose, is decadently rich, the epitome of Oriental luxury.

 

Lyric for Women  Notes

Bergamot, spicy cardamom, cinnamon, ginger, rose, angelica, jasmine, ylang-ylang, geranium, orris, oakmoss, musk, wood, patchouli, vetiver, sandalwood, vanilla, tonka bean, frankincense

description_html:
The Scoop

The quintessence of masculine elegance, Reflection Man captures the seductive power of a man's inner strength. Edgy and classic, the composition juxtaposes coldness of citrus with the warmth of spices. Top notes of rosemary, red pepper and bitter orange leaves are chilly and bracing, a jolting breath of icy air in the midst of summer. The piquancy, which is apparent from the start, is rich and fiery, but never sharp, smoothed and softened by the presence of velvety orris and creamy ylang-ylang. Floral notes contribute to the sun-drenched, summery feel of the blend without compromising its undeniably masculine feel. The base of vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood, combined with the spices and orris, is dark, enveloping, and sensual. Virile and unexpectedly soft at the same time...a luxurious modern classic.

Reflection Man  Notes

Rosemary, red pepper berries, bitter orange leaves, neroli, orris, jasmine, ylang ylang, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, cedarwood.
